title: Hybrid Latent-Structural Fusion (HLSF) for Cyber Anomaly Detection
summary: Malicious anomalous activity detection is a fundamental challenge for cyber security systems. Both tensor decomposition under statistical framework with CANDECOMP-PARAFAC alternating Poisson regression (CP-APR) and normalizing flows have proven to be powerful unsupervised machine learning methods that model multi-dimensional data and capture complex and multi-faceted details of behavior profiles in cyber security applications. In this study, we propose Hybrid Latent-Structural Fusion (HLSF), a weighted anomaly fusion framework integrating CP-APR structural anomaly scores with latent-space density scores derived from normalizing flows. In our experiments, we show that the HLSF framework improves anomaly detection performance on a dataset of real-world compromised user credentials collected from the large enterprise network of Los Alamos National Laboratory (LANL) during a red-teaming exercise, compared with using CP-APR or normalizing flows alone.

title: Search-on-Graph-R1: Training Large Language Models to Search Knowledge Graphs with Reinforcement Learning
summary: Knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) requires navigating from topic entities to an answer several relations away. Recent methods prompt a frontier LLM to explore the graph through a retrieval tool, but their reliance on frontier-scale inference makes them costly to deploy. We present Search-on-Graph-R1 (\sogrone{}), which internalizes this navigation into a compact 8B model through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by reinforcement learning (RL). Our central idea is to scaffold a frontier teacher with each question's gold SPARQL query, so the teacher traverses a known answer-bearing path with a live \texttt{Search} tool rather than having to discover the path itself. Since every call executes against a live Freebase server, the resulting trajectories are grounded in the knowledge graph by construction. On WebQSP, CWQ, and GrailQA, \sogrone{} at 8B surpasses every frozen frontier-LLM system in our comparison and posts the strongest results on CWQ of any system we compare against. It does so using no auxiliary module at inference and no LLM judge during training. Isolating each training stage shows that SFT and RL contribute complementary gains, our approach transfers across model families, and RL learns to reach answers in fewer \texttt{Search} calls than its SFT initialization.

title: Governing Well in the Algorithmic Age: The Foundations of Digital Statecraft
authors: David Uriel Socol de la Osa
summary: The digital substrate of states -- data, algorithms, infrastructure, platforms, applications -- is being governed without adequate conceptual foundations. The ability and legitimacy required to govern this substrate, and to govern with it, are simultaneously misaligned, contested, and structurally absent. We introduce digital statecraft as the organising concept for this emerging field, arguing that 'digital' reconstitutes the statecraft question rather than merely extending its domain. The concept operates on two dimensions - statecraft over digital systems, concerning the authority and capacity of the state in relation to the digital substrate itself, and statecraft with digital systems, concerning the deployment of algorithmic tools as instruments of governing authority. And it rests on two foundational requirements, technical coherence and legitimate authority, that are genuinely in tension. We derive ten principles of digital statecraft from these foundations, each naming a condition whose absence produces an identifiable and structural governance failure: public interest first, human-machine complementarity, governability by design, systemic coherence, hybrid institutions, adaptive governance, human centricity and civic agency, accountable and traceable authority, judgment across time, and the non-delegable core. This article takes the state as the starting point, the institutional form that developed historically in response to the problem of effective and legitimate public governance, and the only current candidate for which the full set of legitimacy conditions is institutionally available. But the digital statecraft programme holds open a deeper question than just whether states can reform themselves: governing well in the algorithmic age may require rethinking the boundaries, scale, and affiliative basis of statehood itself.

title: Trusted Credentials, Untrusted Behavior: Benchmarking LLM-Agent Security in High-Performance Computing
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are starting to take on routine work in high-performance computing (HPC), including monitoring Slurm jobs, diagnosing failed builds, inspecting simulation output, and coordinating scientific workflows. To do this work, an agent commonly acts under its user's credentials and inherits the user's access to files and the scheduler. This arrangement creates a failure mode that ordinary account-level controls do not capture. Adversarial instructions in a log, tool description, shared file, or peer-agent message may redirect the agent beyond the task the user assigned, even though every resulting command is authenticated and permitted for that account. We refer to this as the hijacked authorized agent problem. Existing agent-security studies explain relevant mechanisms, such as indirect prompt injection and tool misuse, but generally evaluate them in web, enterprise, or personal-assistant settings. HPC security, by contrast, has mature controls for identity and isolation but does not ordinarily represent the intent of a particular task. This paper defines the threat model in the HPC setting, identifies attack surfaces created by schedulers, shared storage, multi-project accounts, and scientific workflows, and examines where current controls fall short. It concludes with a research agenda and a plan for an empirical benchmark, TaskBound.

title: The Open Ant: A Robot Platform for Reinforcement Learning Research
comments: Published in the Reinforcement Learning Conference
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) research has demonstrated success in both physical and simulated domains; however, the predominant methodology remains rooted in simulations. The predominance of simulations makes translating research to physical reality uncertain for both algorithms and researchers. We propose a physical platform that is designed to simplify the transition. In this paper, we present the Open Ant: a physical variant of the commonly used Gymnasium Ant environment, along with a simulation. We demonstrate that competent walking policies can be learned from scratch in approximately one hour directly from the physical robot's experience for two substantially different RL algorithms: SARSA($λ$) and Soft Actor-Critic (SAC). Separately, we show policies that were learned in simulation transfer to reality. We also examine how well the platform supports a nimble experimental ecosystem. Specifically, we observe the speed with which new users from diverse backgrounds achieve their first success with the platform, and how easily the platform can be repaired and updated when hardware issues arise. Both the hardware design and software are available as open-source on GitHub for ease of customization. In summary, we advocate for the use of the Open Ant for RL researchers who frequently use simulated environments, so they can more easily include robot experiments in their evaluations.
comment: Published in the Reinforcement Learning Conference

title: Attractor Geometry Determines the Identifiability Limits of System Discovery
summary: Symbolic discovery of governing equations from data is limited not only by algorithm design and data volume, but by the geometry of the attractor: what the long-run dynamics allow to be recovered. Using a within-system design on Lorenz-84, where one forcing parameter drives fixed-point, limit-cycle, and chaotic regimes while the governing equations and library stay fixed, we show that a single number, $λ_{\min}(M)$, the smallest eigenvalue of the invariant-measure moment matrix, sets the identifiability ceiling for both sparse regression (SINDy) and evolutionary symbolic regression (PySR). Derived from the Birkhoff ergodic theorem and obtained from a short reference trajectory before any run, $λ_{\min}(M)$ measures how fully the attractor covers function space: where it vanishes, recovery is impossible for any algorithm, sparse or combinatorial alike; as it grows, both algorithms improve. Chaos raises $λ_{\min}(M)$ by spreading the attractor, but also enlarges it and amplifies noise; because noise enters SINDy's regression bottleneck linearly and PySR's discrimination channel superlinearly, the same transition can push the two methods in opposite directions, so deeper chaos is not uniformly better. Parameter-free mechanistic scores from this framework transfer without refitting to a held-out Lorenz-96 system, confirming mechanism rather than curve-fitting; a criterion read from the equations predicts when added chaos will not improve conditioning. We also introduce Soft F1, a coefficient-weighted structural metric that resolves performance differences invisible to binary-success and predictive scores. The first question of discovery is then not which algorithm, but what the attractor permits.

title: Breaking Network Densification Limits with Distributed Cooperative Massive Access (DCMA)
summary: In this work, we investigate the performance of the distributed cooperative massive access (DCMA) framework in large-scale network setups by incorporating stochastic geometry modeling. A partially centralized cell-free cloud-radio access (C-RAN) architecture is considered where remote radio heads (RRHs) decode transmitted messages and cooperate with each other to enhance system performance. Specifically, they can share decoded messages via feedback links, allowing receivers to cancel inter-user interference through successive interference cancellation (SIC), thus improving the decoding capabilities of the system. For such a network, we propose a novel synergetic decoding algorithm that efficiently resolves the assignment and message sharing routing for each user while accounting for practical network constraints. Furthermore, using game theory, we develop a merge-and-split algorithm with lexicographic preference to solve the problem of minimizing the RRHs utilized without compromising the performance. Simulation results show that the proposed framework significantly outperforms systems that do not implement SIC or take advantage of the cooperation between RRHs in terms of outage probability. Finally, we evaluate the performance of the proposed algorithms and validate their efficiency.

title: Quality over Quantity: Value-Driven Distributed Congestion Control for the Collective Perception Service
summary: While the Collective Perception Service (CPS) enables the exchange of sensor information among Intelligent Transport System Stations (ITS-S'), frequent transmission of Collective Perception Messages (CPMs), their highly variable size, and load from other vehicular services can cause severe channel congestion. Existing Distributed Congestion Control (DCC) Access layer mechanisms typically regulate channel load without considering the relative importance of the objects carried in CPMs. This limits their ability to preserve high-value information under constrained radio resources. More recently, Facilities layer DCC mechanisms attempt to prioritise high value objects within the specified radio resource limits but may not operate well in heterogeneous environments where the number of sensed objects and their importance can vary significantly over time or between ITS-S'. This paper proposes a value-based DCC Facilities layer 'quality' selector that couples a Value of Information (VoI) per bit rate controller with object-level selection. It is benchmarked against state of the art approaches from standards and the literature, with results showing that the proposed method maintains channel load near the target CBR while retaining more high-VoI objects than state of the art approaches, thereby improving the dissemination of perception-critical information.

title: Towards an Automated Test of LLM Security Knowledge
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for a range of software, hardware and human-centered security tasks. Consequently, LLM performance on security tasks is an active area of measurement and research, often with a focus on identifying areas in which LLM security ``knowledge'' may be insufficient. Popular strategies for identifying LLM security knowledge gaps include building corpora of challenge questions or task benchmarks, strategies that require substantial manual work and security expertise to design and execute. We introduce a partially-automated method for assessing LLM knowledge of a security area.The method uses authoritative information from Consumer Protection Agencies (CPAs) to identify instability in LLM responses that can be indicative of knowledge gaps. We demonstrate the method for 2 security topics, identity theft and impostor scams, and 5 LLMs in 2 leading LLM families, Gemini and GPT, using publicly available information about identity theft and impostor scams from 6 CPAs.The method distinguishes between models that have and don't have sufficient knowledge to accurately identify the security topics in text narratives.

title: Splay trees are almost dynamically optimal
summary:
Sleator and Tarjan [JACM, 1985] conjectured that splay trees are dynamically optimal -- that on every access sequence, they perform within a constant factor of the optimal offline dynamic binary search tree. Despite four decades of work, no $o(\log n)$ competitive ratio was known.
  We prove that splay trees are $O(\log\log n \cdot \log^2\log\log n)=\tilde{O}(\log\log n)$-competitive.

title: Large-Signal Stability Analysis of Optimization-Based Secondary Control for Distributed Energy Resources
summary: This article develops a large-signal stability analysis for a sampled-data optimization-based secondary controller for distributed energy resources (DERs) in power systems. The induced closed loop combines nonlinear inverter power-flow dynamics, filtered active and reactive power measurements, constrained optimization updates, and interpolation-based actuation between sampling instants. We study this optimization-in-the-loop nonlinear sampled-data system beyond local linearization. The analysis provides computable bounds on the voltage, filtered reactive power, and the secondary control input. We further characterize steady-state operating points and establish how the optimizer objectives and constraints connect voltage regulation with equal per-unitized reactive power sharing. Finally, input-to-state stability of the frequency dynamics is established with respect to DER voltages and control inputs. These results provide a rigorous mathematical foundation for sampled-data optimization-based secondary control of DERs.

title: Now We Know? A Systematic Comparison of TerraMind and THOR
summary: Benchmarks for Geospatial Foundation Models (GFMs) increasingly rank models by aggregate score, but such rankings obscure why models differ: how much of the gap is architecture, how much is decoder capacity, and how much is a use-case-specific artefact? This study addresses that gap through a controlled comparison of two GFMs developed under European Space Agency's $Φ$-lab with contrasting design philosophies: THOR, which introduces a compute-adaptive architecture supporting variable patch sizes and unifies Sentinel-1, -2, and -3 data at their native resolutions; and TerraMind, a multimodal generative GFM pretrained with a dual-scale token/pixel objective that enables any-to-any cross-modal generation (Thinking-in-Modalities) to infer missing sensors at inference time. Rather than reporting a single leaderboard, we investigate the axes along which the two architectures actually differ - patch size, decoder complexity, finetuning regime, input modality, and model scale - across ten use cases spanning segmentation and regression in diverse domains, including climate disaster response, methane leak detection, snow monitoring, or sea ice mapping. We find that architectural design choices - patch size and decoder type in particular - explain more performance variance than model identity itself, that the two models embody complementary investment strategies (pretraining-time scale for TerraMind versus inference-time tokenisation for THOR), and that correctly interpreting results requires dataset-level characterisation. The resulting picture is not a single winner but a set of hypotheses and a diagnostic ablation methodology that we expect to generalise to future GFMs beyond THOR and TerraMind.

AI.title_translation: 现在我们知道了吗？TerraMind 与 THOR 的系统性对比
AI.tldr: 研究对两款遥感大模型 THOR 和 TerraMind 进行了多维度对比，发现 Patch 尺寸和解码器类型等架构选择比模型名称本身对性能影响更大。
AI.motivation: 现有的遥感基础模型（GFM）基准测试大多依赖综合得分进行排名，掩盖了模型性能差异的真正来源（如架构设计、解码器能力或特定用例的影响），缺乏深入的归因分析。
AI.method: 在包含气候灾害响应、甲烷泄漏检测等 10 个涵盖分割与回归的多元场景中，对 THOR（计算自适应、统一原生分辨率）与 TerraMind（多模态生成式、跨模态补全）进行受控对比，重点评估 Patch 尺寸、解码器复杂度、微调策略、输入模态及模型规模对性能的影响。
AI.result: 架构设计选择（尤其是 Patch 尺寸和解码器类型）比模型标识本身能解释更多的性能方差；两款模型体现了互补的投入策略（TerraMind 侧重预训练阶段的规模，THOR 侧重推理阶段的标记化）；对结果的正确解读依赖于对数据集本身特征的精细化刻画。
AI.conclusion: 研究并未得出单一的“优胜者”，而是提出了一套科学的假设与诊断性消融评估方法论，可为未来更多遥感基础模型的设计、评估与比较提供通用框架。
AI.translation: 遥感基础模型（GFM）的基准测试越来越多地通过综合得分对模型进行排名，但这种排名掩盖了模型产生差异的原因：差距究竟有多少来自架构，多少来自解码器能力，又有多少是特定用例引发的现象？本研究通过对欧洲航天局（ESA）$Φ$-lab 开发的两款设计理念鲜明对比的 GFM 进行受控比较来填补这一空白：THOR 引入了支持可变 Patch 尺寸的计算自适应架构，并统一了 Sentinel-1、-2 和 -3 数据在其原生分辨率下的表示；而 TerraMind 是一款多模态生成式 GFM，采用双尺度标记/像素目标进行预训练，具备跨模态生成能力（思考于模态之中），可在推理阶段推断缺失的传感器数据。我们没有仅报告单一的排行榜，而是跨越包括气候灾害响应、甲烷泄漏检测、积雪监测或海冰映射在内的 10 个涵盖分割与回归的多元领域应用场景，深入探讨了两款架构在实际差异化维度的表现——Patch 尺寸、解码器复杂度、微调策略、输入模态和模型规模。研究发现，架构设计选择（尤其是 Patch 尺寸和解码器类型）解释的性能变异度超过了模型标识本身；两款模型代表了互补的投入策略（TerraMind 侧重预训练阶段的规模扩展，而 THOR 侧重推理阶段的标记化）；且正确解释评估结果需要数据集级别的特征刻画。最终呈现的不是一个单一的胜者，而是一套假设和诊断性消融方法论，我们期望其能推广至未来 THOR 和 TerraMind 之外的其他 GFM 中。
AI.summary: 本研究通过对比 ESA $Φ$-lab 开发的两款不同设计理念的遥感基础模型（TerraMind 与 THOR），在 10 个多样化的下游任务中开展了系统性的消融对比。研究揭示了架构细节（如 Patch 尺寸与解码器）对最终性能的决定性作用，超越了单纯的模型名称差异，为遥感大模型的科学评估提供了诊断性方法论。
AI.keywords: 遥感基础模型, 架构对比, 性能评估, TerraMind, THOR
AI.comments: 本论文创新性地打破了仅依靠“排行榜”单一指标评估遥感基础模型（GFM）的局限，深入到了模型架构参数（如 Patch 尺寸、解码器）对下游任务影响的归因分析，极具诊断性和实用价值。重要性在于为遥感大模型的设计者和应用者提供了极具指导意义的消融分析方法论。局限性在于研究主要聚焦于 ESA $Φ$-lab 旗下的两款特定模型，结论在其他类型遥感大模型上的泛化性仍有待进一步验证。

title: AI Value Alignment for Evolving Social Norms
summary: AI alignment is essential for the safe deployment of advanced AI systems. Given that values and preferences change over time, culture, social roles, and context, we need to develop a better understanding of the possible long-term consequences of AI alignment, in particular considering the likely ubiquitous future use of personalized AI assistants. We introduce a flexible and extensible mathematical modelling framework, rooted in social physics, aimed at answering macro-level questions regarding the evolving social norms in human populations under the assumption of frequent AI use. Our analysis is part-analytical, and part-simulation, enabling us to characterize the long-term dynamical consequences under a diverse set of starting assumptions. We highlight the risk of value lock-in, and normative mode collapse, prominently featured in non-adaptive alignment formulations. Beyond alignment, we advocate for the wider adoption of these kinds of social physics models as an epistemic bridge: enabling rapid, rigorous, and quantitatively-grounded hypothesis testing for sociotechnical foresight in general AI futures, and acting as a tractable precursor to more computationally expensive large-scale agentic evaluations.

AI.title_translation: 适应演化社会规范的AI价值对齐
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于社会物理学的数学建模框架，研究频繁使用AI对人类社会规范演化的长期宏观影响，揭示了非自适应对齐机制可能引发价值锁定和规范模式崩溃的风险。
AI.motivation: 人类社会的价值和偏好会随时间、文化、社会角色和语境动态变化。随着个性化AI助手未来可能的普及，亟需深入理解AI价值对齐对人类社会规范长期动态演化的宏观影响，避免静态对齐带来的潜在风险。
AI.method: 提出了一种植根于社会物理学（Social Physics）的灵活且可扩展的数学建模框架，结合解析计算与计算机仿真，模拟并刻画在频繁使用个性化AI助手的多样化假设条件下，人类群体社会规范的宏观长期动态演化过程。
AI.result: 研究表明，在非自适应（non-adaptive）的对齐设定下，系统存在显著的“价值锁定”（value lock-in）和“规范模式崩溃”（normative mode collapse）风险，即静态的AI对齐可能阻碍人类社会规范的自然演进与多样性。
AI.conclusion: 倡导广泛采用社会物理学模型作为社会技术前瞻的认知桥梁，为通用AI未来的宏观影响提供快速、严谨且具备定量依据的假设检验手段，并作为高计算成本的大规模智能体评估的可行前置方案。
AI.translation: AI对齐对于安全部署先进AI系统至关重要。鉴于价值和偏好会随时间、文化、社会角色和语境发生变化，我们需要更好地理解AI对齐可能的长期后果，特别是考虑到未来个性化AI助手可能被无处不在地使用。我们提出了一个植根于社会物理学的灵活且可扩展的数学建模框架，旨在回答关于在频繁使用AI的假设下人类群体中演化社会规范的宏观层面问题。我们的分析结合了解析与仿真，使我们能够刻画在多种不同初始假设下的长期动态后果。我们强调了非自适应对齐配方中显著存在的价值锁定和规范模式崩溃的风险。除了对齐本身，我们倡导更广泛地采用这类社会物理学模型作为认知桥梁：为通用人工智能未来的社会技术前瞻提供快速、严谨且具备定量依据的假设检验，并作为计算成本更高的复杂大规模智能体评估的易处理前置方案。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了AI价值对齐对演化社会规范的长期宏观影响。作者基于社会物理学构建了一个结合解析与仿真的数学建模框架，用以分析个性化AI助手的广泛应用对人类群体规范动态演化的作用。研究揭示了非自适应对齐可能导致价值锁定和规范模式崩溃等严重后果，并倡导利用社会物理学模型作为评估AI社会技术前景的轻量、严谨的分析工具。
AI.keywords: AI价值对齐, 社会规范演化, 社会物理学, 价值锁定, 动态建模
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将社会物理学建模方法引入AI价值对齐领域，打破了传统对齐研究仅关注微观个体或静态偏好的局限，从宏观社会动态视角揭示了静态对齐可能导致的“价值锁定”与“规范模式崩溃”风险。其重要性在于为通用人工智能（AGI）时代的社会技术治理与前瞻评估提供了一种高效率、低计算成本且兼具定量严谨性的工具。局限性在于基于社会物理学的理论模型往往需要对复杂的现实社会互动进行抽象与简化，其预测效力仍需在更复杂的真实社会数据中进一步验证。

title: AInimation: Animating from Prompt to AI-Generated Responses
summary: We explore the use of animated transitions between a prompt and an AI-generated response. After reviewing 800 examples of prompts and responses, we devise a taxonomy of animated transitions for multimodal text- and image-generative models. The proposed animations include translating and morphing elements of the prompt to their final location in the response; highlighting modifications such as fixed typos; overlaying structural requirements to verify them; and displaying how a model understands references. A study shows that adding animated transitions helps users review the response: participants performed 43% better at locating elements in the response; 153% better at identifying changes; and 20% better at verifying the prompt was correctly interpreted. Our work applies to all software that integrates AI and shows that well-crafted, slower animations are preferable to instant AI responses.

AI.title_translation: AInimation：从提示词到AI生成响应的动态过渡设计
AI.tldr: 本文提出了在提示词与AI生成响应之间增加动态过渡动画的方法，能够显著帮助用户更好地定位元素、辨识修改并验证AI对提示词的理解。
AI.motivation: 现有的AI系统通常瞬间生成或简单流式输出响应，导致用户难以快速理解AI是如何根据输入的提示词（Prompt）构建出最终响应（Response）的，增加了审查和校验AI输出的难度。
AI.method: 通过对800个提示词和响应示例的总结，归纳出一种针对多模态文本和图像生成模型的动画过渡分类法。所设计的动画包括：将提示词元素平移与变异至响应位置、高亮修正内容（如错别字）、叠加结构要求以供校验、以及可视化展现模型对引用内容的理解。
AI.result: 用户研究表明，加入动画过渡显著提升了用户审查AI响应的效果：在响应中定位元素的准确率提升了43%，识别修改内容的准确率提升了153%，验证提示词是否被正确理解的能力提升了20%。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，在提示词和AI生成响应之间加入精心设计的过渡动画，比直接瞬间呈现AI响应更能提升用户体验，这一方法可广泛应用于各类集成AI的软件系统中。
AI.translation: 我们探索了在提示词与AI生成响应之间使用动画过渡的方法。在审查了800个提示词与响应示例后，我们针对多模态文本和图像生成模型制定了一套动态过渡的分类法。所提出的动画形式包括：将提示词中的元素平移并变形至其在响应中的最终位置；高亮显示修改内容（例如修正的错别字）；叠加结构要求以进行校验；以及展现模型如何理解引用。一项用户研究表明，增加动画过渡有助于用户审查响应：参与者在定位响应元素方面的表现提升了43%；在识别修改方面的表现提升了153%；在验证提示词是否被正确理解方面的表现提升了20%。我们的工作适用于所有集成AI的软件，并证明精心设计、稍慢的动画效果要优于瞬间呈现的AI响应。
AI.summary: 本文提出了“AInimation”，一种在提示词与AI生成响应之间加入过渡动画的技术。作者提出了针对多模态AI系统的动画分类法，并通过实验证明过渡动画能大幅提升用户在定位元素、识别修改和验证理解方面的效率与准确率，表明精心设计的慢速动画优于瞬间呈现的AI响应。
AI.keywords: 动画过渡, 人机交互, 生成式AI, 用户界面设计, 可解释性
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将人机交互（HCI）中的过渡动画设计引入生成式AI的用户体验中，挑战了“响应越快越好”的传统认知。实验数据（如变更识别能力提升153%）有力地证明了精心设计的过渡动画在提升AI系统透明度、可解释性和用户审核效率方面的巨大价值。局限性在于，增加动画时长可能会在某些高频轻量级任务中引发部分用户的“等待焦虑”，需要在动画时长和用户体验之间寻求最佳平衡。

title: Style over Substance: A Shortcut Audit of Emotion-Description Preference Evaluation
summary: Preference over model-generated emotion descriptions is emerging as a standard evaluation metric for multimodal emotion understanding, exemplified by the MER2026 MER-Prefer track on EmoPrefer. Such benchmarks assume that predicting the preferred description requires grounded cross-modal understanding of the video. We conduct a systematic shortcut audit of EmoPrefer using content-blind probes. A simple logistic regression using only description length and generator identity, without processing the text, video, or audio, performs comparably to LoRA-finetuned 7B text and audio-visual judges (65.8 versus 66.8 WAF on EmoPrefer-V2). Generator identity is recoverable from description text with 99.5 percent accuracy, every candidate pair contrasts two distinct generators, and the human preference labels agree with a fold-exclusive per-generator win-rate prior on 66 percent of the evaluated pairs. When the human label conflicts with this prior, trained judges still follow the style prior on 63 to 80 percent of the pairs. On a length-matched subset that neutralizes verbosity bias, the tested media configurations yield no statistically significant improvement, while an ODIN-inspired diagnostic that decouples the style shortcut leaves its content head near chance. These results do not imply that human preferences are inherently stylistic or that the descriptions contain no emotional information. Instead, they show that the current scores can be reached without verifying either description against the video. We recommend source-balanced pairing, strict length control, counter-stereotypical sliced reporting, and multi-annotator consensus for future cross-generator evaluations. Code is available at https://github.com/jiabingyang01/EmoPrefer-Audit.

AI.title_translation: 风格胜于实质：情感描述偏好评估的快捷路径审计
AI.tldr: 研究发现多模态情感描述偏好评估严重依赖文本长度和生成器身份等风格快捷路径，而非真正的跨模态视频理解。
AI.motivation: 多模态情感理解领域日益流行采用模型生成的情感描述偏好作为评估指标（如MER2026的EmoPrefer），其假设预测偏好需要对视频进行深入的跨模态理解。本文旨在审计该假设是否成立，探究评估是否存在通过非内容特征（快捷路径）达成的缺陷。
AI.method: 使用盲内容探针（content-blind probes）对EmoPrefer进行系统性审计；构建仅依靠描述长度和生成器身份的逻辑回归模型；分析生成器身份可预测性及胜率先验；使用长度匹配子集控制冗长偏见；采用受ODIN启发的诊断方法将风格快捷路径与内容特征解耦。
AI.result:
1. 仅用描述长度和生成器身份的简单逻辑回归在EmoPrefer-V2上达到了65.8 WAF，与微调后的7B音视频裁判（66.8 WAF）相当。
2. 生成器身份可从文本中以99.5%的准确率还原，人类偏好在66%的候选对上与生成器胜率先验一致。
3. 当人类标签与先验冲突时，训练好的裁判仍有63%-80%遵循风格先验。
4. 在消除长度偏见的匹配子集上，多模态特征未带来显著提升；解耦风格后内容头预测性能接近随机猜想。
AI.conclusion: 当前基准的评估得分可以在完全不验证描述与视频一致性的情况下达成，表明评估模型严重依赖风格快捷路径而非真实的跨模态理解。作者为未来的跨生成器评估提出了来源平衡配对、严格控制文本长度、反刻板切片报告及多标注者共识等建议。
AI.translation: 模型生成的情感描述偏好正在成为多模态情感理解的标准评估指标，MER2026 MER-Prefer轨道的EmoPrefer即是典型代表。此类基准假设预测偏好需要对视频进行接地性的跨模态理解。我们使用盲内容探针对EmoPrefer进行了系统性的快捷路径审计。一个仅使用描述长度和生成器身份、而不处理文本、视频或音频的简单逻辑回归模型，其表现与经过LoRA微调的7B文本和音视频裁判相当（在EmoPrefer-V2上为65.8对比66.8 WAF）。生成器身份可以从描述文本中以99.5%的准确率恢复，每个候选对都对比了两个不同的生成器，且人类偏好标签在66%的评估对上与折外单生成器胜率先验保持一致。当人类标签与此先验冲突时，训练好的裁判在63%至80%的对上仍然遵循风格先验。在一个消除冗长偏见的长度匹配子集上，所测试的媒体配置没有带来统计学上的显著提升，而一个受ODIN启发的解耦风格快捷路径诊断则使其内容头接近随机水平。这些结果并不意味着人类偏好本质上是风格化的，或者描述不包含情感信息。相反，它们表明当前的分数可以在无需针对视频验证任何一个描述的情况下达到。我们建议为未来的跨生成器评估采用来源平衡配对、严格长度控制、反刻板印象切片报告和多标注者共识。代码可在https://github.com/jiabingyang01/EmoPrefer-Audit获取。
AI.summary: 本文针对多模态情感描述偏好评估基准（如EmoPrefer）进行了系统性的快捷路径审计。研究发现，仅利用描述长度和生成器身份等表面风格特征，即可达到与复杂的7B音视频裁判相当的评估性能。这表明现有的偏好评估更多依赖风格捷径而非真正的视频内容理解。作者据此提出了改善未来评估基准设计的建议。
AI.keywords: 情感描述偏好, 快捷路径审计, 多模态评估基准, 风格偏见, 内容盲探针
AI.comments:
1. 创新性：本文创新性地提出使用盲内容探针（content-blind probes）和ODIN风格解耦诊断来对多模态偏好评估基准进行快捷路径审计。
2. 重要性：深刻揭示了当前大模型/多模态偏好评估（LLM-as-a-Judge）中普遍存在的“风格胜过实质”缺陷，为未来多模态基准设计提供了具体的规范和建议。
3. 局限性：主要审计集中在EmoPrefer数据集上，未来可进一步在更多领域的偏好评估基准中验证该现象的普适性。

title: DuSPiT: Dual-Branch Sub-Patch Pixel Diffusion Transformer
summary: Diffusion Transformers achieve strong image generation performance, but most operate in compressed latent spaces. Pixel-space diffusion avoids this information loss, yet existing approaches map each raw image patch to a single token, forcing one representation to handle both global communication and fine-grained details. We address this issue by proposing a new architecture, \textbf{DuSPiT}, a \textbf{Du}al-branch \textbf{S}ub\textbf{P}atch \textbf{Pi}xel \textbf{T}ransformer. This model separates global structural reasoning from local appearance modeling. DuSPiT uses a compact base branch for efficient global reasoning and a parallel, high-capacity pixel branch, organized into subpatch groups, to preserve detailed appearance, with the two branches interacting through cross-attention. Our results show that DuSPiT generates images with richer details and stronger fine-grained structures, while also achieving a better quality--efficiency trade-off than prior pixel-space diffusion transformers.

AI.tldr: DuSPiT通过解耦全局结构推理与局部外观建模的双分支架构，实现了高质量且高效的像素级图像生成。
AI.motivation: 大多数 Diffusion Transformer 在压缩的潜在空间中运行，而直接在像素空间运行的模型将每个原始图像块映射为单一 token，导致单一表征必须同时兼顾全局通信和细粒度细节，限制了细节生成和效率。
AI.method: 提出了DuSPiT架构，将全局结构推理与局部外观建模解耦。模型包含一个用于高效全局推理的紧凑基础分支（base branch），以及一个由子块（subpatch）组组成的并行高容量像素分支（pixel branch），两个分支通过交叉注意力机制（cross-attention）进行交互。
AI.result: DuSPiT生成的图像具有更丰富的细节和更强的细粒度结构，且与以往的像素空间 Diffusion Transformer 相比，取得了更好的生成质量与计算效率之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: DuSPiT成功解决了像素空间扩散模型中全局推理与局部细节建模的矛盾，实现了生成图像质量与计算效率的双重提升。
AI.translation: 扩散 Transformer（Diffusion Transformers）取得了强大的图像生成性能，但大多数模型在压缩的潜在空间中运行。像素空间扩散避免了这种信息损失，然而现有的方法将每个原始图像块映射为单个 token，强迫单一表征同时处理全局通信和细粒度细节。我们通过提出一种新架构 DuSPiT（双分支子块像素 Transformer，Dual-branch SubPatch Pixel Transformer）来解决这个问题。该模型将全局结构推理与局部外观建模分离。DuSPiT 使用一个紧凑的基础分支来进行高效的全局推理，以及一个按子块组组织的并行高容量像素分支来保留详细的外观，两个分支通过交叉注意力进行交互。我们的结果表明，与以往的像素空间扩散 Transformer 相比，DuSPiT 生成的图像具有更丰富的细节和更强的细粒度结构，同时实现了更好的质量与效率权衡。
AI.summary: 针对像素空间 Diffusion Transformer 中单个 token 难以同时兼顾全局推理与局部细节的问题，本文提出了 DuSPiT 架构。该架构通过双分支设计，将用于高效全局推理的紧凑基础分支与用于保留细节的外观像素分支相结合，并通过交叉注意力进行交互。实验结果表明 DuSPiT 在生成丰富细节和精细结构的同时，取得了优异的质量与效率平衡。
AI.keywords: Diffusion Transformers, Pixel-Space Diffusion, Dual-Branch Architecture, Sub-Patch, Image Generation
AI.comments: 该论文提出了巧妙的双分支解耦思想，将像素级Diffusion Transformer中的全局结构推理与局部外观细节建模分离开来，克服了传统方法中单token表征承载过多跨尺度信息的瓶颈，为无需潜在空间压缩的高质量、高效像素级图像生成提供了极具创新性的解决方案。

title: Querying Multimodal Scientific Papers with AI: Practices and Preferences Across Blind, Low-Vision, and Sighted Scientists
summary: Visual diagrams, figures, and tables are central to scientific papers, and convey information beyond what is captured in text. While blind or low-vision (BLV) scientists have traditionally relied on static alternative text to access figures in papers, the rise of artificial intelligence (AI) has made interactive question-answering (QA) a feasible paradigm for visual exploration; yet little is known about how scientists use visual QA in practice or how to improve its accessibility. In this work, we interview five BLV and five sighted scientists across different STEM fields to understand how they use two AI tools, ChatGPT and Gemini, to query multimodal scientific documents. Our findings characterize how scientists review multimodal content, including existing practices (along with accessibility workarounds) for engaging with visuals, and feedback on the suitability of AI-generated responses to multimodal queries. We further find that vague or incomplete image descriptions, as well as incorrect AI outputs more broadly, can cause both BLV and sighted scientists to abandon AI workflows. To support future research, we additionally contribute a dataset of 115 queries and responses from our participants' interactions with the AI tools for papers in their field. We close by discussing implications for AI-powered scientific QA systems, emphasizing considerations for access across abilities and domains.

AI.title_translation: 利用人工智能查询多模态科学论文：视障、低视力与健视科学家的实践与偏好
AI.tldr: 本研究评估了视障与健视科学家使用AI工具（ChatGPT/Gemini）探索多模态论文图表的实践与偏好，揭示了当前AI在准确性和无障碍性上的不足。
AI.motivation: 科研论文中的图表和图像承载着大量文本之外的关键信息。尽管交互式AI问答为视觉探索提供了可能，但目前人们对科学家在实践中如何使用视觉问答系统以及如何提高其无障碍性（Accessibility）仍知之甚少。
AI.method: 对来自不同STEM领域的5位视障/低视力（BLV）科学家和5位健视科学家进行了访谈，深入了解他们如何利用ChatGPT和Gemini两款AI工具对多模态科学文献进行查询，并收集整理了115个来自真实交互的查询与响应数据集。
AI.result: 总结了科学家审阅多模态内容的实践做法与应对方案；发现模糊/不完整的图像描述以及AI输出错误会导致视障和健视科学家放弃AI工作流；同时贡献了一个包含115个真实交互问答的数据集。
AI.conclusion: 文章探讨了未来AI驱动的科学问答系统的设计启示，强调了在不同能力水平和学科领域中提升无障碍性与响应准确性的重要性。
AI.translation: 直观的图表、示意图和表格是科学论文的核心，传达了文本之外的信息。虽然视障或低视力（BLV）科学家传统上依赖静态替代文本（Alt text）来获取论文中的图表信息，但人工智能（AI）的兴起使交互式问答（QA）成为视觉探索的切实可行的新范式；然而，关于科学家在实践中如何使用视觉问答，或者如何改善其无障碍性，人们所知甚少。在这项工作中，我们访谈了来自不同STEM领域的5位BLV科学家和5位健视科学家，以了解他们如何使用ChatGPT和Gemini这两个AI工具来查询多模态科学文献。我们的研究结果刻画了科学家如何审阅多模态内容，包括与视觉效果互动的现有实践（以及无障碍变通方案），以及对AI生成的多模态查询响应适用性的反馈。我们进一步发现，模糊或不完整的图像描述，以及更广泛的错误AI输出，会导致BLV和健视科学家放弃AI工作流程。为了支持未来的研究，我们还贡献了一个包含115个查询和响应的数据集，这些数据源自参与者与其领域内论文的AI工具交互。最后，我们讨论了对AI驱动的科学问答系统的启示，强调了跨能力和跨领域的访问考量。
AI.summary: 本研究调查了视障、低视力及健视科学家使用ChatGPT和Gemini查询多模态科学论文的实践与偏好。研究揭示了多模态内容审阅中的问题（如AI输出错误或图像描述模糊会导致用户放弃使用），并整理出115个真实查询数据集，为未来无障碍科学问答系统的开发提供了指导。
AI.keywords: 多模态科学论文, 视觉问答, 无障碍设计, 视障科学家, 人工智能问答
AI.comments: 该研究具有重要的社会意义与实用价值，将AI的可访问性（Accessibility）延伸至高精尖的科学研究领域。其创新点在于对比了视障/低视力科学家与健视科学家在交互式视觉问答（Visual QA）中的不同习惯与痛点，并贡献了真实科研场景下的问答数据集。局限性在于受访样本量较小（共10位科学家），未来可进一步扩大研究规模以验证通用性。

title: Automated Data Engineering and Feature Selection for the Case Study of Warpage Detection in Fused Deposition Modeling
summary: This study contributes toward development of an Automated Data Processing (ADP) framework designed to evaluate and reinforce optimal machine learning model-feature combinations for predictive tasks in fused deposition modeling (FDM) process datasets. The methodology is centered around a reinforcement learning-inspired policy updating mechanism, where multiple machine learning models are trained on both full feature sets and feature subsets selected through Shapley-based Explainable AI (SHAP XAI) across 217 datasets. At each episode, the framework assesses the predictive accuracy and F1-scores of each model-feature pair, computes a scalar reward, and updates $Q$ values to guide future model selection. SHAP XAI feature importance was employed to generate reduced yet informative feature subsets to enable the framework to explore performance with dimensionality. The policy was shown to evolve over multiple episodes, with reward distributions used to visualize performance stability. Overall, results indicate that leveraging the ADP framework through XAI algorithms successfully converges toward optimal model-feature configurations with improved accuracy and stability. Specifically, the proposed framework improves the test-set AUC from 0.9248 to 0.9731 and increases the mean reward value by more than fifty percent compared with the baseline full-feature configuration.

AI.title_translation: 熔融沉积成型翘曲检测案例研究中的自动化数据工程与特征选择
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种结合强化学习和SHAP可解释AI的自动化数据处理框架，成功实现了FDM 3D打印翘曲检测中模型与特征的最佳组合优化，将预测AUC提升至0.9731。
AI.motivation: 在熔融沉积成型（FDM）工艺预测任务中，旨在构建一种自动化数据处理框架，以探索维度对性能的影响，并自动寻找和强化最佳的机器学习模型与特征组合。
AI.method: 提出了一个受强化学习启发的自动化数据处理（ADP）框架。该框架基于217个数据集，使用SHAP（Shapley值）筛选高重要性特征子集，并在每个回合评估模型-特征对的准确率与F1分数，计算标量奖励并更新Q值，从而自动指导最优模型与特征组合的搜索。
AI.result: 策略在多回合训练中成功演化并保持收敛；相比全特征基线配置，所提框架将测试集AUC从0.9248提升至0.9731，平均奖励值增长了50%以上。
AI.conclusion: 结合XAI算法的自动化数据处理（ADP）框架能够有效收敛至最佳的模型-特征配置，在提升FDM翘曲预测准确率的同时增强了系统的稳定性。
AI.translation: 本研究致力于开发一种自动化数据处理（ADP）框架，旨在评估并强化熔融沉积成型（FDM）工艺数据集预测任务中的最佳机器学习模型-特征组合。该方法的核心是一个受强化学习启发的策略更新机制，其中多个机器学习模型在217个数据集上基于完整特征集以及通过基于Shapley的可解释人工智能（SHAP XAI）筛选出的特征子集进行训练。在每个回合中，框架评估每个模型-特征对的预测准确率和F1分数，计算标量奖励，并更新Q值以指导未来的模型选择。利用SHAP XAI特征重要性生成精简但信息丰富的特征子集，使框架能够探索性能随维度的变化。策略被证明能在多个回合中演化，并利用奖励分布可视化性能稳定性。总体而言，结果表明利用ADP框架结合XAI算法能够成功收敛至最佳模型-特征配置，显著提高了准确率和稳定性。具体而言，与基线全特征配置相比，所提框架将测试集AUC从0.9248提升至0.9731，并将平均奖励值提高了50%以上。
AI.summary: 本文针对熔融沉积成型（FDM）中的翘曲检测问题，开发了一种结合SHAP可解释AI与强化学习策略更新机制的自动化数据处理（ADP）框架。该框架能够自动在全特征及降维特征子集上评估模型表现，动态更新Q值以搜索最优模型-特征组合。实验表明，该方法显著提升了预测性能与稳定性，测试集AUC达到0.9731。
AI.keywords: 熔融沉积成型 (FDM), 自动化数据工程, 特征选择, 强化学习, 可解释人工智能 (SHAP)
AI.comments: 本研究的创新之处在于将强化学习的策略更新机制（Q-learning）与基于SHAP的可解释人工智能（XAI）深度结合，实现了机器学习模型与特征子集协同优化的自动化。其重要性在于为3D打印（FDM）领域的翘曲检测提供了高精度、高稳定性的自动化数据工程解决方案，有效解决了高维特征冗余和模型选择难题；局限性在于摘要中未深入说明该框架在实际高频工业生产环境下的计算开销与实时性表现。

title: Signed Rectified Flow: Negativity-Controlled Generation
summary: We introduce Signed Rectified Flow (Signed RF), a generalization of Rectified Flow that targets the signed measure $π^{sign} = (1+α)π^+ - απ^-$, where $α>0$, $π^+$ is the distribution to promote, and $π^-$ is the distribution to suppress. Although direct sampling from a signed measure is not well-defined, Signed RF induces a valid generative process that concentrates probability in regions where the signed measure is positive while provably excluding regions dominated by its negative component. It therefore provides a principled framework for incorporating negative information and exclusion constraints into generative modeling. We analyze the signed continuity equation underlying Signed RF and use a charged-particle interpretation to explain how negative mass forms exclusion barriers. This theory further motivates practical adaptive guidance algorithms. Across several applications, Signed RF improves the fidelity-diversity trade-off on ImageNet, reduces nearest-neighbor similarity in anti-memorization experiments, and reduces nudity induced by adversarial prompts in Stable Diffusion 3.5 while preserving CLIP and aesthetic scores.

AI.title_translation: 符号整流流：负面可控生成
AI.tldr: 本文提出了符号整流流（Signed RF），通过在生成过程中引入负向分布约束，实现了理论完备且高效的负面可控生成与安全性过滤。
AI.motivation: 传统生成模型缺乏一种理论完备的框架来整合负面信息（抑制不需要的分布 $π^-$）与排除约束，需要解决如何在生成过程中有效抑制特定不良特征或过度记忆问题。
AI.method: 本文提出了符号整流流（Signed RF），将 Rectified Flow 推广至针对符号测度 $π^{sign} = (1+α)π^+ - απ^-$ 的生成。通过分析其底层的符号连续性方程（Signed Continuity Equation），并结合“带电粒子”物理解释阐明负质量如何形成排除屏障，进而提出了实用的自适应引导算法（Adaptive Guidance Algorithms）。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet 上改善了保真度与多样性（Fidelity-Diversity）的权衡；在反记忆实验中降低了最近邻相似度；在 Stable Diffusion 3.5 中大幅减少了对抗性提示词诱导的裸露内容，同时保持了 CLIP 分数和审美得分。
AI.conclusion: Signed RF 成功证明了利用符号测度引入负向信息的可行性，能够有效地将概率集中于目标区域并排除不良区域，为生成模型中的负向控制与安全约束提供了理论完备且实用的解决方案。
AI.translation: 我们提出了符号整流流（Signed Rectified Flow，简称 Signed RF），这是整流流（Rectified Flow）针对符号测度 $π^{sign} = (1+α)π^+ - απ^-$ 的一种推广，其中 $α>0$，$π^+$ 是需要促进的分布，而 $π^-$ 是需要抑制的分布。尽管直接从符号测度中采样并非良定义的，但 Signed RF 引导了一个有效的生成过程，将概率集中在符号测度为正的区域，同时可证明地排除了由负成分主导的区域。因此，它为在生成建模中引入负面信息和排除约束提供了一个理论完备的框架。我们分析了 Signed RF 底层的符号连续性方程，并利用带电粒子解释阐明了负质量如何形成排除屏障。这一理论进一步启发了实用的自适应引导算法。在多项应用中，Signed RF 提高了 ImageNet 上的保真度与多样性权衡，降低了反记忆实验中的最近邻相似度，并在保持 CLIP 和审美得分的同时，减少了 Stable Diffusion 3.5 中由对抗性提示引发的裸露内容。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了“符号整流流”（Signed RF），将 Rectified Flow 推广至符号测度框架，通过同时定义促进分布与抑制分布，在生成过程中形成排除屏障。该方法具有扎实的理论基础和自适应引导算法，在 ImageNet 生成质量提升、模型反记忆以及图像安全过滤等任务中展现了显著的效果。
AI.keywords: 符号整流流, 负向可控生成, 整流流, 反记忆, 图像生成安全
AI.comments:
创新性：该论文将整流流（Rectified Flow）拓展至符号测度（Signed Measure）领域，通过“带电粒子”理论形象地解释了负质量如何构建排除屏障，为在生成模型中融入负面约束提供了坚实的数学与理论基础。
重要性：在图像生成、反记忆（Anti-memorization）以及生成安全（对抗性提示词下的违规内容抑制）等多个现实挑战中均展现出极强的实用价值和优异性能。
局限性：符号测度参数 α 的选择可能需要根据具体任务进行微调，且在更复杂的跨模态或高维极端分布下的收敛性与计算开销仍有待进一步探讨。

title: Beyond Fixed Goal Delivery: Online POMDP Planning for Target Interception in Crowds
comments: Accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
summary: Target interception in crowded environments requires reaching a moving objective while navigating among multiple uncertain human agents. Since human navigation intent is not directly observable, the robot must reason over multiple possible future interaction outcomes. We formulate interception in crowds as a partially observable Markov decision process and solve it online using tree search under a fixed computational budget. In this setting, the action-space structure directly shapes the search tree and how computational effort is allocated. We perform a controlled comparison between a sequential path-speed planner, which first plans a spatial path and then modulates speed along it, and a unified planner that jointly branches over steering and speed within tree search. Across simulations with up to 200 humans, both approaches perform similarly at low crowd density but diverge sharply as density increases. At the highest crowd density, the sequential planner has a safe-interception rate 31 percentage points lower and requires 44% more time than the unified steering-speed planner, revealing a structural limitation of spatial restriction. Project webpage: https://tic-planning.github.io/
comment: Accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)

AI.title_translation: 超越固定目标交付：人群中目标拦截的在线POMDP规划
AI.tldr: 本文将人群中的移动目标拦截建模为在线POMDP问题，证明在拥挤环境中采用“转向与速度联合分支”的统一规划器在安全率和效率上均显著优于传统的“先路径后速度”顺序规划器。
AI.motivation: 在拥挤人群中拦截移动目标时，人类导航意图不可直接观测，需要对多种交互可能进行推理。由于计算资源有限，动作空间的构建方式会直接影响在线树搜索的搜索效率和资源分配，因此需要评估不同动作空间设计对拦截任务的影响。
AI.method: 将人群中的移动目标拦截建模为部分可观察马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），并在固定计算预算下使用树搜索在线求解。对比了“先规划空间路径再进行速度调节”的顺序规划器与“在树搜索中对转向和速度进行联合分支”的统一规划器。
AI.result: 在多达200人的仿真实验中，低密度人群下两类规划器表现接近；但在极高人群密度下，顺序规划器的安全拦截成功率比统一规划器低31个百分点，且拦截耗时多出44%。
AI.conclusion: 顺序规划中先固定空间路径的做法存在结构性局限，而在POMDP树搜索中采用转向与速度联合分支的统一规划器，能更有效地利用计算资源，在拥挤环境中实现高安全性与高效率的目标拦截。
AI.translation: 在拥挤环境中进行目标拦截需要到达一个移动目标，同时在多个不确定的人类个体间导航。由于人类的导航意图无法直接观测，机器人必须推断多种可能的未来交互结果。我们将人群中的拦截问题建模为部分可观察马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），并在固定计算预算下使用树搜索在线求解。在这种设定下，动作空间结构直接塑造了搜索树的形态以及计算资源的分配方式。我们对“先规划空间路径再沿路径调节速度”的顺序路径-速度规划器，与“在树搜索中对转向和速度进行联合分支”的统一规划器进行了受控对比。在包含多达200人的仿真中，两种方法在低人群密度下表现相似，但随着人群密度的增加差异急剧增大。在最高人群密度下，顺序规划器的安全拦截率比统一转向-速度规划器低31个百分点，且所需时间多44%，揭示了空间限制的结构性局限。
AI.summary: 本文提出了基于在线POMDP树搜索的人群移动目标拦截方法，重点对比了顺序路径-速度规划与联合转向-速度规划两种动作空间结构。结果表明在密集的复杂人群环境中，联合规划能大幅提升安全拦截率并缩短拦截时间。
AI.keywords: 目标拦截, 拥挤环境导航, POMDP, 在线树搜索, 动作空间建模
AI.comments: 本文创新性地探讨了在线POMDP树搜索中动作空间结构对复杂交互决策的影响，通过严谨的对比实验证明了联合求解转向与速度在极拥挤环境中的优越性，打破了传统“先空间路径后速度”的解耦规划局限。局限在于目前成果主要基于仿真，需进一步在真实复杂人群环境中验证其实时性与鲁棒性。

title: A Progressive Approach to Synthesizable RTL Design Generation Using LLMs
summary: Large language models can generate register-transfer-level (RTL) designs directly from natural language specifications. Their failures, however, arise mostly from understanding rather than coding \cite{zhang2026understanding, qiu2025towards}. A specification is informal and ambiguous, the model's interpretation stays implicit, and every misreading is committed silently into Verilog, where only simulation can expose it. Intermediate representations make the interpretation partly explicit, yet existing works don't verify the interpretation against the specification, and repair simulation failures at the code level regardless of where the misreading originated. VeriRefine instead treats specification refinement as a verifiable stage of RTL generation. It progressively refines the prose specification into an explicit, schema-constrained account of design intent, expressed as per-signal Abstract Signal Transition Functions (ASTFs) that commit each signal's logic style, clock domain, and reset behavior before any code exists and ground every behavior in a verbatim specification sentence. The refined specification then passes a five-layer audit spanning soundness, completeness, consistency, FSM integrity, and core RTL design rules, so interpretation errors are repaired at the representation level before any Verilog is generated. Once code is generated, each simulation failure is classified as an understanding error or a coding error and routed back to the corresponding stage for targeted repair. Because every signal's hardware class is fixed during refinement, synthesizability becomes a structural property of the pipeline rather than a post-hoc check. With Claude Sonnet 4.6, VeriRefine reaches 94.0\% functional correctness on RTLLM v2.0 and 98.1\% on VerilogEval-Human v2.

AI.title_translation: 基于大语言模型的可综合RTL设计生成的渐进式方法
AI.tldr: VeriRefine通过将自然语言规范渐进细化为受约束的抽象信号转换函数（ASTFs）并在生成代码前进行五层规则审计，显著提升了LLM生成RTL设计的正确率与可综合性。
AI.motivation: LLM生成RTL设计的主要失败原因在于对非形式化、有歧义的自然语言规范的“理解错误”，而非编码能力不足。现有方法未在代码生成前对理解模型进行规范验证，且将所有仿真错误一律在代码层修复，导致误读被隐式提交至代码中。
AI.method: 提出VeriRefine框架：1）将自然语言规范渐进式细化为受模式约束的抽象信号转换函数（ASTFs），在代码生成前明确每个信号的逻辑风格、时钟域和复位行为；2）设立涵盖健全性、完备性、一致性、有限状态机（FSM）完整性和核心RTL设计规则的五层审计体系，在表示层修复理解错误；3）生成代码后，将仿真失败分类为理解错误或编码错误，并路由至对应阶段进行定向修复。
AI.result: 结合Claude Sonnet 4.6模型，VeriRefine框架在RTLLM v2.0基准测试中实现了94.0%的功能正确率，在VerilogEval-Human v2上达到了98.1%的功能正确率。
AI.conclusion: 通过将规范细化定义为显式且可验证的阶段，并结合代码生成前的多层审计与生成后的定向错误修复，能够极大提升LLM在RTL设计生成中的准确率与代码可综合性。
AI.translation: 大语言模型可以直接从自然语言规范生成寄存器传输级（RTL）设计。然而，它们的失败主要源于理解偏差而非编码能力。自然语言规范是非形式化且存在歧义的，模型的理解保持隐式，每一次误读都会静默地提交写入Verilog中，只有通过仿真才能暴露出来。中间表示使理解部分显式化，但现有工作并未针对规范验证其理解，且无论误读源自何处，都在代码层面修复仿真失败。相比之下，VeriRefine将规范细化视为RTL生成的一个可验证阶段。它逐步将散文规范细化为显式、受模式约束的设计意图描述，表达为按信号划分的抽象信号转换函数（ASTFs），在产生任何代码之前确定每个信号的逻辑风格、时钟域和复位行为，并将每个行为建立在规范原文句子的基础上。细化后的规范随后通过包含健全性、完备性、一致性、状态机完整性和核心RTL设计规则的五层审计，因此理解错误在生成任何Verilog之前就在表示层得到了修复。一旦生成代码，每个仿真失败都会被归类为理解错误或编码错误，并路由回相应的阶段进行针对性修复。由于每个信号的硬件类别在细化期间已被固定，可综合性成为流水线的一种结构属性，而非事后检查。在Claude Sonnet 4.6下，VeriRefine在RTLLM v2.0上达到了94.0%的功能正确率，在VerilogEval-Human v2上达到了98.1%。
AI.summary: 针对大语言模型（LLM）生成RTL设计时因自然语言规范歧义导致的“理解错误”问题，本文提出了VeriRefine框架。该框架将规范细化作为可验证的显式阶段，在生成代码前将自然语言转化为受约束的抽象信号转换函数（ASTFs），并通过五层规则审计在表示层修复理解偏差；生成代码后，进一步将仿真失败归类为理解或编码错误进行定向修复。该方法确保了代码的严格可综合性，并在多个基准测试中取得了显著的效果提升。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, RTL设计生成, 规范细化, 抽象信号转换函数, 可综合性
AI.comments: 创新点：该论文巧妙地将LLM生成RTL设计时的“理解偏差”问题前置解决，提出将自然语言规范细化为结构化的ASTFs（抽象信号转换函数），并在代码生成前进行五层规则审计，将“可综合性”转变为流水线的结构属性；同时提出了区分理解与编码错误的定向修复机制。Importance：显著提升了LLM在RTL生成任务中的准确率和实用价值，为硬件设计的自动化提供了新思路。局限性：依赖严格定义的五层审计规则和模式约束，对于极不规范或超出预定义规则范围的复杂硬件设计，其表达和审计能力可能受限。

title: Adaptive Two-Stage Online Learning for Service-Affecting Failure Detection in Mobile Core Networks
summary: Mobile network operators monitor aggregated traffic volumes to assess the operational health of core network infrastructure. Reliable failure detection is challenging due to strong temporal structure, non-stationarity, measurement artefacts, and extreme class imbalance, which limit static threshold-based monitoring. This paper proposes a two-stage online learning framework for traffic-based failure detection in mobile core networks. Stage I incrementally models normal traffic dynamics using lightweight regression with time-aware features. Stage II analyses prediction residuals together with contextual indicators to detect genuine service-affecting network failures. The framework operates fully online under a prequential evaluation protocol, enabling continuous adaptation with low computational overhead. Across linear and non-linear models, the proposed two-stage architecture achieves the best precision-recall trade-off, attaining the highest recall, F1-score, and AUC at acceptable false positive rates. These results demonstrate the importance of explicit residual decomposition for reliable failure detection in streaming mobile core network data.

AI.title_translation: 移动核心网中用于影响服务故障检测的自适应两阶段在线学习
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种两阶段在线学习框架，通过将正常流量建模与残差分析分离，实现了移动核心网中高精度、低开销的实时故障检测。
AI.motivation: 由于聚合流量数据具有强时间结构、非平稳性、测量伪影以及极端的类不平衡，传统的静态阈值监控难以提供可靠的故障检测。
AI.method: 提出了一个两阶段在线学习框架：第一阶段利用带有时间感知特征的轻量级回归模型增量式建模正常流量动态；第二阶段结合预测残差与上下文指标进行分析，以识别真正影响服务的网络故障。该框架基于渐进式评估协议（prequential evaluation protocol）完全在线运行。
AI.result: 在跨线性和非线性模型的实验中，该两阶段架构实现了最佳的精确率-召回率权衡，在保持可接受误报率的同时获得了最高的召回率、F1分数和AUC。
AI.conclusion: 显式残差分解对于在流式移动核心网数据中实现可靠的故障检测具有重要意义。
AI.translation: 移动网络运营商通过监测聚合流量来评估核心网络基础设施的运行健康状况。然而，由于强时间结构、非平稳性、测量伪影以及极端的类不平衡，可靠的故障检测面临巨大挑战，这限制了基于静态阈值的监控方法。本文提出了一种用于移动核心网中基于流量的故障检测的两阶段在线学习框架。第一阶段使用带时间感知特征的轻量级回归模型对正常流量动态进行增量建模。第二阶段将预测残差与上下文指标相结合进行分析，以检测真正影响服务的网络故障。该框架在渐进式评估协议下完全在线运行，能够以较低的计算开销实现持续自适应。在跨线性和非线性模型的评估中，所提出的两阶段架构实现了最佳的精确率-召回率权衡，并在可接受的误报率下取得了最高的召回率、F1分数和AUC。这些结果表明了显式残差分解对于数据流式移动核心网数据中可靠故障检测的重要性。
AI.summary: 本文针对移动核心网流量数据中的非平稳性和极端类不平衡问题，提出了一种自适应两阶段在线学习框架。第一阶段通过轻量级回归建模正常流量，第二阶段基于残差和上下文信息检测影响服务的故障，在保持低计算开销的同时显著提升了检测准确度与可靠性。
AI.keywords: 移动核心网, 故障检测, 在线学习, 两阶段框架, 残差分解
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将移动核心网故障检测拆分为“正常流量建模”与“残差/上下文故障检测”两阶段，有效应对了网络流量的非平稳性与极度的类不平衡问题。完全在线运行与低计算开销的设计使其具备很强的工程应用价值。

title: DASH Robot: Minimalistic Design and Optimal Aerial-Terrestrial Locomotion via Contact-Implicit Control
comments: IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2026
summary: We present a novel and minimalistic design of an aerial-terrestrial robot DASH: Ducted Aerial Spring Hopper. The goal is to enable both aerial and ground locomotion capabilities on a unified mobile robot that is mechanically-minimalistic, locomotion-versatile, and energy-efficient. We propose an organic integration of ducted fan co-axial body with a springy leg at the bottom for realization. The ducted fan module provides thrust-vectoring as the main actuation for agile flying; when it is combined with the light-weight spring leg, the robot realizes highly efficient ground hopping with energy circulation. Moreover, to realize optimal locomotion with two modes, we employ a contact-implicit model predictive controller to automatically choose locomotion modes and actuation. We successfully validated the design and control of DASH through a range of tasks, including periodic hopping, aerial flight, and mode-free locomotion with autonomous mode transitions during obstacle traversal.

AI.title_translation: DASH机器人：基于隐式接触控制的极简设计与最优陆空跨介质运动
AI.tldr: DASH机器人融合涵道风扇与弹簧腿极简设计，并结合隐式接触模型预测控制，实现了高效且能自主切换模式的陆空跨介质运动。
AI.motivation: 旨在开发一种机械极简、功能多样且高能效的统一移动机器人，使其同时具备陆地与空中高效运动能力。
AI.method: 提出涵道风扇同轴机身与底部轻量化弹簧腿的有机结合设计，涵道风扇提供推力矢量飞行，结合弹簧腿进行地面弹跳能量循环；控制上采用隐式接触模型预测控制器（Contact-Implicit MPC）自动选择运动模式与驱动策略。
AI.result: 在周期性弹跳、空中飞行以及障碍物跨越过程中的自主模式切换等多种任务中成功验证了DASH的设计与控制策略。
AI.conclusion: DASH机器人通过物理极简设计与隐式接触MPC控制，成功实现了高效、高适应性的陆空两栖运动能力。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种新型且极简设计的空中-地面跨介质机器人 DASH：涵道式空中弹跳器（Ducted Aerial Spring Hopper）。其目标是在一台机械极简、运动多变且高能效的统一移动机器人上，同时实现空中与地面运动能力。我们提出将涵道风扇同轴机身与底部弹簧腿进行有机结合以实现这一目标。涵道风扇模块提供推力矢量作为敏捷飞行的主要驱动；当其与轻量化弹簧腿相结合时，机器人通过能量循环实现高效的地面弹跳。此外，为了实现两种模式下的最优运动，我们采用了隐式接触模型预测控制器来自动选择运动模式和驱动方式。我们通过一系列任务成功验证了DASH的设计与控制，包括周期性弹跳、空中飞行以及在障碍物跨越过程中具备自主模式切换的无模式运动。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了DASH（涵道空中弹跳机器人），这是一款集涵道风扇同轴机身与弹簧腿于一体的极简陆空跨介质机器人。结合隐式接触模型预测控制，DASH能够自主选择运动模式，实现高效的地面弹跳、敏捷飞行以及越障过程中的无缝模式切换。
AI.keywords: 陆空跨介质机器人, 极简设计, 隐式接触控制, 模型预测控制, 涵道弹跳
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将涵道风扇与轻量化弹簧腿进行极简物理融合，结合隐式接触模型预测控制（Contact-Implicit MPC），克服了传统跨介质机器人结构复杂、模式切换逻辑繁琐的痛点，实现了高效能与自主模式无缝切换。

title: EduPanel: A Three-Agent LLM Judge for Teaching Videos -- Reliability, Complementarity, and Human Trust Calibration
summary: Teaching videos are becoming a major medium for education, creating a growing need for scalable evaluation of their pedagogical quality. Existing automatic judges do not fully address this setting because teaching quality depends on multimodal evidence and should be evaluated with respect to the intended learner rather than as a universal property. We present EduPanel, a rubric-grounded, learner-conditioned LLM judge that decomposes evaluation across specialized agents to produce interpretable assessments for different aspects of teaching quality. Across expert studies, architecture ablations, and learner-persona analyses, EduPanel achieves reliability comparable to a median human expert. In expert evaluation, its feedback improves scoring accuracy (MAE 0.87 to 0.73), while experts remain able to detect unreliable outputs (AUC = 0.77) instead of accepting them blindly. These results suggest that EduPanel can serve as effective assistants for educational evaluation rather than replacements for human experts.

AI.title_translation: EduPanel：面向教学视频的三 Agent LLM 裁判——可靠性、互补性与人类信任校准
AI.tldr: EduPanel 是一种基于三 Agent 的 LLM 教学视频评估框架，能结合学习者设定提供可解释的评分，显著辅助人类专家提升评估准确率。
AI.motivation: 教学视频规模日益扩大，急需可扩展的质量评估手段；而现有自动评估工具忽视了教学质量依赖多模态证据且需针对具体目标学习者的特点。
AI.method: 提出 EduPanel 框架，这是一种基于评分细则（rubric-grounded）且针对特定学习者设定（learner-conditioned）的 LLM 裁判，通过三个专业 Agent 拆解评估任务，从而对教学质量的不同维度生成可解释的评估。
AI.result: EduPanel 的可靠性可媲美中位数人类专家；在专家评估中，其反馈将打分平均绝对误差（MAE）从 0.87 降至 0.73，且专家能够有效识别出不可靠的 AI 输出（AUC = 0.77），未盲目信任。
AI.conclusion: EduPanel 能够作为教育质量评估的有效辅助工具，帮助人类专家提升打分精度，同时保持人类专家的独立判断力。
AI.translation: 教学视频正成为教育的主要载体，引发了对教学质量进行可扩展评估的日益增长的需求。现有的自动裁判无法充分解决这一场景，因为教学质量依赖于多模态证据，且应当针对目标学习者进行评估，而非作为一种通用属性。我们提出了 EduPanel，这是一个基于评分标准且针对学习者情况的 LLM 裁判，它通过专业 Agent 拆解评估流程，对教学质量的不同方面生成可解释的评估。在专家研究、架构消融实验和学习者画像分析中，EduPanel 达到了与中位数人类专家相当的可靠性。在专家评估中，其反馈提升了打分准确性（MAE 从 0.87 降低到 0.73），同时专家依然能够识别不可靠的输出（AUC = 0.77），而非盲目接受。这些结果表明，EduPanel 可以作为教育评估的有效助手，而非人类专家的替代品。
AI.summary: 针对教学视频质量评估难以规模化和缺乏学习者针对性的问题，本文提出了 EduPanel 框架。该框架利用三个专门的 Agent，结合评分细则与学习者背景对教学视频进行多维度可解释评估。实验表明，EduPanel 不仅达到人类专家级别的可靠性，还能有效辅助人类专家提高打分准确率，促进良性的 Human-AI 协作。
AI.keywords: LLM Judge, Multi-Agent, Educational Video Evaluation, Pedagogical Quality, Trust Calibration
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将多 Agent 架构应用于教学视频的质量评估，并强调了结合“目标学习者”背景与评分细则（rubric-grounded）的重要性。此外，论文不仅探讨了模型本身的可靠性，还分析了人类专家如何与 AI 协作（信任校准），展示了 AI 作为辅助工具而非替代者的应用前景，具有很高的实用价值和理论意义。

title: Censoring-Aware In-Context Learning for Generalized Supplier Lead Time Estimation in Supply Chain Planning
summary: Supplier lead time forecasting is a central input to material requirements planning, inventory optimization, and supply chain risk management. However, many industrial lead time datasets are naturally right-censored: at the time forecasts are required, some orders have not yet arrived. Standard regression and classification approaches discard this information, while conventional survival models require task-specific modeling. We propose LeadTime-ICL (LT-ICL), a censoring-aware in-context learning model for probabilistic lead time forecasting. LT-ICL combines a transformer backbone with a conditional normalizing-flow head, producing a full predictive distribution over lead times. The model is pretrained on synthetic right-censored lead time tasks, enabling in-context adaptation to new industrial datasets without task-specific parameter updates. We provide theoretical support for this formulation by showing that excess CRPS is bounded by prior misspecification and amortized approximation errors, providing clear direction for improving forecasting performance. We evaluate LT-ICL on 24 proprietary supply-chain datasets spanning seven industries. LT-ICL achieves the lowest point-forecasting error on 15 of the 24 datasets, and the lowest probabilistic forecasting error on 14 datasets, yielding the best average rank across both. These results support right-censored probabilistic forecasting as a practical formulation for supplier lead time prediction and demonstrate that pretrained in-context models can provide accurate, low-adaptation-cost forecasting for industrial planning systems.

AI.title_translation: 供应链规划中泛化供应商交货时间估计的感知删失上下文学习
AI.tldr: 提出感知右删失数据的上下文学习模型 LT-ICL，实现无需微调的跨行业供应商交货时间准确概率预测。
AI.motivation: 工业供应链中的交货时间数据集普遍存在右删失问题（预测时部分订单尚未到达）。传统回归/分类方法直接丢弃未到达订单信息造成数据浪费，而传统生存模型需要针对具体任务重新训练，存在较高的自适应成本。
AI.method: 提出 LeadTime-ICL (LT-ICL) 模型，采用 Transformer 骨干网络结合条件归一化流（Conditional Normalizing-Flow）标头以输出完整的概率分布；模型在合成的右删失交货时间任务上进行预训练，实现无需参数更新的新数据集上下文自适应，并给出了基于 CRPS 的误差界限理论推导。
AI.result: 在涵盖 7 个行业的 24 个专有供应链数据集上，LT-ICL 在 15 个数据集上取得了最低的点预测误差，在 14 个数据集上取得了最低的概率预测误差，在两项指标的平均排名上均位列第一。
AI.conclusion: 感知右删失的概率预测是解决供应商交货时间预测的实用框架。基于预训练的上下文学习模型无需参数更新即可在多行业真实数据集上实现高效、高精度的预测，显著降低了工业供应链规划系统的建模与部署成本。
AI.translation: 供应商交货时间预测是物料需求计划、库存优化和供应链风险管理的核心输入。然而，许多工业交货时间数据集天然存在右删失现象：在需要预测时，某些订单尚未到达。标准的回归和分类方法丢弃了这些信息，而传统的生存模型需要针对特定任务进行建模。我们提出了 LeadTime-ICL (LT-ICL)，这是一种用于概率交货时间预测的感知删失上下文学习模型。LT-ICL 将 Transformer 骨干网络与条件归一化流（conditional normalizing-flow）标头相结合，生成交货时间的完整预测概率分布。该模型在合成的右删失交货时间任务上进行预训练，从而无需针对特定任务更新参数，即可对新工业数据集进行上下文自适应。我们通过证明过量 CRPS 受限于先验错配和自适应近似误差，为该公式提供了理论支持，为提高预测性能指明了明确方向。我们在涵盖 7 个行业的 24 个专有供应链数据集上对 LT-ICL 进行了评估。LT-ICL 在 24 个数据集中的 15 个上实现了最低的点预测误差，并在 14 个数据集上实现了最低的概率预测误差，在两者上均取得了最佳的平均排名。这些结果支持将右删失概率预测作为供应商交货时间预测的实用公式，并表明预训练的上下文模型可以为工业规划系统提供准确、低自适应成本的预测。
AI.summary: 本研究针对供应链管理中交货时间数据集普遍存在的右删失问题，提出了基于上下文学习的概率预测模型 LT-ICL。该模型结合 Transformer 与条件归一化流，经合成删失任务预训练后，无需微调即可快速适应新的工业数据，并在多行业真实数据集测试中取得了领先的点预测和概率预测精度。
AI.keywords: 供应链规划, 交货时间预测, 上下文学习, 右删失数据, 条件归一化流
AI.comments: 本论文创新性地将上下文学习（In-Context Learning）与生存分析中的右删失数据建模相结合，解决了供应链中未完成订单数据被浪费或需要针对新数据集频繁微调模型的痛点。理论界限证明与覆盖7个行业的24个数据集实验充分验证了其有效性与实用价值。潜在局限在于模型表现高度依赖合成预训练数据的质量与覆盖度，在面对极度异常的工业分布时可能存在先验错配风险。

title: Reasoning Fine-Tuning Induces Persistent Latent Policy States
comments: Accepted at the Conference on Language Modeling (COLM) 2026. 45 pages, including appendices; 24 figures and 12 tables. Code: https://github.com/withmartian/mi-cot
summary: Reasoning-specialized language models show large performance gains over base models, yet the internal changes responsible for improved multi-step reasoning remain poorly understood. It is unclear whether reasoning fine-tuning improves local token-level competence or globally reorganizes how models structure inference over time. We address this question by modeling Chain-of-Thought reasoning as a switching dynamical system (SDS), in which internal representations evolve under discrete latent policy states. Our framework combines time-aware contrastive representation learning with discrete regime discovery to recover latent policies from activation trajectories. Across four benchmarks and model scales from 1.5B to 32B parameters, reasoning-fine-tuned models exhibit richer latent-policy organization than their base counterparts, characterized by more differentiated transition structure and model-dependent changes in state utilization, persistence, and mixing. The recovered regimes exhibit functional specialization aligned with distinct reasoning stages, and extensive controls confirm that their structure is not explained by correctness, representation learning, or modeling priors, but depends on the coherent temporal organization of reasoning trajectories. Causal interventions further show that the regimes are functionally meaningful: state-swap ablations reduce one-step predictive fit, while transplanting reasoning dynamics into base models improves performance on challenging reasoning problems. Finally, SDS-guided pruning of failure-prone reasoning prefixes outperforms self-consistency in 11 of 12 model-dataset settings, with gains of up to 12.5 percentage points. Together, our results suggest that reasoning fine-tuning globally reorganizes latent dynamics, offering a new lens for mechanistic analysis and process-level control of reasoning models.
