AI.translation: 我们提出了OntoBook，一种将医学本体结构转化为编码器语言模型预训练信号的方法。我们的方法包含三个阶段：在本体图上的随机游走捕获了医学代码之间的层级和因果关系，大语言模型将这些游走路径重构为流畅的教科书风格散文，所得文本随后用于在相同数据上以两个目标训练一个包含1.49亿参数的法语编码器ModernCamemBERT：掩码语言建模（MLM）和代码对关系预测。在三个法语医学编码基准（FRACCO、Cantemist-FR、Distemist-FR）上，OntoBook相比仅使用MLM的预训练取得了显着的提升，其中FRACCO上的micro-F1提升了2.5，Distemist上提升了8.0。我们发现目标之间的对齐是必要的：未对齐的训练（即每个任务使用不同的数据）会导致30点的性能下降。我们发布了跨三种法语本体（CIM-10、CCAM、ATC）的130万篇经LLM重构的医学教科书及预训练模型权重。
AI.summary: 本文提出了OntoBook，一种通过图随机游走和LLM重构将结构化医学本体转化为合成教科书文本的方法，用于增强编码器预训练。在同一合成文本上联合训练MLM和关系预测目标后，该模型在多个法语医学编码任务上取得了优异性能，并验证了多任务预训练中数据与目标对齐的重要性。
AI.keywords: 医学本体, 合成教科书, 编码器预训练, 大语言模型, 关系预测
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于巧妙地将图结构数据（医学本体）通过随机游走与LLM重构技术转化为连续、自然的文本语料，从而为编码器模型提供了丰富的结构与语义预训练信号。研究提出的多目标对齐训练机制极具实用启示意义（证明了任务与数据对齐的重要性）。此外，开源130万篇法语医学合成语料和预训练权重，显著推动了非英语医学NLP领域的发展。

title: Error Bound and Stability Analysis for a Randomized Singly Diagonally Implicit Runge-Kutta Method
summary: A randomized Singly Diagonally Implicit Runge-Kutta (SDIRK) method, based on the randomized trapezoidal rule as the underlying quadrature scheme, is proposed. Every realization of the scheme is an algebraically stable SDIRK method of at least second order. The main result is the proof that the randomized scheme converges with order 2.5 in the root mean square sense under low regularity assumptions. Numerical experiments illustrate the robustness of the new scheme when applied to nonsmooth problems.

AI.title_translation: 随机单对角隐式Runge-Kutta方法的误差界与稳定性分析
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种代数稳定的随机SDIRK方法，并在低正则性条件下证明了其具有2.5阶均方收敛性。
AI.motivation: 旨在提高微分方程数值解法在低正则性条件和非光滑问题下的稳定性与收敛精度。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于随机梯形法则作为底求积格式的随机单对角隐式Runge-Kutta（SDIRK）方法。
AI.result: 证明了该方法的每个实现都是至少二阶代数稳定的SDIRK格式，且在低正则性假设下，随机格式在均方意义下具有2.5阶的收敛性；数值实验验证了其鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的随机SDIRK方法不仅保留了代数稳定性，而且在低正则性条件下展现出优异的收敛阶和鲁棒性，非常适合用于非光滑问题的数值求解。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种基于随机梯形法则作为基础求积格式的随机单对角隐式Runge-Kutta（SDIRK）方法。该格式的每一次实现都是至少二阶的代数稳定SDIRK方法。主要结果是证明了在低正则性假设下，该随机格式在均方意义下以2.5阶收敛。数值实验展示了新格式应用于非光滑问题时的鲁棒性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种结合随机梯形法则的随机单对角隐式Runge-Kutta（SDIRK）方法。该方法不仅保证了每次实现的代数稳定性和至少二阶的精度，还在低正则性假设下实现了2.5阶的均方收敛，数值实验证明了其在解决非光滑问题时的优异鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 随机SDIRK方法, 均方收敛性, 代数稳定性, 随机梯形法则, 非光滑问题
AI.comments: 该论文成功将随机化求积思想引入到单对角隐式Runge-Kutta（SDIRK）方法中。在低正则性条件下证明了2.5阶的均方收敛性，克服了传统确定性格式在处理非光滑或低正则性微分方程时收敛阶下降的问题，兼具代数稳定性和较高的理论收敛阶。

title: A User-oriented Portable, Reproducible, and Scalable Software Ecosystem
summary: It is normal for scientists to perform their research on a diverse set of hardware, ranging from laptops and workstations to supercomputers and cloud resources. The standard scenario requires a mix of these resources. In this paper we describe a software ecosystem that enables users to rely on the same development environment for running their workflows across the different computational resources. We describe a modular, unified command-line interface that allows for the interaction with a user-workflow across diverse hardware platform. The software ecosystem has been successfully tested as part of the plan4res EU H2020 project. It can be extended to other projects with similar requirements, so that they can benefit from the same approach for executing computational workflows.

AI.title_translation: 一个面向用户的便携式、可复现且可扩展的软件生态系统
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个模块化且统一的软件生态系统，支持用户在笔记本、超算及云平台等不同计算资源上使用同一开发环境运行工作流。
AI.motivation: 科研人员通常需要在从笔记本电脑、工作站到超级计算机和云平台等多种异构硬件资源上开展研究工作，频繁切换环境导致工作流复现与跨平台运行困难。
AI.method: 提出了一个模块化且统一的命令行界面（CLI），允许用户通过统一的交互接口在多种硬件平台上管理和运行其工作流，并保持一致的开发环境。
AI.result: 该软件生态系统已在欧盟 H2020 plan4res 项目中成功进行了测试与应用。
AI.conclusion: 该生态系统具有良好的通用性，可扩展至具有类似多平台计算需求的其他科研与工程项目中，从而推广这种统一的计算工作流执行方法。
AI.translation: 科学家在从笔记本电脑、工作站到超级计算机和云资源等各种不同的硬件上开展研究是十分普遍的现象。标准场景通常需要结合使用这些资源。在本文中，我们描述了一个软件生态系统，使用户能够依赖同一个开发环境在不同的计算资源上运行其工作流。我们描述了一个模块化、统一的命令行界面，允许跨不同硬件平台与用户工作流进行交互。该软件生态系统已作为欧盟 H2020 plan4res 项目的一部分成功进行了测试。它可以扩展到具有类似需求的其他项目，从而使它们能够从执行计算工作流的相同方法中受益。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一种面向用户的可扩展软件生态系统，旨在解决多计算平台间工作流难以统一管理和复现的问题。该系统通过模块化、统一的命令行界面，使用户能在从个人设备到超级计算机的各类硬件上无缝运行相同的开发环境与工作流。该方案已在欧盟大型项目中得到成功验证并具备广泛推广潜力。
AI.keywords: 软件生态系统, 工作流跨平台, 统一命令行界面, 可复现性, 计算资源集成
AI.comments: 该研究针对科研工作在异构计算资源（如本地设备、超算、云资源）间切换时面临的工作流配置复杂、难以复现等痛点，提出了统一的软件生态解决方案，极大提升了跨平台开发与计算的便利性。其局限性在于摘要未透露具体的底层技术实现（如容器技术或环境隔离机制）及性能损耗情况。

title: Functional Equivalence and Geometric Diversity in Neural Network Approximations: An Empirical Characterization
summary: The Universal Approximation Theorem states that a neural network with a single hidden layer is sufficient to approximate any continuous univariate function on a compact domain to arbitrary error. However, the uniqueness of such neural network representations is not guaranteed, raising questions about practical identifiability. In this work, we address this concern by analyzing functional equivalence and geometric diversity of neural network approximations to a few elementary mathematical functions. The analysis includes an extensive study of single-layer neural networks and multilayer perceptrons under noisy and noise-free conditions. Beyond just network capacity, we study the geometric properties through the lens of sloppiness, characterized by the eigen spectrum of the Hessian of the cost function and the effective rank to quantify the dimensionality of parameter space. The study reveals large equivalence classes of functionally indistinguishable yet geometrically diverse networks that consistently exhibit low effective rank and structural redundancy. Finally, a model select criterion is proposed for identifying optimal models based on parsimony, ease of estimation, and inference efficiency.

AI.title_translation: 神经网络近似中的功能等价性与几何多样性：一项经验表征
AI.tldr: 本文通过Hessian特征谱和有效秩分析了神经网络近似过程中的功能等价性与几何多样性，揭示了参数空间的低有效秩特征，并提出了全新的模型选择标准。
AI.motivation: 虽然通用近似定理保证了单隐层神经网络近似连续函数的能力，但其神经网络表示的唯一性无法得到保证，导致实际应用中模型的可识别性（identifiability）存在疑问。
AI.method: 在含噪与无噪条件下，对单层神经网络和多层感知机近似初等数学函数的过程进行深入实证研究；利用损失函数Hessian矩阵的特征谱分析“松弛性”（sloppiness），并借助有效秩（effective rank）来定量刻画参数空间的几何维度与拓扑特性。
AI.result: 研究发现了大量在功能上不可区分（预测输出一致）但在几何结构上多样化的网络等价类。这些网络一致表现出较低的有效秩和显著的结构冗余。
AI.conclusion: 神经网络近似中存在广泛的功能等价性与几何多样性。针对模型冗余与可识别性问题，提出的兼顾模型简洁性、估计难度和推理效率的模型选择标准，能够有效指导最优神经网络架构的筛选。
AI.translation: 通用近似定理指出，包含单个隐藏层的神经网络足以在紧域上以任意误差近似任何连续单变量函数。然而，此类神经网络表示的唯一性无法得到保证，从而引发了关于实际可识别性的疑问。在本文中，我们通过分析神经网络在近似几种初等数学函数时的功能等价性和几何多样性来解决这一关切。该分析包括在含噪和无噪条件下对单层神经网络和多层感知机的广泛研究。除了网络容量之外，我们还通过松弛性（sloppiness）的视角研究了几何特性，其特征在于损失函数 Hessian 矩阵的特征谱以及用于量化参数空间维度的有效秩。研究揭示了大量在功能上不可区分但在几何上多样化的网络等价类，它们一致表现出低有效秩和结构冗余。最后，提出了一种模型选择标准，用于基于简洁性、估计容易性和推理效率来确定最佳模型。
AI.summary: 本文针对神经网络近似过程中的实证可识别性问题，深入研究了模型的功能等价性与几何多样性。研究通过 Hessian 特征谱和有效秩分析了单层及多层网络在无噪/含噪数据下的参数空间几何特性，揭示了参数空间中广泛存在的低有效秩与冗余性，并据此提出了一套综合评估简洁性、估计难度和推理效率的模型选择标准。
AI.keywords: 通用近似定理, 功能等价性, 几何多样性, 松弛性, 模型选择
AI.comments: 本研究创新性地引入了“松弛性”（Sloppiness）概念、Hessian矩阵特征谱以及有效秩（Effective Rank），从几何视角深刻揭示了神经网络在功能等价下的参数空间冗余与非唯一性（可识别性问题）。其重要性在于为过度参数化神经网络的解空间提供了实证表征，并基于简洁性与效率提出了实用的模型选择标准。局限性在于实验主要基于简单的初等数学函数，未来需要进一步验证该表征在超大规模深度学习模型和复杂真实数据集上的适用性。

title: AI-Powered Browsers Are Broadly Accurate News Summarizers That Reduce Political Bias and Negative Affect
summary: Web browsers now provide AI-generated news summaries for millions of users. Despite their popularity and influence, we lack a systematic understanding of how these systems transform news before people read it. Through a large-scale audit, we investigate the factual accuracy of browser-based AI summarizers and how they alter the political bias, negative affect, and journalistic writing quality of news. Drawing on 13,777 articles from 15 U.S. news outlets, we evaluate their 41,331 summaries generated by three leading AI-powered browsers: Google Chrome (Gemini), Microsoft Edge (Copilot), and Perplexity Comet. We find that browser-based AI summarizers are broadly accurate. Furthermore, they consistently transform news by attenuating ideological bias, partisan stances, negativity, anger, and fear, while increasing clarity and reducing personal tone. With some variations, these patterns hold across browsers, outlet ideologies, and topics. Our findings identify AI-powered browsers as a new class of editorial intermediaries that systematically reshape news, with implications for democratic discourse and AI governance.

AI.title_translation: AI驱动的浏览器是大致准确的新闻摘要工具，能够减少政治偏见和消极情绪
AI.tldr: 大规模实证研究表明，主流AI浏览器的新闻摘要功能不仅大致准确，而且能显著减少新闻中的政治偏见、党派立场和负面情绪（如愤怒与恐惧），提升文章清晰度。
AI.motivation: 虽然AI生成的新闻摘要已被广泛应用，但缺乏对其在新闻传播给公众之前如何系统性重塑和改变新闻内容的科学理解。
AI.method: 对三大主流AI驱动浏览器（Google Chrome/Gemini、Microsoft Edge/Copilot、Perplexity Comet）进行了大规模审计。研究涵盖来自15家美国新闻媒体的13,777篇文章，评估了其生成的41,331份摘要在事实准确性、政治偏见、消极情绪和新闻写作质量等方面的表现。
AI.result: 研究发现基于浏览器的AI摘要工具总体上具有较高的事实准确性。更重要的是，它们持续降低了新闻中的意识形态偏见、党派立场、消极情绪（如愤怒与恐惧），同时提升了文质的清晰度并减少了个人化语气。这些发现跨越不同的浏览器、媒体立场和新闻主题均普遍成立。
AI.conclusion: AI驱动的浏览器正在成为一种新型的“编辑中介”，系统性地重塑新闻内容的呈现方式，这对于公众民主议程和AI治理政策的制定具有重要启示。
AI.translation: 网页浏览器现在为数以百万计的用户提供AI生成的新闻摘要。尽管这些系统非常流行且具有影响力，但我们缺乏对它们在人们阅读新闻前如何改变新闻内容的系统性理解。通过一项大规模审计，我们调查了基于浏览器的AI摘要生成器的事实准确性，以及它们如何改变新闻的政治偏见、消极情绪和新闻写作质量。基于来自15家美国新闻媒体的13,777篇文章，我们评估了由三种领先的AI驱动浏览器（Google Chrome (Gemini)、Microsoft Edge (Copilot) 和 Perplexity Comet）生成的41,331份摘要。我们发现基于浏览器的AI摘要生成器总体上是准确的。此外，它们通过减弱意识形态偏见、党派立场、消极情绪、愤怒和恐惧，同时提高清晰度并减少个人语气，持续重塑新闻。尽管存在一些微小差异，但这些模式在不同的浏览器、媒体意识形态和主题中均成立。我们的研究结果将AI驱动的浏览器定性为一种新型编辑中介，它们系统性地重塑新闻，对民主议程和AI治理具有深远影响。
AI.summary: 本研究通过对三大主流AI浏览器生成的大规模新闻摘要进行实证审计，评估了其事实准确度及对政治偏见和消极情绪的处理。结果表明AI摘要不仅大致准确，还能有效中和偏见和负面情绪，提高文章清晰度，正在成为重塑新闻生态的新型编辑中介。
AI.keywords: AI浏览器, 新闻摘要, 政治偏见, 消极情绪, 大规模审计
AI.comments: 创新性：本文首次对嵌入主流浏览器中的生成式AI新闻摘要功能进行了系统性的实证审计，揭示了AI作为信息“中介”对政治偏见和情绪的去激化作用。重要性：随着数百万用户依赖AI摘要获取每日新闻，理解AI如何塑造信息消费对于民主议程、公众舆论和AI监管治理至关重要。局限性：研究样本仅基于美国15家新闻媒体的英语报道，其结论是否适用于非英语语境或其他国家的媒体生态仍需进一步检验。

title: Transcription Policy as a Latent Variable: Activating Controllable Verbatim ASR with Word-Level Timing
summary: Modern ASR models trained on heterogeneously annotated data treat transcription style (verbatim vs. intended) as an uncontrolled latent variable, causing measurable decoding instability, evaluation confounding (up to 60% of reported WER attributable to style mismatch), and unreliable word-level timing. We show that models already encode both styles; the challenge is controlled activation. Using coverage-aware decoder task tokens trained on parallel verbatim/intended transcript pairs, we raise German disfluency F1 from 10% to 79% zero-shot, despite English-only training. Full English-only fine-tuning surpasses all baselines in verbatim accuracy, disfluency detection, and intended-mode quality across both languages. We further introduce supervised cross-attention fine-tuning that improves word-level timestamps on disfluent speech beyond forced-alignment baselines. Finally, we propose verbatimize, a new task enabling scalable creation and enrichment of speech corpora with high-quality canonical verbatim transcriptions.

AI.title_translation: 将转写策略作为隐变量：结合词级时间戳激活可控的逐字语音识别
AI.tldr: 本文提出了覆盖感知的任务标记和监督交叉注意力微调，实现了对ASR转写风格（逐字/意图）的可控切换，并大幅提升了不流畅语音的识别精度与词级时间戳对齐效果。
AI.motivation: 现代ASR模型因训练于不同标注风格的数据，将“逐字转写（verbatim）”与“意图转写（intended）”视为不可控的隐变量，导致解码不稳定、评估混淆（高达60%的WER源于风格不匹配）以及词级时间戳不准确。
AI.method: 1. 使用在平行逐字/意图转写对上训练的覆盖感知（coverage-aware）解码器任务标记（task tokens）来显式控制生成风格；2. 采用监督式交叉注意力微调（supervised cross-attention fine-tuning）以优化不流畅语音的词级时间戳；3. 提出新任务“verbatimize”用于规模化生成高质量逐字转写数据。
AI.result: 1. 仅凭英文训练，在德语不流畅检测上的F1值从10%零样本提升至79%；2. 全英文微调在跨语言的逐字准确率、不流畅检测及意图模式质量上均超越所有基线；3. 监督交叉注意力微调在不流畅语音上的词级时间戳精度超越了强制对齐基线。
AI.conclusion: ASR模型内部已经隐式编码了逐字与意图两种转写风格，通过覆盖感知的任务标记和监督交叉注意力微调，可以实现精确且可控的风格切换与词级时间戳定位，同时为大规模语料库构建提供了新的范式。
AI.translation: 训练于异质标注数据上的现代ASR模型将转写风格（逐字 vs 意图）视为未受控制的隐变量，导致可测量的解码不稳定性、评估混淆（报道的WER中有高达60%可归因于风格不匹配）以及不可靠的词级时间戳。我们表明模型内部已经编码了这两种风格，核心挑战在于进行可控激活。通过在平行的逐字/意图转写文本对上训练覆盖感知的解码器任务标记，尽管仅使用英文进行训练，我们仍将德语不流畅性F1值从10%零样本提升到了79%。全英文微调在跨两种语言的逐字准确率、不流畅性检测和意图模式质量上均超越了所有基线。我们进一步引入了监督式交叉注意力微调，改善了不流畅语音上的词级时间戳，超越了强制对齐基线。最后，我们提出了verbatimize，这是一项能够大规模创建和丰富具有高质量规范逐字转写的语音语料库的新任务。
AI.summary: 本文针对ASR中转写风格不可控导致的性能不稳定与WER评估偏差问题，提出了通过覆盖感知任务标记显式控制逐字/意图转写模式的方法。实验表明该方法具备强大的零样本跨语言迁移能力，结合监督交叉注意力微调能够显著提升不流畅语音的识别精度与词级时间戳质量。
AI.keywords: 自动语音识别, 逐字转写, 可控生成, 词级时间戳, 不流畅检测
AI.comments: 本研究的创新点在于将传统ASR中被忽视的“转写风格（逐字 vs 意图）”显式建模为可控变量，成功解决了多风格混淆导致的WER计算偏差和解码不稳定问题。其通过覆盖感知的Task Token实现了强力的跨语言零样本迁移（英文训练直接提升德语指标），并利用交叉注意力提升了不流畅语音的时间戳精度。局限性在于摘要未明确说明构建平行逐字/意图文本对的数据成本。

title: Online Stochastic Matchings: Stability on Hypergraphs
summary: We study stochastic dynamic matching on hypergraphs: items of finitely many classes arrive over time and are removed in multisets by activating hyperedges. We characterize stabilizability, the existence of a matching policy under which the queue process is positive recurrent, in terms of the arrival rates and the incidence matrix alone: (G, $λ$) is stabilizable if and only if the conservation equation A$μ$ = $λ$ admits a nonnegative solution whose support induces a surjective submatrix, equivalently $λ$ lies in the interior of the cone generated by the hyperedges. This extends a characterization known for simple graphs (non-bipartiteness together with the independent-set inequalities) to arbitrary hyperedges, allowing multiplicities and mono-edges, and, unlike the constant-regret theory, needs no general-position assumption. Sufficiency is constructive: a single $λ$-oblivious policy, Virtual-Queue Match-the-Longest (VQML), a rewardless variant of the Extended Greedy Primal-Dual policy of Nazari and Stolyar, stabilizes every stabilizable instance and is therefore maximally stable.

AI.title_translation: 在线随机匹配：超图上的稳定性
AI.tldr: 本文刻画了超图上随机动态匹配可稳定性的充要条件，并提出了一种具备最大稳定性且无需到达率信息的VQML匹配策略。
AI.motivation: 旨在将简单图上已知的动态随机匹配可稳定性刻画（非二分性及独立集不等式）推广到允许多重边和单边的任意超图结构，并摆脱传统常数遗憾理论对一般位置假设（general-position assumption）的依赖。
AI.method: 通过结合到达率与关联矩阵分析守恒方程与超边生成锥的几何性质；提出了一种不依赖到达率参数（λ-oblivious）的“虚拟队列最长匹配”（VQML）策略（即Nazari和Stolyar扩展贪婪原始-双重策略的无奖励变体）。
AI.result: 证明了系统(G, λ)可稳定当且仅当守恒方程 Aμ = λ 存在非负解且其支撑集导出满射子矩阵，等价于λ位于超边生成的锥内部；同时证明了所提出的VQML策略能够稳定任意可稳定的实例，从而实现了最大稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 本文完整刻画了超图上随机动态匹配系统的可稳定性充要条件，并构造了一个不依赖到达率参数且具备最大稳定性的匹配策略（VQML）。
AI.translation: 我们研究了超图上的随机动态匹配：有限多个类别的物品随着时间到达，并通过激活超边以多重集的形式被移除。我们仅根据到达率和关联矩阵刻画了可稳定性（即存在一个匹配策略使队列过程正复现）：(G, λ) 是可稳定的，当且仅当守恒方程 Aμ = λ 存在一个非负解，其支撑集导出满射子矩阵，这等价于 λ 位于由超边生成的锥的内部。这把已知用于简单图的刻画（非二分性结合独立集不等式）推广到了允许重边和单边的任意超图，并且与常数遗憾理论不同，它不需要一般位置假设。充分性是构造性的：单一的对 λ 无感的策略——虚拟队列最长匹配（VQML，Nazari 和 Stolyar 的扩展贪婪原始-对偶策略的一种无奖励变体）稳定了每一个可稳定实例，因此是最大稳定的。
AI.summary: 本文研究了超图上的随机动态匹配问题。作者仅凭到达率和关联矩阵，给出了队列过程正复现（即系统可稳定）的充要几何与代数条件，成功将简单图上的传统结论推广至包含多重边和单边的任意超图。此外，文章构造了一种无需感知到达率的VQML策略，证明了其对于所有可稳定实例均能实现系统稳定，具有最大稳定性。
AI.keywords: 随机动态匹配, 超图, 可稳定性, 虚拟队列, 最大稳定性
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将随机动态匹配的可稳定性理论从简单图推广到了更为通用的超图结构，克服了此前理论对一般位置假设的依赖。提出的VQML策略不仅构造巧妙，而且具备到达率不敏感（λ-oblivious）和最大稳定性的优良性质，在队列网络和资源调度领域具有重要的理论与应用价值。

title: NGPS: GPS-Denied Aerial Geo-Localization and 2.5D Reconstruction via Deep Satellite Image Matching and Multi-Rate Sensor Fusion
comments: 9 pages (8-page paper + IEEE copyright/citation cover page), 6 figures. Accepted to IEEE/RSJ IROS 2026
summary: We present NGPS (Next-Generation Positioning System), a visual geo-localization framework for high-altitude UAVs that provides GPS-free absolute positioning by matching down-facing images to georeferenced satellite imagery with deep features. The system combines (1) adaptive confidence-weighted UKF fusion, where NGPS covariance is modulated by RANSAC inlier ratio, reprojection error, and match confidence; (2) velocity-predictive kernel extraction, using VIO velocity to predict the satellite search region; and (3) an asynchronous multi-rate temporal priority queue that interleaves absolute position (1-2 Hz), VIO (10-20 Hz), and IMU (100-200 Hz) updates in chronological order. Globally optimized poses from VINS pose-graph optimization, anchored by NGPS corrections, further enable real-time 2.5D georeferenced orthomosaic reconstruction. On five flight sequences (60-150 m AGL), NGPS achieves 2.94 m position RMSE, with worst-case ATE 6.04 m at 150 m AGL and 2 m/s, yielding a 3.5x improvement over standalone monocular VIO. The system runs in real time on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX. Part of the implementation is open-sourced at https://github.com/snktshrma/ngps_flight.
comment: 9 pages (8-page paper + IEEE copyright/citation cover page), 6 figures. Accepted to IEEE/RSJ IROS 2026

AI.title_translation: NGPS：基于深度卫星图像匹配与多速率传感器融合的无GPS空中地理定位与2.5D重建
AI.tldr: NGPS通过卫星图像深度匹配与多速率传感器融合，实现了无人机在无GPS环境下的实时绝对定位与2.5D地图重建，精度比单目VIO提升3.5倍。
AI.motivation: 高空无人机在GPS信号缺失或被干扰的环境中难以获取绝对地理位置，且传统单目视觉惯性里程计（VIO）存在累积漂移问题，需要实现高精度的无GPS绝对定位与实时2.5D地图重建。
AI.method: NGPS系统包含三大核心模块：（1）自适应置信度加权UKF融合，通过RANSAC内点率、重投影误差和匹配置信度调制协方差；（2）速度预测核提取，利用VIO速度预测卫星检索区域；（3）异步多速率时间优先队列，按按时间顺序交织绝对位置（1-2 Hz）、VIO（10-20 Hz）和IMU（100-200 Hz）更新。此外，系统通过NGPS校正锚定VINS位姿图优化，生成实时2.5D正射影像图。
AI.result: 在60-150米相对地面高度的5个飞行序列测试中，NGPS实现了2.94米的定位均方根误差（RMSE），最坏情况下的绝对轨迹误差（ATE）为6.04米，相比独立单目VIO性能提升了3.5倍，并在NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX上实现了实时运行。
AI.conclusion: NGPS成功解决高空无人机在GPS拒绝环境下的绝对定位与地图重建难题，在边缘计算设备上达到了高精度与实时运行的要求，大幅优于传统单目VIO。
AI.translation: 我们提出了NGPS（下一代定位系统），这是一种用于高空无人机的视觉地理定位框架，通过将向下拍摄的图像与具有深度特征的地理参考卫星图像进行匹配，提供无GPS的绝对定位。该系统结合了：（1）自适应置信度加权UKF融合，其中NGPS协方差由RANSAC内点率、重投影误差和匹配置信度进行调制；（2）速度预测核提取，利用VIO速度预测卫星搜索区域；以及（3）异步多速率时间优先队列，按时间顺序交织绝对位置（1-2 Hz）、VIO（10-20 Hz）和IMU（100-200 Hz）更新。由NGPS校正锚定的VINS位姿图优化全局优化位姿，进一步实现了实时2.5D地理参考正射影像图重建。在五个飞行序列（相对地面高度60-150米）中，NGPS实现了2.94米的定位均方根误差（RMSE），在150米高度和2米/秒速度下的最坏情况绝对轨迹误差（ATE）为6.04米，比独立单目VIO提升了3.5倍。该系统在NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX上实时运行。部分实现已在https://github.com/snktshrma/ngps_flight开源。
AI.summary: 本文提出了NGPS框架，通过将无人机下视图像与卫星图像进行深度特征匹配，结合自适应UKF融合、速度预测搜索区域和异步多速率传感器时间队列，实现了高空无人机在无GPS环境下的高精度绝对定位与实时2.5D正射重建。
AI.keywords: 视觉地理定位, 无GPS导航, 卫星图像匹配, 多传感器融合, 2.5D重建
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将深度卫星图匹配与低延迟的多速率传感器融合（IMU、VIO、低频视觉定位）巧妙结合，并引入速度预测来缩小匹配搜索空间，大大提升了无GPS环境下无人机定位的实时性与抗漂移能力。在Jetson Orin NX边缘设备上的部署与开源更增加了其工程实用价值。局限性在于测试场景主要集中在60-150米高度及较低飞行速度（2 m/s），对于更高动态飞行或地貌跨季节/剧烈变动条件下的匹配鲁棒性仍有待进一步验证。

title: The Twist Decomposition of Serial Robots Under Lower-Mobility Tasks
summary: This paper introduces a twist decomposition framework for serial manipulators performing lower mobility tasks. Rather than relying on Jacobian null-space projections, the method separates the end-effector twist into task and redundant components using geometrically defined twist projectors. This formulation provides a direct and intuitive distinction between task-relevant and task-irrelevant motions in operational space, enabling a compact inverse kinematics scheme that naturally handles both manipulator and task redundancy.

AI.title_translation: 低自由度任务下串联机器人的运动旋量分解
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对低自由度任务的串联机械臂旋量分解框架，通过几何投影仪分离任务与冗余运动，实现了紧凑且自然处理双重冗余的逆运动学求解。
AI.motivation: 传统的雅可比零空间投影在区分任务相关与任务无关运动时不够直观且计算较为繁琐，需要一种更直接、直观的方法来处理低自由度任务中的机械臂冗余和任务冗余。
AI.method: 提出了基于几何定义的旋量投影仪（twist projectors）的旋量分解框架，直接将末端执行器的运动旋量划分为任务相关分量与任务无关（冗余）分量，避免了依赖雅可比零空间投影。
AI.result: 在操作空间中实现了对任务相关与任务无关运动的直接直观区分，建立了一种紧凑的逆运动学求解方案，能够自然流畅地同时解决机械臂冗余与任务冗余问题。
AI.conclusion: 基于几何旋量投影仪的旋量分解框架为解决低自由度任务下串联机械臂的逆运动学问题提供了一种简洁、高效且自然的方法。
AI.translation: 本文针对执行低自由度任务的串联机械臂，提出了一种运动旋量分解框架。该方法不依赖雅可比零空间投影，而是利用几何定义的旋量投影仪将末端执行器的运动旋量分离为任务分量和冗余分量。这种公式化表述在操作空间中对任务相关与任务无关运动提供了直接且直观的区分，从而能够建立一种紧凑的逆运动学方案，自然地处理机械臂冗余和任务冗余。
AI.summary: 本文针对执行低自由度任务的串联机械臂，提出了一种全新的运动旋量分解框架。该方法利用几何旋量投影仪代替传统的雅可比零空间投影，将末端执行器旋量拆分为任务与冗余两部分，从而构建出可自然处理机械臂和任务双重冗余的紧凑逆运动学方案。
AI.keywords: 串联机械臂, 旋量分解, 低自由度任务, 逆运动学, 冗余处理
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于跳出了传统的雅可比矩阵零空间投影思路，采用几何定义的旋量投影仪直接进行运动学分解。这种方法物理概念直观，能够显著简化同时存在机械臂冗余与任务冗余时的逆运动学求解复杂度，在机器人运动控制领域具有重要的应用价值。

title: A Griesmer-Type Bound for List-Decodable Linear Codes
summary: A code $C\subseteq F_q^n$ is $(τ,L)$-list-decodable if every Hamming ball of radius $τ$ contains at most $L$ codewords of $C$. Here $τ$ is the list-decoding radius, and $L$ is the list size. Singleton-type bounds constrain the radius and the rate when $L$ is fixed. These bounds are not the only possible constraints on list-decodable codes. In this paper, we derive an upper bound on the list-decoding radius in terms of generalized Hamming weights. As a consequence, for $1\le L\le q-1$, every $(τ,L)$-list-decodable $q$-ary linear code has minimum distance at least $ τ+\left\lfloor \fracτ{L}\right\rfloor+1. $ Combining this lower bound with the classical Griesmer bound gives a Griesmer-type lower bound on the block length. For $q=3^a$, we construct an explicit family of $q$-ary linear $[q+3,2,q+1]$ codes. These codes are $(2q/3,2)$-list-decodable and meet the Griesmer-type bound with equality. They do not attain the Singleton-type bound. Thus the Griesmer-type bound can be a strict improvement over the Singleton-type bound.

AI.title_translation: 列表可译码线性码的 Griesmer 型界
AI.tldr: 本文推导出了列表可译码线性码的 Griesmer 型码长下界，并显式构造了达到该下界且优于 Singleton 型界的码族。
AI.motivation: 经典的 Singleton 型界并不是对列表可译码约束的唯一限制，需要建立更紧致的界来刻画列表解码半径、码长与码率等参数之间的理论极限。
AI.method: 基于广义 Hamming 权重推导列表解码半径的上界；导出最小距离与列表解码半径的关系；结合经典 Griesmer 界推导码长的 Griesmer 型下界；并通过具体代数构造给出达到该界的码族。
AI.result: 证明了当 $1\le L\le q-1$ 时，$(τ,L)$-列表可译码线性码的最小距离满足 $d \ge τ+\lfloor τ/L \rfloor+1$ 并导出了对应的 Griesmer 型码长下界；对 $q=3^a$ 构造了达到该下界且不满足 Singleton 型界极值的 $[q+3,2,q+1]$ 码族。
AI.conclusion: Griesmer 型界能够为列表可译码线性码的码长提供更紧致的下界，在某些参数下实现了对 Singleton 型界的严格改进。
AI.translation: 如果每个半径为 $τ$ 的 Hamming 球最多包含码 $C$ 的 $L$ 个码字，则码 $C\subseteq F_q^n$ 是 $(τ,L)$-列表可译码的。这里 $τ$ 是列表解码半径，$L$ 是列表大小。当 $L$ 固定时，Singleton 型界限制了半径和码率。这些界并不是对列表可译码约束的唯一可能限制。在本文中，我们根据广义 Hamming 权重推导出了列表解码半径的上界。因此，对于 $1\le L\le q-1$，每个 $(τ,L)$-列表可译码 $q$ 进制线性码的最小距离至少为 $τ+\left\lfloor \fracτ{L}\right\rfloor+1$。将该下界与经典的 Griesmer 界相结合，得到了码长的一个 Griesmer 型下界。对于 $q=3^a$，我们显式构造了一类 $q$ 进制线性 $[q+3,2,q+1]$ 码。这些码是 $(2q/3,2)$-列表可译码的，且等号成立地达到了 Griesmer 型界。它们没有达到 Singleton 型界。因此，Griesmer 型界可以是对 Singleton 型界的严格改进。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了列表可译码线性码的参数界问题。作者利用广义 Hamming 权重推导出了列表解码半径的上界以及最小下界关系，并结合经典 Griesmer 界提出了列表可译码线性码的 Griesmer 型界。此外，论文还构造了 $q=3^a$ 时达到该界的一类显式线性码，表明该界可以严格优于 Singleton 型界。
AI.keywords: 列表可译码, 线性码, Griesmer界, 广义Hamming权重, 编码理论
AI.comments: 本文创新地将广义 Hamming 权重引入列表解码问题的研究中，导出了列表可译码线性码的 Griesmer 型界。显式码族的构造有力地证明了该界在某些情况下优于传统的 Singleton 型界，具有重要的理论价值。

title: What General Intelligence Requires: Non-Reducible Constraints Across Levels of Description
summary: General intelligence, of the kind that underwrites the full range of human cognitive achievement, is not a property of computational architecture alone. This paper advances a single thesis: the structural constraints on general intelligence occupy distinct levels of description and are mutually non-reducible, in the sense that the special-sciences tradition gives to that term. It follows that no single architectural advance, and no continuation of the scaling programme by itself, can produce artificial general intelligence (AGI), and that research programmes must be evaluated against the full constraint profile rather than against performance on any one benchmark. The thesis is developed through a method that reads general intelligence through four evidential lenses, AI systems research, anthropology, law, and economics, each anchored to a distinct level of description, supplemented by speculative fiction used as a disciplined heuristic in the context of discovery rather than the context of justification. Applying the method yields a taxonomy of twenty-three structural constraints organised into eight clusters; six are examined in depth and ordered as an ascending ladder of levels, with explicit bridges showing why progress at one level cannot carry to the next. The argument issues in five falsifiable predictions, each stated with a named benchmark family and a disconfirmation condition, converting a descriptive framework into a research programme with a longer horizon than the scaling hypothesis implies.

AI.title_translation: 通用智能需要什么：跨描述层级的不可约约束
AI.tldr: 通用智能不仅是计算架构的问题，其结构性约束存在于不同且不可约的描述层级。因此，单一架构进步或规模化无法单独实现AGI，需要针对全面的约束进行研究。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在挑战当前认为通过计算架构进步或简单扩展就能实现人工通用智能（AGI）的观点，指出通用智能的复杂性在于其跨多层次的不可约约束。
AI.method: 通过AI系统研究、人类学、法律和经济学这四个证据视角来解读通用智能，每个视角都锚定一个不同的描述层级。此外，还使用推测性小说作为发现语境中的启发式工具。
AI.result: 提出了一个包含23个结构约束的分类法，组织成8个集群。深入研究了其中6个，并将其排列成一个上升的层级阶梯，明确指出为什么在一个层级的进展不能自动延伸到下一个层级。论文还提出了五个可证伪的预测。
AI.conclusion: 实现人工通用智能（AGI）需要一个更长远的研究计划，该计划必须评估全面的约束而非单一基准的表现。单一的架构进步或规模化无法单独产生AGI。
AI.translation: 通用智能，即支撑人类全部认知成就的那种智能，并非仅仅是计算架构的属性。本文提出了一个单一的论点：通用智能的结构性约束占据着不同的描述层级，并且它们是相互不可约的，其含义与特殊科学传统赋予该术语的意义相同。由此可见，任何单一的架构进步，以及单独的规模化程序的延续，都无法产生人工通用智能（AGI），并且研究计划必须根据完整的约束概况而非任何一个基准的表现来评估。该论点是通过一种方法发展起来的，该方法通过四个证据视角（AI系统研究、人类学、法律和经济学）来解读通用智能，每个视角都锚定一个不同的描述层级，并辅以推测性小说作为发现语境而非论证语境中的一种受控启发式工具。应用该方法产生了一个包含23个结构约束的分类法，组织成8个集群；其中6个得到了深入研究，并被排序为上升的层级阶梯，明确的桥梁展示了为什么在一个层级的进展不能延续到下一个层级。该论点提出了五个可证伪的预测，每个预测都附有命名的基准族和反驳条件，从而将一个描述性框架转化为一个比规模化假设所暗示的更具长期视野的研究计划。
AI.summary: 本文提出通用智能的结构性约束存在于不同且相互不可约的描述层级，挑战了仅凭计算架构进步或规模化就能实现人工通用智能（AGI）的观点。作者通过AI系统研究、人类学、法律和经济学等四个视角，并结合推测性小说，识别出23个结构约束，并将其组织成八个集群。研究深入探讨了其中六个约束，并指出不同层级间的进展无法直接迁移。最终，论文提出了五个可证伪的预测，旨在将描述性框架转化为一个更具长期视野的AGI研究计划。
AI.keywords: 通用智能, 不可约约束, 人工通用智能, 跨学科研究, 认知架构
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新之处在于它挑战了当前AGI研究中普遍存在的“规模化假设”，即认为通过简单地增加模型规模或计算能力就能实现通用智能。它强调了通用智能的本质是多层次、不可约的约束系统，并提供了一个跨学科的分析框架。这对于指导未来AGI研究的方向具有重要意义，促使研究人员超越单一技术层面的进步，考虑更广泛的社会、文化和认知维度。

title: Constrained CTC Decoding for Efficient Diacritic Restoration
summary: In this work, we address diacritic restoration for Arabic speech transcripts. Most speech data are undiacritized, limiting the ability of modeling fine-grained phonological distinctions. The speech modality has recently been explored as a way to complement text-based diacritic restoration efforts. We propose an efficient non-autoregressive approach for speech-to-text diacritization based on Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC). Our method incorporates hard constraints during decoding by constructing a character-level diacritization lattice from an undiacritized transcript and restricting hypotheses to valid diacritized realizations. We evaluate on Classical Arabic and Modern Standard Arabic test sets (namely, ArVoice and ClArTTS) against a more computationally-complex multi-modal diacritic restoration baseline, and show statistically significant reductions in diacritic error rates in both, demonstrating that the proposed approach offers both performance and efficiency gains.

AI.title_translation: 用于高效变音符号恢复的受限 CTC 解码
AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于受限CTC解码的高效非自回归阿拉伯语语音变音符号恢复方法，兼具高准确率与计算效率。
AI.motivation: 大多数阿拉伯语语音文本缺乏变音符号，这限制了建模细粒度语音特征的能力；而现有的结合语音模态的复原方法计算复杂度较高。
AI.method: 提出一种基于连接主义时间分类（CTC）的高效非自回归语音到文本变音方法。该方法在解码过程中加入硬约束，利用无变音文本构建字符级变音格点，并将生成的假设限制在有效的带变音文本实现范围内。
AI.result: 在古典阿拉伯语和现代标准阿拉伯语测试集（ArVoice和ClArTTS）上的评估表明，与更复杂的多模态基线相比，该方法显著降低了变音错误率（DER）。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明，所提出的受限CTC解码方法在阿拉伯语变音符号恢复任务上同时实现了性能（变音错误率显著降低）与效率的提升。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们针对阿拉伯语语音转写文本的变音符号恢复问题展开研究。大多数语音数据都不带变音符号，这限制了对细粒度语音特征建模的能力。近期，语音模态已被作为补充基于文本的变音恢复工作的一种途径。我们提出了一种基于连接主义时间分类（CTC）的高效非自回归语音到文本变音方法。我们的方法在解码过程中结合了硬约束，即从无变音文本中构建字符级变音格点，并将假设限制为有效的带变音实现。我们在古典阿拉伯语和现代标准阿拉伯语测试集（即 ArVoice 和 ClArTTS）上将其与计算复杂度更高的多模态变音恢复基线进行了比较评估，结果表明，所提方法在两个测试集上均显著降低了变音错误率，证明了其在性能和效率上的优势。
AI.summary: 针对阿拉伯语语音转写文本缺乏变音符号的问题，本文提出了一种基于CTC的非自回归 speech-to-text 变音恢复方法。该方法通过构建字符级变音格点施加解码硬约束，大幅提高了解码效率并降低了变音错误率。
AI.keywords: 变音符号恢复, CTC解码, 非自回归, 硬约束格点, 阿拉伯语语音处理
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将硬约束（字符级变音格点）整合到基于CTC的非自回归语音到文本恢复框架中，既保证了变音符合法性，又极大地提升了解码效率与准确率，对阿拉伯语等富变音语言的语音与自然语言处理具有重要参考意义。

title: Build-Authorized Evidence for Opaque Calls: A Fail-Closed Rewrite-Authority Boundary
comments: 38 pages, 1 figure, 16 tables; includes a public appendix
summary:
Detached semantic facts about opaque native providers do not by themselves justify compiler rewrites: rewrite authority must be confined to the accepted fact, selected provider and build, caller, callback environment, observation, and runtime target. We present a build-authorized path-effect interface that enforces this boundary through fail-closed authorization and link receipts. The design separates receipt closure, callback-environment closure, and projection identity, and passes accepted facts to LLVM through a narrow internal API. We use one-hop topology-load reuse as a minimal observable witness of authority, not as the optimization target.
  A conservative LLVM consumer reuses a pointer observation only from a noalias root or one constant nonzero projection. Rocq models prove conditional refinement and authority non-amplification under explicit effect, alias, compiler/ABI, and target-resolution premises. We instantiate checked production with Toka: a source-summary gate emits exact LLVM IR, a separate IR checker accepts only a bounded topology-preserving subset, and only accepted IR is compiled into the receipt-bound provider object. A bounded static Darwin/arm64 profile also checks the final direct branch target.
  Across issuer-declared readv, recvmsg, and Cairo boundaries, authorized IR retains each opaque call, reduces the relevant loads from two to one, and preserves observed results; mismatched providers, builds, callbacks, projections, and unsupported IR remain neutral. A libjpeg case is rejected because its callback environment is open, while a bound callback singleton demonstrates the supported closure rule. The contribution is a checked deployment-compiler boundary with an explicit trust and applicability frontier, not a uniquely expressive effect encoding or a new load-elimination algorithm.
comment: 38 pages, 1 figure, 16 tables; includes a public appendix

AI.title_translation: 不透明调用的构建授权证据：一种故障关闭的重写授权边界
AI.tldr: 本文提出了基于构建授权和故障关闭机制的编译器重写边界，确保对不透明调用的安全优化与形式化权限约束。
AI.motivation: 关于不透明原生提供者的孤立语义事实本身不足以证明编译器重写的合理性。重写权限必须严格限定在已被接受的事实、选定的提供者与构建、调用方、回调环境、观察结果以及运行时目标这一完整边界内，以防止不安全或不合规的编译器优化。
AI.method:
1. 提出了基于构建授权的路径-效应接口（path-effect interface），通过故障关闭授权和链接收据（link receipts）来限制重写权限。
2. 解耦收据闭包、回调环境闭包和投影标识，并通过狭窄的内部 API 将接受的事实传递给 LLVM。
3. 在 Rocq 中建立形式化模型，证明显式效应、别名、编译器/ABI 和目标解析前提下的条件精化与权限非放大特性。
4. 基于 Toka 进行生产实例化：源码摘要网关生成精确 LLVM IR，独立的 IR 检查器仅接受有界的保持拓扑子集，并最终编译为受收据约束的提供者对象。
AI.result: 在发件人声明的 readv、recvmsg 和 Cairo 边界测试中，授权的 IR 保留了每个不透明调用，将相关内存加载次数从两次减少到一次，并保持观察结果一致；而提供者、构建、回调、投影不匹配或不支持的 IR 则保持中性（不触发重写）。对回调环境开放的 libjpeg 案例进行了安全拒绝，同时验证了绑定回调单例的受支持闭包规则。
AI.conclusion: 该工作的主要贡献在于建立了一个经过检查的部署-编译器边界，并明确了信任与适用性前沿，成功确保了对不透明调用的编译器重写在未获得完整授权时保持中性（不进行不安全优化）。
AI.translation:
关于不透明原生提供者的孤立语义事实本身不足以证明编译器重写的合理性：重写权限必须严格限定在已被接受的事实、选定的提供者与构建、调用方、回调环境、观察结果以及运行时目标之内。我们提出了一个基于构建授权的路径-效应接口，通过故障关闭授权和链接收据来强制执行该边界。该设计分离了收据闭包、回调环境闭包和投影标识，并通过一个狭窄的内部 API 将接受的事实传递给 LLVM。我们使用单跳拓扑-加载复用作为权限的最小可观察见证，而非优化目标。
一个保守的 LLVM 消费者仅从 noalias 根或一个常数非零投影复用指针观察结果。Rocq 模型证明了在显式效应、别名、编译器/ABI 和目标解析前提下的条件精化与权限非放大性。我们在 Toka 中实例化了经过检查的生产环境：源码摘要网关发出精确的 LLVM IR，独立的 IR 检查器仅接受有界的保持拓扑子集，并且只有被接受的 IR 才会编译到受收据约束的提供者对象中。有界静态 Darwin/arm64 配置集还会检查最终的直接分支目标。
在发件人声明的 readv、recvmsg 和 Cairo 边界上，授权 IR 保留了每个不透明调用，将相关加载从两次减少到一次，并保持观察到的结果；不匹配的提供者、构建、回调、投影和不支持的 IR 则保持中性。libjpeg 案例因其回调环境处于开放状态而被拒绝，而绑定回调单例展示了受支持的闭包规则。本工作的贡献在于具有明确信任和适用性前沿的已检查部署-编译器边界，而非独特的具表现力效应编码或新的加载消除算法。
AI.summary: 本文针对不透明原生调用的编译器优化安全性问题，提出了一种基于构建授权和故障关闭机制的重写授权边界。该方案通过将重写权限严格限制在特定的构建、回调环境及运行时目标内，配合形式化证明和基于 Toka/LLVM 的实例化实现，确保只有符合拓扑约束且完全授权的 IR 才能被优化重写，从而避免了不安全的编译器优化。
AI.keywords: 编译器重写, 授权边界, 不透明调用, 故障关闭, LLVM
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种故障关闭（fail-closed）的重写授权边界机制，解决了在存在不透明原生提供者（opaque native providers）时，编译器如何安全地进行跨边界优化的难题。其创新点在于将授权范围严格限制在特定的构建、回调环境和运行时目标上，并通过形式化证明（Rocq）与实际编译器集成（Toka/LLVM）验证了安全性。限制在于该工作专注于构建与部署边界的安全授权约束，而非提出全新的载入消除算法或更具表现力的效应编码。

title: Design and stability analysis of an underactuated hand with passively rotating fingers
summary: This paper presents an innovative design and stability analysis of an underactuated robotic finger with spatial mobility, designed to enhance gripping dexterity in robotic hands. The finger architecture incorporates a revolute joint at its base, enabling passive spatial rotation that facilitates both cylindrical and spherical grasping. With only two phalanges per finger, the design simplifies kinematic complexity while supporting precision and enveloping grasps. Stability criteria, based on the moment at the finger base joint induced by contact forces, are introduced to ensure reliable object gripping and prevent ejection during manipulation. The study also examines a differential mechanism that distributes a single actuation torque across multiple fingers, allowing adaptive and coordinated motion. This mechanism enhances the hand's ability to grasp diverse object shapes with minimal pre-grasp adjustments, leveraging passivity for autonomous adaptation. Theoretical findings are experimentally validated using a fully mechanical prototype, demonstrating versatility in performing cylindrical, spherical, parallel, and enveloping grasps. The integration of underactuation-both within individual fingers and among multiple fingers-reduces mechanical complexity, cost, and control demands while preserving functional adaptability. This work advances the development of compliant robotic hands suitable for applications requiring dexterity and robustness, such as agricultural robotics, logistics, assistive technologies, and waste sorting. Future research will focus on automating actuation and refining control strategies to further improve grasp stability and precision, paving the way for autonomous manipulation in unstructured environments.

AI.title_translation: 具有被动旋转手指的欠驱动机械手的设计与稳定性分析
AI.tldr: 本文提出并分析了一种具有被动旋转旋转手指的欠驱动机械手设计，该设计通过简化复杂性、引入稳定性标准和差动机构，提高了抓取灵活性和适应性，并通过实验验证了其在多种抓取类型上的多功能性。
AI.motivation: 为了增强机器人手的抓取灵活性，简化运动学复杂性，并支持精确和包络抓取，同时减少机械复杂性、成本和控制需求。
AI.method: 该研究提出了一种欠驱动机械手设计，其手指具有空间移动性，并在基部包含一个旋转关节，实现被动空间旋转以支持圆柱形和球形抓取。每个手指只有两节指骨。引入了基于接触力在手指基部关节产生的力矩的稳定性标准。研究还检查了一个差动机构，该机构将单个驱动扭矩分配到多个手指上，实现自适应和协调运动。通过一个全机械原型进行了实验验证。
AI.result: 该设计在执行圆柱形、球形、平行和包络抓取方面表现出多功能性。欠驱动（在单个手指内部和多个手指之间）的集成降低了机械复杂性、成本和控制需求，同时保持了功能适应性。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作推动了柔顺机器人手的发展，适用于需要灵活性和鲁棒性的应用，如农业机器人、物流、辅助技术和垃圾分类。未来的研究将专注于自动化驱动和完善控制策略，以进一步提高抓取稳定性和精度。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种具有空间移动性的欠驱动机器人手指的创新设计和稳定性分析，旨在增强机器人手的抓取灵活性。手指结构在其基部包含一个旋转关节，实现被动空间旋转，从而有助于圆柱形和球形抓取。每个手指只有两节指骨，该设计简化了运动学复杂性，同时支持精确和包络抓取。引入了基于接触力在手指基部关节产生的力矩的稳定性标准，以确保可靠的物体抓取并防止在操作过程中弹出。该研究还检查了一个差动机构，该机构将单个驱动扭矩分配到多个手指上，允许自适应和协调运动。该机制利用被动性实现自主适应，通过最小的预抓取调整，增强了机械手抓取各种物体形状的能力。理论发现通过一个全机械原型进行了实验验证，展示了在执行圆柱形、球形、平行和包络抓取方面的多功能性。欠驱动的集成（在单个手指内部和多个手指之间）降低了机械复杂性、成本和控制需求，同时保持了功能适应性。这项工作推动了柔顺机器人手的发展，适用于需要灵活性和鲁棒性的应用，如农业机器人、物流、辅助技术和垃圾分类。未来的研究将专注于自动化驱动和完善控制策略，以进一步提高抓取稳定性和精度，为非结构化环境中的自主操作铺平道路。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一种创新的欠驱动机器人手设计，其手指具有被动空间旋转功能，以增强抓取灵活性。该设计通过两节指骨简化了运动学，并引入了基于接触力矩的稳定性标准，以确保可靠抓取。一个差动机构实现了多指间的自适应协调运动。实验验证表明，该机械手在多种抓取类型上表现出多功能性，并且欠驱动特性显著降低了机械复杂性、成本和控制要求，同时保持了功能适应性。该研究为农业机器人、物流和辅助技术等应用中的柔顺机器人手的发展做出了贡献。
AI.keywords: 欠驱动机械手, 被动旋转手指, 抓取稳定性, 差动机构, 机器人抓取
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于其欠驱动机械手设计，特别是手指的被动空间旋转能力和用于多指协调的差动机构。这有效地在简化机械结构、降低成本和控制复杂性的同时，显著提高了抓取的多功能性和适应性。通过引入稳定性标准，解决了欠驱动系统在抓取可靠性方面可能面临的挑战。该工作为柔顺机器人手在多种实际应用中的推广奠定了基础，具有重要的工程实践意义。

title: Online sparse observers for cyber-physical systems under sensor bias
summary:
The design of state observers for cyber-physical systems under sparse sensor biases, faults, or attacks has drawn substantial attention in recent years. While sparsity-based batch approaches, which collect multiple measurements and run offline, are relatively mature, online secure state estimation, for real-time state/attack recovery, is still an open problem. Although some algorithms have been proposed, convergence guarantees remain limited, even for the case of constant attacks.
  As a first step toward addressing this gap, we focus on constant attacks. We analyze the observability of this setting and we study several online sparse observers, derived from different methodological frameworks such as online sparse optimization and block Bregman methods. Some of the proposed observers are adaptations of existing algorithms to the secure state-estimation setting, while others constitute novel algorithmic contributions.
  The goal of this paper is to provide a unified overview of practically implementable, online sparse observers, discuss their convergence properties, and compare their performance through numerical experiments.

AI.title_translation: 网络物理系统传感器偏差下的在线稀疏观测器
AI.tldr: 本文关注网络物理系统在恒定传感器攻击下的在线稀疏观测器设计，分析了可观测性，并研究了基于在线稀疏优化和块Bregman方法等框架的多种观测器，旨在提供一个统一的概述并比较其性能。
AI.motivation: 在稀疏传感器偏差、故障或攻击下的网络物理系统状态观测器设计受到了广泛关注。虽然基于稀疏性的离线批处理方法相对成熟，但用于实时状态/攻击恢复的在线安全状态估计仍然是一个开放问题，现有算法的收敛性保证有限，即使对于恒定攻击情况也是如此。
AI.method: 本文首先针对恒定攻击情况，分析了该设置下的可观测性。研究了几种在线稀疏观测器，这些观测器源自不同的方法框架，如在线稀疏优化和块Bregman方法。其中一些是现有算法在安全状态估计设置下的改编，另一些是新颖的算法贡献。
AI.result: 本文旨在提供一个实用可实现的在线稀疏观测器的统一概述，讨论它们的收敛特性，并通过数值实验比较它们的性能。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过对恒定攻击下的在线稀疏观测器进行统一概述、收敛性讨论和性能比较，为解决网络物理系统在线安全状态估计的开放问题迈出了第一步。
AI.translation:
近年来，在稀疏传感器偏差、故障或攻击下的网络物理系统状态观测器设计受到了广泛关注。虽然基于稀疏性的批处理方法（即收集多个测量值并离线运行）相对成熟，但用于实时状态/攻击恢复的在线安全状态估计仍然是一个开放问题。尽管已经提出了一些算法，但即使对于恒定攻击情况，收敛性保证仍然有限。
作为解决这一空白的第一步，我们关注恒定攻击。我们分析了这种设置下的可观测性，并研究了几种在线稀疏观测器，这些观测器源自不同的方法框架，例如在线稀疏优化和块Bregman方法。一些提出的观测器是现有算法在安全状态估计设置下的改编，而另一些则构成了新颖的算法贡献。
本文的目标是提供一个实用可实现的在线稀疏观测器的统一概述，讨论它们的收敛特性，并通过数值实验比较它们的性能。
AI.summary: 本文针对网络物理系统在恒定传感器攻击下的在线安全状态估计这一开放问题，分析了其可观测性。研究并比较了多种基于在线稀疏优化和块Bregman方法等框架的在线稀疏观测器，其中包含现有算法的改编和新颖的算法贡献。论文旨在提供这些实用观测器的统一概述，讨论其收敛性，并通过数值实验评估其性能。
AI.keywords: 在线稀疏观测器, 网络物理系统, 传感器偏差, 在线估计, 收敛性
AI.comments: 该论文解决了网络物理系统在线安全状态估计中的一个重要且具有挑战性的开放问题，特别是针对恒定攻击。其创新之处在于提供了一个统一的在线稀疏观测器概述，并结合了现有方法的改编和新的算法贡献。对收敛性保证的关注及其通过数值实验进行的性能比较，增强了其实用性和重要性。

title: H$^2$SD: Hybrid Hindsight Self-Distillation
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has substantially improved the reasoning capabilities of large language models on tasks such as mathematical reasoning and code generation. However, most RLVR methods assign a scalar outcome reward to an entire trajectory, resulting in sparse supervision and limited token-level credit assignment. On-policy distillation (OPD) provides denser supervision by distilling token-level distributions from a stronger teacher model, but requires an additional teacher and typically assumes a shared vocabulary. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) removes this dependency by conditioning the same model on privileged information to construct a teacher policy. However, directly matching the teacher distribution may cause information leakage and unstable optimization. RLSD avoids direct matching by using the teacher signal only to modulate update magnitudes, but it cannot provide an explicit correction direction when the sampled reasoning fails. To address this tradeoff, we introduce $\mathrm{H}^{2}\mathrm{SD}$, a hybrid hindsight self distillation framework that uses the teacher differently according to trajectory correctness. For successful trajectories, the teacher receives the student response confirmed as correct together with a rephrasing instruction, and its probabilities on the original response tokens are used to modulate update magnitudes without changing the direction determined by the reward. For failed trajectories, we condition the teacher on a reference hint containing key reasoning steps and a verified answer, and minimize the reverse KL divergence from the student to the teacher. Experiments on multiple challenging reasoning benchmarks show that H$^2$SD consistently outperforms representative RLVR, OPSD, and RLSD baselines while maintaining stable optimization and favorable generation efficiency.

AI.tldr: H$^2$SD是一种新的混合回溯自蒸馏框架，它根据轨迹的正确性以不同方式利用教师模型，从而在可验证奖励的强化学习任务中提高了大型语言模型的推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）方法存在监督稀疏和有限的token级信用分配问题。On-policy distillation (OPD) 需要额外的教师模型。On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) 可能导致信息泄露和优化不稳定。RLSD无法在采样的推理失败时提供明确的纠正方向。
AI.method: H$^2$SD是一个混合回溯自蒸馏框架，它根据轨迹的正确性以不同方式使用教师模型。对于成功轨迹，教师模型接收已确认正确的学生响应和复述指令，其在原始响应token上的概率用于调节更新幅度。对于失败轨迹，教师模型以包含关键推理步骤和已验证答案的参考提示为条件，并最小化从学生到教师的反向KL散度。
AI.result: 实验表明，H$^2$SD在多个具有挑战性的推理基准上始终优于代表性的RLVR、OPSD和RLSD基线，同时保持了稳定的优化和有利的生成效率。
AI.conclusion: H$^2$SD通过其混合回溯自蒸馏框架，有效地解决了现有RLVR方法在监督稀疏、信用分配不足以及自蒸馏方法中信息泄露和优化不稳定等方面的局限性，显著提升了大型语言模型在推理任务上的性能。
AI.translation: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）显著提高了大型语言模型在数学推理和代码生成等任务上的推理能力。然而，大多数RLVR方法为整个轨迹分配一个标量结果奖励，导致监督稀疏和token级信用分配有限。在策略蒸馏（OPD）通过从更强的教师模型蒸馏token级分布来提供更密集的监督，但需要额外的教师模型，并且通常假设共享词汇。在策略自蒸馏（OPSD）通过以特权信息为条件构建教师策略来消除这种依赖。然而，直接匹配教师分布可能导致信息泄露和优化不稳定。RLSD通过仅使用教师信号来调节更新幅度来避免直接匹配，但它无法在采样的推理失败时提供明确的纠正方向。为了解决这种权衡，我们引入了H$^2$SD，一个混合回溯自蒸馏框架，它根据轨迹的正确性以不同方式使用教师模型。对于成功轨迹，教师模型接收已确认正确的学生响应和复述指令，其在原始响应token上的概率用于调节更新幅度而不改变奖励确定的方向。对于失败轨迹，我们以包含关键推理步骤和已验证答案的参考提示为条件来训练教师模型，并最小化从学生到教师的反向KL散度。在多个具有挑战性的推理基准上的实验表明，H$^2$SD始终优于代表性的RLVR、OPSD和RLSD基线，同时保持了稳定的优化和有利的生成效率。
AI.summary: 本文提出了H$^2$SD，一种混合回溯自蒸馏框架，旨在解决现有可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）方法中监督稀疏、信用分配不足以及自蒸馏方法中的信息泄露和优化不稳定问题。H$^2$SD根据轨迹的成功与否，分别采用不同的教师模型指导策略：对成功轨迹，教师模型通过调节更新幅度来增强正确响应；对失败轨迹，教师模型提供关键推理步骤和答案作为提示，并通过最小化反向KL散度来纠正学生模型。实验结果表明，H$^2$SD在推理任务上优于现有RLVR、OPSD和RLSD方法，并保持了优化稳定性和生成效率。
AI.keywords: 强化学习, 自蒸馏, 大型语言模型, 推理, 回溯学习
AI.comments: H$^2$SD的创新点在于其混合式自蒸馏策略，根据轨迹的成功与否动态调整教师信号的使用方式，有效结合了奖励调制和方向纠正的优点，解决了现有方法在稀疏奖励和不稳定优化之间的权衡问题。这种自适应的监督机制对于提高大型语言模型在复杂推理任务上的性能具有重要意义。

title: InstantInfer: Enabling Fast LLM Cold Start with Communicating Finite Automata
summary: Cold starts in large language model (LLM) inference services significantly affect user experience, yet they remain inefficient due to sequential initialization and a massive number of fine-grained I/O requests issued by complex software components. Although refactoring the program can yield advantages such as concurrent execution and I/O merging, this approach is error-prone and carries correctness risks when dealing with massive, heterogeneous components. We propose the Communicating Finite Automata (CFA) abstraction to systematically analyze cross-component optimization opportunities, and design a programming framework to enable CFA-based component program refactoring. This framework preserves the original sequential program structure while enabling safe concurrent component execution. We prove the correctness of the program refactoring. We apply the CFA abstraction and framework to refactor process tree creation, tensor loading, and model switching in vLLM, forming a new cold-start system named InstantInfer. Extensive experiments demonstrate that InstantInfer substantially accelerates LLM cold starts (achieving up to 7.2 times speedup) and exhibits robustness across diverse GPUs, workloads, and scales.

AI.title_translation: 即时推理：利用通信有限自动机实现快速大语言模型冷启动
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为InstantInfer的系统，通过使用通信有限自动机（CFA）来优化大型语言模型（LLM）的冷启动过程，显著减少了启动时间并保证了正确性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）推理服务的冷启动问题严重影响用户体验，但由于初始化过程的顺序性和大量细粒度的I/O请求，目前效率低下。
AI.method: 提出通信有限自动机（CFA）抽象，用于系统性分析跨组件优化机会，并设计了一个基于CFA的组件程序重构框架。该框架在保持原有顺序程序结构的同时，实现了安全的并发组件执行，并通过了正确性证明。将此方法应用于vLLM中的进程树创建、张量加载和模型切换，构建了InstantInfer系统。
AI.result: 实验表明，InstantInfer显著加速了LLM的冷启动，最高可达7.2倍的加速比，并在不同的GPU、工作负载和规模下表现出鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: InstantInfer通过CFA抽象和重构框架，成功解决了LLM冷启动效率问题，大幅提升了性能并保证了正确性。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）推理服务的冷启动严重影响用户体验，但由于复杂的软件组件发出的顺序初始化和大量的细粒度I/O请求，它们仍然效率低下。尽管重构程序可以带来诸如并发执行和I/O合并等优点，但这种方法在处理大量异构组件时容易出错并存在正确性风险。我们提出了通信有限自动机（CFA）抽象来系统性地分析跨组件优化机会，并设计了一个编程框架来实现基于CFA的组件程序重构。该框架在保持原始顺序程序结构的同时，实现了安全的并发组件执行。我们证明了程序重构的正确性。我们将CFA抽象和框架应用于重构vLLM中的进程树创建、张量加载和模型切换，形成了一个名为InstantInfer的新冷启动系统。大量的实验表明，InstantInfer显著加速了LLM的冷启动（最高可达7.2倍的加速），并在各种GPU、工作负载和规模下表现出鲁棒性。
AI.summary: 本研究介绍了InstantInfer，一个通过通信有限自动机（CFA）解决大型语言模型（LLM）冷启动缓慢问题的系统。该系统通过CFA抽象分析优化机会，并提供一个框架来安全地重构组件以实现并发执行，同时保持程序结构。实验证明InstantInfer能显著加速LLM冷启动，最高提速7.2倍，且在不同环境下表现稳定。

title: Dual Adversarial Fine-tuning for Enhancing Robustness of Large Vision Language Model
summary: While Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), represented by LLaVA and GPT-4V, have demonstrated remarkable capabilities, their visual inputs remain vulnerable to adversarial attacks, posing significant security risks. Existing defense methods predominantly target single-task scenarios (e.g., zero-shot classification) and consequently lack generalizability across various multimodal tasks. To address this limitation, we propose a dual adversarial fine-tuning framework that jointly optimizes visual and semantic supervision signals from two modalities, enhancing model robustness while generalizing across multiple downstream tasks. The proposed framework comprises two core components, i.e., $\textbf{Visual}$ supervision branch and $\textbf{Semantic}$ supervision branch. The former branch leverages features from clean images, extracted via a frozen original vision encoder, to guide adversarial robustness while the latter incorporates caption-image alignment as a contextual signal to preserve semantic coherence under attack. Moreover, our method achieves cross-task robustness by simply replacing the CLIP vision encoder in the original model, with no need of separate task-specific retraining or architecture modifications.Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach outperforms the state-of-the-art method in adversarial robustness evaluation across zero-shot classification, image captioning, and visual question answering (VQA) tasks.

AI.title_translation: 用于增强大型视觉语言模型鲁棒性的双重对抗微调方法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种双重对抗微调框架，通过视觉和语义双监督分支，在无需修改架构的前提下显著提升了大型视觉语言模型在多任务下的对抗鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的防御方法主要针对单任务场景（如零样本分类），缺乏在各种多模态任务上的通用性，而大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）的视觉输入容易受到对抗攻击，因此需要一种能泛化到多下游任务的通用防御方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种双重对抗微调框架，包含视觉监督分支（利用冻结的原始视觉编码器从干净图像中提取特征来指导对抗鲁棒性）和语义监督分支（结合图文对齐作为上下文信号以在攻击下保持语义一致性），并通过替换CLIP视觉encoder实现跨任务鲁棒性。
AI.result: 广泛的实验表明，该方法在零样本分类、图像描述和视觉问答（VQA）任务的对抗鲁棒性评估中优于现有的最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种双重对抗微调框架，通过视觉和语义双监督有效提升了大型视觉语言模型在多个下游任务中的对抗鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 尽管以LLaVA和GPT-4V为代表的大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）展现出了卓越的能力，但它们的视觉输入仍然容易受到对抗攻击，带来了显著的安全风险。现有的防御方法主要针对单任务场景（例如零样本分类），因此缺乏在各种多模态任务中的通用性。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了一种双重对抗微调框架，该框架联合优化来自两个模态的视觉和语义监督信号，在增强模型鲁棒性的同时实现跨多个下游任务的泛化。所提出的框架包含两个核心组件，即视觉监督分支和语义监督分支。前者利用通过冻结的原始视觉编码器提取的干净图像特征来引导对抗鲁棒性，而后者结合了图文对齐作为上下文信号，以在攻击下保持语义的一致性。此外，我们的方法只需替换原模型中的CLIP视觉编码器即可实现跨任务鲁棒性，无需单独的任务特定重新训练或架构修改。大量实验表明，该方法在零样本分类、图像描述和视觉问答（VQA）任务的对抗鲁棒性评估中表现优于最先进的方法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对大型视觉语言模型的双重对抗微调框架，通过联合优化视觉和语义监督信号，在不改变模型架构的情况下，显著增强了模型在多个下游任务中的对抗鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 大视觉语言模型, 对抗鲁棒性, 对抗微调, 多模态任务
AI.comments: 该论文针对大视觉语言模型（LVLMs）在对抗攻击下的脆弱性问题，创新性地提出了一种双重对抗微调框架。通过视觉和语义双监督分支，不仅提升了模型的对抗鲁棒性，还保持了跨多任务的泛化能力，且无需复杂的架构修改，具有很高的实用价值。

title: SFGA: A Statistics-First Gating Architecture with Adjudicative Escalation for Trustworthy SFT Data Procurement
summary: Procuring supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data forces a buyer to decide, before any downstream training, whether a candidate corpus is worth acquiring. We present \sys{}, a statistics-first gating architecture that treats procurement as a cost-aware routing problem over three intrinsic quality axes -- diversity, utility, and redundancy. Cheap blind measurements are summarised into per-axis estimates with confidence intervals; a gate accepts a decision only when intervals are tight, sample sizes are adequate, and the axes agree, otherwise it escalates the case to an adjudicative debate between a buy-advocate and a reject-advocate judge, resolved by a presiding verdict. On a controlled benchmark of 12 datasets ($2{\times}3{\times}2$ grid over the three axes) with 5 seeds, the gate reaches 0.90 accuracy and 0.83 $F_1$ at \$0.017 per unit, sitting between an always-verify baseline (0.75) and an oracle upper bound (0.98) while spending less than always-escalate (\$0.020). We further report honest negative diagnostics of the debate path: a con-side win rate of 0.80 ($p\approx3{\times}10^{-6}$) and a 52\% position-flip rate under advocate swapping expose negativity and positional biases that a naive LLM-judge would hide. We frame the injected-knob evaluation explicitly as a controlled synthetic benchmark for measurement fidelity and routing calibration, and delimit external validity as future work.

AI.title_translation: 统计优先门控架构，通过裁决升级实现可信SFT数据采购
AI.tldr: SFGA是一种新的SFT数据采购方法，它首先使用统计数据来评估数据质量（多样性、效用、冗余），然后根据置信度决定是购买还是进行更深入的审查。它在准确性和成本方面优于基线方法，并揭示了现有评估方法的潜在偏差。
AI.motivation: 在下游训练之前，买家需要决定候选语料库是否值得获取，以进行监督微调（SFT）数据的采购。
AI.method: SFGA是一种统计优先的门控架构，将数据采购视为一个成本感知型路由问题，涉及三个内在质量轴：多样性、效用和冗余。它使用廉价的盲测来估算每个轴的置信区间，当区间足够窄、样本量足够大且各轴意见一致时，门控系统会接受购买决定；否则，它会将案件升级为买方倡导者和拒绝倡导者法官之间的裁决辩论，并由主审裁决。
AI.result: 在包含12个数据集（三个轴的2x3x2网格）和5个种子的受控基准测试中，SFGA的准确率为0.90，F1分数为0.83，每单位成本为0.017美元。这优于始终验证基线（0.75），但低于理论最优值（0.98），同时花费低于始终升级策略（0.020美元）。此外，辩论路径显示了0.80的反对方胜率和52%的位置翻转率，揭示了潜在的偏差。
AI.conclusion: SFGA在成本效益和准确性方面提供了一种改进的数据采购方法，但其辩论机制存在显著的偏见，需要进一步研究。
AI.translation: 监督微调（SFT）数据的采购迫使买家在任何下游训练之前决定候选语料库是否值得获取。我们提出了	extvisiblespace{}，一个统计优先的门控架构，将采购视为一个跨越三个内在质量轴——多样性、效用和冗余——的成本感知路由问题。廉价的盲测被汇总为具有置信区间的每轴估计值；只有当区间狭窄、样本量充足且各轴达成一致时，门控才会接受一个决定，否则它会将案件升级为买方倡导者和拒绝倡导者法官之间的裁决辩论，并由主审裁决。在包含12个数据集（三个轴的2x3x2网格）和5个种子的受控基准测试中，门控的准确率为0.90，F1分数为0.83，每单位成本为0.017美元，介于始终验证基线（0.75）和理论最优值（0.98）之间，同时花费低于始终升级策略（0.020美元）。我们进一步报告了对辩论路径的诚实负面诊断：反对方胜率为0.80（p≈3×10^-6），倡导者交换下的位置翻转率为52%，暴露了天真的LLM法官会隐藏的负面和位置偏差。我们将注入旋钮评估明确地构建为测量保真度和路由校准的受控合成基准，并将外部有效性划为未来工作。
AI.summary: SFGA是一种创新的数据采购架构，它利用统计数据来评估SFT数据的多样性、效用和冗余。通过成本效益的门控机制，它能准确识别高质量数据，并在必要时升级至更复杂的裁决过程。实验证明，SFGA在准确性和成本方面表现优异，同时揭示了现有评估方法的局限性。
AI.keywords: 监督微调, 数据采购, 门控架构, 统计优先, 成本感知路由
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的统计优先门控架构（SFGA），用于SFT数据的采购，在成本和准确性之间取得了良好的平衡。通过将数据采购视为一个成本敏感的路由问题，并引入裁决升级机制，SFGA有效地解决了传统方法中的一些痛点。然而，研究也诚实地指出了辩论机制中存在的偏见，这为未来的研究提供了重要的方向，例如如何设计更公正的仲裁系统，以及如何更准确地评估测量保真度和扩展外部有效性。

title: From Dependency to Compositionality: A Neurosymbolic Lifting of LLM Outputs via Combinatory Categorial Grammar
summary: Large language models (LLMs) generate fluent text by incrementally predicting the next token from a prefix. Critics in the generative tradition argue that such systems lack genuine grammar; influential replies from the dependency-grammar perspective hold that LLM behavior is well described by local head-dependent structure built word by word. We argue that a sharper observation has been overlooked: the prefix-driven, type-completing dynamics of autoregressive generation align closely with the incremental processing model that Combinatory Categorial Grammar (CCG) was originally designed to support. On this basis we propose a neurosymbolic framework in which LLM outputs are lifted into typed compositional derivations -- not claiming that LLMs implement CCG internally, but that their outputs admit a principled, incremental, and auditable CCG reconstruction. Two consequences follow. First, through the Curry-Howard correspondence the lifting extends beyond natural language to the formal languages LLMs also produce -- programming languages such as Solidity, description-logic and query languages such as OWL and SQL -- with the type system varying and the architecture held fixed. Second, the lifting supports two layers of checking: a compositional layer that catches structural failures directly, and a content layer that checks the lifted structure against external knowledge sources, enabling the earliest possible flagging of hallucinated content. The account thereby requires of a producer not cognition but a prefix-driven generative profile. We close with a sketch of synchronous LLM-CCG coupling as one direction the framework opens.

AI.title_translation: 从依赖到组合性：通过组合范畴语法对大型语言模型输出进行神经符号提升
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种神经符号框架，将大型语言模型（LLM）的输出通过组合范畴语法（CCG）提升为类型化的组合推导，而不是声称LLM内部实现了CCG。这种方法不仅适用于自然语言，还适用于LLM生成的编程语言和查询语言，并支持两层检查：组合层和内容层，以检测结构故障和幻觉内容。
AI.motivation: 关于LLM是否具有真正语法存在争议；依赖语法学派认为LLM行为可以用局部头-依赖结构来描述。该论文认为，LLM的生成过程（逐个预测）与组合范畴语法（CCG）的增量处理模型高度相似，这被忽视了。
AI.method: 提出一个神经符号框架，将LLM的输出提升为类型化的组合推导，并利用组合范畴语法（CCG）进行分析。该框架不声称LLM内部实现了CCG，而是认为LLM的输出可以被CCG重建。
AI.result: 1. 该框架通过Curry-Howard对应，将LLM的输出（包括自然语言、编程语言如Solidity、描述逻辑、查询语言如OWL和SQL）提升为类型化的组合推导，其中类型系统可变，但架构固定。 2. 该提升支持两层检查：组合层（检测结构故障）和内容层（将提升后的结构与外部知识源进行比较，以检测幻觉内容）。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将LLM的生成过程与CCG的增量处理模型联系起来，通过神经符号提升，不仅能分析自然语言，还能分析LLM生成的其他形式语言，并提供结构和内容两层检查机制，从而及早发现错误和幻觉内容。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）通过逐步预测前缀后的下一个词元来生成流畅的文本。生成式传统中的批评者认为，这样的系统缺乏真正的语法；而来自依赖语法学派的有影响力的回应则认为，LLM的行为可以用逐字构建的局部头-依赖结构来很好地描述。我们认为，一个更敏锐的观察被忽视了：自回归生成的面向前缀、类型补全的动态与组合范畴语法（CCG）最初设计的增量处理模型非常吻合。在此基础上，我们提出了一个神经符号框架，其中LLM的输出被提升为类型化的组合推导——我们并非声称LLM在内部实现了CCG，而是认为它们的输出允许一种原则性的、增量的、可审计的CCG重建。由此产生两个结果。首先，通过Curry-Howard对应，这种提升超越了自然语言，扩展到了LLM也生成的形式语言——如Solidity这样的编程语言、描述逻辑和如OWL及SQL这样的查询语言——其中类型系统会变化，而架构保持固定。其次，这种提升支持两层检查：一个组合层，直接捕获结构故障；一个内容层，将提升后的结构与外部知识源进行检查，从而能够尽早发现幻觉内容。因此，该方法要求生产者具备的不是认知能力，而是一种面向前缀的生成模式。最后，我们简要介绍了同步LLM-CCG耦合，这是该框架开启的一个方向。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种新颖的神经符号框架，将大型语言模型（LLM）生成的文本通过组合范畴语法（CCG）提升为结构化的、类型化的组合推导。该方法利用LLM的自回归生成过程与CCG的增量处理模型的相似性，实现了对LLM输出的原则性、增量式和可审计的重建。该框架不仅适用于自然语言，还能扩展到LLM生成的形式语言（如编程语言和查询语言），并提供两层验证机制：一层用于检查结构完整性，另一层用于核对外部知识以检测内容幻觉。该研究强调，这种方法关注的是生成模式而非认知能力，并为同步LLM-CCG耦合开辟了新的可能性。
AI.keywords: 神经符号学习, 组合范畴语法, 大型语言模型, 组合性, 幻觉检测
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种非常有前景的神经符号方法，将LLM的输出与组合范畴语法（CCG）相结合，实现了对LLM输出的深度结构化和验证。将CCG的增量处理模型与LLM的自回归生成过程联系起来是一个巧妙的切入点。该方法在处理形式语言和提供双层验证（结构和内容）方面具有显著优势，能够有效解决LLM的幻觉问题和提高输出的可信度。然而，实际的“提升”过程在计算上可能非常复杂，并且CCG的覆盖范围和对复杂语言现象的处理能力仍是需要进一步探索的领域。该研究为理解和控制LLM的生成过程提供了一个新的视角和强大的工具。

title: Variational meta-learning inference for low dimensional neural system identification
summary: Deep learning has proven highly effective for nonlinear system identification, but heavily parameterized neural networks are prone to overfitting in low-data regimes and lack reliable uncertainty quantification. The recently developed manifold meta-learning framework addresses the data efficiency problem by restricting the model parameters to a meta-learned low-dimensional manifold. However, that method is purely deterministic. We propose a fully probabilistic extension of the manifold meta-learning framework, based on amortized Variational Inference, where a generative prior over the low-dimensional parameter manifold is learned. During task-specific adaptation, we combine Maximum A Posteriori estimation with the Laplace approximation to yield a mathematically grounded posterior approximation. Evaluated on a static regression task and the Bouc--Wen dynamical system benchmark, the proposed approach achieves predictive accuracy comparable to its deterministic counterpart while successfully providing calibrated uncertainty bounds in severely low-data regimes.

title: Measuring Reward-Seeking via Contrastive Belief Updates
summary: Language models trained with reinforcement learning may learn to optimize the grader's judgment rather than the intended objective. This "reward-seeking" is difficult to measure because a model that pursues the grader's judgment and one that pursues the intended objective behave identically whenever the grader rewards the intended behavior. We measure reward-seeking using Contrastive Synthetic Document Finetuning to change a model's beliefs about what the grader rewards, putting those beliefs in conflict with what users or developers want, and measuring the rate at which the model adopts each party's preferred behavior. Applied to intermediate checkpoints of a capabilities-focused OpenAI o3 RL run, without safety training, we find that these checkpoints often side with grader preferences over those of users or developers on coding and alignment tasks. This tendency to side with the grader trends upward throughout RL training. For example, in an environment that forces a choice between keeping a promise to a supervisor and breaking it to complete the task, a late capabilities-focused o3 checkpoint breaks the promise 87% of the time when SDF documents say the grader rewards task completion, versus 9% when they say it rewards honesty (a choice its chain-of-thought often makes explicit). An earlier checkpoint is far less sensitive (40% vs. 24%). Our method also generalizes to reward-hacking models. A model organism trained to reward-hack (gpt-oss-120b) is more than twice as sensitive to grader preferences as the unmodified model, with the mean behavioral shift in favor of the grader rising from 33% to 86%. These results indicate that RL can increase reward-seeking over the course of training, producing models that may act against their developers' intentions when they believe that doing so leads to higher reward.

title: Skillware: A Software Ontology and Engineering Lifecycle for Persistent Behavioral Artifacts
summary: Agent Skills have become persistent behavioral artifacts across independent AI agent systems. They combine natural-language task specifications with metadata and optional references, scripts, assets, hooks, package manifests, tests, and companion interfaces. Existing studies explain how Skills are specified, executed, maintained, and evolved, but lack an ontology that defines these artifacts as independent software objects. This paper introduces Skillware as the software abstraction that extends software engineering to persistent Behavioral Artifacts in agent systems. A Skill Artifact specifies reusable task behavior; a Skillware Unit manages that artifact as software through an independent identity and lifecycle. A compatible Agent Host activates the unit for runtime interpretation. Three necessary conditions operationalize category membership: behavioral primacy, independent software identity, and an Agent Host execution relationship. Lifecycle Continuity records whether the same unit identity persists through update, maintenance, rollback, and removal as a separate software-grade property. Evidence combines the Agent Skills specification, a frozen corpus of 138,133 content-deduplicated SKILL.md records associated with 20,556 repository identifiers, independent empirical studies, 15 category-boundary cases, and 13 fixed-revision engineering implementations. The evidence establishes a recurring artifact envelope, separable software identities, compatible execution paths, and lifecycle engineering pressure. Skillware provides the software ontology and engineering lifecycle through which agent capabilities can become identifiable, composable, maintainable, and evolvable software artifacts.

title: Verifiable Self-Evolution for Open-Ended Dialogue Skills via Future-Feedback Prediction

summary: Textual skills provide a lightweight way to improve frozen language-model agents, but their self-evolution normally requires a stable validation signal. Such signals are natural in mathematics or code, where an answer can be checked after it changes, yet are problematic in open-ended dialogue: changing the assistant response also changes the user's next reaction, so a logged reaction cannot directly evaluate a counterfactual response. We propose future-feedback skill evolution, which first redirects self-evolution from prescribing the current answer to predicting whether the observed answer will lead to a positive or negative subsequent user signal. This prediction task is verifiable on fixed logged tuples and therefore supports validation-gated textual optimization. The evolved feedback skill captures interpretable criteria for response quality and can subsequently serve as a diagnostic and optimization target for answer skills. On a proprietary, privacy-preserving sales-assistant dataset, careful quality filtering and a balanced resolved/unresolved split yield more than 75% prediction accuracy. Beyond this result, the central contribution is a formulation that converts otherwise moving conversational feedback into a fixed offline learning target, enabling reproducible skill evolution without placing every candidate skill in live traffic. We discuss the boundary between observational verification and counterfactual validity, and position the method as an offline optimization stage rather than a replacement for final human or online evaluation.

title: Mi-Memory: A Lifecycle Memory Framework for Personal AI
summary: Personal AI is moving beyond chat-only interaction toward continuous services that span phones, cars, homes, wearables, cameras, and tools. In this setting, memory cannot remain a cache of prior conversations. It should serve as a continuity and governance substrate: preserving durable user state, grounding answers in multimodal and device evidence, supporting correction and forgetting, bounding policy evolution, and remaining deployable under latency, cost, privacy, and edge-cloud constraints. This technical report presents Mi-Memory, a lifecycle memory framework for Personal AI organized around four roles: Structure, Expansion, Evolution, and Deployment. A shared audit contract links these roles through four recurring artifact families: typed evidence payloads preserve source identity and provenance, diagnostic traces localize evidence loss across the serving pipeline, strategy artifacts make memory-policy changes explicit, and gate/rollback records bound accepted evolution. MiMemory instantiates the roles through MemStack, MemSense/MemFuse, D$^{2}$ACCI/E$^{2}$MEND, and LiteMem. In controlled-reference Structure evaluations, MemStack reaches 93.59%, 57.24%, and 87.47% on LoCoMo, PersonaMem-V2, and LongMemEval, respectively; other tracks report module-level, preliminary/internal, transfer-feasibility, or design-only evidence with explicit boundaries. MiMemory is a step toward auditable, evidence-gated, and deployment-aware memory systems for Personal AI. Project homepage: https://darwin-agent.github.io/Mi-Memory/ .

title: Fishing Out Free Riders: Shapley-Based Reward Attribution for Parallel Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at multi-step reasoning, yet current parallel reasoning approaches often fail to distinguish the contributions of individual reasoning paths. Many paths may be redundant, misleading, or even detrimental, but outcome-level rewards assign uniform reward, leading to ambiguous learning signals and unstable training. We propose Parallel Shapley, a reinforcement learning framework that attributes fine-grained, path-level contributions in multi-path reasoning. Treating each path as a player in a cooperative game, we leverage Shapley values to quantify marginal contributions, using a generative reward model to evaluate path utilities and Monte Carlo sampling for efficient approximation. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show that Parallel Shapley outperforms existing baselines while providing more stable and interpretable training. Our framework effectively "fishes out the free riders," assigning reward proportionally and improving multi-path reasoning in LLMs.

title: AutoJourn: Multi-Perspective Summarisation, Bias Detection and Bias Neutralisation for LLM-Generated News in Automated Journalism
summary: We present AutoJourn, a demonstration system for multi-perspective news generation and bias-aware evaluation using large language models (LLMs). The system tackles three core challenges in responsible automated journalism: extracting diverse perspectives from unstructured social media discussions, generating summaries that preserve viewpoint diversity, and detecting or mitigating bias in AI-generated news. The pipeline integrates advanced prompt engineering with optional retrieval augmentation to produce semantically diverse perspective sets, a multi-perspective summarisation module that merges conflicting viewpoints into balanced summaries, and a bias analysis suite supporting sentence-level bias detection and type classification in the generated news article, and automatic neutralisation. Users can inspect perspective clusters, compare stance-specific summaries, generate news articles, and apply bias-aware rewrites directly in the interface. We evaluate each component with intrinsic metrics -- semantic diversity, summary quality, and bias reduction and show improvements over strong baselines while maintaining content fidelity. A live, publicly accessible demo accompanies the paper to facilitate reproducibility and further research on socially responsible automated journalism.

title: Disentangling Curriculum Learning in NLP: Towards a Unifying Taxonomy
summary: Despite more than a decade of curriculum learning (CL) research in NLP, the field lacks a principled account of which difficulty function or scheduler to use for a given problem. To understand what has hindered progress towards this account, we propose a fine-grained taxonomy separating difficulty evaluation from training scheduling to enable systematic analysis of CL strategies. For difficulty evaluation, we distinguish attribution source and task dependence, revealing difficulty as a perspectival concept encoding different assumptions about what makes an instance hard to learn. For scheduling, we provide the first formalisation of CL schedulers in terms of expected training contribution, enabling comparison across implementations by introducing retention regimes and monotonicity properties. Applied in a dedicated analysis of CL works in NLP, our taxonomy reveals a systematic incomparability problem: prior works conflate distinct notions of difficulty and scheduling, often pursuing different objectives under the same CL label -- hindering comparison and the accumulation of a coherent evidence base. Beyond diagnosis, the taxonomy supports the design, analysis, and comparison of CL strategies, and motivates evaluation practices that disentangle the sources of observed improvement.

title: Athena-Brain Technical Report: An Efficient Robot Brain for General Intelligence and Embodied Interactio
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in language understanding, reasoning, and world knowledge. As embodied agents become increasingly capable, there is a growing demand for compact models that can serve as an on-device brain, preserving the broad general intelligence of LLMs while enabling effective high-level interaction with embodied environments. Existing approaches, however, often prioritize either general-purpose intelligence or specialized embodied capabilities, making it challenging to satisfy both requirements within a single model. We present \textbf{Athena-Brain-8B}, an 8B LLM designed to serve as an on-device brain for embodied intelligence for embodied intelligence. Through a multi-stage post-training pipeline consisting of General Supervised Fine-Tuning, General Reinforcement Learning, Embodied Expert training, and Model Merge, Athena-Brain-8B maintains strong general capabilities while acquiring strong high-level embodied interaction capabilities and generating concise responses for efficient embodied interaction. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of Athena across both general and embodied evaluations. Compared with the corresponding Qwen3-8B thinking model, Athena-Brain-8B achieves comparable performance on general language and reasoning benchmarks while generating substantially shorter responses. On in-domain embodied benchmarks, Athena-Brain-8B consistently outperforms models of similar scale and surpasses several substantially larger frontier models evaluated zero-shot, demonstrating that compact language models can effectively integrate strong general intelligence with embodied capabilities.

title: DobicVLM: Aligning Chest X-Ray Report Generation with Clinically-Grounded Programmatic Rewards via Group Relative Policy Optimization
summary: Medical imaging is a cornerstone of diagnostics, yet automated chest X-ray report generation struggles with structural adherence, anatomical completeness, and semantic faithfulness. We introduce DobicVLM, a vision-language model combining supervised fine-tuning on MedGemma-4B with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and clinically-grounded programmatic rewards. Our approach uses interpretable, rule-based reward components; structural verification, anatomical checklist, semantic similarity, and length constraints to enforce clinical standards without neural reward models. Trained on 1,000 de-identified image-report pairs from a private clinical dataset (with ethics approval and compliance to local regulations), DobicVLM is evaluated via blinded expert review on 69 held-out cases. DobicVLM outperforms Gemini 2.5 Flash across the majority of criteria, achieving the highest impression accuracy (27.2%) and medical terminology (86.5%) compared to both Gemini 2.5 Flash and MedGemma 4B baselines, with minor trade-offs in completeness and referrals. This demonstrates GRPO's value for transparent alignment in resource-limited settings. Keywords: Vision-Language Models, Radiology Report Generation, Reinforcement Learning, Medical AI, GRPO

title: SWITi: Quantifying and Reducing Tiling Artifacts with Sliding Window Inner Tiling
summary: SWITi is a test-time method for reducing artifacts in tiled predictions, particularly for neural networks that learn posterior distributions from which solutions are sampled at inference time. Tiled predictions are unavoidable for large image data, and artifacts arise whenever tiles are smaller than a network's receptive field and when tiles are independent posterior samples. SWITi averages overlapping sliding-window predictions, so discrepancies between neighboring samples are spread across shifted tile positions rather than accumulating at fixed seam coordinates. For posterior models, SWITi uses no more tile samples than an MMSE estimate requires and therefore incurs no additional forward passes. Additionally, we introduce two reference-free metrics, the Fraction of Rejected Tests (FRT) and Artifact Severity (ASV), for detecting and quantifying tiling artifacts from a per-tile permutation test that compares the distribution of pixel gradients across tile seams against the surrounding image content. On pre-trained and published image splitting models across three fluorescence microscopy datasets in 2D and 3D, we show that SWITi substantially attenuates stitching seams while also improving reconstruction fidelity and resolution. Since tiling artifacts in posterior predictions can easily be mistaken for biological structures or for boundaries between biological structures, removing or reducing them using SWITi will improve the downstream processing of large image predictions, which is particularly relevant for biomedical data.

title: Bayesian Sequential Quantum Amplitude Estimation for Rare-Event Structural Failure Probability
summary: Structural reliability analysis often requires estimating small failure probabilities under uncertainty, a task for which direct Monte Carlo simulation becomes inefficient because failure observations are scarce. Quantum amplitude estimation offers a potential quadratic improvement in query complexity for bounded expectation estimation, but practical iterative formulations require reliable inference from finite, amplified measurement data. This paper develops a Bayesian sequential formulation of iterative quantum amplitude estimation for rare-event structural failure probability estimation. Structural failure is represented as a binary indicator over a finite stochastic ensemble and encoded through a lookup-table oracle, allowing the failure probability to be treated as a quantum amplitude. Measurement outcomes collected at different Grover depths are assimilated through Bayesian updating over the amplitude angle, yielding posterior estimates, credible intervals, and uncertainty-aware convergence diagnostics. The framework is evaluated on stochastic finite-element benchmark problems, including a one-dimensional bar and an L-bracket with stress concentration. The results show that amplitude amplification converts rare failure events into measurable success probabilities, enabling substantially lower estimation errors than direct Monte Carlo simulation under the same idealized oracle-query budget. The Bayesian formulation achieves point-estimation accuracy comparable to maximum-likelihood IQAE while additionally providing posterior uncertainty quantification, credible intervals, and transparent convergence assessment. The study demonstrates Bayesian IQAE as a statistically interpretable proof-of-concept for quantum-assisted rare-event reliability analysis, while relying on idealized oracle access.

title: Benchmarking Deep Learning Approaches for AEC Engineering Drawing Layout Detection and Information Extraction
comments: 2026 European Conference of Computing in Construction (EC3 2026), 8 pages
summary: Information Extraction (IE) from Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) drawings remains hindered by manual inefficiency, while Layout Detection, a vital 'middleware' organizing graphical and textual hierarchies, is underexplored. General document layout models, optimized for text-centric content, lack validation on engineering drawings. This study constructs a custom AEC-specific layouts dataset and benchmarks five deep learning architectures. RF-DETR achieves state-of-the-art performance with an $mAP_{50}$ of 0.949, while the Vision-Language Model Qwen3-VL attains a leading F1-score of 0.911. Conversely, models pre-trained on general document datasets suffer from "domain interference", causing performance degradation. This establishes a robust technical foundation for automated IE in AEC.
comment: 2026 European Conference of Computing in Construction (EC3 2026), 8 pages

title: MedDDC-Eval: Diagnosis-Decoupled Evaluation of Multi-Turn Medical Consultation Agents
summary: Multi-turn medical consultation agents must decide what to ask, adapt to patient responses, and determine when the collected evidence is sufficient. However, coupled evaluation conflates the quality of the policy-elicited history with policy-specific terminal diagnosis generation: strong generation can compensate for a thin history, while weaker generation can obscure a rich one. We introduce MedDDC-Eval, a diagnosis-decoupled testbed that treats elicited history as the comparison object and holds the history-to-diagnosis mapping constant through a shared frozen reader. Across two held-out sources, a grounded interface and an auditable diagnosis-trajectory-efficiency (D/T/E) harness measure diagnostic usefulness, information acquisition, and efficiency. Directional semantic coverage followed by deterministic one-to-one assignment yields coherent precision-recall counts for open-ended items, with at most one credited match per prediction or reference. Holding histories fixed, changing only the diagnostic reader shifts diagnosis F1 by 2.2-19.0 points and reverses 18% and 36% of pairwise policy orderings on the Record and Dialogue splits. We further apply standard Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) over interactive multi-turn rollouts to post-train Qwen3-32B using diagnosis-result and trajectory feedback. On the 100-case Record and 70-case Dialogue splits, the trained policy improves over its initialization by 9.7 and 4.6 total-score points; removing either primary signal lowers held-out joint performance. These results show that MedDDC-Eval supports controlled attribution, interpretable elicited-history measurement, and evaluation-guided evidence-acquisition policy development.

title: Learning Semantic-Robust Change Detection via Semantic-Invariant Self-Distillation
summary: Change detection aims to identify semantic changes between remote sensing images. However, features from models are easily disturbed by non-semantic variations, such as illumination, shadows, and atmospheric changes, leading to false alarms and limited generalization in real-world scenarios. In this paper, we propose \textbf{SCDistill}, a framework for learning semantic-robust change detection via semantic-invariant self-distillation. First, to strengthen semantic consistency, we introduce a semantic-invariant self-distillation strategy that learns semantic robustness from perturbed yet semantically consistent data, empowering the change detector to extract disturbance-resistant features and achieve more reliable and accurate semantic change identification. Second, to expand paired data with non-semantic variations, we design a diffusion-based perturbation simulation pipeline that synthesizes complex environmental changes, enabling the model to explicitly learn to distinguish semantic changes from appearance-level fluctuations and reduce false alarms caused by non-semantic disturbances. These components promote robustness from data and representation perspectives, leading to synergistic performance gains. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SCDistill achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple semantic change detection benchmarks and exhibits strong generalization to binary change detection and change captioning tasks. Code is accessible at https://github.com/elecreak/SCDistill.

title: Subject-Conditioned Glucose Forecasting in Type-1 Diabetes
comments: Accepted at the IEEE EMBC 2026 Conference
summary: Accurate forecasting of blood glucose concentration is key in the management of Type 1 Diabetes, facilitating early detection of adverse glycemic events and supporting timely therapeutic interventions. Despite recent advances in glucose prediction, most existing approaches rely on population-level representations or implicit personalization strategies that fail to deliver effective subject-specific forecasts. In this work, we propose Subject-Conditioned Glucose Prediction (SCGP), a novel multimodal deep learning architecture conceived for personalized blood glucose prediction. SCGP conditions glucose predictions based on observed glucose data and a compact subject-specific representation learned from contextual information. By explicitly separating subject characterization from glucose dynamics modeling and avoiding early fusion of heterogeneous inputs, the proposed framework effectively captures inter-subject variability while preserving robust and reliable temporal modeling. Experiments on two state-of-the-art benchmark datasets demonstrate that SCGP consistently improves forecasting performance, enabling reliable detection of adverse glycemic events across multiple prediction horizons, highlighting the benefits of explicit subject conditioning for personalized diabetes management.
comment: Accepted at the IEEE EMBC 2026 Conference

title: Caring Over Computing: An Ethical and Sociotechnical Perspective on Generative AI for Social Connectedness in Dementia Care
comments: Preprint version of a manuscript submitted to Frontiers in Digital Health - Human Factors and Digital Health, under review. 27 pages, 1 figure
summary: People with dementia in residential care often experience reduced social connectedness. Person-centered care approaches foreground meaningful social interactions to support well-being, but staff and time pressures increasingly constrain opportunities for such care. Generative AI (GenAI) technologies offer possibilities for helping care professionals facilitate social connectedness, despite increasing care pressures. Yet, the meaningful integration of such technologies into the complex sociotechnical setting of residential dementia care is not straightforward. To responsibly design GenAI technologies for dementia care, we need to investigate how care professionals recognize and foster social connectedness and how technologies intersect with those approaches in care contexts. We conducted five workshops with 15 care professionals from three care organizations to pursue this objective. Our findings show that fostering social connectedness involves ongoing interpretation, negotiation, and adaptation to residents' individual needs. Technology was used by care professionals to support communication, interaction, and shared activities, yet remained largely peripheral to everyday care routines and required active mediation for use in practice. Drawing on an ethics of care framework, we derive ethical and sociotechnical implications for the responsible design and positioning of GenAI in residential dementia care.
comment: Preprint version of a manuscript submitted to Frontiers in Digital Health - Human Factors and Digital Health, under review. 27 pages, 1 figure

title: Computational Humor with Multimodal LLMs: Methods, Datasets, Evaluation, and Challenges
summary: Multimodal humor in memes, cartoons, and comics remains difficult for AI systems because intended meaning depends on non-literal mechanisms, shared cultural knowledge, and communicative intent rather than literal scene description. This survey focuses on visual humor understanding in single-image and multi-panel artifacts, while treating humor generation as an emerging downstream frontier. We position the literature against prior humor, sarcasm, and general MLLM surveys and organize it using a capability-centric hierarchy spanning recognition, interpretation and reasoning, and generation. Under this lens, we synthesize benchmark design, evaluation protocols, and modeling paradigms, tracing the field's shift from task-specific fusion models to large-model approaches based on multimodal alignment, evidence-grounded reasoning, and controlled generation. We conclude by highlighting the main barriers to progress: shortcut-prone evaluation, limited cultural and narrative coverage, weak evidence grounding, and unresolved safety and ownership concerns.

title: Biological Amnesia in ICU Time-Series Prediction: A Drift-Adaptive Two-Stream Architecture with Temporal Retrieval
