重要性：统一了刚体、柔性体和人形运动等多领域的 Real2Sim 转换流程，且证明了开源小模型即可实现与顶级大模型相当的效果，大幅降低了构建高质量机器人仿真环境的门槛。
局限性：受限于视觉感知模型和 VLM 的推理能力上限，在面对极其复杂的隐性物理特性（如复杂流体、极高动态摩擦等）时，物理参数推断的准确度可能受到一定限制。

title: ABot-World-0: Infinite Interactive World Rollout on a Single Desktop GPU
summary: We present ABot-World-0, an action-conditioned video world model for real-time, long-horizon closed-loop interaction, supported by a multi-source data infrastructure spanning AAA games, simulation engines, and internet videos to learn controllable world dynamics. WorldExplorer performs agent-driven collection guided by training feedback, while a unified pipeline applies 14 deterministic quality checks, VLM-based assessment, and synchronized action and text annotation. We progressively distill a bidirectional action-conditioned teacher into a causal student through teacher forcing and ODE distillation, and introduce LongForcing to align long student self-rollouts with an extended-horizon teacher, mitigating accumulated distribution shift and autoregressive drift. Raw keyboard actions provide a unified control interface for scene roaming and third-person character interaction, while reference-character memory provides persistent appearance cues for identity consistency during third-person rollouts. For deployment, we co-design a streaming inference stack with a lightweight VAE decoder, efficient attention, memory-aware scheduling, and low-bit DiT inference. Across optimized low-bit configurations, ABot-World-0 streams 720P video at up to 16 FPS on a single NVIDIA RTX 5090 desktop GPU, with 1.2s action-to-first-frame latency and approximately 19GiB peak VRAM. Experiments on WorldRoamBench and extended interactive rollouts demonstrate competitive controllability and coherent long-horizon world evolution.

AI.title_translation: ABot-World-0：单块桌面 GPU 上的无限交互式世界演化
AI.tldr: ABot-World-0 是一个动作条件视频世界模型，能在单块 RTX 5090 GPU 上以 720P 16FPS 实时生成连贯的无限长交互式世界。
AI.motivation: 解决视频世界模型在实时、长时域闭环交互中容易出现的累积分布偏移与自回归漂移问题，并实现在单块桌面级 GPU 上进行高效实时部署。
AI.method:
1. 建立多源数据基础设施，使用 WorldExplorer 进行智能体驱动的数据采集与质量校验；
2. 结合 Teacher Forcing 和 ODE 蒸馏，将双向教师模型蒸馏为因果学生模型，并提出 LongForcing 减轻累积自回归漂移；
3. 使用键盘动作统一控制场景漫游与角色交互，引入参考角色记忆保持外观一致性；
4. 协同设计流式推理栈，结合轻量 VAE 解码器、高效注意力机制、内存感知调度及低比特 DiT 推理。
AI.result: 在单块 NVIDIA RTX 5090 桌面 GPU 上，ABot-World-0 能够以高达 16 FPS 的帧率实时流式输出 720P 视频，动作到首帧延迟仅为 1.2 秒，峰值显存约 19GiB，且在长时域演化中保持高度一致与可控。
AI.conclusion: ABot-World-0 证明了通过数据管线优化、模型蒸馏与硬件协同设计，可以在消费级单 GPU 上实现高质量、长时域、低延迟的实时交互式视频世界生成。
AI.translation: 我们提出了 ABot-World-0，这是一个用于实时、长时域闭环交互的动作条件视频世界模型，由涵盖 AAA 级游戏、仿真引擎和网络视频的多源数据基础设施所支持，以学习可控的世界动态。WorldExplorer 在训练反馈引导下执行智能体驱动的数据采集，而统一的管线应用了 14 项确定性质量检查、基于 VLM 的评估以及同步的动作和文本标注。我们通过教师强制（teacher forcing）和 ODE 蒸馏，将双向动作条件教师模型逐步蒸馏为因果学生模型，并引入 LongForcing 将长时自展演化（student self-rollouts）与扩展时域教师模型对齐，减轻累积分布偏移和自回归漂移。原始键盘动作提供了场景漫游和第三人称角色交互的统一控制接口，而参考角色记忆则为第三人称演化过程中的身份一致性提供了持久的外观线索。在部署方面，我们联合设计了一个流式推理栈，包含轻量级 VAE 解码器、高效注意力机制、内存感知调度和低比特 DiT 推理。在优化的低比特配置下，ABot-World-0 在单块 NVIDIA RTX 5090 桌面 GPU 上能以高达 16 FPS 的帧率流式传输 720P 视频，动作到首帧延迟为 1.2 秒，峰值显存约为 19GiB。在 WorldRoamBench 和扩展交互演化上的实验表明，该模型具有极具竞争力的可控性和连贯的长时域世界演化能力。
AI.summary: ABot-World-0 是一个支持实时长时域闭环交互的动作条件视频世界模型。通过多源数据管线、教师-学生蒸馏与 LongForcing 对齐机制，以及软硬件协同设计的流式推理栈，该模型在单块 RTX 5090 GPU 上实现了 720P 16FPS 的低延迟实时渲染与高连贯性的长时域交互生成。
AI.keywords: 世界模型, 动作条件生成, 模型蒸馏, 实时推理, 桌面GPU部署
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于提出了 LongForcing 算法，有效缓解了自回归生成中的分布偏移与漂移问题；同时结合高效蒸馏与流式推理工程优化，成功将复杂的长时域交互式视频世界模型落地在单块消费级桌面 GPU（RTX 5090）上，具备极高的工程实用价值与学术借鉴意义。

title: Cognitive Dual-Process Planning for Autonomous Driving with Structured Scene Knowledge and Verifiable Reasoning-Action Consistency
comments: 12 pages, 7 figures. Zhongyao Yang and Haoyu Li contributed equally to this work
summary: High-level planning for autonomous driving is a knowledge-intensive engineering decision task that requires accurate scene understanding, timely inference, and internally consistent action selection. Vision-language models (VLMs) can make intermediate reasoning explicit, but their use in deployed planners is constrained by costly structured supervision, unnecessary reasoning in routine scenes, and possible inconsistencies between generated rationales and driving actions. We present a cognitive dual-process planning framework that represents planning-relevant scene knowledge in a machine-parsable structured chain-of-thought (S-CoT) schema. An automated data engine integrates perception foundation models, critical-path filtering, and an expert VLM to generate S-CoT supervision without manual annotation of individual rationales. A lightweight visual Arbiter estimates scene complexity from multilevel vision-encoder features before language decoding and routes each input to either fast meta-action prediction or slow structured reasoning. For slow-path outputs, a deterministic rule-based validator checks whether the parsed S-CoT fields are consistent with the final meta-action and provides verifiable rewards for Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). In a 195-scene manual audit, the generated annotations achieve 91.8\% CoT accuracy and a 98.5\% Logical Consistency Score (LCS). On 574 manually verified NAVSIM test samples, the planner achieves 80.14\% planning accuracy and 97.20\% LCS while reducing average latency by 17.39\% relative to applying slow reasoning to every scene. Evaluation on external long-tail subsets further identifies conditions under which routing and planning performance degrade. Together, these results show how explicit scene knowledge can be operationalized through adaptive reasoning and rule-based verification to support high-level VLM planning decisions.
comment: 12 pages, 7 figures. Zhongyao Yang and Haoyu Li contributed equally to this work

AI.title_translation: 具有结构化场景知识和可验证推理-行动一致性的认知双过程自动驾驶规划
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种认知双过程规划框架，通过结构化场景知识和可验证推理-行动一致性，解决了自动驾驶中VLM规划器高成本监督、不必要推理和推理-行动不一致的问题，实现了高规划准确性和低延迟。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶的高级规划是一个知识密集型工程决策任务，需要准确的场景理解、及时推理和内部一致的行动选择。视觉-语言模型（VLMs）可以使中间推理显式化，但其在部署规划器中的应用受到高成本结构化监督、常规场景中不必要的推理以及生成的理由与驾驶行动之间可能存在的不一致性的限制。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种认知双过程规划框架，该框架将规划相关的场景知识表示为机器可解析的结构化思维链（S-CoT）模式。一个自动化数据引擎集成了感知基础模型、关键路径过滤和一个专家VLM来生成S-CoT监督，无需手动标注。一个轻量级视觉仲裁器在语言解码前从多级视觉编码器特征估计场景复杂性，并将每个输入路由到快速元行动预测或慢速结构化推理。对于慢速路径输出，一个确定性基于规则的验证器检查解析的S-CoT字段是否与最终元行动一致，并为群相对策略优化（GRPO）提供可验证的奖励。
AI.result: 在195个场景的手动审计中，生成的标注达到了91.8%的CoT准确性和98.5%的逻辑一致性分数（LCS）。在574个手动验证的NAVSIM测试样本上，规划器实现了80.14%的规划准确性和97.20%的LCS，同时相对于对每个场景应用慢速推理，平均延迟减少了17.39%。对外部长尾子集的评估进一步确定了路由和规划性能下降的条件。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果共同表明，显式场景知识可以通过自适应推理和基于规则的验证来实现操作化，以支持高级VLM规划决策。
AI.translation: 自动驾驶的高级规划是一个知识密集型工程决策任务，需要准确的场景理解、及时推理和内部一致的行动选择。视觉-语言模型（VLMs）可以使中间推理显式化，但其在部署规划器中的应用受到高成本结构化监督、常规场景中不必要的推理以及生成的理由与驾驶行动之间可能存在的不一致性的限制。我们提出了一种认知双过程规划框架，该框架将规划相关的场景知识表示为机器可解析的结构化思维链（S-CoT）模式。一个自动化数据引擎集成了感知基础模型、关键路径过滤和一个专家VLM来生成S-CoT监督，无需手动标注个体理由。一个轻量级视觉仲裁器在语言解码前从多级视觉编码器特征估计场景复杂性，并将每个输入路由到快速元行动预测或慢速结构化推理。对于慢速路径输出，一个确定性基于规则的验证器检查解析的S-CoT字段是否与最终元行动一致，并为群相对策略优化（GRPO）提供可验证的奖励。在195个场景的手动审计中，生成的标注达到了91.8%的CoT准确性和98.5%的逻辑一致性分数（LCS）。在574个手动验证的NAVSIM测试样本上，规划器实现了80.14%的规划准确性和97.20%的LCS，同时相对于对每个场景应用慢速推理，平均延迟减少了17.39%。对外部长尾子集的评估进一步确定了路由和规划性能下降的条件。总而言之，这些结果表明，显式场景知识可以通过自适应推理和基于规则的验证来实现操作化，以支持高级VLM规划决策。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于自动驾驶的认知双过程规划框架，旨在解决视觉-语言模型（VLM）在实际应用中面临的结构化监督成本高、常规场景推理冗余以及推理与行动不一致的问题。该框架引入了机器可解析的结构化思维链（S-CoT）模式来表示场景知识，并通过自动化数据引擎生成S-CoT监督。一个视觉仲裁器根据场景复杂性将输入路由至快速元行动预测或慢速结构化推理。对于慢速路径，一个基于规则的验证器确保S-CoT与最终行动的一致性。实验结果表明，该框架在CoT准确性、逻辑一致性得分和规划准确性方面表现优异，并显著降低了平均延迟。
AI.keywords: 自动驾驶, 双过程规划, 视觉-语言模型, 结构化思维链, 可验证性
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个认知双过程规划框架，有效地结合了快速响应和慢速深层推理，并通过结构化思维链和基于规则的验证器解决了VLM在自动驾驶中存在的监督成本高和推理-行动一致性问题。自动化数据引擎的引入，减少了对人工标注的依赖，提高了实用性。其方法的可验证性为自动驾驶决策提供了更高的可靠性，对于推动VLM在安全关键领域的应用具有重要意义。

title: STL-GCS: A Planner-Controller Framework for Signal Temporal Logic via Graphs of Time-varying Convex Sets
summary: We present a unified trajectory planning and control framework for the satisfaction of Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specifications defined over convex predicates. At the planning layer, STL tasks are encoded as time-varying convex sets in configuration space, specifically designed so that forward invariance of the system with respect to these sets implies satisfaction of the specification with a prescribed robustness margin. This representation is then lifted to the joint time--configuration space and combined with the Graphs of Convex Sets (GCS) framework, yielding a shortest-path formulation of the planning problem over convex spatio-temporal sets. Trajectories are parameterized by B-splines, which enable continuous-time enforcement of STL satisfaction, collision avoidance, and smoothness constraints. At the control layer, the same time-varying sets used for planning are exploited to design a feedback controller that tracks the planned trajectory while prioritizing satisfaction of the STL specification during execution in the presence of tracking errors and model mismatch. We validate the proposed approach in simulation and in real-world experiments on space robotic platforms.

AI.title_translation: STL-GCS: 一种基于时变凸集图的信号时序逻辑规划器-控制器框架
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的规划器-控制器框架（STL-GCS），利用时变凸集和凸集图（GCS）来满足信号时序逻辑（STL）规范，并在仿真和实际机器人平台中进行了验证。
AI.motivation: 满足在凸谓词上定义的信号时序逻辑（STL）规范的统一轨迹规划和控制框架的需求。
AI.method: 规划层将STL任务编码为构型空间中的时变凸集，并结合凸集图（GCS）框架，形成在凸时空集上的最短路径规划问题，轨迹通过B样条参数化。控制层利用相同的时变集设计反馈控制器，在存在跟踪误差和模型不匹配的情况下优先满足STL规范。
AI.result: 所提出的方法在仿真和空间机器人平台的实际实验中得到了验证。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一个统一的轨迹规划和控制框架（STL-GCS），通过时变凸集有效满足STL规范，并在仿真和实际实验中得到验证。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一个统一的轨迹规划和控制框架，用于满足在凸谓词上定义的信号时序逻辑（STL）规范。在规划层，STL任务被编码为构型空间中的时变凸集，这些凸集经过专门设计，使得系统对这些集合的前向不变性意味着以预设的鲁棒性裕度满足规范。然后，这种表示被提升到联合时间-构型空间，并与凸集图（GCS）框架结合，从而产生了在凸时空集上的规划问题的最短路径公式。轨迹通过B样条参数化，这使得STL满足、避碰和平滑度约束能够连续时间执行。在控制层，利用与规划相同的时变集来设计一个反馈控制器，该控制器跟踪规划的轨迹，同时在存在跟踪误差和模型不匹配的情况下，在执行期间优先满足STL规范。我们在仿真和空间机器人平台的实际实验中验证了所提出的方法。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一个统一的信号时序逻辑（STL）轨迹规划与控制框架STL-GCS。该框架在规划层将STL任务编码为时变凸集，并结合凸集图（GCS）进行最短路径规划，轨迹通过B样条参数化。在控制层，利用相同的时变集设计反馈控制器，以在存在跟踪误差和模型不匹配时优先满足STL规范。该方法在仿真和实际空间机器人实验中得到了验证。
AI.keywords: 信号时序逻辑, 轨迹规划, 凸集, 凸集图, 反馈控制
AI.comments: 该论文的创新在于提出了一个统一的规划器-控制器框架，通过将时变凸集与GCS结合来满足STL规范，并利用B样条进行连续时间约束执行，有效连接了规划和控制。其在空间机器人平台上的验证显示了实际应用潜力。

title: Conservative Query and Adaptive Regularization for Offline RL Under Uncertainty Estimation
summary: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) aims to learn an effective policy from a static dataset, but its performance is fundamentally limited by dataset coverage. Action preference queries leverage expert feedback without additional environment interaction, enabling policy improvement during offline training. However, existing methods still face two key challenges: selecting informative preference queries and effectively exploiting the collected feedback. Current approaches typically rely only on the distance between policy actions and dataset actions for query selection, while enforcing fixed constraints that keep the policy close to queried preferences. Such strategies often lead to unstable policy updates and integrate poorly with value regularization. To address these limitations, we propose Conservative Query and Adaptive Regularization under Uncertainty Estimation, a lightweight framework that jointly improves preference querying and preference exploitation. Specifically, we employ a Morse network to estimate the uncertainty of policy actions with respect to the offline dataset. Based on this uncertainty, we introduce a conservative query strategy that selectively queries actions near the dataset to preserve Bellman-update stability, together with an uncertainty-aware adaptive regularization scheme that dynamically adjusts data-level constraints during policy optimization. We integrate our framework with CQL and evaluate it extensively on the D4RL benchmark. Experimental results demonstrate superior or competitive performance across a wide range of tasks.

AI.title_translation: 不确定性估计下离线强化学习的保守查询与自适应正则化
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个轻量级框架，通过保守查询和不确定性感知的自适应正则化，改进了离线RL中偏好查询的选择和利用，解决了现有方法在不确定性下查询选择和反馈利用的挑战，并在D4RL基准上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 离线强化学习中，动作偏好查询在提高策略方面面临两大挑战：选择信息丰富的偏好查询和有效利用收集到的反馈。现有方法仅依赖于策略动作与数据集动作的距离进行查询选择，并强制执行固定约束，这导致策略更新不稳定且与价值正则化结合不佳。
AI.method: 本文提出了“不确定性估计下的保守查询与自适应正则化”框架。该框架使用莫尔斯网络（Morse network）估计策略动作相对于离线数据集的不确定性。基于此，引入了保守查询策略，选择性查询接近数据集的动作以保持贝尔曼更新的稳定性；同时，引入了不确定性感知的自适应正则化方案，在策略优化期间动态调整数据级约束。该框架与CQL集成。
AI.result: 在D4RL基准上进行了广泛评估，实验结果表明在各种任务中均表现出优异或具有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的“不确定性估计下的保守查询与自适应正则化”框架有效地解决了离线强化学习中偏好查询选择和反馈利用的挑战，通过引入不确定性估计和自适应机制，实现了更稳定和高效的策略学习。
AI.translation: 离线强化学习（RL）旨在从静态数据集中学习一个有效的策略，但其性能从根本上受到数据集覆盖范围的限制。动作偏好查询利用专家反馈，无需额外的环境交互，从而在离线训练期间实现策略改进。然而，现有方法仍然面临两个关键挑战：选择信息丰富的偏好查询和有效利用收集到的反馈。目前的方法通常仅依赖于策略动作与数据集动作之间的距离进行查询选择，同时强制执行固定约束，使策略保持接近查询的偏好。此类策略通常导致不稳定的策略更新，并且与价值正则化结合不佳。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了不确定性估计下的保守查询和自适应正则化，这是一个轻量级框架，共同改进了偏好查询和偏好利用。具体来说，我们采用莫尔斯网络来估计策略动作相对于离线数据集的不确定性。基于这种不确定性，我们引入了一种保守查询策略，选择性地查询靠近数据集的动作以保持贝尔曼更新的稳定性，同时引入了一种不确定性感知的自适应正则化方案，在策略优化期间动态调整数据级约束。我们将我们的框架与CQL集成，并在D4RL基准上进行了广泛评估。实验结果表明在各种任务中均表现出优异或具有竞争力的性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个名为“不确定性估计下的保守查询与自适应正则化”的轻量级框架，旨在解决离线强化学习中动作偏好查询的信息选择和反馈利用问题。该框架利用莫尔斯网络估计策略动作的不确定性，并基于此引入了保守查询策略以保持贝尔曼更新稳定性，以及不确定性感知的自适应正则化方案来动态调整约束。实验证明，该方法在D4RL基准上表现出优异或有竞争力的性能。
AI.keywords: 离线强化学习, 偏好查询, 不确定性估计, 自适应正则化, CQL
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入不确定性估计，创新性地解决了离线RL中偏好查询的有效性和稳定性问题。其保守查询策略和自适应正则化方案能够更好地平衡探索与利用，并与现有离线RL算法（如CQL）良好结合，具有重要的实践意义。然而，莫尔斯网络的具体实现细节及其计算效率可能值得进一步探讨。

title: Enhancing Relation Modeling with Social Attributes for Social Media Popularity Prediction
summary: Recent studies highlight the critical role of retrieval-augmented mechanisms in social media popularity prediction (SMPP). Although such frameworks have improved SMPP performance by leveraging historical posts, existing methods still suffer from the low retrieval accuracy due to the oversight of relative relationships among UGC instances. To address this limitation, we propose a novel Relation-Enhanced Retrieval-Augmented framework (RE-Rag) that models UGC similarity as a continuous relation jointly driven by semantic content and social attributes. Specifically, RE-Rag employs a Semantic-Attribute Retriever (SAR) to obtain instances aligned in both semantic and social-attribute distributions. Subsequently, we design a Relation-Guided Predictor (RGP): first, cross-attention encodes multimodal features of retrieved instances; then, a relative relation graph is introduced to guide attention weight allocation, forming a Relation-Guided Transformer (RGTs) that dynamically modulate attention weights based on relative attribute relations to capture the interplay between semantics and various social attributes. The refined features are fused with the target instance for popularity prediction. Experiments on three public benchmarks show that RE-Rag consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both prediction accuracy and retrieval efficiency.

AI.title_translation: 社交属性增强关系建模以预测社交媒体流行度
AI.tldr: 提出RE-Rag框架，通过语义和社交属性共同建模UGC相似度，利用关系引导预测器和Transformer提高社交媒体流行度预测的准确性和检索效率。
AI.motivation: 现有社交媒体流行度预测方法（特别是检索增强机制）因忽视UGC实例之间的相对关系，导致检索准确性低。
AI.method: 提出Relation-Enhanced Retrieval-Augmented framework (RE-Rag)。具体包括：1. Semantic-Attribute Retriever (SAR) 用于获取语义和社交属性分布对齐的实例。2. Relation-Guided Predictor (RGP) 包含交叉注意力编码检索实例的多模态特征，并引入相对关系图指导注意力权重分配，形成Relation-Guided Transformer (RGTs)，根据相对属性关系动态调整注意力权重以捕捉语义和社交属性的相互作用。最后，将精炼特征与目标实例融合进行流行度预测。
AI.result: 在三个公共基准测试中，RE-Rag在预测准确性和检索效率方面均优于最先进的方法。
AI.translation: 近期研究强调了检索增强机制在社交媒体流行度预测（SMPP）中的关键作用。尽管此类框架通过利用历史帖子提高了SMPP性能，但现有方法由于忽视UGC实例之间的相对关系，仍存在检索准确性低的问题。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了一种新颖的关系增强检索增强框架（RE-Rag），该框架将UGC相似性建模为由语义内容和社交属性共同驱动的连续关系。具体而言，RE-Rag采用语义-属性检索器（SAR）来获取在语义和社交属性分布上对齐的实例。随后，我们设计了一个关系引导预测器（RGP）：首先，交叉注意力编码检索实例的多模态特征；然后，引入相对关系图来指导注意力权重分配，形成关系引导Transformer（RGTs），该Transformer根据相对属性关系动态调整注意力权重，以捕捉语义和各种社交属性之间的相互作用。精炼后的特征与目标实例融合以进行流行度预测。在三个公共基准测试上的实验表明，RE-Rag在预测准确性和检索效率方面均持续优于最先进的方法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新颖的关系增强检索增强框架（RE-Rag），旨在解决现有社交媒体流行度预测方法因忽视UGC实例间相对关系导致的检索准确性低问题。RE-Rag通过语义-属性检索器（SAR）获取语义和社交属性对齐的实例，并设计了关系引导预测器（RGP），利用关系引导Transformer（RGTs）动态调整注意力权重，捕捉语义与社交属性的相互作用。实验证明，RE-Rag在预测准确性和检索效率上均优于现有先进方法。
AI.keywords: 社交媒体流行度预测, 检索增强, 关系建模, 社交属性, Transformer
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入社交属性和关系建模来增强检索增强机制，解决了社交媒体流行度预测中检索准确性低的关键问题。其创新点在于将UGC相似性视为由语义内容和社交属性共同驱动的连续关系，并设计了关系引导Transformer动态调整注意力权重，这提供了一种有效捕捉复杂社会交互的新方法。

title: MIRA-Ev:A Benchmark for Granular Evidence Detection and Relational Reasoning in Clinical Exams
summary: Clinical NLP evaluation remains dominated by multiple-choice question answering (MCQA), which scores only final-answer accuracy and cannot detect when a model reaches the correct diagnosis while grounding it in irrelevant, absent, or contradictory evidence. We introduce MIRA-Ev, a clinical argument mining benchmark built on Spanish Médico Interno Residente (MIR) licensing-exam cases, re-annotated by expert clinicians with span-level premises, claims, and directed support/attack relations, and released in parallel Spanish (native), English, and Basque versions, the first clinical argumentation resource in Basque. MIRA-Ev organizes evaluation into a three-tier task hierarchy: evidence sentence retrieval, argumentative component extraction, and relation classification.

AI.title_translation: MIRA-Ev：临床考试中细粒度证据检测与关系推理基准
AI.tldr: 提出了 MIRA-Ev 基准，通过细粒度证据检测和关系推理来克服传统临床医学多项选择题评估的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有的临床 NLP 评估主要由多项选择题（MCQA）主导，只能评估最终答案的准确性，无法检测模型在得出正确诊断时是否基于了无关、缺失或矛盾的证据。
AI.method: 基于西班牙 Médico Interno Residente (MIR) 执业考试案例构建基准，由临床专家重新标注跨度级别的前提、主张以及定向支持/攻击关系，并发布西班牙语、英语和巴斯克语三个平行版本；将评估组织为三层任务体系：证据句子检索、论证成分提取和关系分类。
AI.result: 成功推出了 MIRA-Ev 基准及其三层任务评估体系，涵盖西班牙语、英语和巴斯克语版本，成为首个巴斯克语临床论证资源，能够深入评估模型在临床考试案例中的论证推理和证据检测能力。
AI.conclusion: MIRA-Ev 作为首个细粒度临床证据检测与关系推理基准，有效弥补了现有 MCQA 评估的不足，为临床大模型的推理可信度评估提供了有力支撑。
AI.translation: 临床 NLP 的评估长期以来一直由多项选择问答（MCQA）主导，这种方式只对最终答案的准确率进行评分，无法检测模型在得出正确诊断时是否建立在不相关、缺失或矛盾的证据之上。我们引入了 MIRA-Ev，这是一个基于西班牙 Médico Interno Residente (MIR) 执业考试案例构建的临床论证基准。该基准由临床专家重新标注了跨度级别（span-level）的前提、主张以及定向的支持/攻击关系，并发布了西班牙语（原生）、英语和巴斯克语的平行版本，这也是巴斯克语中的第一个临床论证资源。MIRA-Ev 将评估组织为一个三层任务体系：证据句子检索、论证成分提取和关系分类。
AI.summary: MIRA-Ev 是一个基于临床考试案例的细粒度证据检测与关系推理基准。它通过临床专家的重新标注，构建了包含前提、主张和支持/攻击关系的三层任务评估体系，旨在解决传统多项选择题无法评估模型推理依据的痛点，并推出了西、英、巴斯克三个平行版本。
AI.keywords: 临床NLP, 论证挖掘, 证据检测, 关系推理, 医疗执业考试基准
AI.comments: 该论文填补了临床医学自然语言处理（NLP）中缺乏细粒度证据检测与论证推理基准的空白，不仅超越了传统的多项选择题（MCQA）评估局限，还首次提供了巴斯克语的临床论证资源，对多语言医学AI评估具有重要意义。

title: Assessment in Team Problem-Solving Exercises in Computing Education
comments: Full paper accepted for the main track of the IEEE FIE 2026 conference
summary: This full paper in the research-to-practice track presents methods for assessing student teams in tabletop exercises (TTXs). TTXs enable learner teams to prepare for workplace tasks and practice crisis responses, such as resolving cybersecurity incidents. While assessment is essential for determining how well teams achieve learning objectives, the complex, open-ended nature of TTXs often leads to delayed or incomplete feedback. TTX learning platforms can record teams' actions and communication; yet, leveraging these data to assess performance is underexplored. To address this gap, we compared two post-TTX team assessment methods -- clustering and large language models (LLMs) -- using an original dataset from 81 participants across two countries. We evaluated these methods against instructor-assigned scores based on standardized rubrics. Clustering grouped teams that approached TTX tasks similarly, enabling instructors to deliver faster, targeted feedback to teams within a cluster. This method was valid and reliable, with low computational requirements. LLMs used the standardized rubrics to assess teams' communication. While GPT-4o frequently disagreed with instructor scores, GPT-5.2 demonstrated considerably lower error. The researched methods have been integrated into INJECT, an open-source TTX learning platform, to support scalability and teaching practice. To encourage community adoption, we publicly share all datasets, software tools, and a full-fledged TTX scenario.
comment: Full paper accepted for the main track of the IEEE FIE 2026 conference

AI.title_translation: 计算教育中团队问题解决练习的评估
AI.tldr: 该论文比较了聚类和大语言模型两种自动化评估计算教育中团队桌面演练表现的方法，证明了其有效性并将其集成了开源平台。
AI.motivation: 尽管桌面演练（TTX）在培养团队危机应对能力方面非常有效，但其复杂、开放的特性往往导致评估反馈延迟或不完整，且目前利用学习平台记录的操作与沟通数据进行性能评估的研究尚显不足。
AI.method: 比较了两种基于平台记录数据的后TTX团队评估方法：一是利用聚类将以相似方式完成任务的团队分组以提供定向反馈；二是利用大语言模型（GPT-4o和GPT-5.2）结合标准化评分标准对团队沟通进行评估。并与教师根据标准评分标准给出的分数进行了对比。
AI.result: 聚类方法具有良好的有效性、可靠性且计算需求低；在LLM中，GPT-4o与教师评分常有分歧，而GPT-5.2表现出显著更低的误差。研究成果已集成至开源TTX学习平台INJECT中。
AI.conclusion: 聚类方法和先进的大模型（如GPT-5.2）能够有效辅助评估计算教育中的团队问题解决练习，显著提升反馈效率与可扩展性，并已成功集成至开源平台INJECT中。
AI.translation: 这篇研究实践类的完整论文提出了评估桌面演练（TTX）中学生团队的方法。TTX使学习者团队能够为职场任务做好准备并练习危机响应，例如解决网络安全事件。虽然评估对于确定团队实现学习目标的程度至关重要，但TTX复杂、开放的性质往往会导致延迟或不完整的反馈。TTX学习平台可以记录团队的操作和沟通；然而，利用这些数据来评估绩效的研究尚不充分。为了填补这一空白，我们使用来自两个国家81名参与者的原始数据集，比较了两种TTX后的团队评估方法——聚类和大语言模型（LLM）。我们根据基于标准评分标准的教师评分对这些方法进行了评估。聚类将以类似方式完成TTX任务的团队分组，使教师能够向同一集群内的团队提供更快、更有针对性的反馈。该方法有效且可靠，计算要求低。LLM使用标准评分来评估团队的沟通。虽然GPT-4o经常与教师评分不一致，但GPT-5.2表现出相当低的误差。研究所提出的方法已集成到开源TTX学习平台INJECT中，以支持可扩展性和教学实践。为了鼓励社区采纳，我们公开共享了所有数据集、软件工具和一个成熟的TTX场景。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了两种用于计算教育中桌面演练（TTX）的团队后评估方法——聚类与大语言模型。通过对81名参与者数据的分析，发现聚类能实现高效、有针对性的反馈，而较新的大语言模型（如GPT-5.2）在利用标准评分评估团队沟通方面表现出更低的错误率。相关成果与数据集已开源并集成至INJECT平台。
AI.keywords: 团队问题解决, 桌面演练, 计算教育, 聚类分析, 大语言模型
AI.comments: 本研究探索了利用聚类和大型语言模型对计算教育中桌面演练（TTX）团队表现进行自动化评估的新方法，为解决开放式复杂任务中评估反馈延迟的问题提供了有效途径，具有较高的实用价值和开源贡献。

title: Anatomy-Aware 3D Mesh Refinement of Pericardium Segmentations on Computed Tomography
comments: This preprint has not undergone peer review (when applicable) or any post-submission improvements or corrections. The Version of Record of this contribution is published in the proceedings for MIUA 2026
summary: Accurate delineation of the pericardium in a cardiac CT scan is essential for quantifying epicardial adipose tissue, yet it remains one of the most challenging structures to segment due to its poor contrast boundaries. Instead of solely relying on image gradients, our framework leverages the anatomical context of surrounding anatomical structures to guide the segmentation. This work introduces a novel 3D iterative mesh refinement framework that balances anatomical and geometric forces derived from inherent anatomical rules to refine an initial, possibly ambiguous, segmentation into a high-precision, anatomically plausible result. Designed as a model-agnostic post-processing step, our method uses a 3D vector field to iteratively push the vertices to the correct anatomical locations. Evaluating the refinement on both a high-resolution in-house dataset and a coarse, sparsely annotated open-source dataset, our method consistently improves all volumetric, surface, and anatomical metrics. The framework demonstrates greater improvement when applied to weaker initial segmentations, highlighting its potential for improving segmentations for out-of-domain models and in limited-training-data scenarios. The method is formulated as a gradient-based, GPU-accelerated framework that can be easily extended to other anatomical use cases.

AI.title_translation: 基于CT图像的心包分割的三维网格解剖感知细化
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种新的三维网格细化框架，利用解剖学上下文来提高心包分割的准确性，特别是在初始分割较差的情况下。
AI.motivation: 心包在心脏CT扫描中的准确描绘对于量化心外膜脂肪组织至关重要，但由于其对比度边界不清，分割极具挑战性。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的三维迭代网格细化框架，该框架结合了解剖学和几何学力，并使用三维矢量场迭代地将顶点推向正确的位置，以优化初始分割。该方法作为一种模型无关的后处理步骤，并以梯度为基础，通过GPU加速。
AI.result: 该方法在内部数据集和公开数据集上都持续改进了所有体积、表面和解剖学指标，对较差的初始分割效果尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够通过利用解剖学上下文和几何约束来提高心包分割的准确性和解剖学合理性，尤其在初始分割质量不高的情况下，显示出在不同模型和数据限制场景下的潜力。
AI.translation: 准确描绘心脏CT扫描中的心包对于量化心外膜脂肪组织至关重要，但由于其对比度边界不清，这仍然是最具挑战性的分割结构之一。我们的框架不再仅仅依赖图像梯度，而是利用周围解剖结构的解剖学上下文来指导分割。这项工作引入了一种新颖的三维迭代网格细化框架，该框架利用源于内在解剖学规则的解剖学和几何学力来平衡，将初始的、可能是模糊的分割细化为高精度、解剖学上合理的 S结果。我们的方法被设计为一种模型无关的后处理步骤，使用三维矢量场来迭代地将顶点推向正确解剖学位置。在对高分辨率内部数据集和粗糙、稀疏注释的开源数据集进行细化评估后，我们的方法一致地改进了所有体积、表面和解剖学指标。该框架在应用于较差的初始分割时显示出更大的改进，突显了其在改善域外模型分割和有限训练数据场景下的潜力。该方法被表述为一种基于梯度、GPU加速的框架，可以轻松扩展到其他解剖学应用场景。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种新颖的三维迭代网格细化框架，用于提高心脏CT扫描中具有挑战性的心包分割。该方法利用周围解剖结构的解剖学上下文和内在的解剖学规则，而不是仅仅依赖图像梯度，来指导分割过程。通过迭代地调整网格顶点，该框架能够将模糊的初始分割转化为高精度、解剖学上合理的结果。作为一种模型无关的后处理步骤，该方法在各种数据集上均显示出对体积、表面和解剖学指标的持续改进，尤其是在初始分割质量较低的情况下，这表明其在处理域外模型和有限数据场景中的潜力。该框架采用GPU加速，易于扩展到其他解剖学应用。
AI.keywords: 心包分割, 三维网格细化, 解剖学上下文, CT图像, 图像分割
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的三维网格细化方法，通过整合解剖学上下文来解决心包分割的挑战。其模型无关的后处理特性和对初始分割质量的适应性使其具有广泛的应用前景。然而，计算效率和对不同CT扫描质量的鲁棒性仍有待进一步评估。

title: Do LLMs Ask the Right Questions? Evaluating GPT-Generated Surveys as Instruments for Measuring Social Attitudes
summary: Understanding human beliefs and social attitudes often relies on carefully designed survey instruments. Recent work has suggested that large language models (LLMs) could automate parts of this process by generating surveys at scale, raising questions about the comparability of such instruments to literature-grounded, human-designed surveys. We present a controlled empirical comparison between GPT-generated surveys and established survey baselines across three social domains: climate change, immigration, and diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI). GPT-generated surveys were produced using a fixed prompting framework enforcing a 3x3 structure over beliefs, perceptions, and behaviors, while human baselines were assembled from validated instruments to match survey length and construct coverage. We collected responses from U.S.-based participants, who completed both survey types, allowing direct within-subject comparison. We analyze differences in response distributions, clustering behavior, and alignment with self-identified stances. Our results show that GPT-generated surveys capture the same dominant attitudinal divisions as human-designed instruments, while exhibiting differences in the resolution of belief structure and group separation. These findings suggest that LLM-generated surveys are suited for exploratory and large-scale analyses, and can be used to complement expert-designed instruments.

AI.title_translation: 大型语言模型会问对问题吗？评估 GPT 生成的调查问卷作为衡量社会态度的工具
AI.tldr: 该研究比较了 GPT 生成的调查问卷和人类设计的调查问卷在衡量社会态度方面的有效性，发现 GPT 生成的调查问卷在捕捉主要态度分歧方面与人类设计的调查问卷相似，但在信念结构和群体分离的解析度方面存在差异，建议 GPT 生成的调查问卷可用于探索性和大规模分析。
AI.motivation: 探索大型语言模型（LLMs）是否能够自动化生成调查问卷，并评估其与传统人工设计的调查问卷在衡量社会态度方面的可比性。
AI.method: 在气候变化、移民以及多元化、公平和包容性（DEI）三个社会领域，对 GPT 生成的调查问卷和已建立的调查问卷基线进行了受控的实证比较。GPT 生成的调查问卷采用固定的提示框架，强制执行 3x3 的信念、感知和行为结构；而人工基线则从经过验证的工具中组装而成，以匹配调查问卷的长度和结构覆盖范围。收集了美国参与者的回应，他们完成了两种类型的调查问卷，以便进行直接的受试者内比较。分析了回应分布、聚类行为以及与自我认同立场的对齐程度的差异。
AI.result: 研究结果表明，GPT 生成的调查问卷在捕捉主要态度分歧方面与人类设计的调查问卷相似，但在信念结构的解析度和群体分离方面存在差异。
AI.conclusion: LLM 生成的调查问卷适合进行探索性和大规模分析，并且可以作为专家设计的工具的补充。
AI.translation: 理解人类的信念和社会态度通常依赖于精心设计的调查工具。最近的研究表明，大型语言模型（LLMs）可以通过大规模生成调查问卷来自动化这一过程的某些部分，这引发了关于此类工具与基于文献的人类设计调查问卷可比性的问题。我们对 GPT 生成的调查问卷和已建立的调查问卷基线进行了受控的实证比较，涵盖了三个社会领域：气候变化、移民以及多元化、公平和包容性（DEI）。GPT 生成的调查问卷采用固定的提示框架，强制执行 3x3 的信念、感知和行为结构，而人工基线则从经过验证的工具中组装而成，以匹配调查问卷的长度和结构覆盖范围。我们收集了美国参与者的回应，他们完成了两种类型的调查问卷，以便进行直接的受试者内比较。我们分析了回应分布、聚类行为以及与自我认同立场的对齐程度的差异。我们的结果表明，GPT 生成的调查问卷在捕捉主要态度分歧方面与人类设计的调查问卷相似，但在信念结构的解析度和群体分离方面存在差异。这些发现表明，LLM 生成的调查问卷适合进行探索性和大规模分析，并且可以用来补充专家设计的工具。
AI.summary: 本研究通过实证比较评估了 GPT 生成的调查问卷在衡量社会态度方面的有效性。研究发现，尽管 GPT 生成的调查问卷在捕捉主要态度分歧方面与人类设计的调查问卷表现相似，但在解析信念结构和群体分离方面存在差异。研究结论认为，GPT 生成的调查问卷可作为一种有价值的工具，用于探索性和大规模的社会态度分析，并可补充传统方法。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型,调查问卷生成,社会态度测量,GPT,实证比较
AI.comments: 该研究首次对 LLM 生成的调查问卷的有效性进行了实证评估，并将其与人类设计的调查问卷进行了直接比较。研究结果具有重要的实际意义，为 LLM 在社会科学研究中的应用提供了指导。然而，研究也存在一些局限性，例如仅使用了 GPT-3.5 模型，并且研究对象仅限于美国参与者。未来的研究可以扩展到其他 LLM 模型和更广泛的人群。

title: Computing on the Fly: Navigating a Vision for the Future of Drone Computing
summary:
The report envisions a decade in which drones move goods, medical supplies, and information at a scale comparable to national infrastructure investments like highways and the electric grid. Potential applications include natural disaster detection drones that spot wildfire sources within minutes, medical supply chains that bypass ground congestion to reach rural hospitals, and nationwide fleets that continuously inspect bridges and power lines. Realizing this future, however, requires closing what report authors call a "capability gap," where hardware and aspirations are outpacing the software and systems needed to operate safely at scale.
  The report identifies twelve technical challenges that must be addressed to realize the transformative potential of drone technology: Scaling to millions of drones; AI intelligence and assurance; Edge-cloud continuum and real-time coordination; AI autonomy and agentic systems; Data, training, and validation infrastructure; Critical infrastructure protection; Building reliable fleets from non-deterministic agents; Trust, security, and distributed authentication; Next-generation drone networks; Human-AI partnership and scalable insight; Standards, certification, and regulation; and Workforce development and education.
  These twelve challenges and proposed approaches to them form the basis of the report, laying out a multifaceted path forward for the evolution of done technology.

AI.title_translation: 即时计算：探索无人机计算的未来愿景
AI.tldr: 报告指出未来无人机大规模应用面临软硬件“能力差距”，并提出了必须解决的十二大技术挑战及发展路径。
AI.motivation: 为了应对无人机在货物运输、医疗物资配送、灾害检测等大规模基础设施应用中，硬件与远大设想超越了安全规模化运营所需的软件和系统这一“能力差距”问题。
AI.method: 报告通过勾勒未来愿景、识别软硬件之间的“能力差距”，系统地梳理并提出了未来十年无人机计算技术发展必须解决的十二大技术挑战及应对方法。
AI.result: 明确并总结了实现未来变革性无人机技术所需解决的十二个关键技术挑战，为无人机技术的未来演进铺平了多维度的发展道路。
AI.conclusion: 实现未来大规模无人机应用的愿景，关键在于弥合软硬件之间的“能力差距”，并通过系统性地解决所提出的十二大技术挑战来推动无人机计算的演进。
AI.translation:
该报告设想了未来十年无人机以可媲美高速公路和电网等国家基础设施投资的规模来运送货物、医疗物资和信息的时代。潜在应用包括数分钟内发现野火源头的自然灾害探测无人机、绕过地面拥堵到达农村医院的医疗供应链、以及持续检查桥梁和输电线路的全国性机队。然而，实现这一未来需要弥合报告作者所称的“能力差距”，即硬件和宏伟设想的发展速度超过了安全大规模运营所需的软件和系统。
报告指出了实现无人机技术变革潜力必须解决的十二项技术挑战：扩展到数百万架无人机；AI智能与保障；边缘云连续体与实时协调；AI自主性与智能体系统；数据、训练与验证基础设施；关键基础设施保护；从非确定性智能体构建可靠机队；信任、安全与分布式认证；下一代无人机网络；人机伙伴关系与可扩展洞察；标准、认证与监管；以及劳动力发展与教育。
这十二项挑战及其提出的应对方法构成了报告的基础，为无人机技术的演进铺平了多维度的发展道路。
AI.summary: 该报告展望了未来十年无人机作为国家级基础设施的大规模应用前景，指出了当前软硬件发展的不均衡（即“能力差距”），并提出了实现安全规模化运营所需应对的十二大关键技术挑战与解决途径。

title: Keeping the Cache Warm Pays: Keepalive Economics for Agentic Workloads
comments: 5 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Measurement data and harness: https://github.com/mempko/pi (scripts/cache-research)
summary: Frontier LLM providers cache a prompt's processed prefix so that a follow-up request sharing it pays ~10% of the input price and skips most of the prefill latency. Agentic workloads systematically destroy this benefit: the agent sends a request, runs a tool or waits for approval for minutes, and by the time the follow-up is sent the cached prefix has been evicted, so the agent pays the full prefill again. A client-side keepalive, replaying the prefix on a timer during the pause, prevents this, and it is individually rational: across Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and DeepSeek we show that a keepalive holds the prefix warm through gaps where idle baselines are evicted, cutting the post-pause request cost by up to 12.5x. The strategic question is the ping frequency, and it has a clean answer: keepalive cost falls monotonically in the interval, so the economical choice is the largest interval safely under the provider's TTL, about 4 minutes at Anthropic's 5-minute TTL rather than the 30-second convention, and the strategy breaks even against a re-prefill at idle ~tau(w/r - 1) (~46 min for Anthropic, ~36 min for OpenAI and DeepSeek). Because the benefit is real and bounded only by each user's own bill, rational adoption is universal adoption; and since cache residency is priced per read rather than per token-hour, a keepalive-saturated tier gives LRU eviction nothing to rank. We argue this externality will push providers to meter cache residency directly, and one already does. We derive the operator's policy until then.
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables. Measurement data and harness: https://github.com/mempko/pi (scripts/cache-research)

title: HACO: Hedged Agent Computing for Reliable LLM Systems
summary: As large language model (LLM) agents move from isolated prompting to longhorizon workflows, failures increasingly arise at the role-to-instance binding boundary, where task-specific role requests must be assigned to concrete agent instances under current service, network, and query conditions. Existing agent system research has improved role specialization, workflow topology, memory, and tool use, but often assumes a fixed stable execution environment. This assumption limits deployed reliability, because the same role request can exhibit different latency, failure probability, and output quality across agent instances operating under different service regions and network conditions. We propose Hedged Agent Computing (HACO), a runtime control scheme that treats each role request as a reliability-constrained selection problem over candidate agent instances, each coupling a role type, an LLM, and a concrete execution environment. Different from routing, HACO adaptively selects a hedge set of candidates for each invocation. Its allocation rule combines optimistic ranking, which prioritizes candidates with high estimated quality, reliability, and informative uncertainty, with conservative reliability accumulation, which stops selection only after the hedge set reaches a target success probability. Through experience harvesting, HACO updates candidate and link profiles from all executed candidate traces, including quality, success, latency, and network statistics. Experiments on various benchmarks, together with runtime degradation studies, show that HACO improves robustness and output quality under changing deployment conditions, while using lower token and latency cost than exhaustive parallel execution.

title: Squeezing the Most Out of Preemption for AoI Minimization: Single-source Case
summary: In this work, we study a single-source single-server continuous-time status update system where the updates arrive according to a Poisson process and update service times are generally distributed. In our proposed setting, a preemption policy refers to one where a new update preempts the ongoing one with a probability depending on the age of the update in service. We first propose an analytical method to derive the average age of information (AoI) and average peak AoI (PAoI) for any such preemption policy. This analysis is then utilized to tune two particular preemption policies: (i) probabilistic preemption (PP), in which preemption takes place according to a fixed probability regardless of the update age, (ii) threshold-based preemption (TP), for which preemption is incurred when the update age exceeds a certain threshold, both using one-dimensional line search. The effectiveness of policy tuning for the PP and TP policies is validated using lognormal-distributed update service times.

title: Beyond Score Prediction: LLM-Based Essay Scoring and Feedback Generation via Reinforcement Learning with Rubric Rewards
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have been widely applied to automated essay scoring (AES) and automated feedback generation (AFG). However, existing studies rely primarily on prompt engineering or supervised fine-tuning, while systematic research on reinforcement learning (RL) post-training and automated evaluation of feedback quality remains limited. We propose RLAES, a unified LLM framework that jointly optimizes essay scoring and feedback generation through RL. To make feedback quality measurable, interpretable, and usable for training, we introduce Rubric-based Feedback Evaluation (RFE), an essay-grounded feedback evaluation framework comprising 166 fine-grained binary rubric items and an LLM-as-judge. Building on RFE, we propose Adaptive Gated Feedback Optimization (AGFO), which activates rubric-based feedback rewards on demand during RL, reducing evaluation overhead while improving feedback quality. We also propose Adjacent Contrastive Reasoning (ACR) to improve ordinal score calibration by explicitly contrasting adjacent score levels. Experimental results show that the RFE framework captures essay-feedback consistency, exhibits strong pairwise discriminative power, and closely aligns with expert preferences. On the ASAP benchmark, RLAES-AGFO achieves the best scoring performance among LLM-based methods (QWK = 0.803), while maintaining feedback quality comparable to GPT-5.5 and avoiding the feedback degradation observed under score-only RL. Code and datasets are publicly available at https://github.com/hellomuyi/RLAES.

title: AdaFlash: Adaptive Speculative Decoding via On-Policy Distilled Diffusion Drafters
summary: Speculative decoding, in which a lightweight draft model first generates a draft sequence that is then verified in parallel by the target model, has become a prevalent paradigm for accelerating large language model inference. Recent work such as DFlash further boosts drafting efficiency by leveraging diffusion drafters, whose parallel denoising mechanism enables draft generation in a single forward pass. In this work, we uncover a central pitfall of diffusion drafters: bidirectional attention is a double-edged sword. On one hand, it endows the model with parallel generation and global contextual modeling capabilities; on the other hand, this inherent global dependency introduces high variance at both the domain-level and the token-level: acceptance rates fluctuate substantially across different domains, and draft token quality also varies heterogeneously at different token positions. To tackle this issue, we propose AdaFlash framework, comprising two components: (i) an on-policy distillation (OPD) algorithm with reverse-KL divergence tailored for diffusion drafters, bringing stable convergence and effectively reducing domain-level variance; and (ii) an adaptive length head that dynamically adjusts the candidate sequence length on the fly, substantially lowering the verification cost of the target model and handling token-level variance. Experiments demonstrate that AdaFlash consistently improves speedup rate during deployment, with especially significant gains in high-concurrency scenarios, achieving up to approximately 66% higher throughput than previous state-of-the-art methods.

title: The Price of Reasoning: Cost-Quality Tradeoffs in Reinforcement Learning for Neural Machine Translation
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has been established as a viable paradigm for the post-training of Large Language Models (LLMs), including downstream tasks, such as Neural Machine Translation (NMT). With the latest research indicating that RLVR could be the preferred training method for translating legal documents due to the induced reasoning capabilities, it raises the question whether it is really attributed to the reasoning or more generally to the training paradigm. We investigate the importance of including the model's reasoning trace in the generated responses during both training and inference by systematically omitting it from one of the phases. Our experiments show that including the reasoning, specifically during inference, has a positive effect on the overall translation quality. Furthermore, we recognise that the reasoning leads to an increase in output tokens, hence we study the cost-quality tradeoff between the increased computational demands and the improved translation quality.

title: IGGT4D: Streaming 4D Instance-Grounded Geometry Transformer
summary: Real-world spatial intelligence requires agents to understand scenes from continuous video streams, where objects move, persist, disappear, and reappear over time. While recent spatial foundation models have enabled generalizable feed-forward 3D reconstruction, most streaming methods remain geometry-centric and lack temporally consistent object-level understanding. Meanwhile, existing semantic reconstruction and 3D-aware vision-language methods largely rely on externally extracted 2D semantic cues or loosely coupled geometry inputs, limiting unified geometry-instance learning in long dynamic scenes. In this paper, we propose IGGT4D, a streaming instance-grounded geometry Transformer for online 4D scene understanding. IGGT4D processes video frames sequentially, reuses historical context through causal spatial-temporal modeling, and incrementally updates a unified representation of camera motion, geometry, and object identity. This enables long-sequence feed-forward reconstruction with geometry-instance consistency in dynamic environments. To address the lack of high-quality 4D supervision, we further construct InsScene4D-147K, a large-scale dataset spanning real/synthetic and static/dynamic scenes, with RGB images, depth, poses, and temporally consistent instance masks generated by an automated geometry-guided annotation pipeline. Experiments on 3D reconstruction, pose estimation, instance spatial tracking, and open-vocabulary segmentation demonstrate that IGGT4D outperforms existing streaming baselines while maintaining scalable online inference for long dynamic sequences.

title: Selection Shapes the Boundary: A Preregistered Replication of Monotonicity and Label Agreement in Unselected NLI Populations
comments: 11 pages, 2 figures, 9 tables. Preregistered replication. Code, data, and audit trail: https://github.com/oudeis01/nli-hlv-selection
summary: Prior work on human label variation (HLV) in natural language inference (NLI) has often relied on re-annotation resources that select items by disagreement level. An earlier study (arXiv:2607.15870) found that hypotheses containing non-upward monotonicity operators showed lower label agreement in ChaosNLI (Cliff's delta = -0.284), which is restricted to items whose majority label carries exactly three of five votes. We preregistered a replication of this boundary in the unselected populations that ChaosNLI was drawn from: the SNLI and MultiNLI development sets, using the same operator tagger and a four-level ordinal agreement outcome. The registered prediction fails. All seven contrasts return a positive Cliff's delta (non-upward items agree slightly more, not less), the only significant confirmatory contrast has the opposite sign to the registration, and every effect is far below our smallest effect size of interest (0.10). Robustness checks support the measurement: simulated tagger misclassification shrinks the effects rather than manufacturing them, and a manual re-tagging audit reaches four-class agreement of 0.875 on a fresh 200-item sample. We conclude that the earlier negative boundary is plausibly a structure conditional on low-agreement selection rather than a population-level property, and that HLV structure claims built on selected re-annotation resources should state their selection conditional explicitly.

title: S3: Stable Subgoal Selection by Constraining Uncertainty of Coarse Dynamics in Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
comments: Manuscript accepted to the Eighteenth Workshop on Adaptive and Learning Agents (ALA), at the 25th International Conference of Autonomous Agents and Multi Agent Systems 2026
summary: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (HRL) intends to separate strategic planning from primitive execution. It has been widely successful in solving long-horizon and complex tasks, where flat-RL algorithms have difficulty in learning. However, while the low-level agent in HRL benefits from dense feedback and abundant trial opportunities, the high-level agent receives sparse, delayed feedback from the environment and its performance depends on the low-level execution capability. In this paper, we study whether subgoal selection by the high-level agent can be performed more strategically, by providing it with dynamics-aware intrinsic motivation. Since motivation based on primitive transition dynamics would require broad coverage of the state-action space, we propose to use coarse dynamics, i.e., environment transitions aggregated over multiple steps at the temporal scale at which the high-level agent operates. This approach stabilizes the high-level policy by learning to minimize the predictive uncertainty associated with the coarse dynamics, and provides a guided structure for navigation. We model the predictive uncertainty by evaluating different dispersion metrics as approximated by a Mixture Density Network (MDN). Empirically, we observe that a dense, dynamics-aware intrinsic reward leads to risk-averse subgoal selection, enabling it to outperform state-of-the-art HRL methods in non-stationary long-horizon environments.

title: In-Context Time Series Classification with Random Convolutional Features
summary:
Time series classification is central to domains like medical signal analysis, industrial monitoring, and sensor-based activity recognition, where class information manifests as localized shapes, specific frequencies, temporal shifts, or complex cross-channel interactions. Random convolutional transforms efficiently map these sequences to fixed-dimensional tabular features but are traditionally paired with simple linear classifiers. We investigate whether a pretrained tabular foundation model can more effectively harness these rich representations.
  We propose MASHT, a pipeline that marries MultiRocket and Hydra features with the power of in-context tabular foundation models. By leveraging a pretrained tabular foundation model, our approach completely bypasses task-specific model training, requiring only feature extraction and direct inference. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MASHT matches state-of-the-art time series classification baselines on univariate tasks, achieving a lower average rank than HIVE-COTE 2.0. On multivariate datasets, MASHT remains highly competitive with the strongest reference methods.

title: MeetingToM: Evaluating Multimodal LLMs on Theory-of-Mind Reasoning in Multi-Party Meetings
summary: Theory of Mind (ToM), the ability to infer other's beliefs, intentions, and states of knowledge, is central to social interaction, yet remains challenging for current Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), especially in multi-party meetings where cues are distributed across speech and behavior. Existing multimodal ToM benchmarks mainly focus on video-grounded question answering over overt, externally verifiable signals, and provide limited coverage of latent social states and group dynamics. We introduce MeetingToM, a benchmark for complex social behavior reasoning in naturalistic multi-party meetings. MeetingToM targets meeting-specific phenomena such as \textbf{pseudo-consensus}, where apparent agreement masks private dissent under social pressure. The benchmark is hierarchically organized to evaluate ToM at increasing levels of social granularity, including (i) subject-level mental state prediction, (ii) dyadic-level addressee understanding, and (iii) group-level consensus reasoning. We provide a unified evaluation protocol and conduct systematic analyses of representative MLLMs, revealing persistent limitations in integrating non-verbal cues, inferring hidden attitudes, and distinguishing genuine consensus from pseudo-consensus. Our results highlight key challenges and establish MeetingToM as a testbed for advancing meeting-grounded ToM in multimodal models.

title: DBMol: Design of High-Affinity, Target-Specific Small Molecules through Structure Prediction Models
summary: Designing small molecule ligands that bind with high affinity to specific protein pockets is a fundamental goal in drug discovery, as small molecules constitute a major fraction of approved therapeutics. Recent breakthroughs in structure prediction, such as AlphaFold-3 and Boltz-2, enable accurate biomolecular interaction prediction and show promise as foundation models for downstream tasks, including binding affinity prediction. We propose to leverage these models and introduce DBMol, a new structure predictor-guided framework for de novo small molecule design. DBMol formulates an alternating optimization and projection process. In the optimization stage, DBMol starts from an initial molecule and uses gradient-based optimization to improve pocket-specific interactions and predicted binding affinity using a structure prediction model. In the projection stage, a flow-matching model maps the optimized molecular graph to discrete and chemically valid molecules. Experiments show that DBMol effectively optimizes the Boltz-2 affinity proxy and generates molecules with strong predicted affinity and specificity under Boltz-2 evaluation. To reduce self-confirmation bias, we further evaluate generated molecules using held-out metrics, including AF3-based evaluation. DBMol substantially improves pocket coverage while maintaining molecular diversity over unconditional generation, and is competitive under held-out metrics despite the absence of reference-ligand supervision. These results support the promise of structure prediction models as effective optimization signals for de novo molecular design.

title: FinanceComplexQA: Benchmarking Agentic Reasoning on Industrial-grade Financial Documents
summary: Agentic Reasoning has become a transformative force in financial analysis due to its ability to integrate large-scale information and generate reliable and accurate content. However, when handling complex real-world problems, different agents still show significant performance variation. In this work, we design Finance-LaTeX SKILL, a skill for synthesizing financial documents with complex layouts based on expert knowledge. Using an agent workflow built on this skill, we generate 2,000 professional financial documents along with 6,000 high-quality question-answer pairs. To evaluate the overall capability of agents, we introduce FinanceComplexQA, a comprehensive open-ended generation benchmark for financial documents that closely resembles real-world scenarios. It contains 2,026 deep research tasks targeting 1009 financial documents. FinanceComplexQA has 8 key features: bilingual support; coverage of six mainstream scenarios and seven tasks; expert-level document reasoning questions; deep research of complex layouts; relatively stable and permanent reference answers; and precise evaluation through an Agent-as-a-Judge with multiple evaluation metrics. Using FinanceComplexQA, we conduct a comprehensive evaluation of leading RAG systems and agentic reasoning tools for financial document QA. Through identifying and analyzing failure cases, we provide an in-depth study of their capabilities in numerical computation, multi-hop reasoning, content summarization, and industry analysis.

title: Thermodynamics-Informed Input Reparameterization for Neural Prediction of Real-Fluid Thermodynamic Properties in Supercritical Combustion
summary: Real-fluid thermodynamic property evaluation is a major computational cost in supercritical combustion simulations. In the enthalpy-based pressure-correction formulation, the closure evaluates temperature T, density $ρ$, and compressibility coefficient $ψ$ from the solver state (h,p,Y) through enthalpy-temperature inversion and repeated real-fluid equation-of-state evaluations. Neural-network surrogates offer fixed-cost inference, but direct mapping from (h,p,Y) to $(T,ρ,ψ)$ must capture the enthalpy-temperature relation and non-ideal equation-of-state response, resulting in a complex regression problem. This work introduces a thermodynamics-informed input reparameterization strategy, termed target-aligned input reparameterization (TAIR). TAIR replaces the raw enthalpy coordinate of each property network with a target-matched thermodynamic coordinate: the temperature network uses a temperature estimate obtained by inverting a constant-$c_p$ ideal-gas mixture enthalpy approximation, whereas the density and compressibility networks use an ideal-gas density estimate. These algebraic transformations use only solver-available variables and species constants, guiding the networks to learn real-fluid departures from ideal-gas baselines rather than reconstructing the full closure from raw enthalpy. The method is assessed using supercritical methane-oxygen counterflow flame data against a raw-input baseline and target-inconsistent cross-reparameterization controls. TAIR reduces held-out RMSE by factors of about 1.5, 2.0, and 7.5 for T, $ρ$, and $ψ$, respectively. For an unseen strain-rate flame within the augmented thermodynamic envelope, the corresponding factors are 3.6, 14.5, and 6.0. The target-inconsistent controls perform worse, indicating that the gains arise from thermodynamically matched input design rather than generic preprocessing.

title: Inference-Time Steering for Cross-Lingual Factual Consistency in LLMs
comments: 8 pages (21 in total), 2 figures, 4 tables. Original manuscript for a Guided Research project conducted at the Technical University of Munich, detailing the complete methodology, full data pipeline, and comprehensive experimental results. A related, condensed subset of this work was subsequently adapted and published at the StereACuLT 2026 workshop
summary: Although Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable multilingual fluency, their internal knowledge representations remain disproportionately biased toward high-resource languages. This leads to cross-lingual factual inconsistency, where they shift their empirical answer distributions based solely on the prompt language. We investigate whether these biases can be mitigated at inference time, forcing an English-prompted model to answer as if it were queried in target languages (German, Spanish, Bulgarian), and evaluate four intervention strategies: zero-shot contextual steering (persona prompting), internal representation manipulation via Contrastive Activation Addition (CAA), and lightweight weight modification via Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) trained on benchmark-derived factual data as well as conceptual generalization data. To assess alignment, we curate a multilingual factual dataset alongside a novel generalization benchmark comprising culturally rooted queries to determine whether factual interventions transfer to broader target-centric preferences. Experiments on Gemma 3 12B Instruct reveal persona prompting to be the strongest overall intervention, balancing efficacy, safety, and out-of-domain generalization. While CAA yields sharp inconsistency benchmark shifts, it is configuration-sensitive and risks knowledge degradation. DPO-based adapters offer permanent, yet narrower and less transferable gains. These findings suggest that cross-lingual inconsistency is at least partly a selection problem, and that simple contextual interventions may outperform more invasive methods for robust, transferable alignment.
