AI.title_translation: 果蝇如何保持单一目标：基于果蝇FC2的机制是归一化而非选择
AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析果蝇的神经连接组，发现果蝇保持单一目标方向的机制是归一化而非选择。FC2神经元之间的全局抑制（主要由FB5A细胞介导）将活动维持在一个集中的活动峰值，而不是通过竞争来选择一个目标。研究还排除了其他可能的机制，并提出了一个实验来验证其理论。
AI.motivation: 研究果蝇如何在前庭-运动（FC2）神经元上保持单一目标方向的活动模式，特别是探究其神经回路是主动选择一个目标（winner-take-all）还是仅仅维持一个已确定的目标（归一化）。
AI.method: 通过分析果蝇的神经连接组（FlyWire），追踪FC2神经元之间的抑制性连接，并构建动力学模型（包括脉冲网络模型）来模拟其活动。研究还评估了不同神经元（FB5A、hDelta）在目标选择中的作用，并通过排除法确定了目标设定的上游网络。
AI.result: 研究发现，FC2神经元之间的抑制主要是全局性的，由FB5A细胞提供，而不是局部性的。这种全局抑制阻止了winner-take-all机制的实现，表明FC2神经元是通过归一化来维持一个单一、集中的活动峰值，而不是主动选择目标。研究还发现，目标设定的上游网络可能是一个hDelta网络，并排除了其他可能的输入源。
AI.conclusion: 果蝇通过FC2神经元的全局归一化机制来保持单一目标方向，而不是通过竞争选择。FB5A神经元很可能在这个过程中起到了关键的全局归一化作用。目标设定的上游网络可能是一个hDelta网络。
AI.translation: 一只行走的苍蝇会朝着一个目标方向导航，这个方向在扇形体的FC2神经元群中表现为一个活动“团块”。这些神经元之间还存在远距离抑制，距离越远抑制越强，这种反馈被认为可以使苍蝇保持在单一目标上。我们从神经连接组入手，探究产生这种抑制的神经回路，以及它是让FC2主动选择一个竞争目标（winner-take-all）还是仅仅将目标保持为一个清晰的活动团块。通过追踪单一FlyWire大脑的连接，我们发现这种抑制几乎是全局性的：四个FB5A细胞大致平等地抑制所有FC2神经元，hDelta中间神经元提供了一部分较小的、与距离有关的抑制，而直接抑制则微不足道。扇形体（FB）的环状吸引子winner-take-all机制（如指南针所使用的）需要局部递归兴奋，而FC2的连接缺乏这种结构，因此无法构建这样的机制；并且在包括脉冲网络在内的各种动力学模型中，在神经连接组规模的参考耦合下，没有任何版本的神经回路能够锁定一个获胜者。因此，FC2对外部设定的目标进行归一化处理，而不是选择目标，其中FB5A很可能像蘑菇体中的APL神经元一样，充当全局归一化器。我们明确指出了两个悬而未决的问题：原则上，另一种机制，即两个竞争目标之间的相互抑制（由hDelta提供），在非常强的耦合下可以选择目标，我们对此进行了界定而非排除；并且FB5A的抑制性身份是神经连接组的转录分类器的一个低置信度预测，尚未测量，并且很可能不是GABA能的。然后，我们探究目标实际上是在哪里设定的：神经连接组提出了一个上游的hDelta网络，并排除了主要的备选方案，该备选方案的神经元提供的输入占FC2总输入的不到0.2%。最后，我们提出了一个直接的实验：在成像FC2的同时沉默FB5A，这将检验我们的解释。
AI.summary: 本研究利用果蝇的神经连接组数据，探究了其维持单一目标方向的神经机制。研究发现，果蝇的FC2神经元通过全局抑制网络（主要由FB5A神经元介导）来维持一个集中的活动模式，实现对目标的“归一化”处理，而非通过“winner-take-all”机制主动选择目标。研究还确定了目标设定的上游网络，并提出了一个实验验证方案。
AI.keywords: 果蝇, FC2神经元, 神经连接组, 目标导航, 归一化
AI.comments: 这项研究通过结合神经连接组学和动力学模型，深入揭示了果蝇导航行为背后的神经计算机制，特别是区分了“归一化”和“选择”这两种不同的信息处理方式。研究方法严谨，结论清晰，并指出了未来研究的方向和实验验证的途径，具有重要的科学意义。然而，FB5A神经元的抑制性身份尚未得到实验证实，以及强耦合下的相互抑制机制的精确作用仍需进一步探究。

title: The Tractability Landscape of Sampling with Inexact Scores
summary: We provide a simple and tight characterization of the types of inexact score oracle access that permit sampling with vanishing total variation bias, for a standard, well-behaved target family. Our main result shows that any weaker error than the sub-Gaussian assumption used by [YW26] rules out the tractability of unbiased sampling. This strengthens the conclusion of [CCSW26] to be algorithm-agnostic, and to hold for a wider range of error assumptions.

AI.title_translation: 采样与不精确分数的可处理性图景
AI.tldr: 本文对允许以消失的总变差偏差进行采样的不精确分数预言机访问类型进行了简单而严格的刻画，并证明任何弱于亚高斯假设的误差都会排除无偏采样的可处理性。
AI.motivation: 研究在不精确分数预言机访问下，哪些类型的误差允许进行具有消失的总变差偏差的采样。
AI.method: 本文提供了一种简单且严格的刻画（characterization）。
AI.result: 主要结果表明，任何弱于[YW26]使用的亚高斯假设的误差都会排除无偏采样的可处理性。
AI.conclusion: 本文强化了[CCSW26]的结论，使其与算法无关，并适用于更广泛的误差假设。
AI.translation: 我们对允许在标准、表现良好的目标族下以消失的总变差偏差进行采样的不精确分数预言机访问类型提供了简单而严格的刻画。我们的主要结果表明，任何弱于[YW26]使用的亚高斯假设的误差都会排除无偏采样的可处理性。这强化了[CCSW26]的结论，使其与算法无关，并适用于更广泛的误差假设。
AI.summary: 本文对在不精确分数预言机访问下进行具有消失总变差偏差的采样所需误差类型进行了精确刻画。研究表明，只有满足至少亚高斯假设的误差才能保证无偏采样的可处理性，从而推广并加强了现有研究的结论。
AI.keywords: 采样, 不精确分数, 可处理性, 亚高斯假设, 总变差偏差
AI.comments: 本文通过精确刻画不精确分数预言机访问的误差类型，为无偏采样的可处理性设定了严格的界限。其创新之处在于证明了亚高斯假设是实现可处理性采样的必要条件，并使现有结论更具普适性，对采样理论具有重要意义。

title: Observable Matrix Dynamics of Stocks
summary: The Observable Matrix Dynamics (OMD) approach monitors the time development of complex non-linear systems through the trajectory of a fixed-size distance matrix and its spectrum. We apply it to the S\&P 500 cross section over three crisis decades, the 2001 dot-com bust, the 2007--2008 financial crisis, and the 2020 Covid crash, with three fixed-size observables on a fixed universe. The arccos distance matrix of the rolling return correlations reads the correlation geometry: its effective dimension collapses at the 2008 and 2020 crises, while the 2001 bust is a dispersed unwind. Read against machine-learning distance matrices, its spectrum stays in the un-relaxed, pre-learning regime with no low-dimensional manifold, so the market never learns its correlation structure or relaxes to a stationary geometry. Subtracting the market factor exposes a coherent sector rotation, whose name-level attribution identifies which stocks drive each crisis and in what order. At a short lookback these signals resolve precursors and forecast the endogenous 2008 crisis, though not the exogenous 2020 shock. The other two observables model the daily return and volatility rankings as Markov chains on their ranking spaces. The return chain has persistent, defensive-led bellwethers and near-reversible dynamics. The volatility chain is far more persistent, led by the financial sector, and is the only one to carry a weak, episodic arrow of time, flaring at market stress and matching volatility clustering and the Zumbach effect. All three matrices show coherent changes during market crashes.

AI.title_translation: 股票的可观测矩阵动力学
AI.tldr: 本文利用可观测矩阵动力学方法分析了标普500指数在三次重大危机中的股票相关性、行业轮换及波动率演化，发现该方法能够有效揭示市场危机的内在动力学特征并预测内生危机。
AI.motivation: 监测复杂非线性系统的时间演化，通过固定大小的距离矩阵及其谱来深入研究标准普尔500指数在重大危机（如2001年网络泡沫破裂、2007-2008年金融危机和2020年新冠股灾）期间的动态特征与演变规律。
AI.method: 应用可观测矩阵动力学（OMD）方法，分析S&P 500横截面在三个危机十年的数据，使用固定大小的距离矩阵及其谱、反余弦距离矩阵、机器学习距离矩阵，以及将日收益率和波动率排名建模为排名空间上的马尔可夫链。
AI.result: 2008年和2020年危机期间有效维度崩溃，而2001年则是分散的去杠杆；市场从未学会其相关结构或松弛到平稳几何；减去市场因子暴露出相干的行业轮换；短期回溯信号可预测2008年的内生危机但无法预测2020年外生冲击；波动率链显示出微弱的、偶发的时间箭头并与波动率聚集相匹配。
AI.conclusion: 通过可观测矩阵动力学方法分析S&P 500指数，揭示了不同危机中不同的市场几何形态、部门轮换以及内生危机的可预测性，展现了该方法在监测非线性金融系统方面的强大潜力。
AI.translation: 可观测矩阵动力学（OMD）方法通过固定大小的距离矩阵及其谱的轨迹，监测复杂非线性系统的时间演化。我们将该方法应用于过去三个危机十年（2001年网络泡沫破裂、2007-2008年金融危机以及2020年新冠股灾）的S&P 500横截面，在固定股票集合上使用了三个固定大小的可观测变量。滚动收益率相关的arccos距离矩阵反映了相关性几何：其有效维度在2008年和2008年危机中崩溃，而2001年的泡沫破裂则是一个分散的解体过程。与机器学习距离矩阵相比，其谱保持在未松弛、预学习的状态，没有低维流形，因此市场从未学习其相关结构或松弛到平稳几何。减去市场因子暴露出相干的行业轮换，其个股归因确定了哪些股票在各个危机中推动了危机以及推动的顺序。在较短的回溯期下，这些信号可以解析前兆并预测2008年的内生危机，但无法预测2020年的外生冲击。另外两个可观测变量将日收益率和波动率排名建模为排名空间上的马尔可夫链。收益率链具有持久的、防御性主导的领头羊和近乎可逆的动力学。波动率链更加持久，由金融部门主导，是唯一携带微弱、偶发时间箭头的链，在市场压力时爆发，并与波动率聚集和祖姆巴赫效应相匹配。所有三个矩阵在市场崩盘期间都显示出相干的变化。
AI.summary: 该论文运用可观测矩阵动力学（OMD）方法，通过分析S&P 500在三个危机时期的固定大小距离矩阵及其谱、行业轮换以及收益率和波动率的马尔可夫链，揭示了市场在危机中的动力学行为、相关性几何演变及内生危机的前兆特征。
AI.keywords: Observable Matrix Dynamics, S&P 500, Financial crises, Correlation geometry, Markov chains
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的可观测矩阵动力学（OMD）方法，通过固定大小的距离矩阵及其谱来监测复杂的非线性金融系统，成功揭示了标准普尔500指数在过去三个主要危机期间的市场动力学特征。其亮点在于结合了机器学习距离矩阵、马尔可夫链排序模型以及对市场因子的剥离，为理解金融危机的前兆与演变提供了新的视角。

title: Evaluating DV/CV-QKD Architectures for SAFE Long-Term Secure Storage: A Risk Model and ILP-Based Cost Optimization Approach
comments: This article (now on 15 double-column pages) extends the preliminary version presented at the 2026 International Conference on Quantum Communications, Networking, and Computing (QCNC)
summary: This paper presents a unified cost-modeling and optimization framework designed to evaluate hybrid discrete-variable/continuous-variable quantum key distribution (DV/CV-QKD) infrastructures operating within the SAFE (Secure and Efficient) long-term storage (LTSS) protocol. Our methodology jointly addresses the information-theoretic and computational dimensions of cryptographic durability over multi-decade horizons by coupling a quantitative risk model with a stochastic integer linear programming (ILP) formulation. Going beyond idealized physics-informed limits, the framework incorporates realistic next-generation industrial implementations and multiplexed coexistence specifications, together with a sample-average approximation (SAA) pipeline, to determine cost-optimal and structurally feasible SAFE topologies under transmission-budget and security constraints. The proposed framework is evaluated on both randomized synthetic deployments and realistic metropolitan-scale QKD infrastructures, including the Paris Metro-Scale and Greater Paris networks, to characterize the interplay between network topology, QKD modality, and deployment cost while enforcing a target global compromise tolerance $ε$. Numerical results show that the economically optimal architecture is highly scenario-dependent and that both hybrid and homogeneous modality allocations naturally emerge from the optimization. More importantly, the analysis reveals a non-monotonic relationship between the minimum required QKD link capacity and the infrastructure cost: contrary to intuition, increasing the minimum required per-link secret-key rate may reduce the overall deployment cost by enabling a global transition toward more economical CV-based solutions, whereas further capacity increases do not necessarily yield additional savings.

AI.title_translation: 评估用于SAFE长期安全存储的DV/CV-QKD架构：风险模型和基于ILP的成本优化方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个针对SAFE长期存储中混合DV/CV-QKD基础设施的成本建模和优化框架，该框架结合了风险模型和ILP，以确定成本最优且安全的拓扑结构。研究发现，最优架构高度依赖于场景，并且增加链路容量可能反直觉地通过启用CV-QKD来降低成本。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在通过联合解决跨越数十年期限的密码耐久性的信息理论和计算维度，评估用于SAFE长期安全存储的混合DV/CV-QKD基础设施。其动机是需要在传输预算和安全约束下，考虑现实工业实施，找到成本最优和结构可行的SAFE拓扑。
AI.method: 本文提出了一个统一的成本建模和优化框架。该框架将定量风险模型与随机整数线性规划（ILP）公式相结合。它整合了现实的下一代工业实施、多路复用共存规范以及样本平均近似（SAA）管道。该框架在随机合成部署和真实的都市规模QKD基础设施（如巴黎地铁规模和大巴黎网络）上进行了评估。
AI.result: 经济最优架构高度依赖于具体场景。混合和同质模式分配都自然地从优化中产生。所需最小QKD链路容量与基础设施成本之间存在非单调关系。增加每个链路所需的最小密钥速率可能会通过促使全球转向更经济的CV解决方案来降低总体部署成本。进一步的容量增加不一定能带来额外的节省。
AI.conclusion: 本文得出结论，用于长期安全存储的最优QKD架构高度依赖于场景，并且反直觉地，增加QKD链路容量有时可以通过偏向更经济的CV解决方案来降低成本，但这种效果并非无限。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一个统一的成本建模和优化框架，旨在评估在SAFE（安全高效）长期存储（LTSS）协议中运行的混合离散变量/连续变量量子密钥分发（DV/CV-QKD）基础设施。我们的方法通过将定量风险模型与随机整数线性规划（ILP）公式相结合，共同解决了跨越数十年期限的密码耐久性的信息理论和计算维度。该框架超越了理想化的物理限制，整合了现实的下一代工业实施和多路复用共存规范，以及样本平均近似（SAA）管道，以在传输预算和安全约束下确定成本最优和结构可行的SAFE拓扑。所提出的框架在随机合成部署和真实的都市规模QKD基础设施（包括巴黎地铁规模和大巴黎网络）上进行了评估，以表征网络拓扑、QKD模式和部署成本之间的相互作用，同时强制执行目标全局妥协容忍度ε。数值结果表明，经济最优架构高度依赖于具体场景，并且混合和同质模式分配都自然地从优化中产生。更重要的是，分析揭示了所需最小QKD链路容量与基础设施成本之间存在非单调关系：与直觉相反，增加每个链路所需的最小密钥速率可能会通过促使全球转向更经济的CV解决方案来降低总体部署成本，而进一步的容量增加不一定能带来额外的节省。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个统一的框架，用于在SAFE长期存储协议中对混合DV/CV-QKD基础设施进行成本建模和优化。它将定量风险模型与随机整数线性规划相结合，考虑了现实的工业实施，以在各种约束下确定成本最优和安全的拓扑结构。该框架在合成和真实世界的QKD网络上进行了评估，结果表明最优架构依赖于场景。一个关键发现是QKD链路容量与成本之间的非单调关系，其中增加容量可以出乎意料地通过偏向更经济的CV解决方案来降低总体部署成本，尽管这种益处并非无限。
AI.keywords: 量子密钥分发, DV/CV-QKD, 成本优化, 风险模型, 整数线性规划
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新之处在于提供了一个全面的框架，将信息理论和计算方面与QKD网络设计的实际工业考虑相结合，特别是针对长期安全存储。使用定量风险模型和ILP进行成本优化是稳健的。最重要的发现是链路容量与成本之间反直觉的非单调关系，这挑战了传统假设，并为实际QKD部署策略（特别是CV-QKD的采用）提供了宝贵的见解。其局限性可能在于现实世界风险建模的复杂性以及ILP公式中做出的假设。

title: From Operations to Elderly Care Outcomes: A Thematic Review of Industrial Engineering and Decision-Support Approaches
summary: The rapid growth of the global aging population presents severe challenges to healthcare systems, necessitating efficient, equitable, and patient-centered care models. While Industrial Engineering and Operations Research (OR) provide robust optimization and decision-support tools to address these multidimensional complexities, current applications often remain fragmented. This paper presents a thematic review of 30 seminal studies at the intersection of OR and elderly care, categorizing the literature into home healthcare operations, polypharmacy management, and clinical chronotherapy. Our analysis highlights a significant methodological evolution from static, deterministic models toward dynamic and stochastic frameworks integrated with artificial intelligence (AI). Despite these advancements, a critical translational gap persists: the current OR literature is heavily dominated by process-level optimizations, such as staff routing, and struggles to translate these operational efficiencies into measurable clinical outcomes. Furthermore, holistic models bridging the transition between hospital and community care remain critically underexplored. To develop resilient and smart healthcare systems, this study proposes a conceptual framework that shifts the research focus from isolated operational tasks to integrated, multi-level decision-making. We emphasize the critical need for robust systems analysis, human-inclusive design, and the smartification of care through emerging digital technologies - including digital twins and large language models - to successfully bridge the gap between theoretical operational metrics and tangible patient-level health outcomes.

AI.title_translation: 从运营到老年护理结果：工业工程和决策支持方法的专题回顾
AI.tldr: 该综述探讨了工业工程和运筹学在老年护理中的应用，指出现有研究主要集中在运营优化而非临床结果，并提出了一个将运营与患者健康结果相结合的框架。
AI.motivation: 全球老龄化人口的快速增长给医疗保健系统带来了严峻挑战，需要高效、公平和以患者为中心的护理模式。工业工程和运筹学提供了强大的优化和决策支持工具，但现有应用往往分散。
AI.method: 对30项关于运筹学和老年护理交叉领域的重要研究进行了专题回顾，并将文献分为居家护理运营、多重用药管理和临床计时疗法。
AI.result: 分析表明，方法学上已从静态、确定性模型向集成人工智能的动态和随机框架演变。然而，研究主要集中在运营优化（如人员路线规划），而将这些运营效率转化为可衡量的临床结果方面存在差距。此外，连接医院和社区护理之间过渡的整体模型仍未得到充分探索。
AI.conclusion: 为了开发有弹性和智能的医疗保健系统，研究重点需要从孤立的运营任务转向多层次的集成决策。研究强调了系统分析、面向人的设计以及通过数字孪生和大型语言模型等新兴数字技术实现护理的智能化，以弥合理论运营指标与可衡量的患者健康结果之间的差距。
AI.translation: 全球老龄化人口的快速增长给医疗保健系统带来了严峻挑战，这需要高效、公平和以患者为中心的护理模式。虽然工业工程和运筹学（OR）提供了强大的优化和决策支持工具来应对这些多方面复杂的挑战，但目前的应用往往仍然是零散的。本文对运筹学与老年护理交叉领域的30项开创性研究进行了专题回顾，将文献分为居家护理运营、多重用药管理和临床计时疗法。我们的分析强调，方法学上已从静态、确定性模型向集成人工智能的动态和随机框架演变。尽管取得了这些进展，但仍然存在一个关键的转化差距：目前的运筹学文献主要集中在运营层面的优化，如人员路线规划，并且难以将这些运营效率转化为可衡量的临床结果。此外，连接医院和社区护理之间过渡的整体模型仍然未得到充分探索。为了开发有弹性和智能的医疗保健系统，本研究提出了一个概念框架，将研究重点从孤立的运营任务转向集成、多层次的决策。我们强调了进行稳健的系统分析、面向人的设计以及通过新兴数字技术（包括数字孪生和大型语言模型）实现护理智能化的关键需求，以成功弥合理论运营指标与可衡量的患者级别健康结果之间的差距。
AI.summary: 本文对运筹学在老年护理中的应用进行了专题综述，发现现有研究主要关注运营优化而非临床结果。作者提出了一个框架，强调从孤立的运营任务转向多层次决策，并利用数字技术弥合运营效率与患者健康结果之间的差距。
AI.keywords: 老年护理, 运筹学, 决策支持, 运营优化, 临床结果
AI.comments: 该研究有效地指出了工业工程和运筹学在老年护理领域应用的现状和挑战，特别是运营优化与临床结果之间的脱节。提出的框架具有前瞻性，强调了系统集成和新兴技术的重要性，但其实施的复杂性和实际效果仍有待进一步验证。

title: Wavefront Parallelization for Efficient Learned Image Compression
summary: Autoregressive context models are foundational for learned image compression,but they suffer from slow serial inference. Existing acceleration methods such as checkerboard context require architectural changes and retraining, thus are inapplicable to pre-trained models. We propose a completely training-free inference-time acceleration algorithm inspired by wavefront parallelism in video coding standards. Our method reorganizes inference into an optimal ``staggered'' wavefront order, minimizing sequential steps while maintaining exact autoregressive dependencies. Experimental results show our approach accelerates pre-trained autoregressive models (e.g., Cheng et al.) by more than $13\times$ while preserving the original rate-distortion performance. We also demonstrate that faster decoding is possible by trading off precise context dependencies. Source code will be available at https://github.com/tokkiwa/compressai-wavefront.

title: Fast reconstruction of tensor tomographic X-ray scattering data for real-time applications
summary: X-ray scattering tensor tomography reveals nanoscale structural orientation in 3D, but its reliance on slow iterative reconstruction limits real-time use. We introduce an extension of a direct reconstruction approach for parallel-beam geometries that computes algebraic filters approximating multiple iterative updates with a single filtering and back-projection step. By explicitly separating the tomographic projector from a view-dependent mixing operator, the method generalizes across tensor representations and modes of (small-angle) X-ray scattering measurement. Simulated and experimental results show that the approach approximates iterative reconstructions while reducing computation time by over an order of magnitude, realizing a reconstruction of a 53x53x53x28 tensor volume in 1 second on commercially-available hardware. The resulting speed and stability enable high-throughput analysis and open the door to real-time scattering-based imaging.

title: MIRAGE: Multi-scale Lesion-Informed Representation with Auxiliary Guidance for MRI Contrast Enhancement
summary: Inferring contrast enhancement from one pre-contrast breast MRI slice is underdetermined: post-contrast appearance contains physiological information that is not uniquely encoded in baseline anatomy. Optimizing only paired pixel fidelity can suppress uncertain lesion enhancement, whereas adversarial or stochastic generative objectives can favor realistic post-contrast appearance without guaranteeing patient-specific lesion fidelity. We introduce MIRAGE, a residual 2D U-Net that combines global reconstruction and perceptual losses with three forms of lesion-aware supervision available only during training: an asymmetric penalty for missed tumor enhancement, multi-scale auxiliary tumor segmentation, and guidance through a frozen post-contrast tumor segmentation nnU-Net. We evaluate the method on 301 cases from the multi-centre MAMA-SYNTH data using eight complementary image-, region-, radiomics-, and segmentation-based metrics. MIRAGE ranks first on six metrics and markedly improves downstream lesion localization over tuned pix2pix, conditional diffusion, and latent bridge-matching baselines. The generative alternatives retain advantages in LPIPS or contrast classification, revealing a clear fidelity-utility trade-off. Leave-one-in and leave-one-out ablations show that the losses are partly redundant for lesion localization but exert distinct effects on appearance, radiomics, and boundary accuracy. These results support task-aware synthesis while also showing that its apparent optimality is conditional on the downstream models and metrics used to define utility.

title: Free energy landscape of Dense Associative Memory
summary: Using large deviations theory, we solve and obtain a general expression for the free energy functional for a broad class of associative memories, including dense associative memories. We illustrate the method by reproducing classical results for the Hopfield model. For a finite number of patterns, we derive the temperature-dependent free energy functional for dense associative memories featuring polynomial interactions and Log-Sum-Exponential (LSE) activation. We also evaluate the disorder-averaged ground-state energy of these systems in the extensive limit. Our analytical framework reveals how memory retrieval depends on the initial state in higher-order dense networks, and gives the exact full-retrieval threshold for the LSE model. This method provides a systematic procedure for analyzing diverse, complex architectures in associative memory.

title: ATLAS: A Foundation Neural Sampler for Amorphous Materials
summary: Amorphous materials exhibit exceptional mechanical and functional properties, yet their rugged energy landscapes are notoriously difficult to sample. Below the glass-transition temperature, conventional molecular dynamics and Monte Carlo become inefficient because equilibration relies on rare barrier-crossing events, while data-driven generative models are constrained by scarce and biased reference ensembles. Here, we introduce ATLAS, an efficient sampler that learns a diffusion process to generate Boltzmann-distributed amorphous structures directly from a target energy function. Parameterized by an equivariant graph neural network, ATLAS generalizes across system size, temperature, and composition. By exploiting the time reversal of the diffusion process, it enables efficient estimation of thermodynamic quantities and steering toward target observables. In two-dimensional Kob-Andersen systems, ATLAS reproduces parallel tempering Markov chain Monte Carlo structural distributions, free energies and entropies, achieving below 0.2% free energy error in the low-temperature glass regime with over 500-fold fewer energy evaluations. In Cu-Zr and Cr-Co-Ni metallic glasses, ATLAS recovers experimentally observed short-range-order trends and steers structures toward prescribed order parameters and optimized bulk moduli. Moreover, composition-amortized pretraining outperforms composition-specific training from scratch, reduces inverse-design costs by several hundred-fold, and enables sampling with expensive universal machine learning interatomic potentials. Coupled to a large language model agent, ATLAS searches an eight-element space for high-entropy metallic glasses balancing stiffness and ductility, identifying a converged Pareto frontier within 480 oracle evaluations. Together, these results establish ATLAS as a foundation model for sampling, steering and designing amorphous materials.

title: Teleportation Game: Quantum Teleportation in Multi-Agent Systems for Interactive Music
summary: This paper introduces an interactive music system with quantum musical agents that communicate by teleporting quantum states to one another. Human performers interact in real time with agents whose melodic and rhythmic behaviours are encoded as quantum states using Single Qubit Probability Amplitude Modulation (SQPAM) and structured through Quantum Phase Estimation (QPE). Up to three agents are combined within a single quantum circuit, with directed communication via quantum teleportation. We are interested in supporting ambiguous, transformative interactions reminiscent of free Jazz improvisation. Therefore, rather than treating noise and decoherence as limitations, the system embraces NISQ-era constraints as creative affordances, framing agent communication as quantum whispers, that is, deliberate, musically expressive imperfections in state transfer. We provide demonstrations and analyses based on melodic correlation, pitch-set distance, and state fidelity, where a continuum between imitation and divergence can be observed. We developed a tunable interpretation method to assess how agents reinterpret teleported states. This work positions teleportation as a promising interaction mechanism for agent-based quantum computer music and outlines future directions toward distributed ensembles connected via the Quantum Internet.

title: The Limits of Quantum Computers for Power Flow
summary: This letter proves realistic grid properties limit the applicability of quantum computers for power flow. Grids that split into two large regions meeting at only a few buses, common in transmission networks, force the pseudo condition number of the DC susceptance matrix to grow polynomially in the network size, and long chains of lines bridging such regions force quadratic growth, making recent empirical observations rigorous. The bounds also hold with overwhelming probability for arbitrary bounded random line susceptances. Combined with query and tomography lower bounds, this precludes end-to-end quantum advantage for DC power flow at every readout level, and these obstructions persist through AC power flow, optimal power flow, and unit commitment. All proofs are formally verified with accompanying Lean 4 source code.

title: Resolution of the ENO-TV conjecture: a parity dichotomy
summary: We resolve the ENO--TV conjecture, a discrete coercivity problem in compactness theory for entropy-stable approximations of hyperbolic conservation laws. For order-$k$ essentially non-oscillatory (ENO) reconstruction from compactly supported cell averages, it asks whether the nonnegative ENO source times the $(k-1)$st power of the amplitude uniformly controls the $(k+1)$st absolute-jump moment. We prove a parity dichotomy: the estimate holds for odd $k\ge3$ and fails for even $k\ge4$; the known second-order case completes the classification. Localization gives a selection-independent finite-difference functional uniformly comparable to the source and reduces the conjecture to discrete interpolation. For odd orders, summation by parts reveals a hidden square; a discrete Gagliardo--Nirenberg inequality yields coercivity. For even orders, Euler-polynomial blocks from the functional's polynomial kernel yield counterexamples that persist under arbitrarily small perturbations making all affected ENO comparisons strict. We also prove two coercive estimates for every $k\ge2$: control of jumps larger than a fixed fraction of the amplitude and of local blocks modulo sampled polynomials of degree at most $k-2$. Via the Cayley--Sylvester decomposition, we compute the dimensions of homogeneous first-cohomology spaces for the lattice shift on polynomial jump profiles. At fourth order, for a cubic flux and a globally strictly convex entropy, a total-degree-seven component of a reduced entropy-flux mismatch represents a nonzero class on profiles of degree at most two and hence has no translation-invariant finite-stencil $C^7$ local primitive at the zero constant state. Odd-order coercivity persists on globally quasi-uniform meshes, whereas for each $k\ge2$ it fails on a fixed irregular mesh even though every interface contribution remains nonnegative. This failure is due to the mesh geometry.

AI.title_translation: ENO-TV猜想的解决：奇偶二分性
AI.tldr: 本文解决了双曲守恒律熵稳定近似中的ENO-TV猜想，证明了奇偶二分性：奇数阶（$k\ge 3$）强迫性估计成立，偶数阶（$k\ge 4$）估计失效。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决双曲守恒律熵稳定近似紧致性理论中的一个关键离散强迫性问题——ENO-TV猜想，即确定非负ENO源乘以振幅的$(k-1)$次幂能否一致控制$(k+1)$阶绝对跳跃矩。
AI.method: 通过局域化将猜想化归为离散插值问题；对于奇数阶，采用分部求和法（SBP）揭示隐式平方项，并利用离散Gagliardo--Nirenberg不等式导出强迫性；对于偶数阶，利用泛函多项式核中的欧拉多项式块构造严格反例；此外，利用Cayley--Sylvester分解计算网格平移齐次第一上同调空间的维数，并分析了网格几何对强迫性的影响。
AI.result:
1. 证明了奇偶二分性：对于奇数阶$k \ge 3$，估计式成立；对于偶数阶$k \ge 4$，估计式不成立（结合已知的$k=2$情况，完成了全分类）。
2. 对所有$k \ge 2$，证明了两个弱化形式的强迫性估计（控制大于振幅固定比例的跳跃，以及模去采样次数最多为$k-2$的多项式块）。
3. 证明了在四阶情况下，归约熵-通量不匹配项在零常数态下不存在平移不变的有限格式 $C^7$ 局部原函数。
4. 证明了奇数阶强迫性在全局准均匀网格上依然保持，但对于任何$k \ge 2$，在固定不规则网格上强迫性均因网格几何原因而失效。
AI.conclusion: 本文彻底解决了ENO-TV猜想，明确了该强迫性估计成立与否的充分必要条件（阶数的奇偶性以及网格几何的均匀性），为双曲守恒律高阶ENO格式的收敛性与紧致性分析奠定了坚实的理论基础。
AI.translation: 我们解决了 ENO-TV 猜想，这是双曲守恒律熵稳定近似的紧致性理论中的一个离散强迫性问题。对于由紧支集单元平均值进行的 $k$ 阶本质无振荡（ENO）重构，该猜想探讨非负 ENO 源乘以振幅的 $(k-1)$ 次幂是否能够一致控制 $(k+1)$ 阶绝对跳跃矩。我们证明了一个奇偶二分性：该估计对于奇数 $k\ge3$ 成立，而对于偶数 $k\ge4$ 失效；结合已知的二阶情况完成了完整分类。局域化给出了一个独立于选择的有限差分泛函，其与源一致可比，并将猜想规约至离散插值。对于奇数阶，分部求和揭示了一个隐藏的平方项，而离散 Gagliardo--Nirenberg 不等式给出了强迫性。对于偶数阶，来自泛函多项式核的欧拉多项式块给出了反例，且这些反例在使所有受影响的 ENO 比较变为严格比较的任意小扰动下依然保持。我们还对每个 $k\ge2$ 证明了两个强迫性估计：控制大于振幅固定比例的跳跃，以及模去采样次数最多为 $k-2$ 的多项式后的局部块。通过 Cayley--Sylvester 分解，我们计算了多项式跳跃剖面上网格平移的齐次第一上同调空间的维数。在四阶情况下，对于三次通量和全局严格凸熵，归约熵-通量不匹配的七次总次数分量在次数最多为二的剖面上表示一个非零类，因此在零常数态下不存在平移不变的有限格式 $C^7$ 局部原函数。奇数阶强迫性在全局准均匀网格上保持，而对于每个 $k\ge2$，即使每个界面贡献保持非负，它在固定的不规则网格上也会失效。这种失效是由网格几何形状决定的。
AI.summary: 本文解决了双曲守恒律紧致性理论中的ENO-TV猜想。作者证明了阶数$k$的奇偶二分性：对于奇数阶$k\ge3$，ENO源能够一致控制跳跃矩（强迫性成立）；对于偶数阶$k\ge4$，由于欧拉多项式反例的存在，估计式失效。此外，论文给出了对所有$k\ge2$均成立的弱强迫性估计，并揭示了网格不规则性对离散强迫性的破坏作用。
AI.keywords: ENO-TV猜想, 奇偶二分性, 双曲守恒律, 离散强迫性, 熵稳定格式
AI.comments: 本文彻底解决了高阶计算流体力学与数值分析领域中悬而未决的ENO-TV猜想，提出了非常深刻的“奇偶二分性”结论。文章技术路线极为精妙，巧妙结合了局域化分析、离散Gagliardo-Nirenberg不等式、欧拉多项式核构造反例以及Cayley-Sylvester上同调分解等深层数学工具。不仅给出了分类结果，还给出了网格几何对格式强迫性影响的深刻见解，具有极高的理论价值与创新性。

title: SoK: Adversarial Robustness of the Variational Quantum Eigensolver via Red-Teaming
comments: Accepted by QCE26 2nd Workshop on QC Security, Privacy & Resilience (Q-Sec)
summary: The Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE) is a leading algorithm for estimating molecular ground-state energies on near-term quantum hardware, with applications spanning quantum chemistry, materials science, and drug discovery. As VQE workloads are increasingly deployed through cloud-based ``VQE-as-a-service'' pipelines, they become exposed to adversaries such as compromised service components, malicious co-tenants, or insiders in the transpilation stack, any of which can corrupt results before they reach the user. A range of attacks on variational quantum circuits has been proposed, but each has been studied in isolation: some on quantum classifiers with accuracy-based metrics, others on variational quantum algorithms with energy-error metrics. This lack of a common evaluation setup makes their relative severity difficult to compare and leaves the security of VQE poorly characterized. In this work, we present \textbf{VQE-AdvBench}, the first unified red-teaming benchmark for the Variational Quantum Eigensolver, systematizing these attacks under a single evaluation protocol to rigorously assess VQE's adversarial robustness. We organize attacks along a black-, gray-, and white-box access taxonomy, and evaluate seven representative attack scenarios -- the QTrojan circuit backdoor, the QDoor parameter backdoor, parameter-space adaptations of FGSM and PGD, and three QNBAD noise-induced variants -- over a fixed molecule-ansatz-backend-metric configuration, on H$_2$ and H$_3^+$ across five noise-calibrated IBM backends. Our results reveal a clear severity ordering: noise-induced attacks that manipulate the Zero-Noise Extrapolation (ZNE) pipeline are the most damaging (up to 8.84$\times$ error amplification), followed by the QTrojan circuit-level backdoor (7.52$\times$), while the QDoor parameter-level backdoor is the least effective, yielding only marginal amplification (up to 1.37$\times$).
comment: Accepted by QCE26 2nd Workshop on QC Security, Privacy & Resilience (Q-Sec)

AI.title_translation: SoK：通过红队演习评估变分量子本征求解器对抗鲁棒性
AI.tldr: 本文提出了VQE-AdvBench，一个统一的红队基准测试，用于系统评估变分量子本征求解器（VQE）的对抗鲁棒性，并发现噪声引起的攻击对VQE的危害最大。
AI.motivation: 变分量子本征求解器（VQE）在云服务中部署时，易受各种攻击影响，导致结果被破坏。现有攻击研究各自独立，缺乏统一评估，使得VQE的安全性评估不足。
AI.method: 本文提出了VQE-AdvBench，这是首个针对变分量子本征求解器的统一红队基准测试。它将攻击系统化为单一评估协议，并根据黑盒、灰盒和白盒访问分类攻击。研究在固定的分子-ansatz-后端-度量配置下，针对H$_2$和H$_3^+$分子，在五个经过噪声校准的IBM后端上评估了七种代表性攻击场景。
AI.result: 结果显示，噪声引起的攻击（特别是操纵零噪声外推ZNE管道的攻击）最具破坏性，误差放大高达8.84倍。其次是QTrojan电路级后门攻击（7.52倍），而QDoor参数级后门攻击效果最差，仅产生高达1.37倍的边际放大。
AI.conclusion: 噪声引起的攻击，特别是那些操纵零噪声外推（ZNE）管道的攻击，对变分量子本征求解器（VQE）的鲁棒性影响最大，其次是电路级后门攻击。
AI.translation: 变分量子本征求解器（VQE）是用于在近期量子硬件上估计分子基态能量的领先算法，应用范围涵盖量子化学、材料科学和药物发现。随着VQE工作负载越来越多地通过基于云的“VQE即服务”管道部署，它们暴露于各种对手，例如受损的服务组件、恶意共同租户或转译堆栈中的内部人员，任何这些都可能在结果到达用户之前损坏结果。已经提出了一系列针对变分量子电路的攻击，但每种攻击都孤立地进行了研究：有些针对基于准确性度量的量子分类器，另一些针对基于能量误差度量的变分量子算法。这种缺乏共同评估设置使得它们相对严重性难以比较，并使VQE的安全性特征描述不足。在这项工作中，我们提出了\textbf{VQE-AdvBench}，这是首个针对变分量子本征求解器的统一红队基准测试，通过单一评估协议系统化这些攻击，以严格评估VQE的对抗鲁棒性。我们根据黑盒、灰盒和白盒访问分类攻击，并在H$_2$和H$_3^+$分子上，通过五个经过噪声校准的IBM后端，在固定的分子-ansatz-后端-度量配置下，评估了七种代表性攻击场景——QTrojan电路后门、QDoor参数后门、FGSM和PGD的参数空间适应以及三种QNBAD噪声诱导变体。我们的结果揭示了明确的严重性排序：操纵零噪声外推（ZNE）管道的噪声诱导攻击最具破坏性（高达8.84倍的误差放大），其次是QTrojan电路级后门（7.52倍），而QDoor参数级后门效果最差，仅产生边际放大（高达1.37倍）。
AI.summary: 本文提出了VQE-AdvBench，这是首个统一的变分量子本征求解器（VQE）红队基准测试，旨在系统评估VQE的对抗鲁棒性。研究将现有攻击按访问类型分类，并在H$_2$和H$_3^+$分子上，通过五个IBM后端评估了七种代表性攻击。结果表明，操纵零噪声外推（ZNE）管道的噪声引起的攻击最具破坏性，其次是电路级后门攻击，而参数级后门攻击效果最弱。
AI.keywords: 变分量子本征求解器, 对抗鲁棒性, 红队演习, VQE-AdvBench, 量子安全
AI.comments: 这项工作通过引入VQE-AdvBench，填补了VQE安全评估中缺乏统一基准的空白，其创新性在于系统化了对VQE的对抗攻击评估。研究揭示了不同类型攻击的相对严重性，对于未来增强VQE的安全性具有重要指导意义，尤其是在云服务部署场景下。

title: Fundamental limits of distributed multiclass classification from simple binary decisions
summary: We consider the problem of constructing a $K$-class classifier from the combination of $O(\log K)$ simple binary classifiers -- this is a natural paradigm to construct a sophisticated classifier in a distributed manner with each agent performing a relatively straightforward task. We study the fundamental performance limits of such a classifier when the corresponding binary classifiers are hyperplanes. For a stylized Gaussian setting where the $K$ class centers are independent Gaussian points in $\mathbb R^d$ and the observations are corrupted by Gaussian noise, we derive explicit performance bounds across several decoding and dimensional regimes. Extensive simulation experiments provide strong empirical validation of the presented theoretical results.

AI.title_translation: 分布式多类分类从简单二元决策的根本限制
AI.tldr: 研究了从O(log K)个简单二元分类器构建K类分类器的性能极限，特别是在高斯设置下推导了明确的性能界限。
AI.motivation: 通过组合O(log K)个简单二元分类器来构建复杂的K类分类器，是在分布式环境中，每个代理执行相对简单任务的一种自然范式。
AI.method: 研究了当二元分类器为超平面时，此类分类器的基本性能限制。在一个风格化的高斯设置中，其中K个类中心是R^d中的独立高斯点，观测值被高斯噪声破坏，推导了在几种解码和维度机制下的明确性能界限。通过广泛的模拟实验验证了理论结果。
AI.result: 在风格化的高斯设置下，推导了在多种解码和维度机制下的明确性能界限。广泛的模拟实验提供了对所提出理论结果的强有力实证验证。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过理论推导和模拟验证，揭示了从简单二元决策构建分布式多类分类器的基本性能限制，特别是在高斯噪声环境下的超平面二元分类器组合。
AI.translation: 我们考虑从O(log K)个简单二元分类器的组合构建K类分类器的问题——这是一种以分布式方式构建复杂分类器的自然范式，其中每个代理执行相对简单的任务。我们研究了当相应的二元分类器是超平面时，此类分类器的基本性能限制。对于一个风格化的高斯设置，其中K个类中心是R^d中独立的（independent）高斯点，并且观测值被高斯噪声破坏，我们推导出了在几种解码和维度机制下的明确性能界限。广泛的模拟实验为所提出的理论结果提供了强有力的实证验证。
AI.summary: 本文研究了通过组合O(log K)个简单二元分类器来构建K类分类器的基本性能限制，这是一种在分布式环境中构建复杂分类器的有效方法。具体地，在二元分类器为超平面且类中心为独立高斯点、观测值受高斯噪声影响的风格化高斯设置下，论文推导了明确的性能界限，并通过广泛的模拟实验验证了这些理论结果。
AI.keywords: 分布式分类, 多类分类, 二元决策, 性能极限, 高斯噪声
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于量化了从简单二元决策构建分布式多类分类器的基本性能限制，特别是在特定高斯模型下提供了明确的理论界限。这对于理解分布式学习系统的理论瓶颈和设计更优的分布式分类器具有重要意义。

title: MacWilliams Identities for $m$-tuple Weight Enumerators
comments: 17 pages. Jesse Geneson discovered a typo in the statement of Corollary 13. The expression inside the parentheses on the right side of the equation should read, "(X+(q^{2m}-1)Y,X-Y)" instead of "(X+(q^m-1)Y,X-Y)". The published version of the article also contains this typo
summary: Since MacWilliams proved the original identity relating the Hamming weight enumerator of a linear code to the weight enumerator of its dual code there have been many different generalizations, leading to the development of $m$-tuple support enumerators. We prove a generalization of theorems of Britz and of Ray-Chaudhuri and Siap, which build on earlier work of Kløve, Shiromoto, Wan, and others. We then give illustrations of these $m$-tuple weight enumerators.

AI.title_translation: MacWilliams 恒等式用于 $m$ 元组权重枚举器

title: Improved Inapproximability Results for Steiner Tree via Long Code Based Reductions
comments: This was an early and insufficiently verified attempt. Errors affecting the main results were later identified, and the manuscript has been withdrawn
summary: The best algorithm for approximating Steiner tree has performance ratio $\ln(4)+ε\approx 1.386$ [J. Byrka et al., \textit{Proceedings of the 42th Annual ACM Symposium on Theory of Computing (STOC)}, 2010, pp. 583-592], whereas the inapproximability result stays at the factor $\frac{96}{95} \approx 1.0105$ [M. Chlebík and J. Chlebíková, \textit{Proceedings of the 8th Scandinavian Workshop on Algorithm Theory (SWAT)}, 2002, pp. 170-179]. In this article, we take a step forward to bridge this gap and show that there is no polynomial time algorithm approximating Steiner tree with constant ratio better than $\frac{19}{18} \approx 1.0555$ unless \textsf{P = NP}. We also relate the problem to the Unique Games Conjecture by showing that it is \textsf{UG}-hard to find a constant approximation ratio better than $\frac{17}{16} = 1.0625$. In the special case of quasi-bipartite graphs, we prove an inapproximability factor of $\frac{25}{24} \approx 1.0416$ unless \textsf{P = NP}, which improves upon the previous bound of $\frac{128}{127} \approx 1.0078$. The reductions that we present for all the cases are of the same spirit with appropriate modifications. Our main technical contribution is an adaptation of a Set-Cover type reduction in which the Long Code is used to the geometric setting of the problems we consider.
comment: This was an early and insufficiently verified attempt. Errors affecting the main results were later identified, and the manuscript has been withdrawn

AI.title_translation: 基于长码规约的Steiner树不可近似性结果的改进
AI.tldr: 本文通过基于长码的规约，改进了Steiner树问题的不可近似性界限，缩小了近似算法与理论下界之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 现有Steiner树近似算法的最佳性能比与已知的不可近似性下界之间存在较大差距，本文旨在缩小这一理论差距。
AI.method: 本文采用基于长码的规约方法，其主要技术贡献是对几何问题背景下使用长码的集合覆盖类型规约进行了适应性改进。
AI.result: 研究表明，除非 P=NP，否则不存在常数比率优于 $\frac{19}{18} \approx 1.0555$ 的多项式时间算法来近似Steiner树。除非 UG 困难，否则无法找到优于 $\frac{17}{16} = 1.0625$ 的常数近似比率。在准二分图的特殊情况下，除非 P=NP，否则不可近似性因子提高到 $\frac{25}{24} \approx 1.0416$，改进了之前的 $\frac{128}{127} \approx 1.0078$ 的界限。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过引入基于长码的规约，成功地改进了Steiner树问题及其在准二分图上的不可近似性界限，为该问题提供了更严格的理论下限，并缩小了理论界限与实际算法之间的差距。
AI.translation: Steiner树的最佳近似算法的性能比为 $\ln(4)+\epsilon\approx 1.386$ [J. Byrka et al., \textit{Proceedings of the 42th Annual ACM Symposium on Theory of Computing (STOC)}, 2010, pp. 583-592]，而不可近似性结果停留在因子 $\frac{96}{95} \approx 1.0105$ [M. Chlebík and J. Chlebíková, \textit{Proceedings of the 8th Scandinavian Workshop on Algorithm Theory (SWAT)}, 2002, pp. 170-179]。在本文中，我们向前迈进了一步，以弥合这一差距，并表明除非 \textsf{P = NP}，否则不存在常数比率优于 $\frac{19}{18} \approx 1.0555$ 的多项式时间算法来近似Steiner树。我们还通过证明除非 \textsf{UG} 困难，否则无法找到优于 $\frac{17}{16} = 1.0625$ 的常数近似比率，从而将该问题与唯一博弈猜想联系起来。在准二分图的特殊情况下，我们证明了除非 \textsf{P = NP}，否则不可近似性因子为 $\frac{25}{24} \approx 1.0416$，这改进了之前 $\frac{128}{127} \approx 1.0078$ 的界限。我们为所有情况提出的规约本质上是相同的，并进行了适当修改。我们的主要技术贡献是适应了将长码用于我们考虑问题的几何设置的集合覆盖类型规约。
AI.summary: 本文通过基于长码的规约，改进了Steiner树问题的不可近似性界限，缩小了现有近似算法性能与理论下界之间的差距。研究表明，除非 P=NP，否则不存在优于19/18的常数近似比率算法；除非 UG 困难，否则不存在优于17/16的常数近似比率。此外，在准二分图上，将不可近似性因子提高到25/24。核心技术是利用长码对几何问题背景下的集合覆盖类型规约进行了适应性改进。
AI.keywords: Steiner树, 不可近似性, 长码, 规约, 唯一博弈猜想
AI.comments: 本文通过创新的长码规约方法，显著提高了Steiner树及其在特定图类型上的不可近似性界限，为该领域的理论研究设定了更严格的基准。其重要性在于缩小了近似算法与理论下限之间的差距，指明了未来算法改进的难度。

title: Sparse Approximation by Semidefinite Programming
comments: This was an early and insufficiently verified attempt. Errors affecting the main results were later identified, and the manuscript has been withdrawn
summary: The problem of sparse approximation and the closely related compressed sensing have received tremendous attention in the past decade. Primarily studied from the viewpoint of applied harmonic analysis and signal processing, there have been two dominant algorithmic approaches to this problem: Greedy methods called the matching pursuit (MP) and the linear programming based approaches called the basis pursuit (BP). The aim of the current paper is to bring a fresh perspective to sparse approximation by treating it as a combinatorial optimization problem and providing an algorithm based on the powerful optimization technique semidefinite programming (SDP). In particular, we show that there is a randomized algorithm based on a semidefinite relaxation of the problem with performance guarantees depending on the coherence and the restricted isometry constant of the dictionary used. We then show a derandomization of the algorithm based on the method of conditional probabilities.

AI.title_translation: 稀疏逼近的半定规划方法
AI.tldr: 本文通过半定规划（SDP）为稀疏逼近问题提供了一种新的算法，并给出了性能保证。
AI.motivation: 稀疏逼近和压缩感知问题在过去十年受到广泛关注，主要有贪婪方法（匹配追踪）和线性规划方法（基追踪）。本文旨在从组合优化角度，利用强大的半定规划技术为稀疏逼近提供一个新视角和算法。
AI.method: 将稀疏逼近问题视为组合优化问题，并通过半定规划（SDP）松弛开发了一种随机算法，该算法的性能保证取决于字典的相干性和受限等距常数。随后，基于条件概率方法进行了算法的去随机化。
AI.result: 提出了一种基于半定松弛的随机算法，其性能保证取决于所用字典的相干性和受限等距常数。并成功地将该算法去随机化。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过引入半定规划为稀疏逼近问题提供了一种新颖的算法框架，并为该算法提供了理论性能保证。
AI.translation: 稀疏逼近问题及其密切相关的压缩感知在过去十年中受到了极大的关注。主要从应用调和分析和信号处理的角度进行研究，这个问题有两种主要的算法方法：称为匹配追踪（MP）的贪婪方法和称为基追踪（BP）的基于线性规划的方法。本文旨在通过将稀疏逼近视为一个组合优化问题，并提供一种基于强大的优化技术半定规划（SDP）的算法，为稀疏逼近带来一个全新的视角。特别是，我们证明存在一种基于问题半定松弛的随机算法，其性能保证取决于所用字典的相干性和受限等距常数。然后，我们展示了基于条件概率方法的算法的去随机化。
AI.summary: 本文针对稀疏逼近问题，提出了一种新的基于半定规划（SDP）的算法。与传统的贪婪法和线性规划法不同，该方法将稀疏逼近视为组合优化问题。研究者开发了一种带有性能保证的随机算法，其有效性与字典的相干性和受限等距常数相关，并进一步实现了算法的去随机化。
AI.keywords: 稀疏逼近,半定规划,组合优化,随机算法,压缩感知
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于将稀疏逼近问题重新构想为组合优化问题，并引入了强大的半定规划（SDP）技术来解决。这为该领域带来了全新的理论视角和算法路径，并提供了严格的性能保证，这对于理解和改进稀疏逼近算法具有重要意义。

title: Entity-Relation Extraction as Multi-Turn Question Answering
summary: In this paper, we propose a new paradigm for the task of entity-relation extraction. We cast the task as a multi-turn question answering problem, i.e., the extraction of entities and relations is transformed to the task of identifying answer spans from the context. This multi-turn QA formalization comes with several key advantages: firstly, the question query encodes important information for the entity/relation class we want to identify; secondly, QA provides a natural way of jointly modeling entity and relation; and thirdly, it allows us to exploit the well developed machine reading comprehension (MRC) models. Experiments on the ACE and the CoNLL04 corpora demonstrate that the proposed paradigm significantly outperforms previous best models. We are able to obtain the state-of-the-art results on all of the ACE04, ACE05 and CoNLL04 datasets, increasing the SOTA results on the three datasets to 49.4 (+1.0), 60.2 (+0.6) and 68.9 (+2.1), respectively. Additionally, we construct a newly developed dataset RESUME in Chinese, which requires multi-step reasoning to construct entity dependencies, as opposed to the single-step dependency extraction in the triplet exaction in previous datasets. The proposed multi-turn QA model also achieves the best performance on the RESUME dataset.

AI.title_translation: 实体关系抽取作为多轮问答
AI.tldr: 本文提出将实体关系抽取任务转化为多轮问答问题，利用QA模型的优势在多个数据集上取得了SOTA性能，并构建了一个新的中文数据集RESUME。
AI.motivation: 传统的实体关系抽取方法可能存在局限性，作者旨在提出一种新的范式来改进实体关系抽取任务。
AI.method: 将实体关系抽取任务重新定义为多轮问答问题，即通过识别上下文中的答案跨度来抽取实体和关系。这种多轮QA形式化具有编码实体/关系类别信息、联合建模实体和关系以及利用成熟的机器阅读理解模型等优势。
AI.result: 在ACE和CoNLL04语料库上的实验表明，所提出的范式显著优于以往的最佳模型，在ACE04、ACE05和CoNLL04数据集上分别将SOTA结果提高到49.4 (+1.0)、60.2 (+0.6) 和68.9 (+2.1)。此外，在一个新的中文数据集RESUME上也取得了最佳性能。
AI.conclusion: 将实体关系抽取任务转化为多轮问答问题是一种有效且具有前景的范式，能够显著提升实体关系抽取的性能，并在新构建的中文数据集上表现优异。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种实体关系抽取任务的新范式。我们将该任务视为一个多轮问答问题，即将实体和关系的抽取转化为从上下文中识别答案跨度的任务。这种多轮问答形式化具有几个关键优势：首先，问题查询编码了我们想要识别的实体/关系类别的重要信息；其次，问答提供了一种自然的方式来联合建模实体和关系；第三，它允许我们利用成熟的机器阅读理解（MRC）模型。在ACE和CoNLL04语料库上的实验表明，所提出的范式显著优于以往的最佳模型。我们在ACE04、ACE05和CoNLL04所有数据集上都取得了最先进的结果，将这三个数据集上的SOTA结果分别提高到49.4 (+1.0)、60.2 (+0.6) 和68.9 (+2.1)。此外，我们构建了一个新开发的中文数据集RESUME，该数据集需要多步推理来构建实体依赖关系，而不是像之前数据集中的三元组抽取那样进行单步依赖抽取。所提出的多轮问答模型在RESUME数据集上也取得了最佳性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种将实体关系抽取任务重新定义为多轮问答问题的新范式。该方法通过将实体和关系抽取转化为识别上下文中的答案跨度来实现，并利用了问答模型在信息编码、联合建模和机器阅读理解方面的优势。实验结果表明，该范式在ACE04、ACE05和CoNLL04等标准数据集上取得了最先进的性能提升。此外，在一个需要多步推理的中文数据集RESUME上也表现出色。
AI.keywords: 实体关系抽取, 多轮问答, 机器阅读理解, 状态最佳, RESUME数据集
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将实体关系抽取这一复杂任务巧妙地转换为多轮问答，从而能够利用成熟的机器阅读理解模型，并自然地实现实体和关系的联合建模。这种范式转换不仅简化了问题，还在多个基准测试中取得了显著的性能提升，特别是对于需要多步推理的复杂依赖关系抽取，展现了其强大的潜力。

title: Dice Loss for Data-imbalanced NLP Tasks
summary: Many NLP tasks such as tagging and machine reading comprehension are faced with the severe data imbalance issue: negative examples significantly outnumber positive examples, and the huge number of background examples (or easy-negative examples) overwhelms the training. The most commonly used cross entropy (CE) criteria is actually an accuracy-oriented objective, and thus creates a discrepancy between training and test: at training time, each training instance contributes equally to the objective function, while at test time F1 score concerns more about positive examples. In this paper, we propose to use dice loss in replacement of the standard cross-entropy objective for data-imbalanced NLP tasks. Dice loss is based on the Sorensen-Dice coefficient or Tversky index, which attaches similar importance to false positives and false negatives, and is more immune to the data-imbalance issue. To further alleviate the dominating influence from easy-negative examples in training, we propose to associate training examples with dynamically adjusted weights to deemphasize easy-negative examples.Theoretical analysis shows that this strategy narrows down the gap between the F1 score in evaluation and the dice loss in training. With the proposed training objective, we observe significant performance boost on a wide range of data imbalanced NLP tasks. Notably, we are able to achieve SOTA results on CTB5, CTB6 and UD1.4 for the part of speech tagging task; SOTA results on CoNLL03, OntoNotes5.0, MSRA and OntoNotes4.0 for the named entity recognition task; along with competitive results on the tasks of machine reading comprehension and paraphrase identification.

AI.title_translation: 用于数据不平衡NLP任务的Dice Loss
AI.tldr: 本文提出使用Dice Loss代替交叉熵损失函数来解决数据不平衡的自然语言处理（NLP）任务中的负例过多问题，并通过动态调整权重进一步削弱简单负例的影响，从而在多项NLP任务上取得了显著的性能提升和SOTA结果。
AI.motivation: 许多NLP任务（如标注和机器阅读理解）面临严重的数据不平衡问题，即负例数量远超正例，且大量背景（或简单负例）淹没了训练过程。常用的交叉熵（CE）标准是面向准确率的目标，导致训练与测试之间存在差异：训练时每个实例对目标函数贡献相等，而测试时F1分数更关注正例。
AI.method: 提出使用Dice Loss替代标准交叉熵目标函数来处理数据不平衡的NLP任务。Dice Loss基于Sorensen-Dice系数或Tversky指数，对假阳性和假阴性赋予相似的重要性，对数据不平衡问题更具鲁棒性。为进一步减轻简单负例在训练中的主导影响，提出将训练实例与动态调整的权重相关联，以降低简单负例的重要性。理论分析表明该策略缩小了评估中的F1分数与训练中Dice Loss之间的差距。
AI.result: 在广泛的数据不平衡NLP任务上观察到显著的性能提升。在词性标注任务（CTB5, CTB6和UD1.4）上取得了SOTA结果；在命名实体识别任务（CoNLL03, OntoNotes5.0, MSRA和OntoNotes4.0）上取得了SOTA结果；在机器阅读理解和复述识别任务上取得了有竞争力的结果。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的Dice Loss结合动态权重调整的训练目标，有效解决了数据不平衡NLP任务中的挑战，显著提升了模型性能，并在多个关键NLP任务上达到了最先进水平，验证了其在处理此类问题上的优越性。
AI.translation: 许多NLP任务，如标注和机器阅读理解，面临着严重的数据不平衡问题：负例数量显著超过正例，并且大量的背景例（或简单负例）淹没了训练。最常用的交叉熵（CE）准则实际上是一个面向准确率的目标，因此在训练和测试之间造成了差异：在训练时，每个训练实例对目标函数贡献相等，而在测试时F1分数更关注正例。在本文中，我们提出使用Dice Loss替代标准交叉熵目标函数，用于数据不平衡的NLP任务。Dice Loss基于Sorensen-Dice系数或Tversky指数，它对假阳性和假阴性赋予相似的重要性，并且对数据不平衡问题更具免疫力。为了进一步缓解训练中简单负例的主导影响，我们提出将训练实例与动态调整的权重相关联，以降低简单负例的重要性。理论分析表明，该策略缩小了评估中的F1分数与训练中的Dice Loss之间的差距。通过提出的训练目标，我们观察到在广泛的数据不平衡NLP任务上性能显著提升。值得注意的是，我们在词性标注任务的CTB5、CTB6和UD1.4上取得了SOTA结果；在命名实体识别任务的CoNLL03、OntoNotes5.0、MSRA和OntoNotes4.0上取得了SOTA结果；以及在机器阅读理解和复述识别任务上取得了有竞争力的结果。
AI.summary: 该论文针对数据不平衡的自然语言处理（NLP）任务，提出用Dice Loss替代传统的交叉熵损失函数。Dice Loss基于Sorensen-Dice系数，对假阳性和假阴性给予相似权重，从而更有效地处理数据不平衡问题。为进一步减轻简单负例的影响，作者引入了动态调整的训练权重。理论分析表明，此策略缩小了F1分数与Dice Loss之间的差距。实验结果显示，该方法在多种数据不平衡NLP任务上显著提升了性能，并在词性标注和命名实体识别任务上取得了最先进（SOTA）成果，在机器阅读理解和复述识别任务上也表现出竞争力。
AI.keywords: Dice Loss, 数据不平衡, NLP, 交叉熵, 动态权重
AI.comments: 该论文通过将通常用于图像分割的Dice Loss引入到数据不平衡的NLP任务中，展现了跨领域方法应用的创新性。结合动态权重调整的策略，有效解决了传统交叉熵损失在处理正负样本极度不平衡时效率低下的问题，尤其对于F1分数这类更关注正样本性能的评估指标具有重要意义。理论分析的支持以及在多项NLP任务上取得SOTA或有竞争力的结果，证明了该方法的有效性和实用价值。

title: ChineseBERT: Chinese Pretraining Enhanced by Glyph and Pinyin Information
summary: Recent pretraining models in Chinese neglect two important aspects specific to the Chinese language: glyph and pinyin, which carry significant syntax and semantic information for language understanding. In this work, we propose ChineseBERT, which incorporates both the {\it glyph} and {\it pinyin} information of Chinese characters into language model pretraining. The glyph embedding is obtained based on different fonts of a Chinese character, being able to capture character semantics from the visual features, and the pinyin embedding characterizes the pronunciation of Chinese characters, which handles the highly prevalent heteronym phenomenon in Chinese (the same character has different pronunciations with different meanings). Pretrained on large-scale unlabeled Chinese corpus, the proposed ChineseBERT model yields significant performance boost over baseline models with fewer training steps. The porpsoed model achieves new SOTA performances on a wide range of Chinese NLP tasks, including machine reading comprehension, natural language inference, text classification, sentence pair matching, and competitive performances in named entity recognition. Code and pretrained models are publicly available at https://github.com/ShannonAI/ChineseBert.

AI.title_translation: ChineseBERT：通过字形和拼音信息增强的中文预训练
AI.tldr: ChineseBERT通过整合字形和拼音信息，显著提升了中文预训练模型的性能，并在多项中文NLP任务上达到了SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有的中文预训练模型忽略了中文特有的字形和拼音信息，而这些信息对语言理解具有重要的句法和语义作用。
AI.method: 提出ChineseBERT模型，将汉字的字形和拼音信息都融入到语言模型预训练中。字形嵌入基于汉字的不同字体获得，能够从视觉特征中捕捉字符语义；拼音嵌入表征汉字发音，处理中文中普遍存在的异读现象。
AI.result: 在更少的训练步骤下，ChineseBERT模型比基线模型性能显著提升。在机器阅读理解、自然语言推理、文本分类、句子对匹配等中文NLP任务上取得了新的SOTA性能，并在命名实体识别上表现具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: ChineseBERT通过有效整合中文特有的字形和拼音信息，显著提升了中文预训练模型的性能，并在多个NLP任务上取得了先进结果。
AI.translation: 最近的中文预训练模型忽略了中文特有的两个重要方面：字形和拼音，它们对语言理解具有重要的句法和语义信息。在这项工作中，我们提出了ChineseBERT，它将汉字的字形和拼音信息都融入到语言模型预训练中。字形嵌入是基于汉字的不同字体获得的，能够从视觉特征中捕捉字符语义；拼音嵌入表征汉字的发音，处理中文中普遍存在的异读现象（同一个字有不同的发音，对应不同的含义）。在大型无标注中文语料库上预训练后，所提出的ChineseBERT模型在更少的训练步骤下，比基线模型性能显著提升。所提出的模型在广泛的中文NLP任务上取得了新的SOTA性能，包括机器阅读理解、自然语言推理、文本分类、句子对匹配，并在命名实体识别方面表现出竞争力。代码和预训练模型已在 https://github.com/ShannonAI/ChineseBert 公开。
AI.summary: ChineseBERT是一个创新的中文预训练模型，通过将汉字的字形和拼音信息整合到预训练过程中，解决了现有模型对这些中文特有语言特征的忽视。该模型利用字形嵌入捕捉视觉语义，并利用拼音嵌入处理异读现象，从而显著提升了在多项中文NLP任务上的性能，并取得了新的SOTA结果。
AI.keywords: 中文预训练, 字形, 拼音, ChineseBERT, 自然语言处理
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于充分利用了中文特有的字形和拼音信息来增强预训练语言模型，填补了现有模型在这方面的空白。通过结合这些深层语言学特征，ChineseBERT在中文NLP任务上取得了显著进步，展示了对特定语言特征进行精细建模的重要性。

title: Internet-of-Things Architectures for Secure Cyber-Physical Spaces: the VISOR Experience Report
summary: Internet of things (IoT) technologies are becoming a more and more widespread part of civilian life in common urban spaces, which are rapidly turning into cyber-physical spaces. Simultaneously, the fear of terrorism and crime in such public spaces is ever-increasing. Due to the resulting increased demand for security, video-based IoT surveillance systems have become an important area for research. Considering the large number of devices involved in the illicit recognition task, we conducted a field study in a Dutch Easter music festival in a national interest project called VISOR to select the most appropriate device configuration in terms of performance and results. We iteratively architected solutions for the security of cyber-physical spaces using IoT devices. We tested the performance of multiple federated devices encompassing drones, closed-circuit television, smart phone cameras, and smart glasses to detect real-case scenarios of potentially malicious activities such as mosh-pits and pick-pocketing. Our results pave the way to select optimal IoT architecture configurations -- i.e., a mix of CCTV, drones, smart glasses, and camera phones in our case -- to make safer cyber-physical spaces' a reality.

AI.title_translation: 物联网架构在安全网络物理空间中的应用：VISOR经验报告
AI.tldr: 本文报告了VISOR项目在荷兰复活节音乐节进行的实地研究，通过测试无人机、闭路电视、智能手机和智能眼镜等多种物联网设备，旨在为网络物理空间的安全监控选择最佳的物联网架构配置。
AI.motivation: 随着物联网技术在城市空间中的普及，公共场所日益转变为网络物理空间。同时，对恐怖主义和犯罪的担忧日益增加，导致对安全的需求提高，视频物联网监控系统成为研究重点。
AI.method: 在名为VISOR的国家利益项目中，研究人员在荷兰复活节音乐节进行了一项实地研究。他们迭代地设计了物联网设备解决方案，并测试了包括无人机、闭路电视、智能手机摄像头和智能眼镜在内的多种联邦设备的性能，以检测潜在的恶意活动（如冲撞和扒窃）的真实场景，从而选择最合适的设备配置。
AI.result: 研究结果为选择最佳物联网架构配置（即闭路电视、无人机、智能眼镜和手机摄像头的组合）铺平了道路。
AI.conclusion: 通过选择最优的物联网架构配置，可以实现更安全的网络物理空间。
AI.translation: 物联网（IoT）技术正日益成为普通城市空间中民用生活的一部分，这些空间正迅速转变为网络物理空间。与此同时，人们对公共场所恐怖主义和犯罪的担忧不断增加。由于由此产生的对安全需求的增加，基于视频的物联网监控系统已成为一个重要的研究领域。考虑到非法识别任务中涉及的大量设备，我们在一个名为VISOR的国家利益项目中，在荷兰复活节音乐节进行了一项实地研究，以在性能和结果方面选择最合适的设备配置。我们迭代地构建了使用物联网设备实现网络物理空间安全的解决方案。我们测试了包括无人机、闭路电视、智能手机摄像头和智能眼镜在内的多种联邦设备的性能，以检测潜在恶意活动（如冲撞和扒窃）的真实场景。我们的结果为选择最佳物联网架构配置——即本案例中闭路电视、无人机、智能眼镜和手机摄像头的组合——铺平了道路，从而使“更安全的网络物理空间”成为现实。
AI.summary: 本研究报告了VISOR项目在荷兰复活节音乐节进行的一项实地研究，旨在为日益增长的网络物理空间安全需求选择最优的物联网监控架构。通过迭代设计和测试无人机、闭路电视、智能手机和智能眼镜等多种联邦物联网设备，以检测真实的恶意活动，研究结果表明，通过优化这些设备的组合配置，可以有效提升公共场所的安全性。
AI.keywords: 物联网架构, 网络物理空间, 安全监控, VISOR, 实地研究
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过一个真实的节日场景实地研究，验证了多源物联网设备协同在网络物理空间安全监控中的潜力。其创新之处在于结合了不同类型的移动和固定监控设备，并进行了实际场景的性能评估。局限性可能在于其研究范围仅限于一个特定的音乐节场景，结果的普适性可能需要进一步验证。

title: Real-world K-Anonymity Applications: the \textsc{KGen} approach and its evaluation in Fraudulent Transactions
summary: K-Anonymity is a property for the measurement, management, and governance of the data anonymization. Many implementations of k-anonymity have been described in state of the art, but most of them are not able to work with a large number of attributes in a "Big" dataset, i.e., a dataset drawn from Big Data. To address this significant shortcoming, we introduce and evaluate \textsc{KGen} an approach to K-anonymity featuring Genetic Algorithms. \textsc{KGen} promotes such a meta-heuristic approach since it can solve the problem by finding a pseudo-optimal solution in a reasonable time over a considerable load of input. \textsc{KGen} allows the data manager to guarantee a high anonymity level while preserving the usability and preventing loss of information entropy over the data. Differently from other approaches that provide optimal global solutions catered for small datasets, \textsc{KGen} works properly also over Big datasets while still providing a good-enough solution. Evaluation results show how our approach can still work efficiently on a real world dataset, provided by Dutch Tax Authority, with 47 attributes (i.e., the columns of the dataset to be anonymized) and over 1.5K+ observations (i.e., the rows of that dataset), as well as on a dataset with 97 attributes and over 3942 observations.

AI.title_translation: 真实世界的K匿名应用：\textsc{KGen} 方法及其在欺诈交易中的评估
AI.tldr: KGen是一种基于遗传算法的K匿名方法，能有效处理大数据集，并在保证匿名性的同时保持数据可用性，已在真实世界数据集中得到验证。
AI.motivation: 现有的K匿名方法大多无法处理大数据集中大量属性的数据，存在显著不足。
AI.method: 本文引入并评估了一种名为\textsc{KGen}的K匿名方法，该方法利用遗传算法作为元启发式方法，在合理时间内找到伪最优解，以处理大数据集。它旨在保证高匿名性水平同时保留数据可用性并防止信息熵损失。
AI.result: \textsc{KGen} 在荷兰税务局提供的真实世界数据集（47个属性，超过1.5K+观测值）和另一个包含97个属性和超过3942个观测值的数据集上均能高效工作，并提供足够好的解决方案。
AI.conclusion: \textsc{KGen} 是一种有效且高效的K匿名方法，能够处理大数据集，同时保持数据可用性。
AI.translation: K匿名是数据匿名化测量、管理和治理的一种属性。现有技术中描述了许多K匿名实现，但其中大多数无法处理“大数据集”（即从大数据中提取的数据集）中的大量属性。为了解决这一显著缺点，我们介绍并评估了\textsc{KGen}，一种以遗传算法为特征的K匿名方法。\textsc{KGen} 推广这种元启发式方法，因为它可以在相当大的输入负载下，在合理时间内找到伪最优解来解决问题。\textsc{KGen} 允许数据管理者在保证高匿名性水平的同时，保留可用性并防止数据信息熵的损失。与其他为小型数据集提供最优全局解的方法不同，\textsc{KGen} 也能在大数据集上正常工作，同时仍提供足够好的解决方案。评估结果显示，我们的方法在荷兰税务局提供的具有47个属性（即要匿名化的数据集的列）和超过1.5K+观测值（即该数据集的行）的真实世界数据集上，以及在具有97个属性和超过3942个观测值的数据集上，仍然能够高效工作。
AI.summary: 本文针对现有K匿名方法难以处理大数据集中大量属性的问题，提出并评估了一种基于遗传算法的K匿名方法\textsc{KGen}。\textsc{KGen} 采用元启发式方法，能够在合理时间内为大数据集找到伪最优解，并在保证高匿名性水平的同时，有效保留数据可用性并防止信息熵损失。实验结果表明，\textsc{KGen} 在包含47个属性和超过1.5K+观测值的真实世界数据集以及更大规模的数据集上均表现出高效性。
AI.keywords: K匿名, 遗传算法, 大数据, 数据匿名化, 欺诈交易
AI.comments: \textsc{KGen} 的创新之处在于将遗传算法引入K匿名，以解决传统方法在大数据集和多属性场景下的效率问题。其重要性体现在为处理真实世界大数据匿名化提供了一个实用的解决方案，特别是在数据隐私和可用性之间取得平衡。

title: A Compositional Approach to Verifying Modular Robotic Systems
summary: Robotic systems used in safety-critical scenarios often rely on modular software architectures, and increasingly include autonomous components. Verifying that these modular robotic systems behave as expected requires approaches that can cope with, and preferably take advantage of, this inherent modularity. This paper describes a compositional approach to specifying the nodes in robotic systems built using the Robot Operating System (ROS), where each node is specified using First-Order Logic (FOL) assume-guarantee contracts that link the specification to the ROS implementation. We introduce inference rules that facilitate the composition of these node-level contracts to derive system-level properties. We also present a novel Domain-Specific Language, the ROS Contract Language (RCL), which captures a node's FOL specification and links this contract to its implementation. RCL contracts can be automatically translated, by our tool Vanda, into executable monitors; which we use to verify the contracts at runtime. We illustrate our approach through the specification and verification of an autonomous rover engaged in the remote inspection of a nuclear site, and finish with smaller examples that illustrate other useful features of our framework.

AI.title_translation: 模块化机器人系统验证的组合式方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种组合式方法，使用一阶逻辑假定-保证契约和ROS契约语言（RCL）来验证模块化机器人系统，并通过工具Vanda在运行时自动监控契约。
AI.motivation: 在安全关键场景中使用的机器人系统依赖于模块化软件架构和自主组件。验证这些系统是否按预期运行需要能够处理并利用其固有模块性的方法。
AI.method: 本文描述了一种组合式方法，用于指定使用机器人操作系统（ROS）构建的机器人系统中的节点。每个节点都使用一阶逻辑（FOL）假定-保证契约进行指定，这些契约将规范与ROS实现联系起来。引入了推理规则以促进这些节点级契约的组合，从而推导出系统级属性。还提出了一种新颖的领域特定语言——ROS契约语言（RCL），它捕获节点的FOL规范并将其契约与其实现关联起来。RCL契约可以通过工具Vanda自动翻译成可执行的监视器。

title: Scheme-Theoretic Approach to Computational Complexity. III. SETH
comments: This was an early and insufficiently verified attempt. Errors affecting the main results were later identified, and the manuscript has been withdrawn
summary: We show that there exist infinitely many $n \in \mathbb{Z}^+$ such that for any constant $ε> 0$, any deterministic algorithm to solve $k$-\textsf{SAT} for $k \geq 3$ must perform at least $(2^{k-\frac{3}{2}-ε})^{\frac{n}{k+1}}$ operations, where $n$ is the number of variables in the $k$\textsf{-SAT} instance.

AI.title_translation: 计算复杂性的概形论方法。III. SETH

AI.motivation: 旨在通过引入一种新颖的代数几何工具（概形论方法）来研究和推进计算复杂性理论，特别是针对经典的k-SAT问题及其底层的指数时间复杂度下限（与强指数时间假说SETH相关）进行深入探索。
AI.method: 采用概形论的方法（Scheme-Theoretic Approach）来研究计算复杂性，通过分析变量和实例的代数/几何结构来推导确定性算法求解k-SAT的复杂度下界。
AI.result: 证明了对于无穷多个正整数n，任何用于求解k-SAT（k ≥ 3）的确定性算法，在面对具有n个变量的实例时，对于任意常数ε > 0，必须执行至少 (2^{k-3/2-ε})^{n/(k+1)} 次操作。
AI.conclusion: 作者利用概形论方法证明了关于k-SAT算法复杂度的一类新型下界结果，为计算复杂性理论中的强指数时间假说（SETH）研究提供了新的数学工具和视角。
AI.translation: 我们证明了存在无穷多个 $n \in \mathbb{Z}^+$，使得对于任意常数 $\varepsilon > 0$，任何求解 $k \ge 3$ 的 $k$-\textsf{SAT} 的确定性算法必须执行至少 $(2^{k-\frac{3}{2}-\varepsilon})^{\frac{n}{k+1}}$ 次操作，其中 $n$ 是 $k$-\textsf{SAT} 实例中的变量数。
AI.summary: 本文利用概形论方法研究了计算复杂性，证明了存在无穷多个变量数n，使得对于任意常数ε>0，任何求解k-SAT的确定性算法都需要至少 (2^{k-3/2-ε})^{n/(k+1)} 次操作，这为理解k-SAT的计算复杂度提供了新的理论下界。
AI.keywords: 概形论, 计算复杂性, k-SAT, 强指数时间假说 (SETH), 下界
AI.comments: 该论文采用代数几何或概形论的方法来研究计算复杂性理论中的核心猜想（SETH），为理解多项式时间与指数时间之间的界限提供了独特的数学视角。不过，抽象中给出的具体下界是否能推翻或完全等同于标准的SETH，仍需结合全文的证明细节来进一步验证其创新性与普适性。

title: Scheme-Theoretic Approach to Computational Complexity. IV. A New Perspective on Hardness of Approximation
comments: This was an early and insufficiently verified attempt. Errors affecting the main results were later identified, and the manuscript has been withdrawn
summary:
We provide a new approach for establishing hardness of approximation results, based on the theory recently introduced by the author. It allows one to directly show that approximating a problem beyond a certain threshold requires super-polynomial time. To exhibit the framework, we revisit two famous problems in this paper. The particular results we prove are:
  MAX-3-SAT$(1,\frac{7}{8}+ε)$ requires exponential time for any constant $ε$ satisfying $\frac{1}{8} \geq ε> 0$. In particular, the gap exponential time hypothesis (Gap-ETH) holds.
  MAX-3-LIN-2$(1-ε, \frac{1}{2}+ε)$ requires exponential time for any constant $ε$ satisfying $\frac{1}{4} \geq ε> 0$.

AI.motivation: 本文旨在提供一种新的、直接的方法来建立近似硬度结果，以证明将问题近似到超出特定阈值需要超多项式时间。

title: IBoxCLA: Towards Robust Box-supervised Segmentation of Polyp via Improved Box-dice and Contrastive Latent-anchors
summary: Box-supervised polyp segmentation attracts increasing attention for its cost-effective potential. Existing solutions often rely on learning-free methods or pretrained models to laboriously generate pseudo masks, triggering Dice constraint subsequently. In this paper, we found that a model guided by the simplest box-filled masks can accurately predict polyp locations/sizes, but suffers from shape collapsing. In response, we propose two innovative learning fashions, Improved Box-dice (IBox) and Contrastive Latent-Anchors (CLA), and combine them to train a robust box-supervised model IBoxCLA. The core idea behind IBoxCLA is to decouple the learning of location/size and shape, allowing for focused constraints on each of them. Specifically, IBox transforms the segmentation map into a proxy map using shape decoupling and confusion-region swapping sequentially. Within the proxy map, shapes are disentangled, while locations/sizes are encoded as box-like responses. By constraining the proxy map instead of the raw prediction, the box-filled mask can well supervise IBoxCLA without misleading its shape learning. Furthermore, CLA contributes to shape learning by generating two types of latent anchors, which are learned and updated using momentum and segmented polyps to steadily represent polyp and background features. The latent anchors facilitate IBoxCLA to capture discriminative features within and outside boxes in a contrastive manner, yielding clearer boundaries. We benchmark IBoxCLA on five public polyp datasets. The experimental results demonstrate the competitive performance of IBoxCLA compared to recent fully-supervised polyp segmentation methods, and its superiority over other box-supervised state-of-the-arts with a relative increase of overall mDice and mIoU by at least 6.5% and 7.5%, respectively.

title: EAR-Net: Pursuing End-to-End Absolute Rotations from Multi-View Images
summary: Absolute rotation estimation is an important topic in 3D computer vision. Existing works in literature generally employ a multi-stage (at least two-stage) estimation strategy where multiple independent operations (feature matching, two-view rotation estimation, and rotation averaging) are implemented sequentially. However, such a multi-stage strategy inevitably leads to the accumulation of the errors caused by each involved operation, and degrades its final estimation on global rotations accordingly. To address this problem, we propose an End-to-end method for estimating Absolution Rotations from multi-view images based on deep neural Networks, called EAR-Net. The proposed EAR-Net consists of an epipolar confidence graph construction module and a confidence-aware rotation averaging module. The epipolar confidence graph construction module is explored to simultaneously predict pairwise relative rotations among the input images and their corresponding confidences, resulting in a weighted graph (called epipolar confidence graph). Based on this graph, the confidence-aware rotation averaging module, which is differentiable, is explored to predict the absolute rotations. Thanks to the introduced confidences of the relative rotations, the proposed EAR-Net could effectively handle outlier cases. Experimental results on three public datasets demonstrate that EAR-Net outperforms the state-of-the-art methods by a large margin in terms of accuracy and speed.

title: Fairness and Incentive Compatibility via Percentage Fees
comments: 26 pages. This is the TheoretiCS journal version
summary:
We study incentive-compatible mechanisms that maximize the Nash Social Welfare. Since traditional incentive-compatible mechanisms cannot maximize the Nash Social Welfare even approximately, we propose changing the traditional model. Inspired by a widely used charging method (e.g., royalties, a lawyer that charges some percentage of possible future compensation), we suggest charging the players some percentage of their value of the outcome. We call this model the percentage fee model.
  We show that there is a mechanism that maximizes exactly the Nash Social Welfare in every setting with non-negative valuations. Moreover, we prove an analog of Roberts theorem that essentially says that if the valuations are non-negative, then the only implementable social choice functions are those that maximize weighted variants of the Nash Social Welfare. We develop polynomial time incentive compatible approximation algorithms for the Nash Social Welfare with subadditive valuations and prove some hardness results.
comment: 26 pages. This is the TheoretiCS journal version

title: Nonparametric Steady-State Learning for Nonlinear Output Feedback Regulation
summary: This article addresses the nonparametric and robust output regulation problem of the general nonlinear output feedback system with error output. The global robust output regulation problem for a class of general output feedback nonlinear systems with an uncertain exosystem and high relative degree can be tackled by constructing a linear generic internal model, provided that a continuous nonlinear mapping exists. Leveraging the proposed nonadaptive framework facilitates the conversion of the nonlinear robust output regulation problem into a robust nonadaptive stabilization formulation for the augmented system endowed with Input-to-State Stable dynamics. This approach removes the need for constructing a specific Lyapunov function with positive semidefinite derivatives and avoids the common assumption of linear parameterization of the nonlinear system. The nonadaptive approach is extended by incorporating the nonparametric learning framework to ensure the feasibility of the nonlinear mapping, which can be tackled using a data-driven method. Moreover, the introduced nonparametric learning framework allows the controlled system to learn the dynamics of the steady-state input behavior from the signal generated from the internal model with the output error as the feedback. As a result, the nonparametric approach can be advantageous to guarantee the convergence of the estimation and tracking error even when the underlying controlled system dynamics are complex or poorly understood. The effectiveness of the theoretical results is illustrated for three practical examples: regulation of a magnetic levitation system, regulation of a virtual synchronous generator, and heading control of a surface vessel.

title: Saving the legacy of Hero Ibash: Evaluating Four Language Models for Aminoacian
comments: arXiv admin note: This submission has been withdrawn due to violation of arXiv policies for acceptable submissions
summary: This study assesses four cutting-edge language models in the underexplored Aminoacian language. Through evaluation, it scrutinizes their adaptability, effectiveness, and limitations in text generation, semantic coherence, and contextual understanding. Uncovering insights into these models' performance in a low-resourced language, this research pioneers pathways to bridge linguistic gaps. By offering benchmarks and understanding challenges, it lays groundwork for future advancements in natural language processing, aiming to elevate the applicability of language models in similar linguistic landscapes, marking a significant step toward inclusivity and progress in language technology.

title: Denoising Monte Carlo Renders with Diffusion Models
summary: Physically-based renderings contain Monte Carlo noise, with variance that increases as the number of rays per pixel decreases. This noise, while zero-mean for good modern renderers, can have heavy tails (most notably, for scenes containing specular or refractive objects). Learned methods for restoring low fidelity renders are highly developed, because suppressing render noise means one can save compute and use fast renders with few rays per pixel. We demonstrate that a diffusion model can denoise low fidelity renders successfully. Furthermore, our method can be conditioned on a variety of natural render information, and this conditioning helps performance. Quantitative experiments show that our method is competitive with SOTA across a range of sampling rates. Qualitative examination of the reconstructions suggests that the image prior applied by a diffusion method strongly favors reconstructions that are like real images -- so have straight shadow boundaries, curved specularities and no fireflies.

title: CRATOR: a Dark Web Crawler
summary: Dark web crawling is a complex process that involves specific methodologies and techniques to navigate the Tor network and extract data from hidden services. This study proposes a general dark web crawler designed to extract pages handling security protocols, such as captchas, efficiently. Our approach uses a combination of seed URL lists, link analysis, and scanning to discover new content. We also incorporate methods for user-agent rotation and proxy usage to maintain anonymity and avoid detection. We evaluate the effectiveness of our crawler using metrics such as coverage, performance and robustness. Our results demonstrate that our crawler effectively extracts pages handling security protocols while maintaining anonymity and avoiding detection. Our proposed dark web crawler can be used for various applications, including threat intelligence, cybersecurity, and online investigations.

title: 9/7-Approximation for Two-Edge-Connectivity and Two-Vertex-Connectivity

title: The equational theory of the Weihrauch lattice with (iterated) composition
comments: 49 pages - major revision, consisting in the addition of informal explanations, examples, related work and bugfixes. Section 3 was extensively revised for clarity and results therein generalized to alternating automata. Sections 1, 2, 5 and 6 were also substantially revised. Some of the terminology was changed, including using "partial" rather than overloading "extended"
summary: We study the equational theory of the Weihrauch lattice with composition and iteration, meaning the collection of equations between terms built from variables, the lattice operations $\sqcup,\sqcap$, the composition operator $\star$ and its iteration $(-)^\diamond$, which are true however we substitute (partial) Weihrauch degrees for the variables. We characterize them using Büchi games on finite graphs and give a complete axiomatization that derives them. The term signature and the axiomatization are reminiscent of Kleene algebras, except that we additionally have meets and the lattice operations do not fully distribute over composition. The game characterization gives a variant of the notion of simulation for alternating automata. It also implies that it is decidable whether an equation is universally valid. We give some complexity bounds; in particular, the problem is PSPACE-hard in general and we conjecture that it is solvable in PSPACE. We expect that the axiomatizations and games can also be applicable as-is to characterize the existence of strong natural transformation between polynomial functor expressions.

title: MEDIC: Comprehensive Evaluation of Leading Indicators for LLM Safety and Utility in Clinical Applications
comments: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (06/2026)
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve superhuman performance on standardized medical licensing exams, these static benchmarks have become saturated and increasingly disconnected from the functional requirements of clinical workflows. To bridge the gap between theoretical capability and verified utility, we introduce MEDIC, a comprehensive evaluation framework establishing leading indicators of clinical LLM competence across five dimensions. These upfront indicators reveal cross-benchmark capability gaps, such as the divergence between static knowledge retrieval and functional execution, that inform model selection before costly deployment-based evaluation. Beyond standard question-answering, we assess operational capabilities using deterministic execution protocols and a novel Cross-Examination Framework (CEF), which quantifies information fidelity and hallucination rates without reliance on reference texts. Our evaluation across a heterogeneous task suite exposes critical performance trade-offs: we identify a significant knowledge-execution gap, where proficiency in static retrieval does not predict success in operational tasks such as clinical calculation or SQL generation. Furthermore, we observe a divergence between passive safety (refusal) and active safety (error detection), revealing that models fine-tuned for high refusal rates often fail to reliably audit clinical documentation for factual accuracy. These findings demonstrate that no single architecture dominates across all dimensions, highlighting the necessity of a portfolio approach to clinical model deployment. We accompany this work with a publicly available MEDIC leaderboard at https://hf.co/spaces/m42-health/MEDIC-Benchmark.
comment: Published in Transactions on Machine Learning Research (06/2026)

title: Survival of the Cheapest: Cost-Aware Hardware Adaptation for Adversarial Robustness
summary: Deploying adversarially robust machine learning systems requires continuous trade-offs between robustness, cost, and latency. We present an autonomic decision-support framework providing a quantitative foundation for adaptive hardware selection and hyper-parameter tuning in cloud-native deep learning. The framework applies accelerated failure time (AFT) models to quantify the effect of hardware choice, batch size, epochs, and validation accuracy on model survival time. This framework can be naturally integrated into an autonomic control loop (monitor--analyse--plan--execute, MAPE-K), where system metrics such as cost, robustness, and latency are continuously evaluated and used to adapt model configurations and hardware selection. Experiments across three GPU architectures confirm the framework is both sound and cost-effective: the Nvidia L4 yields a 20% increase in adversarial survival time while costing 75% less than the V100, demonstrating that expensive hardware does not necessarily improve robustness. The analysis further reveals that model inference latency is a stronger predictor of adversarial robustness than training time or hardware configuration.

title: Efficient Uniform Negative Edge Weights
summary: We consider a maximum entropy edge weight model that allows for negative weights. Given a graph $G$ and possible weights $\mathcal{W}$ typically consisting of positive and negative values, the model selects edge weights $w \in \mathcal{W}^m$ uniformly at random from all weights that do not introduce a negative cycle. We propose an MCMC process and show that it converges to the required distribution. We then engineer an implementation of the process using a dynamic version of Johnson's algorithm in connection with a bidirectional Dijkstra search as well as an innovative resampling method. We empirically study the performance characteristics of these novel sampling algorithms as well as the output produced by the model.

title: Soft-TransFormers for Continual Learning
summary: Inspired by the Well-initialized Lottery Ticket Hypothesis (WLTH), we introduce Soft-TransFormers (Soft-TF), a continual learning framework that adapts a frozen pre-trained Transformer through task-specific soft subnetworks: real-valued multiplicative masks over the query, key, value, and output projections of selected self-attention layers. The masks are initialized at one, so optimization starts exactly at the pre-trained solution, and mask-space gradient descent is intrinsically biased toward modulating the backbone's dominant pathways; we prove that, under standard convex-Lipschitz assumptions, both the convergence rate and the parameter drift of mask-only fine-tuning are controlled by the distance from the pre-trained weights to a task-optimal configuration. This bounded drift yields two properties. Since the backbone and per-task masks are never overwritten, forgetting is structurally eliminated. And since every task subnetwork stays near the shared pre-trained solution, a wrong mask still evaluates a near-generalist function, so task-inference errors are largely harmless and class-incremental accuracy is decoupled from task-inference reliability. As a plug-in, Soft-TF couples with L2P, DualPrompt, HiDe-Prompt, and NoRGa, selecting masks by task-key matching, an entropy-gradient criterion, or a learned task-identity classifier. Across class-incremental learning benchmarks -- Split-CIFAR100, Split-ImageNet-R, CUB-200, and 5-Datasets -- Soft-TF consistently outperforms prompt-based, adapter-based, and LoRA-style baselines at comparable trainable-parameter budgets, while keeping inference cost identical to the unmodified backbone.

title: Fast randomized Kronecker tensor decomposition: algorithms and error analysis
summary: This paper proposes fast randomized algorithms for computing the Kronecker Tensor Decomposition (KTD) by replacing the sequence of deterministic SVDs in the TTr1SVD framework with randomized SVDs incorporating oversampling and power iterations. The proposed algorithms can decompose a given tensor into the KTD format significantly faster than existing state-of-the-art deterministic methods. Our principal idea is to use randomization to reduce computational complexity while maintaining controlled accuracy. A detailed theoretical analysis is presented, including a recursive error bound that accounts for error propagation through the TTr1SVD tree structure. We prove that the expected Frobenius norm error is bounded by a sum of tail energies multiplied by factors that decay exponentially with the number of power iterations. Extensive simulations on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate several orders of magnitude acceleration compared to the deterministic approach, with applications to tensor completion, video/image compression, image denoising, and image super-resolution.

title: FedCod: An Efficient Communication Protocol for Cross-Silo Federated Learning with Coding
comments: This paper has been accepted to IEEE/ACM International Symposium on Quality of Service (IWQoS 2026)
summary: Federated Learning (FL) is an innovative distributed machine learning paradigm that enables multiple parties to collaboratively train a model without sharing their raw data, thereby preserving data privacy. Communication efficiency concerns arise in cross-silo FL, particularly due to the network heterogeneity and fluctuations associated with geo-distributed silos. Most existing solutions to these problems focus on algorithmic improvements that alter the FL algorithm but sacrificing the training performance. How to address these problems from a network perspective that is decoupled from the FL algorithm remains an open challenge. In this paper, we propose FedCod, a new application layer communication protocol designed for cross-silo FL. FedCod transparently utilizes a coding mechanism to enhance the efficient use of idle bandwidth through client-to-client communication, and dynamically adjusts coding redundancy to mitigate network bottlenecks and fluctuations, thereby improving the communication efficiency and accelerating the training process. In our real-world experiments, FedCod demonstrates a significant reduction in average communication time by up to 62% compared to the baseline, while maintaining FL training performance and optimizing inter-client communication traffic.
