title: Optimal-Time Move Structure Construction
summary: The move structure represents a permutation $π$ of $[0,n)$ by partitioning the domain into $O(r)$ disjoint, contiguously permuted intervals, with $r$ being the minimum number of such intervals. This data structure occupies $O(r)$ words of space and enables $O(1)$-time computation of $π(i)$ given the interval that contains $i$. For permutations where $r \ll n$, this provides an efficient, compressed representation for navigation. While existing best $O(r)$-space construction approaches require $O(r\log r)$-time, we present an optimal $O(r)$-time and space construction algorithm. This is achieved by replacing balanced search trees with pointer-based lists by introducing a bidirectional strategy that synchronizes construction of the structures for $π$ and its inverse $π^{-1}$ in a single, unified pass. By applying this algorithm, we achieve the first optimal $O(n)$-time construction of the longest common prefix (LCP) array from a run-length-encoded Burrows-Wheeler transform (RLBWT) of $r$ runs in $O(r)$ working space. Empirical evaluation on pangenome-scale data confirms that our move structure construction algorithm is consistently faster than the previous best, achieving speedups of up to $\sim 2\times$ with comparable memory usage.

title: Architecture-Derived CBOMs for Cryptographic Migration: A Security-Aware Architecture Tradeoff Method
comments: Accepted at the International Workshop on Migration and Agility in Cryptographic Systems (MAgiCS 2026). This version matches the open-access conference paper published by Springer
summary: Cryptographic migration driven by algorithm deprecation, regulatory change, and post-quantum readiness requires more than an inventory of cryptographic assets. Existing Cryptographic Bills of Materials (CBOMs) are typically tool- or inventory-derived. They lack architectural intent, rationale, and security context, limiting their usefulness for migration planning. This paper introduces Security-Aware Architecture Tradeoff Analysis Method (SATAM), a security-aware adaptation of scenario-based architecture evaluation that derives an architecture-grounded, context-sensitive CBOM. SATAM integrates established approaches: ATAM, arc42, STRIDE, ADR, and CARAF. These are included to identify and analyze security-relevant cryptographic decision points and document them as explicit architectural decisions. These artifacts are used to annotate CBOM entries with architectural context, security intent, and migration-critical metadata using CycloneDX-compatible extensions. Following a Design Science Research approach, the paper presents the method design, a conceptual traceability model, and an illustrative application. The results demonstrate that architecture-derived CBOMs capture migration-relevant context that is typically absent from inventory-based approaches. Thereby, SATAM improves availability of information required for informed cryptographic migration planning and long-term cryptographic agility.
comment: Accepted at the International Workshop on Migration and Agility in Cryptographic Systems (MAgiCS 2026). This version matches the open-access conference paper published by Springer

title: The Missing Adapter Layer for Research Computing
summary: Higher Degree by Research (HDR) candidates increasingly depend on cloud-provisioned virtual machines and local GPU hardware for their computational experiments, yet a persistent and under-addressed gap separates having compute resources from using them productively. Cloud and infrastructure teams can provision a virtual machine in minutes, but the path from a raw VM to a reproducible, GPU-ready research environment remains a significant barrier for researchers who are domain experts, not systems engineers. We argue that this gap is not a shortcoming of any particular tool but a missing architectural layer: an adapter layer that bridges cloud provisioning and interactive research work. We present a lightweight, open-source implementation of this layer, built on k3s and Coder and already in active use in our research workspace environment. A CI/CD pipeline connects GitHub directly to the local cluster, carrying a research project from commit to a running, accessible workspace in under five minutes. We then define a concrete metrics framework for evaluating any adapter layer covering deployment latency, environment reproducibility, onboarding friction, and resource utilisation and establish baselines against which improvements can be measured.

title: Estimating near-verbatim extraction risk in language models with decoding-constrained beam search
summary: Recent work shows that standard greedy-decoding extraction methods for quantifying memorization in LLMs miss how extraction risk varies across sequences. Probabilistic extraction -- computing the probability of generating a target suffix given a prefix under a decoding scheme -- addresses this, but is tractable only for verbatim memorization, missing near-verbatim instances that pose similar privacy and copyright risks. Quantifying near-verbatim extraction risk is expensive: the set of near-verbatim suffixes is combinatorially large, and reliable Monte Carlo (MC) estimation can require ~100,000 samples per sequence. To mitigate this cost, we introduce decoding-constrained beam search, which yields deterministic lower bounds on near-verbatim extraction risk at a cost comparable to ~20 MC samples per sequence. Across experiments, our approach surfaces information invisible to verbatim methods: many more extractable sequences, substantially larger per-sequence extraction mass, and patterns in how near-verbatim extraction risk manifests across model sizes and types of text.

title: Doctorina MedBench-ICD10: A Dialogue-Based Benchmark and Evaluation Framework for Agent-Based Medical AI
summary:
We present Doctorina MedBench, a comprehensive evaluation framework for agent-based medical AI based on the simulation of realistic physician-patient interactions. Unlike traditional medical benchmarks that rely on solving standardized test questions, the proposed approach models a multi-step clinical dialogue in which either a physician or an AI system must collect medical history, analyze attached materials (including laboratory reports, images, and medical documents), formulate differential diagnoses, and provide personalized recommendations. System performance is evaluated using the D.O.T.S. metric, which consists of four components: Diagnosis, Observations/Investigations, Treatment, and Step Count, enabling assessment of both clinical correctness and dialogue efficiency.
  The system also incorporates a multi-level testing and quality monitoring architecture designed to detect model degradation during both development and deployment. The framework supports safety-oriented trap cases, category-based random sampling of clinical scenarios, and full regression testing. The dataset currently contains more than 1,000 clinical cases covering over 750 diagnoses. The universality of the evaluation metrics allows the framework to be used not only to assess medical AI systems, but also to evaluate physicians and support the development of clinical reasoning skills. Our results suggest that simulation of clinical dialogue may provide a more realistic assessment of clinical competence compared to traditional examination-style benchmarks.

title: M-RAG: Semantic Key-Value Indexing for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) turns external documents into evidence for large language models. In practice, this is also a data access problem: a system must decide what to index, what to retrieve, and what evidence to place in the context under a token budget. Most RAG pipelines use text chunks for both lookup and generation. This couples two different objectives. Retrieval benefits from compact and discriminative records, while generation needs contextual and faithful evidence. As a result, small chunks may fragment answer-bearing information, whereas large chunks may introduce noise and waste the context budget. We propose M-RAG, a semantic key-value indexing layer for budget-constrained RAG query processing. M-RAG extracts meta-markers from complete documents, where each record contains a retrieval key, an information value, and provenance pointers. Online retrieval operates over the key field, which can be searched by dense vector retrieval or sparse lexical retrieval; the paired values are returned as generation payloads and assembled under the token budget. Provenance pointers further support coverage validation and position-aware context ordering. This design separates the physical index entry from the evidence payload without changing the underlying retriever or generator. Experiments on LongBench QA subtasks show that M-RAG achieves competitive or better accuracy than representative chunk-based baselines, especially under tight token budgets. Further analyses show high document coverage, stronger robustness under expanding candidate corpora, and lower online retrieval latency. These results suggest that semantic key-value indexing is a practical access method for RAG workloads.

title: Interacting Multiple Model Proprioceptive Odometry for Legged Robots
summary: State estimation for legged robots remains challenging because legged odometry generally suffers from limited observability and therefore depends critically on measurement constraints to suppress drift. When exteroceptive sensors are unreliable or degraded, such constraints are mainly derived from proprioceptive measurements, particularly contact-related leg kinematics information. However, most existing proprioceptive odometry methods rely on an idealized point-contact assumption, which is often violated during real locomotion. Consequently, the effectiveness of proprioceptive constraints may be significantly reduced, resulting in degraded estimation accuracy. To address these limitations, we propose an interacting multiple model (IMM)-based proprioceptive odometry framework for legged robots. By incorporating multiple contact hypotheses within a unified probabilistic framework, the proposed method enables online mode switching and probabilistic fusion under varying contact conditions. Extensive simulations and real-world experiments demonstrate that the proposed method achieves superior pose estimation accuracy over state-of-the-art methods while maintaining comparable computational efficiency.

title: Blockspace Under Pressure: An Analysis of Spam MEV on High-Throughput Blockchains
summary:
On high-throughput, low-fee blockchains, a qualitatively new form of maximal extractable value (MEV) has emerged: searchers submit large volumes of speculative transactions, whose profitability is resolved only at execution time. We refer to this as spam MEV. On major rollups, it can at times consume more than half of block gas, even though only a small fraction of probes ultimately results in a trade. Despite growing awareness of this phenomenon, there is no principled framework for understanding how blockchain design parameters shape its prevalence and impact.
  We develop such a framework, modeling spam transactions competing for on-chain opportunities under a competitive equilibrium that drives their profits to zero, and deriving equilibrium spam volumes as a function of block capacity, minimum gas price, and the transaction fee mechanism. Empirical evidence from Base and Arbitrum supports the model: spam grew sharply as block capacity was scaled up and fell when minimum gas prices were introduced. Our analysis yields three main insights. First, spam is always costly: when block capacity is scarce, it displaces users and drives up gas prices; as block capacity grows, it increasingly consumes execution resources, raising network externality, i.e., the cost of provisioning and processing blocks. We show that spam takes an increasing share of each additional unit of block capacity, so capping it before all users are included creates a favorable trade-off: forgoing a small amount of user welfare eliminates disproportionate spam and externality. Second, we extend the analysis to priority fee ordering and show that ordering transactions by gas price helps reduce spam, as spammers must pay more to reach early block positions. Third, as user demand grows and blockspace is scaled accordingly, spam's share of block capacity plateaus rather than growing indefinitely.

title: Semantic Richness or Geometric Reasoning? The Fragility of VLM's Visual Invariance
summary: This work investigates the fundamental fragility of state-of-the-art Vision-Language Models (VLMs) under basic geometric transformations. While modern VLMs excel at semantic tasks such as recognizing objects in canonical orientations and describing complex scenes, they exhibit systematic failures at a more fundamental level: lack of robust spatial invariance and equivariance required to reliably determine object identity under simple rotations, scaling, and identity transformations. We demonstrate this limitation through a systematic evaluation across diverse visual domains, including symbolic sketches, natural photographs, and abstract art. Performance drops sharply as semantic content becomes sparse, and this behavior is observed across architectures, model capacities, and prompting strategies. Overall, our results reveal a systematic gap between semantic understanding and spatial reasoning in current VLMs, highlighting the need for stronger geometric grounding in future multimodal systems.

title: FVRuleLearner: Operator-Level Reasoning Tree (Op-Tree)-Based Rules Learning for Formal Verification
summary: The remarkable reasoning and code generation capabilities of large language models (LLMs) have recently motivated increasing interest in automating formal verification (FV), a process that ensures hardware correctness through mathematically precise assertions but remains highly labor-intensive, particularly through the translation of natural language into SystemVerilog Assertions (NL-to-SVA). However, LLMs still struggle with SVA generation due to limited training data and the intrinsic complexity of FV operators. Consequently, a more efficient and robust methodology for ensuring correct SVA operator selection is essential for producing functionally correct assertions. To address these challenges, we introduce FVRuleLearner, an Operator-Level Rule (Op-Rule) learning framework built on a novel Operator Reasoning Tree (Op-Tree), which models SVA generation as structured, interpretable reasoning. FVRuleLearner operates in two complementary phases: (1) Training: it constructs Op-Tree that decomposes NL-to-SVA alignment into fine-grained, operator-aware questions, combining reasoning paths that lead to correct assertions; and (2) Testing: it performs operator-aligned retrieval to fetch relevant reasoning traces from the learned Op-Tree and generate new rules for unseen specifications. In the comprehensive studies, the proposed FVRuleLearner outperforms the state-of-the-art baseline by 3.95% in syntax correctness and by 31.17% in functional correctness on average. Moreover, FVRuleLearner successfully reduces an average of 70.33% of SVA functional failures across diverse operator categories through a functional taxonomy analysis, showing the effectiveness of applying learned Op-Tree to the Op-Rule generations for unseen NL-to-SVA tasks. These results establish FVRuleLearner as a new paradigm for domain-specific reasoning and rule learning in formal verification.

title: JD-BP: A Joint-Decision Generative Framework for Auto-Bidding and Pricing
summary: Auto-bidding services optimize real-time bidding strategies for advertisers under key performance indicator (KPI) constraints such as target return on investment and budget. However, uncertainties such as model prediction errors and feedback latency can cause bidding strategies to deviate from ex-post optimality, leading to inefficient allocation. To address this issue, we propose JD-BP, a Joint generative Decision framework for Bidding and Pricing. Unlike prior methods, JD-BP jointly outputs a bid value and a pricing correction term that acts additively with the payment rule such as GSP. To mitigate adverse effects of historical constraint violations, we design a memory-less Return-to-Go that encourages future value maximizing of bidding actions while the cumulated bias is handled by the pricing correction. Moreover, a trajectory augmentation algorithm is proposed to generate joint bidding-pricing trajectories from a (possibly arbitrary) base bidding policy, enabling efficient plug-and-play deployment of our algorithm from existing RL/generative bidding models. Finally, we employ an Energy-Based Direct Preference Optimization method in conjunction with a cross-attention module to enhance the joint learning performance of bidding and pricing correction. Offline experiments on the AuctionNet dataset demonstrate that JD-BP achieves state-of-the-art performance. Online A/B tests at JD.com confirm its practical effectiveness, showing a 4.70% increase in ad revenue and a 6.48% improvement in target cost.

AI.title_translation: JD-BP：一种用于自动出价与定价的联合决策生成式框架
AI.tldr: JD-BP提出了一种联合生成出价与定价修正项的决策框架，通过轨迹增强和偏好优化解决了自动出价中的预测偏差问题，在京东线上实测中实现了4.70%的广告收入增长。
AI.motivation: 在自动出价服务中，模型预测误差和反馈延迟等不确定因素会导致出价策略偏离事后最优解，从而降低广告资源分配的效率。
AI.method:
1. 提出了JD-BP联合生成框架，同时输出出价和可加性定价修正项；
2. 设计无记忆Return-to-Go（Memory-less RTG），结合定价修正项消除历史约束违规带来的累积偏差；
3. 提出轨迹增强算法，将基础出价策略转化为联合出价-定价轨迹，实现对现有RL/生成出价模型的即插即用部署；
4. 结合交叉注意力模块与基于能量的直接偏好优化（E-DPO）方法提升联合学习效果。
AI.result:
1. 在AuctionNet数据集上的离线实验表明，JD-BP达到了当前的SOTA（最先进）性能；
2. 在京东进行的线上A/B测试中，广告收入提升了4.70%，目标成本改善了6.48%。
AI.conclusion: JD-BP框架成功解决了实时竞价中因不确定性导致的策略偏离问题，离线实验与京东线上A/B测试均证明了其卓越的性能与工业落地价值。
AI.translation: 自动出价服务在投资回报率目标和预算等关键绩效指标（KPI）约束下，为广告主优化实时出价策略。然而，模型预测误差和反馈延迟等不确定性可能导致出价策略偏离事后最优，引发分配低效。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了JD-BP，一种用于出价与定价的联合生成决策框架。与以往方法不同，JD-BP联合输出出价数值和一个定价修正项，该修正项以可加的方式作用于广义次高价拍卖（GSP）等支付规则。为了减轻历史约束违反带来的不利影响，我们设计了一种无记忆的Return-to-Go机制，鼓励出价行为最大化未来价值，同时累积偏差由定价修正来处理。此外，本文提出了一项轨迹增强算法，可从（可能是任意的）基础出价策略中生成联合出价-定价轨迹，从而实现从现有强化学习/生成出价模型中的高效即插即用部署。最后，我们采用基于能量的直接偏好优化方法结合交叉注意力模块，以增强出价和定价修正的联合学习性能。在AuctionNet数据集上的离线实验表明，JD-BP达到了业界领先性能。京东的线上A/B测试进一步证实了其在实践中的有效性，广告收入增长了4.70%，目标成本改善了6.48%。
AI.summary: 本文提出了JD-BP框架，通过联合生成出价与定价修正项，解决自动出价中因预测误差和延迟导致的不确定性问题。该框架包含无记忆RTG机制、轨迹增强部署算法以及基于能量的偏好优化方法，在离线评估和京东线上A/B测试中均取得了显著优于现有方法的性能表现。
AI.keywords: Auto-Bidding (自动出价), Joint Decision (联合决策), Generative Framework (生成式框架), Pricing Correction (定价修正), Preference Optimization (偏好优化)
AI.comments:
创新性：本文首次将自动出价与定价修正进行联合生成决策，创新地设计了无记忆Return-to-Go与定价修正项来协调处理累积偏差，并引入轨迹增强算法实现现有强化学习/生成模型的“即插即用”。
重要性：解决了广告系统中预测误差与反馈延迟导致的离线/在线策略失效问题，在京东工业级线上系统获得了4.70%的广告收入提升，具有极高的工程应用价值。
局限性：定价修正项对传统拍卖机制（如GSP）激励相容性（Truthfulness）的影响需要更深度的机制设计理论证明，摘要中未给出在其他复杂拍卖规则下的泛化效果。

title: Robust Reasoning Benchmark
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve high performance on standard mathematical benchmarks, their problem-solving abilities depend on the context and textual formatting. We introduce the Robust Reasoning Benchmark (RRB), a pipeline of 13 deterministic textual perturbations applied to AIME 2024 and AIME 2025. Evaluating 8 state-of-the-art models, we find that frontier models are largely resilient, with the notable exception of Claude, which categorically refuses many transformed prompts. Open-weights reasoning models exhibit a range of failure modes under structural noise (cognitive thrashing, tokenization breakdown, and reasoning collapse), with up to 54% average accuracy drops across perturbations and up to 100% on some. We further study one of these failure modes in isolation: attention dilution caused by the model's own chain-of-thought. By tasking models with solving multiple independent mathematical problems sequentially within a single context window, we identify Intra-Query Attention Dilution. Open-weights models ranging from 7B to 120B parameters exhibit accuracy decay on subsequent problems, suggesting that intermediate reasoning steps progressively pollute standard dense attention mechanisms. We argue that in order to achieve reliable reasoning, future architectures need to integrate explicit contextual resets within models' own chain-of-thought, leading to open research questions regarding the optimal granularity of reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RRB基准测试LLM的推理鲁棒性，发现开源模型在文本扰动下准确率大幅暴跌且存在“查询内注意力稀释”现象，而Claude则频繁拒绝回答扰动后的问题。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型在标准数学基准上表现优异，但其解题能力高度依赖上下文和文本格式。需要评估模型在面对文本结构噪声及长推理过程时的真实鲁棒性与失败模式。
AI.method: 提出了鲁棒推理基准（RRB），将13种确定性文本扰动应用于AIME 2024和AIME 2025数据集，评估了8个最先进的模型。同时，设计了在单个上下文窗口内让模型连续求解多个独立数学问题的实验，以隔离并定量研究“查询内注意力稀释”现象。
AI.result: 前沿闭源模型大多对扰动具备韧性，但Claude会系统性拒绝许多扰动提示词；开源推理模型在结构噪声下表现出认知打扰、分词崩溃和推理坍塌等严重失败模式，平均准确率下降高达54%，部分扰动下准确率暴跌100%。此外，7B至120B参数量的开源模型在同一窗口内连续解题时，后续问题的准确率呈持续衰减趋势。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，中间推理步骤会逐渐污染标准密集注意力机制。为了实现可靠的长链条推理，未来模型架构需要引入显式的上下文重置机制（contextual resets），这为探索推理任务的最佳粒度开辟了新的研究方向。
AI.translation: 虽然大语言模型（LLM）在标准数学基准测试中取得了优异表现，但其解决问题的能力在很大程度上依赖于上下文和文本格式。我们引入了鲁棒推理基准（RRB），这是一个由13种确定性文本扰动构成的流水线，应用于AIME 2024和AIME 2025数据集。通过对8个最先进的模型进行评估，我们发现前沿模型大多具备韧性，但Claude是个显著例外，它明确拒绝了许多变换后的提示词。开源推理模型在结构噪声下展示出一系列失败模式（认知打扰、分词崩溃和推理坍塌），在不同扰动下的平均准确率下降高达54%，在某些扰动下甚至下降100%。我们进一步单独研究了其中一种失败模式：由模型自身的思维链引发的注意力稀释。通过要求模型在单个上下文窗口内顺序解决多个独立的数学问题，我们识别出了“查询内注意力稀释”（Intra-Query Attention Dilution）。从7B到120B参数量的开源模型在后续问题上均表现出准确率衰减，这表明中间推理步骤会逐渐污染标准的密集注意力机制。我们主张，为了实现可靠的推理，未来的架构需要在模型自身的思维链中集成显式的上下文重置机制，从而引出了关于推理任务最佳粒度的开放研究问题。
AI.summary: 论文提出了鲁棒推理基准（RRB），通过13种文本扰动测试了8个主流大语言模型在AIME数学题上的表现。研究发现开源模型在格式扰动下极易崩溃，且长思维链会导致“查询内注意力稀释”，降低后续解题准确率。闭源模型中Claude则表现出高拒绝率。研究强调了未来架构引入上下文重置机制的必要性。
AI.keywords: 鲁棒推理, 大语言模型, 注意力稀释, 思维链, 文本扰动
AI.comments:
1. **创新性**：提出了针对复杂数学推理的确定性文本扰动基准（RRB），并首次明确并隔离研究了由于模型自身Chain-of-Thought导致的“查询内注意力稀释”（Intra-Query Attention Dilution）现象。
2. **重要性**：揭示了当前大语言模型（特别是开源模型）在真实复杂/非标准格式环境下的脆弱性，打破了标准榜单的高分假象，并对未来的长推理架构设计（如显式上下文重置）提出了重要的指导意义。
3. **局限性**：评估数据集主要集中于AIME数学竞赛题，且对于闭源模型内部机制的分析受限于API访问，未能完全厘清Claude拒绝回答的具体底层机制。

title: Social Reality Construction via Active Inference: Modeling the Dialectic of Conformity and Creativity
summary: Social agents both internalize collective norms and reshape them through creative action, yet computational models have not captured this bidirectional process within a unified framework. We propose a multi-agent simulation model grounded in active inference that formalizes the dialectical constitution of social reality on a structured social network. Each agent maintains an internal generative model, communicates with neighbors to form social priors, creates novel observations, and selectively incorporates others' creations into memory. Simulation experiments demonstrate three main findings. First, informationally cohesive social groups emerge endogenously, with representational alignment mirroring the cluster topology of the underlying network. Second, a circular mutual constitution arises between social representations and the observation distribution, maintained through agents' creative acts that project representational structure onto the external world. Third, the propagation of creations exhibits selective, heterogeneous patterns distinct from the stable diffusion of social representations, indicating that agents construct cultural niches through local interaction dynamics. These results suggest that the interplay between social conformity and creative deviation can give rise to the endogenous formation and differentiation of shared social reality.

AI.title_translation: 通过主动推理构建社会现实：从众与创造的辩证关系建模
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于主动推理的多智能体模型，成功在统一框架内模拟了社会从众与创造性偏离相互作用并内生构建社会现实的过程。
AI.motivation: 社会智能体既会内化集体规范，又会通过创造性行动重塑规范，但现有的计算模型尚未在一个统一的框架内捕获这一双向辩证过程。
AI.method: 提出了一个基于主动推理（Active Inference）的结构化社交网络多智能体仿真模型。在该模型中，每个智能体维护一个内部生成模型，通过与邻居通信形成社会先验，创造新的观测，并选择性地将他人的创造融合进自身记忆中。
AI.result: 1. 信息凝聚的社会群体内生涌现，其表征对齐镜像反映了底层网络的聚类拓扑结构；2. 社会表征与观测分布之间形成了循环互构，通过智能体将表征结构投射到外部世界的创造性行为来维持；3. 创造物的传播展现出选择性和异质性模式，与社会表征的稳定扩散不同，表明智能体通过局部互动动态构建文化生态位。
AI.conclusion: 社会从众与创造性偏离之间的相互作用能够导致共享社会现实的内生形成与分化。
AI.translation: 社会智能体既内化集体规范，又通过创造性行动重塑规范，但计算模型尚未在统一框架内捕捉这一双向过程。我们提出了一个基于主动推理的多智能体仿真模型，形式化了结构化社交网络上社会现实的辩证构成。每个智能体维护一个内部生成模型，与邻居通信以形成社会先验，创造新的观测，并选择性地将他人的创造融入记忆中。仿真实验展示了三个主要发现：首先，信息凝聚的社会群体内生涌现，表征对齐反映了底层网络的聚类拓扑；其次，社会表征与观测分布之间产生了循环互构，这是通过智能体将表征结构投射到外部世界的创造性行为来维持的；第三，创造物的传播表现出异于社会表征稳定扩散的选择性、异质性模式，表明智能体通过局部互动动态构建文化生态位。这些结果表明，社会从众与创造性偏离之间的相互作用可以促成共享社会现实的内生形成和分化。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了社会现实构建中“规范从众”与“创造重塑”的辩证关系。作者提出了一个基于主动推理的多智能体网络仿真模型，智能体通过通信形成先验、产生创造性观测并吸收他人创造。实验证实了社会群体的涌现、社会表征与环境的循环互构以及文化生态位的形成，为理解共享社会现实的内生演化提供了计算框架。
AI.keywords: 主动推理, 社会现实构建, 多智能体仿真, 从众与创造, 文化生态位
AI.comments: 本研究创新性地将主动推理（Active Inference）引入多智能体社会计算中，成功在统一框架下形式化了社会学中“从众与创造/偏离”的辩证过程。论文将认知层面的生成模型与社交网络拓扑相结合，揭示了微观互动如何自下而上涌现出宏观文化生态位与社会现实。不足之处在于研究基于仿真实验，未来尚需结合实际社会心理学或网络互动数据进行进一步实证检验。

title: Teaching Robots to Interpret Social Interactions through Lexically-guided Dynamic Graph Learning
comments: We have expanded on this study further, and a new paper covering all the findings will be published shortly
summary: For a robot to be called socially intelligent, it must be able to infer users internal states from their current behaviour, predict the users future behaviour, and if required, respond appropriately. In this work, we investigate how robots can be endowed with such social intelligence by modelling the dynamic relationship between user's internal states (latent) and actions (observable state). Our premise is that these states arise from the same underlying socio-cognitive process and influence each other dynamically. Drawing inspiration from theories in Cognitive Science, we propose a novel multi-task learning framework, termed as \textbf{SocialLDG} that explicitly models the dynamic relationship among the states represent as six distinct tasks. Our framework uses a language model to introduce lexical priors for each task and employs dynamic graph learning to model task affinity evolving with time. SocialLDG has three advantages: First, it achieves state-of-the-art performance on two challenging human-robot social interaction datasets available publicly. Second, it supports strong task scalability by learning new tasks seamlessly without catastrophic forgetting. Finally, benefiting from explicit modelling task affinity, it offers insights on how different interactions unfolds in time and how the internal states and observable actions influence each other in human decision making.
comment: We have expanded on this study further, and a new paper covering all the findings will be published shortly

AI.title_translation: 通过词汇引导的动态图学习教机器人理解社交互动
AI.tldr: 提出 SocialLDG 框架，通过语言模型词汇先验与动态图学习对人机交互中的心理状态和行为关联进行动态建模，实现了SOTA社交理解性能与抗遗忘的可扩展性。
AI.motivation: 社交智能机器人需要能够从用户的可观察行为中推断其隐式内部状态并预测未来行为。这些内部状态与外部行为源于相同的社会认知过程并存在动态相互影响，因此需要一种能够显式建模这种动态演化关系的方法。
AI.method: 提出了名为 SocialLDG 的多任务学习框架，将用户状态和行为建模为六个独立任务。该框架利用语言模型为各个任务引入词汇先验（lexical priors），并结合动态图学习（dynamic graph learning）来显式建模随时间演化的任务关联度/亲和力（task affinity）。
AI.result: 1. 在两个公开的极具挑战性的人机社交互动数据集上取得了当前最优（SOTA）性能；2. 具有极强的任务可扩展性，能够无缝学习新任务且不会发生灾难性遗忘；3. 能够揭示不同社交互动随时间展开的规律，以及人类决策中内部状态与可观察行为之间的相互影响机制。
AI.conclusion: SocialLDG 框架通过显式建模社会认知状态之间的动态相互作用，有效地赋予了机器人理解和预测人类社交互动行为的能力。
AI.translation: 为了让机器人具备社交智能，它必须能够从用户当前的行为中推断其内部状态，预测用户未来的行为，并在需要时做出适当的响应。在这项工作中，我们研究了如何通过对用户的内部状态（隐状态）与行为（可观察状态）之间的动态关系进行建模，赋予机器人这种社交智能。我们的前提是这些状态源于相同的底层社会认知过程，并相互动态影响。受认知科学理论的启发，我们提出了一种名为 SocialLDG 的新型多任务学习框架，该框架显式地对表示为六个不同任务的状态之间的动态关系进行建模。我们的框架利用语言模型为每个任务引入词汇先验，并使用动态图学习来建模随时间演化的任务亲和力。SocialLDG 具有三个优势：首先，它在两个公开的挑战性人机社交互动数据集上达到了当前最优（SOTA）性能。其次，它通过无缝学习新任务且不会发生灾难性遗忘，展现出极强的任务可扩展性。最后，得益于对任务亲和力的显式建模，它为了解不同互动随时间的展开方式以及在人类决策中内部状态和可观察行为如何相互影响提供了深刻见解。
AI.summary: 本文提出了用于人机社交互动的 SocialLDG 框架。该框架受认知科学启发，利用语言模型的词汇先验和动态图学习，对构成人类社交过程的六个动态演化的任务亲和力进行显式多任务建模。实验证明该方法实现了SOTA性能，具备抗灾难性遗忘的扩展能力，并显著提升了交互过程的可解释性。
AI.keywords: 社交智能, 多任务学习, 动态图学习, 语言模型, 人机交互
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将认知科学理论与语言模型的词汇先验以及动态图学习相结合，成功解决了人机社交互动中隐性内部状态与显性行为协同演化的复杂建模难题。显式建模任务亲和力不仅带来了性能突破和无灾难性遗忘的任务扩展能力，还为理解人类社交决策过程提供了良好的可解释性。局限性在于其表现可能依赖于预先定义的社交任务结构，在未知或极端复杂交互场景下的泛化能力仍需验证。

title: CPGRec+: A Balance-oriented Framework for Personalized Video Game Recommendations
comments: Published in ACM Transactions on Information Systems (TOIS). 43 pages, 9 figures
summary: The rapid expansion of gaming industry requires advanced recommender systems tailored to its dynamic landscape. Existing Graph Neural Network (GNN)-based methods primarily prioritize accuracy over diversity, overlooking their inherent trade-off. To address this, we previously proposed CPGRec, a balance-oriented gaming recommender system. However, CPGRec fails to account for critical disparities in player-game interactions, which carry varying significance in reflecting players' personal preferences and may exacerbate over-smoothness issues inherent in GNN-based models. Moreover, existing approaches underutilize the reasoning capabilities and extensive knowledge of large language models (LLMs) in addressing these limitations. To bridge this gap, we propose two new modules. First, Preference-informed Edge Reweighting (PER) module assigns signed edge weights to qualitatively distinguish significant player interests and disinterests while then quantitatively measuring preference strength to mitigate over-smoothing in graph convolutions. Second, Preference-informed Representation Generation (PRG) module leverages LLMs to generate contextualized descriptions of games and players by reasoning personal preferences from comparing global and personal interests, thereby refining representations of players and games. Experiments on \textcolor{black}{two Steam datasets} demonstrate CPGRec+'s superior accuracy and diversity over state-of-the-art models. The code is accessible at https://github.com/HsipingLi/CPGRec-Plus.
comment: Published in ACM Transactions on Information Systems (TOIS). 43 pages, 9 figures

AI.title_translation: CPGRec+：一种面向平衡的个性化电子游戏推荐框架
AI.tldr: CPGRec+通过结合图神经网络边重赋权与大语言模型表征生成，成功平衡了电子游戏推荐系统的准确性与多样性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于GNN的游戏推荐方法过于注重准确性而忽视多样性，且无法处理玩家-游戏交互的重要性差异，容易加剧GNN的过度平滑问题；同时现有方法缺乏对LLM推理能力与丰富常识知识的充分利用。
AI.method: 提出了两个新模块：1. 偏好知情边重赋权（PER）模块：分配带符号的边权重以区分玩家的兴趣与不兴趣，并定量测量偏好强度，减轻图卷积的过度平滑问题；2. 偏好知情表征生成（PRG）模块：利用大语言模型比较全局与个人兴趣推理偏好，生成游戏和玩家的上下文描述以精炼表征。
AI.result: 在两个Steam数据集上的实验表明，CPGRec+在推荐准确性和多样性上均显著优于现有最先进（SOTA）模型。
AI.conclusion: CPGRec+成功融合了GNN结构优化与LLM推理能力，有效改善了交互差异建模与过度平滑问题，实现了个性化游戏推荐中准确性与多样性的极佳平衡。
AI.translation: 电子游戏产业的快速扩张需要针对其动态格局量身定制的高级推荐系统。现有的基于图神经网络（GNN）的方法主要侧重于准确性而非多样性，忽视了它们固有的权衡关系。为了解决这一问题，我们此前提出了CPGRec——一种面向平衡的游戏推荐系统。然而，CPGRec未能考虑到玩家与游戏交互中的关键差异，这些差异在反映玩家个人偏好方面具有不同的重要性，并可能加剧基于GNN模型固有的过度平滑问题。此外，现有方法在解决这些局限性时，未充分利用大语言模型（LLMs）的推理能力和广泛知识。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了两个新模块。首先，偏好知情的边重赋权（PER）模块分配带符号的边权重，以定性区分显著的玩家兴趣与不兴趣，随后定量测量偏好强度，以减轻图卷积中的过度平滑现象。其次，偏好知情的表征生成（PRG）模块利用LLM通过对比全局与个人兴趣来推理个人偏好，从而生成游戏和玩家的上下文描述，进一步精炼玩家和游戏的表征。在两个Steam数据集上的实验证明了CPGRec+相比于最先进模型具有更优越的准确性和多样性。代码已在https://github.com/HsipingLi/CPGRec-Plus开源。
AI.summary: 本文提出了针对电子游戏推荐的平衡框架CPGRec+。针对传统GNN忽略交互差异、易过度平滑且忽视多样性的问题，CPGRec+通过PER模块引入带符号边重赋权，并利用PRG模块借助大语言模型推理玩家偏好并生成富上下文表征，在Steam数据集上取得了准确性与多样性的双重领先。
AI.keywords: 游戏推荐系统, 图神经网络, 大语言模型, 多样性平衡, 过度平滑
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将图神经网络（GNN）的图结构增强（带符号边重赋权）与大语言模型（LLM）的上下文推理能力相结合，有效缓解了GNN的过度平滑问题，并在保证推荐准确性的同时显著提升了多样性。局限性在于摘要中未讨论LLM引入带来的额外计算开销与推断延迟。

title: Category-based and Popularity-guided Video Game Recommendation: A Balance-oriented Framework
comments: Published in The Web Conference (WWW) 2024. 11 pages, 8 figures
summary: In recent years, the video game industry has experienced substantial growth, presenting players with a vast array of game choices. This surge in options has spurred the need for a specialized recommender system tailored for video games. However, current video game recommendation approaches tend to prioritize accuracy over diversity, potentially leading to unvaried game suggestions. In addition, the existing game recommendation methods commonly lack the ability to establish strict connections between games to enhance accuracy. Furthermore, many existing diversity-focused methods fail to leverage crucial item information, such as item category and popularity during neighbor modeling and message propagation. To address these challenges, we introduce a novel framework, called CPGRec, comprising three modules, namely accuracy-driven, diversity-driven, and comprehensive modules. The first module extends the state-of-the-art accuracy-focused game recommendation method by connecting games in a more stringent manner to enhance recommendation accuracy. The second module connects neighbors with diverse categories within the proposed game graph and harnesses the advantages of popular game nodes to amplify the influence of long-tail games within the player-game bipartite graph, thereby enriching recommendation diversity. The third module combines the above two modules and employs a new negative-sample rating score reweighting method to balance accuracy and diversity. Experimental results on the Steam dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method in improving game recommendations. The dataset and source codes are anonymously released at: https://github.com/CPGRec2024/CPGRec.git.
comment: Published in The Web Conference (WWW) 2024. 11 pages, 8 figures

AI.title_translation: 基于类别与流行度引导的电子游戏推荐：一种平衡导向的框架
AI.tldr: 本文提出了CPGRec框架，结合游戏类别和流行度引导，通过三大模块有效平衡电子游戏推荐中的准确性与多样性。
AI.motivation: 现有电子游戏推荐系统大多偏向准确性而牺牲多样性，导致推荐结果单一；同时缺乏建立游戏间严格连接机制的能力，且现有关注多样性的方法未能有效利用游戏类别和流行度等关键信息。
AI.method: 提出了名为CPGRec的框架，包含三个模块：1）准确性驱动模块：通过更严格的游戏间连接方式扩展现有SOTA方法以提升精度；2）多样性驱动模块：在游戏图中连接不同类别的邻居，并利用热门游戏节点扩大长尾游戏在玩家-游戏二部图中的影响力以提升多样性；3）综合模块：融合前两个模块，并采用全新的负样本评分重加权方法来平衡准确性与多样性。
AI.result: 在Steam数据集上的实验结果表明，所提出的CPGRec框架在改进游戏推荐（平衡准确性与多样性）方面具有显著效果。
AI.conclusion: CPGRec框架成功克服了现有推荐算法在准确性与多样性权衡上的不足，在Steam真实数据集上证明了其提升游戏推荐综合质量的有效性。
AI.translation: 近年来，电子游戏产业经历了大幅增长，为玩家提供了海量的游戏选择。这种选项的激增催生了对专门面向电子游戏的推荐系统的需求。然而，现有的电子游戏推荐方法往往优先考虑准确性而忽视多样性，这可能导致推荐结果单一。此外，现有的游戏推荐方法通常缺乏建立游戏之间严格连接以提高准确性的能力。再者，许多关注多样性的方法在邻居建模和消息传播过程中未能利用诸如项目类别和流行度等关键项目信息。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了一名为CPGRec的新框架，包含三个模块，即准确性驱动模块、多样性驱动模块和综合模块。第一个模块通过以更严格的方式连接游戏来扩展现有的以准确性为中心的最佳游戏推荐方法，从而提高推荐准确性。第二个模块在提出的游戏图中连接具有不同类别的邻居，并利用热门游戏节点的优势来放大玩家-游戏二部图中长尾游戏的影响力，从而丰富推荐的多样性。第三个模块结合了上述两个模块，并采用了一种新的负样本评分重加权方法来平衡准确性和多样性。在Steam数据集上的实验结果表明了我们提出的方法在改进游戏推荐方面的有效性。数据集和源代码已匿名发布于：https://github.com/CPGRec2024/CPGRec.git。
AI.summary: 本文针对电子游戏推荐中准确性与多样性失衡、以及未能充分利用类别和流行度信息的问题，提出了一个名为CPGRec的新型框架。该框架通过准确性驱动、多样性驱动和结合负样本重加权的综合模块，实现了推荐准确率与长尾多样性的良好平衡。在Steam数据集上的实验证实了该方法的有效性。
AI.keywords: 电子游戏推荐, 推荐系统, 多样性与准确性平衡, 图神经网络, 长尾推荐
AI.comments: 该论文针对电子游戏推荐领域中过度关注准确性而忽视多样性、以及未充分利用游戏类别和流行度信息的问题，提出了CPGRec框架。其创新点在于巧妙结合了游戏类别图与玩家-游戏二部图，并提出负样本评分重加权策略来平衡准确性与长尾多样性。该方法在Steam数据集上验证了有效性，对兼顾推荐系统精准度与长尾挖掘具有实际应用价值。

title: Geometric Capacity of Transformers: A Tropical Geometry Perspective
summary: To quantify the geometric capacity of transformers, we develop a tropical-geometric framework for analyzing the spatial partitions induced by conditioned self-attention. In the zero-temperature limit, we show that fixed-key top-$1$ routing is exactly represented by a power diagram in query space, while an auxiliary log-lifted value parameterization yields a vector-valued tropical rational representation. For Multi-Head Self-Attention (MHSA) with sequence length $N$ and $H$ attention heads, the joint routing geometry is encoded by Minkowski sums of headwise Newton polytopes, giving an $\mathcal{O}(N^H)$ universal bound that sharpens to $\mathcal{O}((HN)^{d_{\mathrm{model}}-1})$ once the number of heads reaches the intrinsic dimension $d_{\mathrm{model}}$. Extending this analysis across depth $L$, we derive the first tight asymptotic bounds on the number of linear regions in transformers ($Θ\!\left(N^{\min\{H,d_{\mathrm{model}}-1\}L}\right)$). We further show that finite-temperature softmax preserves the top-$1$ routing structure and admits exponentially decaying local approximation and differential bounds away from routing boundaries.

AI.title_translation: Transformer 的几何容量：热带几何视角
AI.tldr: 本文利用热带几何分析 Transformer 的空间划分与表达能力，首次给出了 Transformer 线性区域数量的渐近紧界。
AI.motivation: 为了量化 Transformer 的几何表达容量，建立一个能够严谨分析条件自注意力机制所诱导的空间划分的理论框架。
AI.method: 构建基于热带几何（tropical geometry）的分析框架；在零温度极限下将 Top-1 路由表示为查询空间中的权图（power diagram），并结合对数提升值参数化得到向量值热带有理表示；采用头向牛顿多面体的闵可夫斯基和（Minkowski sums）分析多头自注意力的联合路由几何，并推广至深度 $L$ 的网络中。
AI.result:
1. 证明零温度下的固定键 Top-1 路由精确对应查询空间中的权图，联合路由几何由牛顿多面体的闵可夫斯基和编码。
2. 推导得到多头自注意力的通用界 $\mathcal{O}(N^H)$，并在头数达到固有维度时精确至 $\mathcal{O}((HN)^{d_{\mathrm{model}}-1})$。
3. 首次给出了深度为 $L$ 的 Transformer 中分段线性区域数量的渐近紧界 $\Theta(N^{\min\{H,d_{\mathrm{model}}-1\}L})$。
4. 证明有限温度 Softmax 保持 Top-1 路由结构，并在远离路由边界处具备指数衰减的局部近似与微分界。
AI.conclusion: 基于热带几何的分析框架成功揭示了 Transformer 注意力路由的内在几何结构，并首次给出了 Transformer 几何表达能力（线性区域数量）的渐近紧界。
AI.translation: 为了量化 Transformer 的几何容量，我们建立了一个热带几何框架，用于分析条件自注意力所诱导的空间划分。在零温度极限下，我们证明固定键 top-1 路由在查询空间中可以被精确表示为权图（power diagram），而辅助的对数提升值参数化则给出了向量值热带有理表示。对于序列长度为 $N$、注意力头数为 $H$ 的多头自注意力（MHSA），其联合路由几何由头向牛顿多面体的闵可夫斯基和编码，给出了 $\mathcal{O}(N^H)$ 的通用上界；一旦头数达到固有维度 $d_{\mathrm{model}}$，该界将精细化为 $\mathcal{O}((HN)^{d_{\mathrm{model}}-1})$。将此分析扩展到深度 $L$，我们首次导出了 Transformer 中线性区域数量的渐近紧界（$\Theta(N^{\min\{H,d_{\mathrm{model}}-1\}L})$）。我们进一步表明，有限温度 softmax 保持了 top-1 路由结构，并在远离路由边界处具有指数衰减的局部近似与微分界。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个基于热带几何的理论框架，用于分析 Transformer 条件自注意力的几何容量。研究表明零温度下的 Top-1 注意力路由可表示为权图与热带有理函数，多头几何由牛顿多面体的闵可夫斯基和刻画。利用该框架，作者首次推导出了深度 Transformer 线性区域数量的渐近紧界，并证实了有限温度 Softmax 对路由结构的保持性。
AI.keywords: Transformer, 热带几何, 自注意力机制, 几何容量, 线性区域
AI.comments: 本研究将热带几何成功引入到 Transformer 理论分析中，提供了独特且严谨的数学视角。其主要创新在于揭示了注意力路由与权图及牛顿多面体之间的内在联系，并首次导出了深度 Transformer 分段线性区域数量的渐近紧界，填补了自注意力机制几何表达能力理论分析的空白。局限性在于主要分析建立在零温度极限下的 Top-1 路由假设之上，尽管文章证明了有限温度 Softmax 的逼近性质，但对实际训练中连续 Softmax 的复杂动态几何特性的刻画仍有待进一步深入。

title: Why Do Vision Language Models Struggle To Recognize Human Emotions?
summary: Understanding emotions is a fundamental ability for intelligent systems to be able to interact with humans. Vision-language models (VLMs) have made tremendous progress in the last few years for many visual tasks, potentially offering a promising solution for understanding emotions. However, it is surprising that even the most sophisticated contemporary VLMs struggle to recognize human emotions or to outperform even specialized vision-only classifiers. In this paper we ask the question 'Why do VLMs struggle to recognize human emotions?', and observe that the inherently continuous and dynamic task of facial expression recognition (DFER) exposes two critical VLM vulnerabilities. First, emotion datasets are naturally long-tailed, and the web-scale data used to pre-train VLMs exacerbates this head-class bias, causing them to systematically collapse rare, under-represented emotions into common categories. We propose alternative sampling strategies that prevent favoring common concepts. Second, temporal information is critical for understanding emotions. However, VLMs are unable to represent temporal information over dense frame sequences, as they are limited by context size and the number of tokens that can fit in memory, which poses a clear challenge for emotion recognition. We demonstrate that the sparse temporal sampling strategy used in VLMs is inherently misaligned with the fleeting nature of micro-expressions (0.25-0.5 seconds), which are often the most critical affective signal. As a diagnostic probe, we propose a multi-stage context enrichment strategy that utilizes the information from 'in-between' frames by first converting them into natural language summaries. This enriched textual context is provided as input to the VLM alongside sparse keyframes, preventing attentional dilution from excessive visual data while preserving the emotional trajectory.

AI.title_translation: 为什么视觉语言模型难以识别人类情感？
AI.tldr: 本文揭示了视觉语言模型在情感识别中的两大瓶颈（长尾偏见与时序采样缺陷），并提出了利用自然语言摘要增强上下文的解决策略。
AI.motivation: 探索最先进的视觉语言模型（VLM）在识别人类情感方面表现欠佳、甚至不如专用的纯视觉分类器的根本原因，解决动态人脸表情识别（DFER）中的核心瓶颈。
AI.method: 1. 针对数据分布问题，提出替代采样策略，防止预训练过程中的长尾头类偏见导致稀有情感被归为常见情感；2. 针对时序信息丢失问题，提出多阶段上下文增强诊断策略，将视频中的“中间帧”转化为自然语言摘要，并将该丰富文本上下文与稀疏关键帧一同作为输入提供给VLM，以保留情感轨迹并避免视觉注意力稀释。
AI.result: 揭示了VLM现有的稀疏时间采样策略与持续仅0.25-0.5秒的微表情之间存在本质上的不匹配；证明了利用自然语言摘要丰富文本上下文能够在不超出VLM上下文和内存限制的前提下，有效保留情感轨迹并防止注意力稀释。
AI.conclusion: VLM在动态人脸表情识别中的劣势主要源于预训练数据的长尾偏见以及稀疏时间采样对微表情信息的丢失。通过改进采样策略与引入多阶段文本上下文增强，可以有效提升VLM对动态情感与微表情的感知与识别能力。
AI.translation: 理解情感是智能系统能够与人类进行交互的一项基本能力。视觉语言模型（VLM）在过去几年中在许多视觉任务上取得了巨大进展，为理解情感提供了有前景的解决方案。然而，令人惊讶的是，即使是最复杂的当代VLM也难以识别人类情感，甚至无法超越专门的纯视觉分类器。在本文中，我们提出了“为什么VLM难以识别人类情感？”的问题，并观察到人脸表情识别（DFER）这一本质上连续且动态的任务暴露了VLM的两个关键漏洞。首先，情感数据集天然具有长尾分布，用于预训练VLM的网络规模数据加剧了这种头类偏见，导致它们系统性地将罕见、未被充分代表的情感折叠进常见类别中。我们提出了防止偏向常见概念的替代采样策略。其次，时间信息对于理解情感至关重要。然而，由于受限于上下文大小和内存中能容纳的token数量，VLM无法在密集帧序列上表示时间信息，这给情感识别带来了明确的挑战。我们证明，VLM中使用的稀疏时间采样策略与微表情（0.25-0.5秒）的短暂本质存在固有不匹配，而微表情通常是最关键的情感信号。作为诊断探针，我们提出了一种多阶段上下文增强策略，该策略首先将“中间帧”的信息转化为自然语言摘要。这种丰富的文本上下文与稀疏关键帧一起作为输入提供给VLM，在保留情感轨迹的同时避免了因视觉数据过多导致的注意力稀释。
AI.summary: 本文分析了视觉语言模型（VLM）难以精准识别人类情感的原因，指出其两大关键漏洞：一是网络预训练数据的长尾效应导致模型将罕见情感误判为常见情感；二是受限于上下文和内存大小，VLM的稀疏采样无法有效捕获微表情等关键动态时序信息。为此，作者提出了改进采样策略和多阶段文本上下文增强方法，将中间帧转化为自然语言摘要辅助关键帧识别，显著提升了VLM对情感轨迹的理解能力。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言模型, 情感识别, 动态人脸表情识别, 长尾偏见, 上下文增强
AI.comments: 本文深刻洞察了视觉语言模型（VLM）在细粒度情感感知领域的局限性，精准指出了长尾分布偏见与密集时序信息处理困难两大核心痛点。论文创新地提出将中间帧转化为自然语言摘要，将密集的视觉时序转化为高维文本语义，既巧妙绕过了VLM上下文窗口和内存限制，又保留了微表情的情感轨迹，对推动多模态模型在情感计算领域的发展具有重要实用价值。

title: AnchorRefine: Synergy-Manipulation Based on Trajectory Anchor and Residual Refinement for Vision-Language-Action Models
comments: The authors have decided to withdraw this manuscript because the work requires substantial revision and further experimental validation
summary: Precision-critical manipulation requires both global trajectory organization and local execution correction, yet most vision-language-action (VLA) policies generate actions within a single unified space. This monolithic formulation forces macro-level transport and micro-level refinement to be optimized under the same objective, causing large motions to dominate learning while suppressing small but failure-critical corrective signals. In contrast, human manipulation is structured by global movement planning together with continuous local adjustment during execution. Motivated by this principle, we propose AnchorRefine, a hierarchical framework that factorizes VLA action modeling into trajectory anchor and residual refinement. The anchor planner predicts a coarse motion scaffold, while the refinement module corrects execution-level deviations to improve geometric and contact precision. We further introduce a decision-aware gripper refinement mechanism to better capture the discrete and boundary-sensitive nature of gripper control. Experiments on LIBERO, CALVIN, and real-robot tasks demonstrate that AnchorRefine consistently improves both regression-based and diffusion-based VLA backbones, yielding gains of up to 7.8% in simulation success rate and 18% in real-world success rate.
comment: The authors have decided to withdraw this manuscript because the work requires substantial revision and further experimental validation

AI.title_translation: AnchorRefine：基于轨迹锚点与残差精细化的视觉-语言-动作模型协同操作
AI.tldr: 提出了AnchorRefine分层框架，将VLA模型的动作预测解耦为粗粒度轨迹锚点与细粒度残差修正，显著提升机器人高精度操作成功率。
AI.motivation: 精密机器人操作既需要全局轨迹规划，又需要局部微调。但现有的VLA模型大多在单一统一空间内生成动作，导致大尺度移动主导了学习过程，掩盖了对关键接触和操作至关重要的微观纠正信号。
AI.method: 提出了AnchorRefine层次化框架，将动作建模解耦为预测粗略运动骨架的轨迹锚点规划器和修正执行偏差的残差精细化模块，并进一步引入了决策感知的夹爪精细化机制以优化离散且边界敏感的夹爪控制。
AI.result: 在LIBERO、CALVIN仿真环境及真实机器人任务上的实验证明，AnchorRefine在基于回归和基于扩散的VLA主干网络上均取得了持续提升，仿真成功率最高提升7.8%，真实世界成功率最高提升18%。
AI.conclusion: 将VLA动作建模解耦为粗粒度轨迹锚点与细粒度残差修正的层次化控制，能有效解决大尺度运动掩盖微观纠正信号的问题，大幅提升机器人精密操作的准确性与成功率。
AI.translation: 高精度操作既需要全局轨迹组织，又需要局部执行修正，但大多数视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略都在单一统一的空间内生成动作。这种单体式表达迫使宏观移动和微观精细化在同一目标下进行优化，导致大幅度运动主导了学习过程，同时抑制了虽小但对失败至关重要的纠正信号。相比之下，人类的操作是由全局运动规划以及执行过程中的持续局部调整构成的。受此启发，我们提出了 AnchorRefine，这是一个层次化框架，它将 VLA 动作建模分解为轨迹锚点和残差精细化。锚点规划器预测粗略的运动骨架，而精细化模块纠正执行层面的偏差，以提高几何和接触精度。我们进一步引入了一种决策感知的夹爪精细化机制，以更好地捕捉夹爪控制的离散性和边界敏感性。在 LIBERO、CALVIN 和真实机器人任务上的实验表明，AnchorRefine 持续改进了基于回归和基于扩散的 VLA 主干网络，在仿真中的成功率最高提升了 7.8%，在真实世界中的成功率最高提升了 18%。
AI.summary: 本文提出了AnchorRefine框架，通过将视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的动作预测解耦为粗粒度的轨迹锚点规划和细粒度的残差修正，解决了传统模型中大运动掩盖微小纠正信号的问题。配合针对夹爪的决策感知精细化机制，该方法在仿真和真实机器人实验中大幅提升了操作成功率。
AI.keywords: Vision-Language-Action Models, Trajectory Anchor, Residual Refinement, Robotic Manipulation
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于指出了现有单体式VLA模型中宏观移动与微观调整在单一优化目标下的冲突，并借鉴人类操作的控制哲学，提出了‘轨迹锚点+残差精细化’的分层解耦设计。此外，针对夹爪控制离散性和边界敏感性的改进进一步增强了接触精度。实机验证成功率提升达18%，体现了极高的实用价值和良好的通用性。

title: Blossom VI: A Practical Minimum Weight Perfect Matching Algorithm
summary: Minimum weight perfect matching is a fundamental problem in combinatorial optimization. Since 2009, Blossom V has been the leading practical implementation. We present Blossom VI, a practical algorithm that improves upon Blossom V. We test the performance of our implementation on nine benchmark families with graphs containing up to roughly 10 million edges. Blossom VI is significantly faster on the hardest tested instances, while being at most a factor of two slower on families where Blossom V already scales nearly linearly. Blossom VI is a primal-dual solver whose primal phase computes a maximum-cardinality matching in the zero-slack subgraph using cherry trees. At the end of each primal phase, Blossom VI contracts entire cherry blossoms instead of sequences of nested traditional blossoms that would be created by Blossom V. This produces shallower contraction hierarchies and avoids costly cascades of blossom expansions. Our measurements show that reduced blossom depth and fewer expensive expansion operations can explain the observed improvement.

AI.title_translation: Blossom VI：一种实用的最小权完美匹配算法
AI.tldr: Blossom VI 通过利用樱桃树收缩整个樱桃花朵，降低了花朵结构深度并减少扩展开销，显著提升了最难图实例上最小权完美匹配的求解速度。
AI.motivation: 自2009年以来，Blossom V 一直是最小权完美匹配问题的领先算法实现。为了突破 Blossom V 在处理复杂困难图时的性能瓶颈，本文提出了改进版的 Blossom VI。
AI.method: Blossom VI 是一种原始-对偶（primal-dual）求解器。在原始阶段，它使用樱桃树在零松弛子图中计算最大基数匹配。在每个原始阶段结束时，算法直接收缩整个樱桃花朵（cherry blossoms），而非 Blossom V 所采用的一系列嵌套传统花朵序列，从而构建出更浅的收缩层次结构，避免了高昂的花朵级联扩展开销。
AI.result: 在多达约1000万条边的九个基准图族上的测试表明，Blossom VI 在最困难的测试实例上求解速度显著加快；而在 Blossom V 已经能接近线性扩展的简单图族上，速度最多慢两倍。
AI.conclusion: 减少的花朵深度和更少的高成本扩展操作有效地提升了算法效率，使 Blossom VI 成为求解复杂图上最小权完美匹配的高效实用算法。
AI.translation: 最小权完美匹配是组合优化中的一个基础问题。自2009年以来，Blossom V一直是领先的实用实现。我们提出了 Blossom VI，这是一种对 Blossom V 进行改进的实用算法。我们在包含多达约1000万条边的九个基准图族上测试了我们实现的性能。Blossom VI 在最困难的测试实例上明显更快，而在 Blossom V 已经几乎线性扩展的图族上，最多慢两倍。Blossom VI 是一个原始-对偶求解器，其原始阶段使用樱桃树在零松弛子图中计算最大基数匹配。在每个原始阶段结束时，Blossom VI 收缩整个樱桃花朵，而不是像 Blossom V 那样收缩一系列嵌套的传统花朵。这产生了更浅的收缩层次结构，并避免了高成本的花朵扩展级联。我们的测量表明，减少的花朵深度和更少的高成本扩展操作可以解释所观察到的改进。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 Blossom VI 算法，对领先的最小权完美匹配求解器 Blossom V 进行了改进。通过采用基于樱桃树的原始-对偶框架并直接收缩樱桃花朵，Blossom VI 降低了花朵收缩深度并减少了级联扩展开销，在处理大规模困难图实例时展现出显著的加速效果。
AI.keywords: 最小权完美匹配, Blossom算法, 组合优化, 原始-对偶方法, 樱桃树
AI.comments: 创新性：提出了基于樱桃树（cherry trees）的樱桃花朵（cherry blossoms）直接收缩机制，取代了传统嵌套花朵序列收缩，大幅简化了数据结构的层次结构。重要性：最小权完美匹配是组合优化中的核心基础问题，Blossom VI 进一步突破了在大规模困难图实例上的计算瓶颈。局限性：在原本 Blossom V 就能近似线性扩展的简单图族上，算法性能可能有最多两倍的轻微下降。

title: Participatory provenance as representational auditing for AI-mediated public consultation
summary: AI-assisted consultation can speed large-scale public engagement, but concise summaries may reflect some submissions more closely than others. This paper introduces participatory provenance, a framework for auditing how semantic coverage is distributed from submissions to summary sentences. Applied to two topics in Canada's 2025 AI Strategy consultation (5,253 records; 2,861 participants), official summaries had higher observed mean coverage than exact-length random text, although statistical significance depended on the embedding model. Low coverage concentrated in semantic regions, especially those centered on criticism of educational technology and distrust of technology and oversight, whereas few or no records crossed the operational threshold in several better-covered regions. Same-budget, cross-fitted extractive benchmarks improved mean and lower-tail coverage on held-out submissions, showing that better semantic coverage was feasible without longer summaries. Consultation summaries should be evaluated not only for coherence and factual support, but also for how coverage is distributed across the range of submitted views.

AI.title_translation: 参与式溯源：作为AI介导公众咨询的代表性审计
AI.tldr: 本文提出了“参与式溯源”审计框架，用于评估AI公众咨询摘要的观点代表性，揭示了官方摘要容易忽略批评性意见的问题，并证明了提升语义覆盖分布公平性的可行性。
AI.motivation: 虽然人工智能辅助咨询能够加快大规模公众参与的效率，但生成的简短摘要可能偏向某些意见而忽略另一些意见，导致代表性偏差。
AI.method: 提出了“参与式溯源”（participatory provenance）框架，用于审计从提交意见到摘要句子的语义覆盖率分布；并基于加拿大2025年AI战略咨询数据集（5,253条记录，2,861名参与者），利用交叉拟合的抽取式基准模型与官方摘要进行定量对比。
AI.result: 官方摘要的平均语义覆盖率虽高于等长随机文本，但统计显著性取决于嵌入模型；低覆盖率集中在批评教育技术以及表达对技术和监管不信任的观点区域；在相同字数预算下，抽取式基准模型显著改善了对长尾（低覆盖率）观点的语义覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 评估公众咨询摘要时，不应仅关注连贯性和事实准确性，还需评估其在所有提交观点中的分布公平性。研究表明，在不增加摘要篇幅的前提下提高语义覆盖率是可行的。
AI.translation: 人工智能辅助的咨询可以加速大规模公众参与，但简短的摘要对某些提交意见的反映可能比其他意见更加密切。本文提出了“参与式溯源”（participatory provenance），这是一个用于审计语义覆盖率如何从提交意见分布到摘要句子的框架。应用于加拿大2025年AI战略咨询中的两个主题（5,253条记录；2,861名参与者）时，官方摘要的观察平均覆盖率高于等长随机文本，但统计显著性取决于嵌入模型。低覆盖率集中在特定的语义区域，特别是以对教育技术的批评以及对技术和监管的不信任为中心的区域，而在几个覆盖较好的区域中，很少或没有记录达到操作阈值。在预算相同的情况下，交叉拟合的抽取式基准在留出（held-out）提交意见上改善了平均覆盖率和下尾（低覆盖率）覆盖率，表明在不延长摘要的情况下实现更好的语义覆盖率是可行的。公众咨询摘要不仅应当根据连贯性和事实支持进行评估，还应当根据覆盖率在所提交观点的范围内的分布情况进行评估。
AI.summary: 本文针对AI辅助公众咨询摘要可能存在的代表性不均问题，提出了“参与式溯源”审计框架，用以评估摘要对公众提交意见的语义覆盖分布。通过对加拿大AI战略咨询数据的分析，揭示了官方摘要对批评性观点的覆盖不足，并证明了采用更好的抽取方法可在不延长摘要的情况下实现更公平的语义覆盖。
AI.keywords: 参与式溯源, 代表性审计, 人工智能辅助咨询, 语义覆盖率, 文本摘要
AI.comments: 本研究提出了“参与式溯源”这一创新框架，旨在解决人工智能辅助公共决策摘要中的代表性不公和观点偏见问题。研究强调了AI摘要在处理公众意见时可能忽略批评性或非主流声音（如对技术的不信任）的风险，具有很强的社会与伦理应用价值。局限性在于结果的统计显著性对具体的嵌入模型存在依赖，且实验目前仅基于单个国家的特定咨询数据集。

title: Agentic AI-assisted coding offers a unique opportunity to instill epistemic grounding during software development
summary: The capabilities of AI-assisted coding are progressing at breakneck speed. Chat-based vibe coding has evolved into fully fledged AI-assisted, agentic software development using agent scaffolds where the human developer creates a plan that agentic AIs implement. One current trend is utilizing documents beyond this plan document, such as project and method-scoped documents. Here we propose GROUNDING.md, a community-governed, field-scoped epistemic grounding document, using mass spectrometry-based proteomics as an example. We have drafted a file specific to proteomics: proteomics_GROUNDING.md (available at https://github.com/OmicsGrounding/proteomics-grounding) to demonstrate what a GROUNDING.md would look like. This explicit field-scoped grounding document encodes Hard Constraints (non-negotiable validity invariants empirically required for scientific correctness) and Convention Parameters (community-agreed defaults) that override all other contexts to enforce validity, regardless of what the user prompts. In practice, this will empower a non-domain expert to generate code, tools, and software that have best practices baked in at the ground level, providing confidence to the software developer but also to those reviewing or using the final product. Undoubtedly it is easier to have agentic AIs adhere to guidelines than humans, and this opportunity allows for organizations to develop epistemic grounding documents in such a way as to keep domain experts in the loop in a future of democratized generation of bespoke software solutions.

AI.title_translation: 代理式AI辅助编程为软件开发过程中注入认识论基础提供了独特机遇
AI.tldr: 本文提出了GROUNDING.md规范（以蛋白质组学为例），通过将特定领域的硬性科学约束和惯例注入AI代理，确保AI生成的代码严格遵循领域最佳实践。
AI.motivation: 随着代理式AI辅助编程的飞速发展，非领域专家正在广泛参与定制化软件的开发，但生成的代码常缺乏领域内的科学正确性与最佳实践保障，需要一种机制来确保AI生成的代码符合特定领域的专业规范。
AI.method: 提出了GROUNDING.md框架——一种由社区管理的特定领域认识论基准文档（并给出了蛋白质组学示例：proteomics_GROUNDING.md）。该文档编码了“硬约束”（保证科学正确性不可违背的有效性不变量）和“惯例参数”（社区共识默认值），能覆盖其他上下文并强制执行有效性。
AI.result: 成功设计并公开发布了proteomics_GROUNDING.md示例文件，证明了通过该文档能够强制AI代理生成符合领域最佳实践的代码，使非专家开发者生成的工具和软件更具可靠性，增强了开发者、评审者和用户的信心。
AI.conclusion: 让代理式AI遵守规则比人类更高效。通过开发特定领域的认识论基准文档，可以在定制化软件开发普及化的未来，确保领域专家始终参与核心规范的制定与把关。
AI.translation: AI辅助编程的能力正以惊人的速度推进。基于对话的“氛围编程”（vibe coding）已演变为使用代理脚手架的全功能AI辅助代理软件开发，其中人类开发者制定计划，由代理AI负责实施。当前的一个趋势是在计划文档之外利用更多文档，例如项目和方法作用域的文档。在此，我们以基于质谱的蛋白质组学为例，提出了GROUNDING.md——一种由社区管理的特定领域认识论基准文档。我们起草了一个专门针对蛋白质组学的文件：proteomics_GROUNDING.md（可在 https://github.com/OmicsGrounding/proteomics-grounding 获取），以展示GROUNDING.md的形态。该明确的特定领域基准文档编码了“硬约束”（经验上保证科学正确性所必需且不可谈判的有效性不变量）和“惯例参数”（社区达成共识的默认值），无论用户提示词如何，它们都会覆盖所有其他上下文以强制确保有效性。在实践中，这将使非领域专家能够生成在底层就注入了最佳实践的代码、工具和软件，不仅能给软件开发者带来信心，也能给评审或使用最终产品的人带来信心。毫无疑问，让代理AI遵守指导方针比让人类遵守更容易，这一机遇使得各组织能够开发认识论基准文档，从而在未来定制软件解决方案大众化的进程中，让领域专家始终处于开发闭环之中。
AI.summary: 本文提出了GROUNDING.md这一特定领域认识论基准文档规范，旨在解决代理式AI辅助编程中缺乏领域专业规范约束的问题。以质谱蛋白质组学为例，该方法通过在配置文件中定义科学硬约束与社区惯例参数，重写AI上下文，强制AI代理生成符合领域最佳实践的代码，从而在跨学科软件开发普及化的背景下保障代码的可靠性与科学正确性。
AI.keywords: Agentic AI, AI-assisted coding, Epistemic grounding, Proteomics, Software development
AI.comments: 创新性：该研究创造性地提出了GROUNDING.md规范，将领域特定知识（认识论基准）标准化为AI代理可强制执行的配置文件，解决了AI代码生成中缺乏领域深度与科学正确性约束的核心痛点。重要性：随着代理式AI推动软件开发的普及化，该方法为非领域专家编写高质量、符合科学规范的代码提供了可信保障，同时也为AI开发框架中的可控性和合规性提供了新思路。局限性：社区治理和维护此类特定领域的标准文档可能面临较高的组织与协调成本，且针对高度复杂或快速演进的领域编写涵盖全面的“硬约束”具备一定挑战。

title: Zero-Shot DINOv3-Based Image Matching via Many-to-Many Association
summary: We explore zero-shot image matching based on DINOv3 features. These general-purpose features are semantically rich yet geometrically ambiguous -- the nearest neighbor in feature space is often a false geometric match -- so the conventional one-to-one association paradigm is prone to discarding true correspondences. We instead retain many-to-many associations and cast the ensuing estimation as maximum-likelihood inference. This formulation reveals the existing robust mechanism for many-to-many association as a zeroth-order approximation to the otherwise intractable likelihood, and yields a novel mechanism with faster evaluation and finer granularity. We condense these theoretical findings into a two-stage LO-RANSAC algorithm which, combined with careful layer selection and positional bias correction for DINOv3 features, forms a zero-shot pipeline that degrades gracefully under background variation and across RGB-thermal pairs, where specialized baselines collapse under domain shift. Code released at https://github.com/LIAS-CUHKSZ/Zero-Shot-DINOv3-Image-Matching.

AI.title_translation: 基于多对多关联的零样本DINOv3图像匹配
AI.tldr: 本文通过将多对多关联建模为极大似然推断，结合位置偏差校正与LO-RANSAC算法，实现了基于DINOv3特征的高鲁棒性零样本跨域图像匹配。
AI.motivation: DINOv3等通用特征虽然语义信息丰富，但在几何上具有模糊性（特征空间中的最近邻常为错误的几何匹配），导致传统的一对一关联范式容易误删正确的对应关系。
AI.method: 保留多对多关联并将对应估计转化为极大似然推断问题，由此导出评估更快、粒度更细的新关联机制；结合针对DINOv3特征的层选择与位置偏差校正，集成到两阶段LO-RANSAC算法中，构建完整的零样本图像匹配管线。
AI.result: 该零样本管线在背景大幅变化以及跨RGB-热成像配对的场景下能够优雅降级并保持良好性能，而针对特定任务训练的基线模型在这些域偏移场景下严重崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 通过将通用语义特征与基于极大似然推断的多对多关联相结合，能够克服几何模糊性，显著提升零样本图像匹配在复杂环境与跨模态域偏移下的鲁棒性和准确性。
AI.translation: 我们探索了基于DINOv3特征的零样本图像匹配。这些通用特征虽然语义丰富，但在几何上存在模糊性——特征空间中的最近邻往往是错误的几何匹配——因此传统的一对一关联范式容易丢弃真实的对应关系。相反，我们保留了多对多关联，并将随后的估计建模为极大似然推断。该公式揭示了现有针对多对多关联的鲁棒机制只是对难以处理的似然函数的零阶近似，并由此产生了一种评估更快、粒度更细的新机制。我们将这些理论发现浓缩为一个两阶段LO-RANSAC算法，结合针对DINOv3特征的仔细层选择和位置偏差校正，形成了一个零样本管线，该管线在背景变化和跨RGB-热成像配对的情况下能够优雅降级，而在这些域偏移情况下专用基线模型会发生崩溃。代码已开源：https://github.com/LIAS-CUHKSZ/Zero-Shot-DINOv3-Image-Matching。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于DINOv3通用特征的零样本图像匹配方法。为解决通用特征语义丰富但几何模糊的问题，研究将匹配估计建模为多对多关联的极大似然推断，推导出了高效且细粒度的匹配新机制。结合针对DINOv3的位置偏差校正、层选择与两阶段LO-RANSAC算法，该管线在跨模态（如RGB与热成像）和复杂背景变化等域偏移场景中展现出了远超专用基线模型的鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 零样本图像匹配, DINOv3, 多对多关联, 极大似然推断, 域偏移
AI.comments: 创新性在于打破了传统一对一匹配的范式，针对DINOv3通用特征语义丰富但几何模糊的问题，引入多对多关联并将其建模为极大似然推断问题，给出了严谨的数学推导与改进机制。该方法无需训练即可在RGB-热成像等极大域偏移场景下表现出极强的泛化能力和鲁棒性，具有很高的理论与应用价值。

title: Large Language Models Explore by Latent Distilling
summary: Generating diverse responses is crucial for test-time scaling of large language models (LLMs), yet standard stochastic sampling mostly yields surface-level lexical variation, limiting semantic exploration. In this paper, we propose Exploratory Sampling (ESamp), a decoding approach that explicitly encourages semantic diversity during generation. ESamp is motivated by the well-known observation that neural networks tend to make lower-error predictions on inputs similar to those encountered before, and incur higher prediction error on novel ones. Building on this property, we train a lightweight Distiller at test time to predict deep-layer hidden representations of the LLM from its shallow-layer representations to model the LLM's depth-wise representation transitions. During decoding, the Distiller continuously adapts to the mappings induced by the current generation context. ESamp uses the prediction error as a novelty signal to reweight candidate token extensions conditioned on the current prefix, thereby biasing decoding toward less-explored semantic patterns. ESamp is implemented with an asynchronous training--inference pipeline, with less than 5% worst case overhead (1.2% in the optimized release). Empirical results show that ESamp significantly boosts the Pass@k efficiency of reasoning models, showing superior or comparable performance to strong stochastic and heuristic baselines. Notably, ESamp achieves robust generalization across mathematics, science, and code generation benchmarks and breaks the trade-off between diversity and coherence in creative writing. Our code has released at: https://github.com/LinesHogan/tLLM.

AI.title_translation: 大语言模型通过潜空间蒸馏进行探索
AI.tldr: 本文提出ESamp采样方法，利用在线训练的轻量表征蒸馏器预测误差作为新颖性信号，在极低开销下大幅提升LLM生成过程中的语义多样性与推理效率。
AI.motivation: 标准的随机采样主要产生表面词汇变化而缺乏深层语义探索，限制了大语言模型在测试时扩展（Test-Time Scaling）的表现。需要一种能显式鼓励语义多样性的解码机制。
AI.method: 提出了探索性采样（ESamp）。该方法在测试阶段在线训练一个轻量化蒸馏器（Distiller），利用LLM浅层隐藏表征预测深层隐藏表征。解码过程中将蒸馏器的预测误差作为新颖性信号，重新加权候选Token的分布，引导解码偏向探索较少的语义模式。实现上采用了异步训练与推理流水线。
AI.result: ESamp显著提升了推理模型的Pass@k效率，在数学、科学和代码生成等基准测试中表现优异，并在创意写作中打破了多样性与连贯性之间的权衡。优化后的运行开销仅为1.2%。
AI.conclusion: ESamp是一种高效且泛化性强的探索性解码采样策略，能够在几乎不增加计算负担的前提下显著提升LLM的语义探索能力与测试时扩展效率。
AI.translation: 生成多样化的响应对于大语言模型（LLM）的测试时扩展至关重要，然而标准的随机采样大多仅产生表面词汇的变化，限制了语义探索。在本文中，我们提出了探索性采样（ESamp），一种在生成过程中显式鼓励语义多样性的解码方法。ESamp的灵感来自于一个著名观察：神经网络倾向于对与之前遇到的相似输入做出较低误差的预测，而对新颖输入产生较高的预测误差。基于这一特性，我们在测试时训练一个轻量级蒸馏器（Distiller），通过LLM的浅层隐藏表征来预测其深层隐藏表征，从而建模LLM深度方向的表征转换。在解码过程中，蒸馏器不断适应由当前生成上下文引导的映射。ESamp将预测误差用作新颖性信号，对基于当前前缀的候选Token扩展进行重加权，从而使解码偏向较少探索的语义模式。ESamp采用异步训练-推理流水线实现，最坏情况下的额外开销低于5%（优化版本中为1.2%）。实证结果表明，ESamp显著提升了推理模型的Pass@k效率，在强随机和启发式基线面前表现出优异或相当的性能。值得注意的是，ESamp在数学、科学和代码生成基准测试中实现了鲁棒的泛化，并打破了创意写作中多样性与连贯性之间的权衡。我们的代码已开源。
AI.summary: 针对LLM随机采样缺乏语义多样性的问题，本文提出了探索性采样（ESamp）。ESamp通过在测试阶段在线训练轻量级表征蒸馏器，将浅层至深层的预测误差作为新颖性信号来调整Token选择，从而促进深度语义探索。实验表明该方法以极低的计算开销显著提升了Pass@k性能及生成质量。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 探索性采样, 潜空间蒸馏, 语义多样性, 测试时扩展
AI.comments: 本文创新性地将“预测误差反映新颖性”这一认知机制巧妙应用于LLM测试阶段的解码采样中。通过浅层到深层表征的在线蒸馏，无需修改原模型权重，就能以极低（1.2%）的计算开销实现深层语义维度的有效探索，打破了多样性与连贯性的权衡，对LLM测试时扩展（Test-Time Scaling）具有显著的实用价值。

title: Lifting Embodied World Models for Planning and Control
comments: Accepted to ECCV2026. Edited policy masking
summary: World models of embodied agents predict future observations conditioned on an action taken by the agent. For complex embodiments, action spaces are high-dimensional and difficult to specify: for example, precisely controlling a human agent requires specifying the motion of each joint. This makes the world model hard to control and expensive to plan with as search-based methods like CEM scale poorly with action dimensionality. To address this issue, we train a lightweight policy that maps high-level actions to sequences of low-level joint actions. Composing this policy with the frozen world model produces a lifted world model that predicts a sequence of future observations from a single high-level action. We instantiate this framework for a human-like embodiment, defining the high-level action space as a small set of 2D waypoints annotated on the current observation frame, each specifying a near-term goal position for a leaf joint (pelvis, head, hands). Waypoints are low-dimensional, visually interpretable, and easy to specify manually or to search over. We show that the lifted world model substantially outperforms searching directly in low-level joint space ($3.8\times$ lower mean joint error to the goal pose), while remaining more compute-efficient and generalizing to environments unseen by the policy.
comment: Accepted to ECCV2026. Edited policy masking

AI.title_translation: 提升具身世界模型用于规划与控制
AI.tldr: 通过引入轻量策略将低维视觉航向点映射为低阶关节动作，本文构建了“提升世界模型”，大幅降低了高维具身智能体规划与控制的计算开销和控制误差。
AI.motivation: 对于人形等复杂具身智能体，动作空间高维且难以指定，导致世界模型难以控制，且使用CEM等基于搜索的规划方法时计算开销极其昂贵、扩展性差。
AI.method: 训练一个轻量级策略，将高阶动作（在当前观察帧上标注的末端关节如骨盆、头部、手部的2D目标航向点）映射为低阶关节动作序列；再将该策略与冻结的世界模型组合，构成“提升世界模型”（lifted world model），从而仅凭单一高阶动作即可预测未来的观察序列。
AI.result: 在人形具身形态上的实验表明，相比直接在低阶关节空间中搜索，提升世界模型到达目标姿态的平均关节误差降低了3.8倍，计算效率更高，且能够有效泛化至策略未见过的全新环境。
AI.conclusion: 通过将低维高阶动作映射策略与冻结的世界模型结合构建“提升世界模型”，能够克服高维动作空间导致的搜索规划难题，实现高效、精确且具备良好泛化能力的人形具身控制。
AI.translation: 具身智能体的世界模型会根据智能体采取的动作来预测未来的观察结果。对于复杂的具身形态，动作空间是高维且难以指定的：例如，精确控制一个人形智能体需要指定每个关节的运动。这使得世界模型难以控制，且规划开销昂贵，因为像CEM这样基于搜索的方法在动作维度增加时扩展性很差。为了解决这个问题，我们训练了一个轻量级策略，将高阶动作映射为低阶关节动作序列。将该策略与冻结的世界模型相结合，产生了一个“提升世界模型”，能够从单个高阶动作预测未来的观察序列。我们在一个人形具身形态上实例化了这个框架，将高阶动作空间定义为在当前观察帧上标注的一组少量2D航向点，每个航向点指定末端关节（骨盆、头部、手部）的近期目标位置。航向点是低维的、视觉上可解释的，并且易于手动指定或进行搜索。我们表明，提升世界模型显著优于直接在低阶关节空间中搜索（到达目标姿态的平均关节误差降低了3.8倍），同时保持更高计算效率，并能泛化到策略未见过的环境。
AI.summary: 本文提出了针对复杂具身智能体的“提升世界模型”框架。该方法通过轻量级策略将高阶视觉航向点（2D目标点）转换为低阶关节动作序列，并与冻结的世界模型组合，实现了在低维空间内的高效规划与控制，显著降低了控制误差并提高了计算效率。
AI.keywords: 具身世界模型, 轨迹规划, 高维控制, 人形智能体, 动作抽象
AI.comments:
1. 创新性：提出了“提升世界模型”（Lifted World Model）框架，巧妙地利用轻量级策略将高维低阶关节控制抽象为低维可解释的2D视觉航向点，有效解决了复杂具身规划中的维度灾难问题。
2. 重要性：显著提升了高维具身智能体（如人形机器人）在控制与规划中的计算效率与控制精度，为复杂机器人的高效规划提供了新思路。
3. 局限性：高阶动作空间依赖于末端关节（如手、头、骨盆）的2D航向点设定，对于需要极高局部精细操作或接触力控制的任务，其表达能力可能受到一定限制。

title: Length Value Model: Scalable Value Pretraining for Token-Level Length Modeling
summary: Tokens are the fundamental units of computation in modern autoregressive models, and generation length directly influences both inference cost and reasoning performance. Despite its importance, existing approaches model length primarily at the coarse sequence level. We introduce the Length Value Model (LenVM), a token-level framework that estimates the remaining generation length at every decoding step. By formulating length modeling as a value estimation problem and assigning a constant negative reward to each generated token, LenVM predicts a bounded, discounted return that is a monotone proxy for the remaining generation horizon. This value formulation provides annotation-free, dense, unbiased, and scalable supervision. Experiments on LLMs and VLMs show that LenVM supports exact control, continuous performance--efficiency steering, length prediction, and interpretation. On LIFEBench-token, it raises the exact-length score of Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct from $30.9$ to $64.8$ in one pass and reaches $83.6$ when combined with LCG. Near $200$ tokens on GSM8K, LenVM retains about $63\%$ Pass@1 versus $6\%$ under a hard token budget. Across other settings, LenVM improves matched-length quality over prompting and EOS calibration, while its length-prediction accuracy improves with scale and exceeds specialized predictors. Its token-level values also identify markers of shifts between longer and shorter trajectories. These results establish generation length as an effective scalable token-level value signal for control, prediction, and future value-based training.

AI.title_translation: 长度价值模型：面向 Token 级别长度建模的可扩展价值预训练
AI.tldr: 提出了 Length Value Model (LenVM)，将长度建模转化为 Token 级价值估计，实现了无标注、密集的剩余长度预测与精确控制。
AI.motivation: 生成长度直接决定了自回归大模型的推理成本与推理性能，但现有的长度建模方法多集中在粗粒度的序列级别，缺乏 Token 级别的精准控制、预测与可解释手段。
AI.method: 提出 Length Value Model (LenVM) 框架，将长度建模转化为 Token 级别的价值估计问题。通过在每个解码步骤为生成的 token 分配恒定的负奖励，LenVM 能够预测一个有界且折扣的累积回报，作为剩余生成步长的单调代理指标，从而获得密集、无标注、无偏且可扩展的监督信号。
AI.result: 在 LIFEBench-token 上，LenVM 单次运行将 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 的精确长度控制得分从 30.9 提升至 64.8（结合 LCG 可达 83.6）；在 GSM8K 约 200 个 token 的预算限制下，LenVM 保持了 63% 的 Pass@1（硬截断限制下仅为 6%）；此外，其长度预测准确率超越了专门的预测器，并且 Token 级别的价值能够识别轨迹转换的特征标识。
AI.conclusion: 生成长度可以作为一种有效且可扩展的 Token 级别的价值信号，成功用于精准控制、长度预测、性能与效率的连续调节以及未来的价值预训练。
AI.translation: Token 是现代自回归模型中计算的基本单位，生成长度直接影响推理成本和推理性能。尽管其非常重要，现有的方法主要在粗粒度的序列级别上对长度建模。我们提出了长度价值模型（Length Value Model，LenVM），这是一个 Token 级别的框架，可以在每个解码步骤中估计剩余的生成长度。通过将长度建模公式化为价值估计问题，并为每个生成的 Token 分配恒定的负奖励，LenVM 能够预测一个有界且折扣的累积回报，该回报是剩余生成步长的单调代理指标。这种价值公式化提供了无需标注、密集、无偏且可扩展的监督。在大语言模型（LLM）和视觉语言模型（VLM）上的实验表明，LenVM 支持精确控制、连续的性能-效率协同调节、长度预测和可解释性。在 LIFEBench-token 上，它在单次运行中将 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 的精确长度得分从 30.9 提高到 64.8，在与 LCG 结合时达到 83.6。在 GSM8K 上接近 200 个 Token 的预算下，LenVM 保持了约 63% 的 Pass@1，而在硬 Token 预算下仅为 6%。在其他设置中，LenVM 在匹配长度下的生成质量优于 Prompting 和 EOS 校准，同时其长度预测准确率随规模扩大而提高，并超越了专门的预测器。其 Token 级别的价值还可以识别更长和更短轨迹之间转变的标志。这些结果表明生成长度是一种用于控制、预测和未来基于价值的训练的有效且可扩展的 Token 级别价值信号。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 Length Value Model (LenVM)，通过将生成长度建模公式化为 Token 级别的价值估计任务，为自回归模型提供了密集、无标注且无偏的价值监督信号。LenVM 在精确长度控制、性能-效率连续调节以及长度预测等任务上均取得了显著优于传统方法（如 Prompting 或 EOS 校准）的效果，展示了将生成长度作为标量价值信号用于强化学习和预训练的巨大潜力。
AI.keywords: Length Modeling, Value Estimation, Token-level Control, Autoregressive Models, Efficiency Steering
AI.comments:
创新性：将生成长度建模巧妙地构想为强化学习中的 Token 级价值估计问题（每生成一个 token 赋予恒定负奖励），无需额外人工标注即可获得密集且无偏的监督信号。
重要性：解决了大模型实际落地中关于推理成本与推理性能（如 CoT 长度）难以精确平衡的痛点，显著提升了生成长度控制精度及预算受限下的模型推理表现。
局限性：尽管能提供连续的效率-性能控制，但在极短生成长度强约束下，模型内部思维链推理能力仍可能受到物理长度上限的潜在限制。

title: Sim-FA: A GPGPU Simulator Framework for Fine-Grained Asynchronous Pipeline Analysis
comments: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary:
To efficiently support Large Language Models (LLMs), modern GPGPU architectures have introduced new features and programming paradigms, such as warp specialization. These features enable temporal overlap between the producer and consumer, as well as between matrix multiplication and activation function operations, substantially improving performance. To conduct effective AI infrastructure and computer architecture research, cycle-accurate simulators that support these new features, together with analytical models that faithfully capture workload characteristics, are essential.
  However, existing academic tools provide limited support for these emerging requirements. Existing cycle-accurate simulators do not incorporate new NVIDIA GPU features, such as the Tensor Memory Accelerator (TMA), in a timely manner. Moreover, existing analytical models can misestimate DRAM traffic under certain configurations.
  In this paper, we build Sim-FA, a cycle-accurate simulation framework for Hopper TMA/WGMMA pipelines. We first develop an operator-agnostic trace frontend that instruments kernels at the Triton TTGIR level and validates it on 23 GEMM shapes, achieving 5.49\% MAPE against H800, confirming that the simulator core is not tied to any single operator. Because FlashAttention-3 introduces additional complexity beyond standard TMA/WGMMA kernels (asymmetric producer-consumer pipelines, softmax, ping-pong synchronization), we further build an FA3-specialized frontend that achieves 5.7\% MAPE with a maximum error of 12.7\%. Within the same framework, SimFA-python serves as an analytical fast path for large-scale design-space exploration where cycle-accurate simulation is prohibitively slow; validated against cuTile kernels on Blackwell (GB10), it explains why existing analytical models can produce inaccurate traffic estimates.

AI.title_translation: Sim-FA：一种用于细粒度异步流水线分析的GPGPU模拟器框架
AI.tldr: Sim-FA是一个周期精确的GPGPU模拟器框架，用于分析Hopper TMA/WGMMA流水线，并支持FlashAttention-3，同时提供一个快速分析路径，解决了现有工具对新兴GPGPU特性支持不足以及DRAM流量估算不准确的问题。
AI.motivation: 为了高效支持大型语言模型（LLMs），现代GPGPU架构引入了新的特性和编程范式（如warp specialization），显著提高了性能。然而，现有的学术工具对这些新兴需求的支持有限，例如现有周期精确模拟器未能及时整合NVIDIA GPU新特性（如Tensor Memory Accelerator, TMA），且现有分析模型在某些配置下可能错误估计DRAM流量。因此，需要支持这些新特性的周期精确模拟器和能准确捕捉工作负载特征的分析模型。
AI.method: 本文构建了Sim-FA，一个用于Hopper TMA/WGMMA流水线的周期精确模拟框架。首先，开发了一个与操作符无关的跟踪前端，在Triton TTGIR级别检测内核，并在23个GEMM形状上进行验证。其次，由于FlashAttention-3引入了标准TMA/WGMMA内核之外的复杂性（非对称生产者-消费者流水线、softmax、ping-pong同步），进一步构建了一个FA3专用前端。最后，在同一框架内，SimFA-python作为一个分析快速路径，用于大规模设计空间探索，并针对Blackwell（GB10）上的cuTile内核进行了验证。
AI.result: 与操作符无关的跟踪前端在23个GEMM形状上对H800的MAPE为5.49%。FA3专用前端的MAPE为5.7%，最大误差为12.7%。SimFA-python在Blackwell（GB10）上针对cuTile内核的验证解释了为什么现有分析模型会产生不准确的流量估计。
AI.conclusion: Sim-FA框架成功地提供了一个周期精确的模拟器，支持Hopper TMA/WGMMA流水线和FlashAttention-3等新兴GPGPU特性，并通过其分析快速路径解决了现有工具在支持新特性和DRAM流量估算方面的不足，为AI基础设施和计算机架构研究提供了重要工具。
AI.translation:
为了高效支持大型语言模型（LLMs），现代GPGPU架构引入了新的特性和编程范式，例如warp specialization。这些特性实现了生产者和消费者之间以及矩阵乘法和激活函数操作之间的时间重叠，从而大幅提高了性能。为了进行有效的AI基础设施和计算机架构研究，支持这些新特性的周期精确模拟器以及能忠实捕捉工作负载特征的分析模型至关重要。
然而，现有学术工具对这些新兴需求的支持有限。现有周期精确模拟器未能及时整合NVIDIA GPU新特性，例如Tensor Memory Accelerator（TMA）。此外，现有分析模型在某些配置下可能错误估计DRAM流量。
在本文中，我们构建了Sim-FA，一个用于Hopper TMA/WGMMA流水线的周期精确模拟框架。我们首先开发了一个与操作符无关的跟踪前端，在Triton TTGIR级别检测内核，并在23个GEMM形状上进行验证，对H800的MAPE为5.49%，证实了模拟器核心不依赖于任何单一操作符。由于FlashAttention-3引入了标准TMA/WGMMA内核之外的额外复杂性（非对称生产者-消费者流水线、softmax、ping-pong同步），我们进一步构建了一个FA3专用前端，实现了5.7%的MAPE，最大误差为12.7%。在同一框架内，SimFA-python作为一个分析快速路径，用于大规模设计空间探索，因为周期精确模拟速度过慢；针对Blackwell（GB10）上的cuTile内核进行验证后，它解释了为什么现有分析模型会产生不准确的流量估计。
AI.summary: Sim-FA是一个针对Hopper TMA/WGMMA流水线的周期精确GPGPU模拟器框架，旨在解决现有工具在支持LLM相关的新兴GPGPU特性（如TMA、WGMMA）以及DRAM流量估算不准确的问题。该框架包含一个与操作符无关的跟踪前端，验证了其核心的通用性，并为FlashAttention-3等复杂内核提供了专用前端。此外，Sim-FA还集成了SimFA-python作为快速分析路径，用于大规模设计空间探索，并能解释现有分析模型在流量估算上的误差。其验证结果表明了其在准确性和实用性方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: GPGPU模拟器, 周期精确模拟, TMA, WGMMA, FlashAttention-3
AI.comments: 本文提出的Sim-FA框架，通过提供一个周期精确的GPGPU模拟器，填补了现有工具在支持现代GPGPU架构新兴特性（如TMA、WGMMA）方面的空白，这对于LLM等高性能计算至关重要。其创新点在于结合了操作符无关的跟踪前端和针对特定复杂工作负载（如FlashAttention-3）的专用前端，确保了模拟器的通用性和准确性。同时，引入SimFA-python作为快速分析路径，有效解决了周期精确模拟在大规模设计空间探索中的效率问题，这对于AI基础设施和计算机架构研究具有重要意义。该工作不仅提升了模拟的准确性，还为深入理解和优化GPGPU性能提供了强大的工具。

title: VOFA: Visual Object Goal Pushing with Force-Adaptive Control for Humanoids
comments: Accepted at IROS 2026. Project website: https://amrl.cs.utexas.edu/VOFA
summary: The ability to push large objects in a goal-directed manner using onboard egocentric perception is an essential skill for humanoid robots to perform complex tasks such as material handling in warehouses. To robustly manipulate heavy objects to arbitrary goal configurations, the robot must cope with unknown object mass and ground friction, noisy onboard perception, and actuation errors; all in a real-time feedback loop. Existing solutions either rely on privileged object-state information without onboard perception or lack robustness to variations in goal configurations and object physical properties. In this work, we present VOFA, a visual goal-conditioned humanoid loco-manipulation system capable of pushing objects with unknown physical properties to arbitrary goal positions. VOFA consists of a two-level hierarchical architecture with a high-level visuomotor policy and a low-level force-adaptive whole-body controller. The high-level policy processes noisy onboard observations and generates goal-conditioned commands to operate in closed loop across diverse object-goal configurations, while the low-level whole-body controller provides robustness to variations in object physical properties. VOFA is extensively evaluated in both simulation and real-world experiments on the Booster T1 humanoid robot. Our results demonstrate strong performance, achieving over 90% success in simulation and over 80% success in real-world trials. Moreover, VOFA successfully pushes objects weighing up to 17kg, exceeding half of the Booster T1's body weight.

AI.title_translation: VOFA：基于力适应控制的人形机器人视觉目标物体推移
AI.tldr: VOFA通过高层视觉运动策略与低层力自适应全身控制的分层架构，使人形机器人能仅凭机载感知将未知物理属性的重物推至指定目标位置。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人在推移重物时面临未知物体质量、地面摩擦、机载感知噪声及执行误差等挑战，而现有方法要么依赖特权状态信息，要么对目标配置和物体物理属性的变化缺乏鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出包含两层分层架构的VOFA系统：高层视觉运动策略处理带噪机载观测并生成闭环目标指令；低层力自适应全身控制器用于适应物体质量和摩擦力等物理特性的变化。
AI.result: 在仿真和Booster T1人形机器人的实机实验中，仿真成功率超过90%，实机成功率超过80%，并成功推动重达17kg（超过机器人体重一半）的物体。
AI.conclusion: VOFA系统成功实现了仅依靠机载视觉感知和力自适应控制，使人形机器人能够鲁棒地将未知物理特性的重物推送到任意指定目标位置。
AI.translation: 使用机载自心感知以目标导向的方式推动大型物体，是人形机器人执行仓库物料搬运等复杂任务的关键技能。为了将重物鲁棒地操作到任意目标配置，机器人必须在实时反馈循环中应对未知的物体质量和地面摩擦、带噪的机载感知以及执行误差。现有的解决方案要么依赖没有机载感知的特权物体状态信息，要么缺乏对目标配置和物体物理特性变化的鲁棒性。在这项工作中，我们提出了VOFA，一种视觉目标条件化的人形机器人全身操纵系统，能够将具有未知物理特性的物体推送到任意目标位置。VOFA包含一个两层分层架构，由高层视觉运动策略和低层力自适应全身控制器组成。高层策略处理带噪的机载观测，并生成目标条件指令，以在不同物体-目标配置间实现闭环运行；而低层全身控制器则对物体物理特性的变化提供鲁棒性。VOFA在仿真以及Booster T1人形机器人实机实验中进行了广泛评估。我们的结果展示出强劲的性能，在仿真中实现了超过90%的成功率，在实机试验中实现了超过80%的成功率。此外，VOFA成功推动了重达17kg的物体，超过了Booster T1体重的半数。
AI.summary: 本文提出了VOFA系统，通过高层视觉运动策略与低层力自适应全身控制器的分层结合，使人形机器人能够仅利用机载感知，鲁棒地将未知物理属性的重物推移至任意目标位置，并在实机实验中验证了其出色的成功率和负载能力。
AI.keywords: 人形机器人, 视觉运动策略, 目标推移, 力自适应控制, 全身控制
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将高层视觉闭环运动策略与低层力自适应全身控制相结合，有效克服了感知噪声与物理参数不确定的双重挑战；在实机上展现了极强的负载推移能力（推重达体重的50%以上）。局限性在于摘要未提及面对复杂障碍物环境时的避障与规划能力。

title: A Low-Frequency, Autoresonant Wireless Power Transfer Link for Bidirectional Bionic Interfaces
comments: This is a peer-reviewed version of an article accepted for presentation at the 8th International Conference on Smart Applications, Communications and Networking (IEEE SmartNets 2026) conference, to be held in Rome, Italy
summary: To provide multimode sensory feedback and motion control, bidirectional bionic interfaces for advanced prosthetic systems require continuous and secure energy delivery to implantable electronics and integration in the sensing WBAN (Wireless Body Area Network) of the patient. However, powering such interfaces is still an open issue. Wireless Power Transfer (WPT) avoids implanted batteries and transcutaneous connections, but its design is constrained by stringent requirements on electromagnetic safety, implant size, voltage compliance, and coexistence with sensitive bio-signal acquisition and stimulation circuitry. This paper presents the design and testing of a low-frequency (127 kHz) inductive WPT link for an implantable bidirectional bionic interface. The system includes an autoresonant driving control to maintain operation at resonance under varying coupling and load conditions of the cyber-physical prosthesis. Starting from the requirements of the bionic interface, the wireless body-area sensing system is designed by selecting the working frequency, drawing the electrical schemes, and checking its safety and regulatory compliance. Preliminary WPT prototypes can provide up to ~140 mA and ~20 V, achieving a maximum power transfer efficiency higher than 40% and satisfying the project requirements up to a 2 cm implantation depth.
