AI.title_translation: 无细胞大规模MIMO系统中基于ADMM的低复杂度多播波束赋形
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于ADMM的低复杂度求解框架，用于无细胞大规模MIMO网络中的多播波束赋形，能高效获得近全局最优的秩一解并具备良好的扩展性。
AI.motivation: 物理层多播在无细胞大规模MIMO中虽能提高频谱效率，但其核心的最大化最小公平性（MMF）和服务质量（QoS）波束赋形优化问题因非凸约束和秩一条件而属于NP-hard问题。传统SDR后接随机化方法随规模扩展性差，而现有的逐次凸近似（SCA）方法容易陷于局部驻点，因此需要一种高效率且可扩展的求解算法。
AI.method: 提出了一个基于交替方向乘子法（ADMM）的优化框架，在结合半正定松弛（SDR）的基础上，于ADMM迭代更新中引入了一种新型迭代消除策略，从而能够以较低的计算复杂度高效提取近全局最优的秩一波束赋形解。
AI.result: 数值评估表明，与标准SDP求解器、随机化方法以及最先进的基于SCA的算法相比，所提ADMM方法不仅实现了更优异的频谱效率，而且在天线和用户数量增加时表现出良好的可扩展性与更低的计算复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 所提ADMM框架为下一代大规模多播通信系统提供了一个兼具卓越频谱效率与高扩展性的低复杂度实用解决方案。
AI.translation: 对将公共内容高效传输给多个用户设备（UE）的日益增长的需求，推动了物理层多播技术的显著研究。通过利用大规模MIMO的波束赋形能力，多播提供了一种避免组内不必要干扰的高频谱效率解决方案。然而，一个关键挑战是解决最大化最小公平性（MMF）和服务质量（QoS）多播波束赋形优化问题，由于非凸结构和对秩一解的要求，这些问题属于NP-hard问题。基于半正定松弛（SDR）后接随机化的传统方法随系统规模的扩展性较差，而最先进的逐次凸近似（SCA）方法仅能保证收敛到驻点。在本文中，我们提出了用于无细胞大规模MIMO网络中MMF和QoS多播波束赋形的基于交替方向乘子法（ADMM）的框架。该算法利用了SDR，但在ADMM更新中结合了一种新型迭代消除策略，与标准SDP求解器和随机化方法相比，能够以降低的计算复杂度高效获得近全局最优的秩一波束赋形解。数值评估表明，与最先进的基于SCA的算法相比，所提出的基于ADMM的流程不仅实现了卓越的频谱效率，而且随天线和UE数量的增加表现出良好的扩展性，使其成为下一代多播系统的实用工具。
AI.summary: 针对无细胞大规模MIMO网络中多播波束赋形优化（MMF与QoS）因非凸和秩一约束导致的求解难题，本文提出了一种基于ADMM的低复杂度算法框架。该算法利用SDR并结合新型迭代消除策略，实现了比传统SDR/随机化方法和SCA算法更优的近全局最优解获取能力及系统可扩展性。
AI.keywords: 无细胞大规模MIMO, 多播波束赋形, 交替方向乘子法, 半正定松弛, 频谱效率
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将ADMM框架与新型迭代消除策略相结合，有效解决了传统SDR方法在规模扩大时复杂度过高以及SCA算法易陷入局部驻点的问题。该方法在保证近全局最优秩一解性能的同时显著降低了计算复杂度，对下一代无细胞大规模MIMO系统中的高效多播传输具有重要的工程实用价值。

title: Fixed-phase Resonance Tracking for Fast Nonlinear Resonant Ultrasound Spectroscopy
summary: Nonlinear Resonant Ultrasound Spectroscopy (NRUS) experiments that rely on repeated sampling of resonance curves are inherently sensitive to measurement protocol due to evolution of material parameters caused by fast and slow dynamic effects. We introduce a model-assisted discrete-time resonance tracking method that maintains a system at its instantaneous resonance condition without the need to acquire full frequency sweeps. Resonance is defined through a prescribed phase relation between excitation and response, and the excitation frequency is iteratively updated using a linearized frequency--phase model. The procedure allows controlled suppression of transient wave buildup using optional feedforward correction with respect to an external control parameter. The method is demonstrated on NRUS and performing a conditioning-relaxation protocol, both conducted on a sandstone bar, providing estimates of resonance frequency and damping. Comparison with conventional approaches shows that measurement speed and mode stability significantly influence the inferred nonlinear indicators. The proposed framework is not limited to nonlinear acoustics and can be applied to arbitrary resonant systems with slowly evolving parameters.

AI.title_translation: 用于快速非线性谐振超声光谱的固定相位谐振跟踪
AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于模型辅助和固定相位的离散时间谐振跟踪方法，无需全频率扫描即可实时锁定瞬时谐振状态，大幅提升了非线性超声表征的速度与稳定性。
AI.motivation: 依赖重复频率扫描的传统非线性谐振超声光谱（NRUS）实验，由于快慢动态效应引起的材料参数演变，对测量协议高度敏感。因此需要一种无需完整频率扫描即可实时维持系统瞬时谐振状态的方法。
AI.method: 提出一种模型辅助的离散时间谐振跟踪方法。根据激励与响应之间预设的相位关系来定义谐振，利用线性化的频率-相位模型迭代更新激励频率；同时可选用基于外部控制参数的前馈修正，以控制和抑制瞬态波积累。
AI.result: 在砂岩棒上的NRUS及“状态调节-松弛”实验中验证了该方法，成功估计了瞬时谐振频率和阻尼。与传统方法对比表明，测量速度和模式稳定性对推断出的非线性指标具有显著影响。
AI.conclusion: 该离散时间谐振跟踪框架能够显著提高测量速度和模式稳定性，克服传统频率扫描的局限，且不仅限于非线性声学，还可广泛应用于参数缓慢演化的任意谐振系统。
AI.translation: 依赖于重复采样谐振曲线的非线性谐振超声光谱（NRUS）实验，由于快和慢动态效应引起的材料参数演变，本质上对测量协议非常敏感。我们引入了一种模型辅助的离散时间谐振跟踪方法，该方法无需获取完整的频率扫描即可将系统维持在其瞬时谐振条件。谐振通过激励与响应之间预设的相位关系来定义，并且使用线性化的频率-相位模型迭代更新激励频率。该过程允许使用针对外部控制参数的可选前馈修正来有控制地抑制瞬态波积累。该方法在砂岩棒上进行的NRUS和状态调节-松弛协议中得到了示范，提供了谐振频率和阻尼的估计。与传统方法的比较表明，测量速度和模式稳定性显著影响推断出的非线性指标。所提出的框架不仅限于非线性声学，还可以应用于具有缓慢演变参数的任意谐振系统。
AI.summary: 本文针对传统非线性谐振超声光谱（NRUS）因频扫速度慢而易受快慢动态效应干扰的问题，提出了一种固定相位的离散时间谐振跟踪方法。该方法通过线性化频率-相位模型迭代更新激励频率，免去了全频率扫描过程，实现了快速、稳定的瞬时谐振跟踪与参数估计。
AI.keywords: 非线性谐振超声光谱 (NRUS), 谐振跟踪, 固定相位, 动态效应, 频率-相位模型
AI.comments: 创新性：通过固定相位关系定义谐振并结合线性化频率-相位模型迭代跟踪，摆脱了传统NRUS对完整频率扫描的依赖，极大地提升了测量速度。实用性：能有效应对快慢动态效应带来的材料参数演变，且具备推广至其他慢演化谐振系统的泛化能力。局限性：实验仅在砂岩棒上进行了验证，在更复杂几何形状或极强非线性/高噪声环境下的稳健性仍有待进一步探讨。

title: Multi-Objective Adaptive Beamforming Using Partial Knowledge of Dynamic Dielectric Media for Non-Invasive Microwave Hyperthermia
summary: We investigate multi-objective adaptive beamformer design strategies for non-invasive microwave hyperthermia. Our focus is to address the challenges of maintaining focused power deposition in desired locations while reducing unwanted heating elsewhere under conditions of changing dielectric properties. The process of heating the media causes changes in the dielectric properties of the media, which can degrade the effectiveness beamformers with static weights. Typical hyperthermic beamformer designs calculate antenna beamforming weights using patient-specific high resolution dielectric maps obtained by MRI or microwave tomography, however this process is time consuming and difficult to perform in real-time. In this work, we explore the efficacy of microwave hyperthermia in various inhomogeneous media under changing dielectric conditions, with the goal of informing the design of future adaptive real-time microwave hyperthermia techniques. We aim to achieve cell apoptosis by obtaining temperatures of $\sim$ 45 $^\circ\text{C}$ through selective absorption of electromagnetic wave focusing at a 2.5 GHz carrier frequency with little to no knowledge of the changes in the dielectric media and simultaneously place nulls to avoid unwanted heating outside of the treatment zone. We investigate the effectiveness of the linear constrained minimum power (LCMP) algorithm for near-field multi-objective beamforming and examine the power density obtained from finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) simulations on simple analytical models and anatomically realistic numerical breast phantoms. To gain a comprehensive knowledge of the efficacy of the beamformer we evaluate the resulting thermal maps of the models in simple homogeneous cases, heterogeneous cases and MRI-derived phantom breast models.

AI.title_translation: 基于动态介电介质局部知识的无创微波热疗多目标自适应波束形成
AI.tldr: 利用LCMP近场自适应波束形成算法，在缺乏完整介电参数知识且介质动态变化的情况下，实现了无创微波热疗中的靶区选择性聚焦加热与非靶区抑制。
AI.motivation: 微波热疗过程中，组织加热会导致介电特性发生改变，使静态权重的波束形成器性能下降；而通过MRI或微波层析成像获取实时高分辨率介电图既耗时又难以实时完成，因此需要探索在缺乏完整介电知识且介质动态变化时仍能保持精准加热的自适应波束成形策略。
AI.method: 针对2.5 GHz载波频率，研究了近场多目标线性约束最小功率（LCMP）波束形成算法。利用时域有限差分（FDTD）仿真，在简单均匀模型、非均匀模型以及基于MRI的解剖学真实乳腺数值模型中对功率密度和热图进行了模拟与评估。
AI.result: 评估了简单均匀介质、非均匀介质及MRI衍生乳腺模型中的功率密度与热图，证实了在介电知识极其有限且介质动态变化的情况下，波束形成器仍能在靶区实现选择性电磁波聚焦加热（达到约45 °C以诱导细胞凋亡），同时在非治疗区成功形成零陷以避免不必要的损伤。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明利用LCMP近场多目标自适应波束形成算法，即使在仅有局部/极少介质变化知识的情况下，也能有效应对动态介电环境带来的性能退化，为未来实时自适应微波热疗系统的设计提供了可行性参考。
AI.translation: 我们研究了用于无创微波热疗的多目标自适应波束形成器设计策略。本研究的重点在于解决在介电特性发生变化的条件下，如何在减少其他区域不必要加热的同时，保持对预期位置的聚焦功率沉积。加热介质的过程会导致介质的介电特性发生改变，这可能会降低静态权重波束形成器的有效性。典型的热疗波束形成器设计是使用通过MRI或微波层析成像获得的患者特定高分辨率介电图来计算天线波束形成权重，然而该过程非常耗时且难以实时进行。在这项工作中，我们探索了在介电条件变化的各种非均匀介质中微波热疗的功效，旨在为未来实时自适应微波热疗技术的设计提供参考。我们的目标是在几乎或完全不知道介电介质变化的情况下，通过在2.5 GHz载波频率下选择性吸收电磁波聚焦来达到约45 °C的温度以实现细胞凋亡，同时设置零陷以避免治疗区域之外的不必要加热。我们研究了线性约束最小功率（LCMP）算法在近场多目标波束形成中的有效性，并检查了在简单分析模型和解剖学真实的数值乳腺模型上通过时域有限差分（FDTD）仿真获得的功率密度。为了全面了解波束形成器的功效，我们评估了模型在简单均匀情况、非均匀情况和MRI衍生乳腺模型中的最终热图。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了用于无创微波热疗的多目标自适应波束形成策略。针对加热过程中组织介电特性动态变化导致静态波束形成器失效、且实时高精度介电图获取困难的问题，研究利用LCMP算法在2.5 GHz频率下进行近场波束控制。通过FDTD仿真并在均匀、非均匀及MRI生成的乳腺模型上评估热图，验证了在知识有限的动态介电介质中实现靶区精准加热（约45 °C）与非靶区抑制的可行性。
AI.keywords: 微波热疗, 自适应波束形成, 动态介电介质, LCMP算法, 辐射聚焦
AI.comments: 本研究的创新点在于针对微波热疗过程中介电特性随温度变化的动态难题，探索了在仅掌握局部或极少介电知识的情况下，利用LCMP自适应波束形成算法实现近场多目标聚焦与零陷控制。其重要性在于为未来实时、无创的微波热疗系统设计提供了理论与仿真基础。局限性在于目前主要基于数值仿真和理化/乳腺模型，尚未经过复杂的临床活体实验验证。

title: GigaSpeechBench: A Real-World Multilingual Speech-to-Text Benchmark
summary: While modern ASR systems achieve low error rates on high-resource benchmarks, such performance often overestimates real-world robustness. Existing evaluations address challenges in isolation, lacking a unified benchmark for domain terminology, age variation, dialects, accents, and low-resource languages, particularly across the Middle East and Southeast Asia, representing over one billion under-evaluated speakers. To address this gap, we introduce GigaSpeechBench, a comprehensive multilingual and multidimensional in-the-wild ASR & AST benchmark comprising 680 hours of human-annotated speech. It features five modules: (1) 12 low-resource Middle Eastern and Southeast Asian languages, plus challenging Japanese and Korean; (2) 6 Chinese dialects; (3) 6 English accents; (4) dense terminology across 12 vertical domains for Chinese and English; and (5) older adult and child speech. We further provide human-annotated Chinese and English translations for 11 languages to support AST evaluation. Extensive evaluations of leading foundation models and commercial APIs reveal significant performance degradation in these challenging settings, exposing critical evaluation blind spots.

AI.title_translation: GigaSpeechBench：一个真实世界多语言语音转文本基准
AI.tldr: 本文介绍了GigaSpeechBench，一个全面的多语言、多维度、真实世界的语音转文本（ASR）和语音翻译（AST）基准，旨在解决现有ASR评估对真实世界鲁棒性估计过高的问题，并通过对主流模型和商业API的广泛评估，揭示了它们在挑战性设置中的性能显著下降，暴露了关键的评估盲点。
AI.motivation: 现代ASR系统在资源丰富的基准上表现良好，但这种性能往往高估了真实世界的鲁棒性。现有评估孤立地解决挑战，缺乏一个统一的基准来涵盖领域术语、年龄差异、方言、口音以及低资源语言，特别是中东和东南亚地区，这些地区代表着超过十亿未被充分评估的说话者。
AI.method: 引入GigaSpeechBench，一个综合性的多语言、多维度、真实世界的ASR和AST基准，包含680小时的人工标注语音。该基准具有五个模块：12种低资源中东和东南亚语言（以及日语、韩语），6种中文方言，6种英语口音，12个垂直领域中中文和英语的密集术语，以及老年人和儿童语音。此外，还为11种语言提供了人工标注的中文和英文翻译，以支持AST评估。
AI.result: 对领先的基础模型和商业API进行的广泛评估揭示了在这些具有挑战性的设置中，模型性能显著下降。
AI.conclusion: 现有评估存在关键的盲点，未能充分反映ASR系统在真实世界复杂环境中的鲁棒性。GigaSpeechBench通过其全面的评估揭示了这一问题。
AI.translation: 现代ASR系统在资源丰富的基准上取得了较低的错误率，但这种性能往往高估了其真实世界的鲁棒性。现有评估孤立地解决挑战，缺乏一个统一的基准来涵盖领域术语、年龄差异、方言、口音以及低资源语言，特别是中东和东南亚地区，这些地区代表着超过十亿未被充分评估的说话者。为了弥补这一空白，我们引入了GigaSpeechBench，一个全面的多语言、多维度、真实世界的ASR和AST基准，包含680小时的人工标注语音。它具有五个模块：(1) 12种低资源中东和东南亚语言，以及具有挑战性的日语和韩语；(2) 6种中文方言；(3) 6种英语口音；(4) 12个垂直领域中中文和英语的密集术语；以及 (5) 老年人和儿童语音。我们还为11种语言提供了人工标注的中文和英文翻译，以支持AST评估。对领先的基础模型和商业API进行的广泛评估揭示了在这些挑战性设置中性能的显著下降，暴露了关键的评估盲点。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了GigaSpeechBench，一个旨在解决现有ASR系统在真实世界鲁棒性评估不足问题的多语言、多维度语音转文本基准。该基准包含680小时人工标注语音，覆盖了低资源语言、方言、口音、领域术语以及不同年龄段语音等多种挑战性场景。通过对主流模型和商业API的评估，GigaSpeechBench揭示了它们在复杂真实世界环境中的性能显著下降，暴露了当前评估方法的局限性。
AI.keywords: 语音识别, 语音翻译, 基准测试, 多语言, 真实世界, 低资源语言
AI.comments: GigaSpeechBench的创新之处在于其综合性和多维度性，在一个统一的基准中整合了多种真实世界的挑战，填补了现有评估在低资源语言、方言和特定领域鲁棒性方面的空白。它对于推动ASR和AST技术在实际应用中的发展具有重要意义。

title: Metamodel-based methodology for uncertainty propagation and global sensitivity analysis of tailings dam-breach flows
summary: Tailings dam-breach analyses are essential for flood-hazard assessment, emergency planning and risk estimation, but their results are strongly affected by uncertainties in breach development, released volume and tailings rheology. This study proposes an efficient probabilistic methodology that integrates uncertainty quantification and global sensitivity analysis for tailings dam-breach studies. High-dimensional outputs (spatial maps) and the computational cost of deterministic simulations are addressed through dimensionality reduction and metamodeling. The methodology is demonstrated on a benchmark case with complex terrain using HEC-RAS v6.6 and considering uncertainties in breach parameters and rheological properties. The results quantify uncertainty in maximum flow depth and arrival time, characterize their statistical distributions and identify the spatial influence of the main input variables through sensitivity maps. Sensitivity indices reveal the dominance of breach parameters near the dam and yield stress farther downstream. The modular and non-intrusive framework can be coupled with other deterministic models and applied to different dam-breach scenarios, supporting more standardized and risk-informed assessments.

AI.title_translation: 尾矿坝溃决流不确定性传播和全局敏感性分析的元模型方法
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种高效的概率方法，整合了不确定性量化和全局敏感性分析，用于尾矿坝溃决研究，通过降维和元模型解决了高维输出和计算成本问题，并在一个基准案例中进行了验证。
AI.motivation: 尾矿坝溃决分析对于洪水危害评估、应急规划和风险估计至关重要，但其结果受到溃决发展、释放量和尾矿流变学不确定性的强烈影响。
AI.method: 本研究提出了一种高效的概率方法，整合了不确定性量化和全局敏感性分析。通过降维和元模型解决了高维输出（空间图）和确定性模拟的计算成本问题。该方法使用HEC-RAS v6.6在一个复杂地形的基准案例中进行了演示，并考虑了溃决参数和流变特性的不确定性。
AI.result: 结果量化了最大流深和到达时间的不确定性，表征了它们的统计分布，并通过敏感性图识别了主要输入变量的空间影响。敏感性指数揭示了坝附近溃决参数的主导作用和下游更远处的屈服应力。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的模块化和非侵入式框架可以与其他确定性模型耦合，并应用于不同的溃坝情景，支持更标准化和风险知情的评估。
AI.translation: 尾矿坝溃决分析对于洪水危害评估、应急规划和风险估计至关重要，但其结果受到溃决发展、释放量和尾矿流变学不确定性的强烈影响。本研究提出了一种高效的概率方法，整合了不确定性量化和全局敏感性分析，用于尾矿坝溃决研究。通过降维和元模型解决了高维输出（空间图）和确定性模拟的计算成本问题。该方法在一个复杂地形的基准案例中进行了演示，使用了HEC-RAS v6.6，并考虑了溃决参数和流变特性的不确定性。结果量化了最大流深和到达时间的不确定性，表征了它们的统计分布，并通过敏感性图识别了主要输入变量的空间影响。敏感性指数揭示了坝附近溃决参数的主导作用和下游更远处的屈服应力。该模块化和非侵入式框架可以与其他确定性模型耦合，并应用于不同的溃坝情景，支持更标准化和风险知情的评估。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于元模型的高效概率方法，用于尾矿坝溃决流的不确定性传播和全局敏感性分析。该方法通过降维和元模型解决了高维输出和计算成本问题，并在HEC-RAS v6.6基准案例中验证了其有效性，成功量化了最大流深和到达时间的不确定性，并识别了关键输入变量的空间敏感性。该框架具有模块化和非侵入性，有助于实现更标准化和风险知情的评估。
AI.keywords: 尾矿坝溃决, 不确定性传播, 全局敏感性分析, 元模型, HEC-RAS
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将不确定性量化和全局敏感性分析与元模型相结合，有效解决了尾矿坝溃决模拟中高维输出和计算成本高的挑战。其模块化和非侵入式框架增强了方法的通用性和实用性，对尾矿坝风险评估具有重要意义。

title: SPYCE: A Doubly Robust Estimator for Trials Targeting Early Huntington Disease under Outcome-Dependent Censoring
summary: Clinical trials for neurodegenerative diseases must identify sensitive endpoints -- outcomes that change rapidly enough to detect treatment effects. In Huntington disease, this requires measuring how outcomes change as participants approach Stage 1. Yet many participants exit studies before reaching this stage, making their time to Stage 1 right-censored. Estimating how outcomes change requires models for both time to Stage 1 and time to study exit. When participants with worse outcomes exit earlier, this outcome-dependent censoring causes existing estimators to produce contradictory results: for the same cognitive outcome, one estimator suggests improvement while another shows decline. Existing estimators either ignore outcome-dependent censoring or require one model to be correctly specified, with no protection when it is not. We introduce SPYCE, a doubly robust estimator (consistent when either model is correctly specified) that achieves the smallest possible variance and allows both models to be estimated nonparametrically without sacrificing efficiency. Applied to data from PREDICT-HD, an observational Huntington disease study, SPYCE resolves current contradictions, identifies caudate and putamen volume ratios as the most promising sensitive endpoints, and shows that as few as 241 participants per arm are needed to detect treatment effects, versus hundreds of thousands under estimators that cannot handle outcome-dependent censoring.

AI.title_translation: SPYCE：一种针对亨廷顿病早期试验中结果依赖性删失的双重稳健估计器
AI.tldr: 针对神经退行性疾病（如亨廷顿病）的临床试验中，现有估计器在结果依赖性删失下会产生矛盾结果。SPYCE是一种新型双重稳健估计器，解决了这些问题，识别了敏感终点，并显著减少了样本量需求。
AI.motivation: 神经退行性疾病（如亨廷顿病）的临床试验需要识别敏感终点。许多参与者在达到疾病第一阶段之前退出研究，导致结果依赖性删失。当结果较差的参与者更早退出时，现有估计器会产生矛盾结果或在模型未正确指定时缺乏保护。
AI.method: 本文引入了SPYCE，这是一种双重稳健估计器。它在两个模型（到第一阶段的时间和到研究退出的时间）中任一正确指定时都是一致的，并实现了最小可能的方差。它允许非参数估计这两个模型而不会牺牲效率。
AI.result: 应用于PREDICT-HD的观察性亨廷顿病研究数据，SPYCE解决了当前的矛盾，将尾状核和壳核体积比确定为最有希望的敏感终点，并显示每组仅需241名参与者即可检测治疗效果，而其他无法处理结果依赖性删失的估计器则需要数十万名参与者。
AI.conclusion: SPYCE为处理神经退行性疾病临床试验中结果依赖性删失问题提供了一个鲁棒且高效的解决方案，能够更清晰地识别敏感终点，并大幅减少未来试验所需的样本量。
AI.translation: 神经退行性疾病的临床试验必须识别敏感终点——即足以快速变化以检测治疗效果的结果。在亨廷顿病中，这需要测量参与者接近第一阶段时结果如何变化。然而，许多参与者在达到此阶段之前退出研究，使得他们到第一阶段的时间为右删失。估计结果如何变化需要到第一阶段的时间和到研究退出的时间两个模型。当结果较差的参与者更早退出时，这种结果依赖性删失会导致现有估计器产生矛盾的结果：对于相同的认知结果，一个估计器表明改善，而另一个则显示下降。现有估计器要么忽略结果依赖性删失，要么要求一个模型被正确指定，在未正确指定时没有保护。我们引入了SPYCE，这是一种双重稳健估计器（当任一模型被正确指定时都是一致的），它实现了最小可能的方差，并允许非参数估计两个模型而不会牺牲效率。应用于PREDICT-HD（一项观察性亨廷顿病研究）的数据，SPYCE解决了当前的矛盾，将尾状核和壳核体积比确定为最有希望的敏感终点，并表明每组仅需241名参与者即可检测治疗效果，而其他无法处理结果依赖性删失的估计器则需要数十万名参与者。
AI.summary: SPYCE旨在解决神经退行性疾病临床试验中结果依赖性删失的挑战，特别是针对早期亨廷顿病。当前方法在参与者因结果不佳而提前退出研究时，会产生矛盾结果或缺乏对模型错误指定的鲁棒性。SPYCE是一种新型的双重稳健估计器，它在到第一阶段的时间和到研究退出的时间这两个模型中任一正确时都能保持一致性，并能实现最小方差，同时允许非参数模型估计而不牺牲效率。将SPYCE应用于PREDICT-HD数据，成功解决了现有矛盾，识别出尾状核和壳核体积比作为关键敏感终点，并显著降低了未来试验所需的样本量。
AI.keywords: SPYCE, 双重稳健估计器, 结果依赖性删失, 亨廷顿病, 临床试验
AI.comments: SPYCE的创新性在于其双重鲁棒性和在处理结果依赖性删失方面的效率，这在长期临床试验中是一个关键问题。它能够大幅减少所需的样本量，这对于亨廷顿病等疾病未来试验的可行性和成本效益至关重要。其在不牺牲效率的情况下进行非参数估计也是一个显著优点。

title: Adaptive Penalization and Bootstrap-Smoothed Inference for Two-Sample Mendelian Randomization with Summary Data
summary: Two-sample Mendelian randomization (MR) uses genetic variants as instrumental variables to estimate causal effects from observational data using summary association statistics. However, horizontal pleiotropy can invalidate standard MR estimators and lead to biased causal inference. Pleiotropy-robust methods have been proposed to address this issue, including regularization-based approaches such as MR-Lasso. However, MR-Lasso may fail to identify invalid instruments consistently, and its post-selection inference can be unreliable. In this paper, we develop two lasso-type procedures for two-sample MR with summary-level data. The first, MR-ALasso, extends MR-Lasso by introducing adaptive penalty weights for pleiotropic effects in order to improve the identification of valid and invalid instruments. The second, MR-ALasso-B, combines adaptive lasso selection with bootstrap smoothing to improve post-selection inference. We establish theoretical results for MR-ALasso under the two-sample summary data framework, including invalid instrument identification consistency and oracle-type post-selection behavior. Simulation studies show that MR-ALasso generally improves upon MR-Lasso in estimation accuracy and invalid-instrument identification, whereas MR-ALasso-B substantially improves coverage and type-I error control relative to naive post-selection inference. A real-data application based on bidirectional analyses of multiple complex traits further illustrates the practical usefulness of the proposed methods. We provide an R package, MRAlasso, to facilitate implementation.

AI.title_translation: 用于汇总数据的两样本孟德尔随机化的自适应惩罚和引导平滑推断
AI.tldr: 本文提出了两种新的Lasso型方法（MR-ALasso和MR-ALasso-B），以改进两样本孟德尔随机化中水平多效性的处理，提高无效工具变量的识别和推断的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 标准孟德尔随机化（MR）估计器容易受到水平多效性的影响，导致因果推断有偏差。现有的多效性鲁棒方法，如MR-Lasso，在识别无效工具变量方面可能不一致，并且其后选择推断可能不可靠。
AI.method: 本文开发了两种Lasso型程序：1. MR-ALasso，通过引入多效性效应的自适应惩罚权重来改进MR-Lasso，以更好地识别有效和无效工具变量。2. MR-ALasso-B，结合自适应Lasso选择和引导平滑，以改善后选择推断。
AI.result: MR-ALasso在估计精度和无效工具变量识别方面通常优于MR-Lasso。MR-ALasso-B在覆盖率和I类错误控制方面相对于朴素的后选择推断有显著改善。实际数据应用进一步证明了所提方法的实用性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的MR-ALasso和MR-ALasso-B方法能有效解决两样本MR中水平多效性问题，提高无效工具变量的识别和推断的可靠性，并已通过R包MRAlasso提供实现。
AI.translation: 两样本孟德尔随机化（MR）使用遗传变异作为工具变量，利用汇总关联统计数据从观察性数据中估计因果效应。然而，水平多效性可能使标准MR估计器失效，并导致有偏差的因果推断。已提出多效性鲁棒方法来解决这个问题，包括基于正则化的方法，如MR-Lasso。然而，MR-Lasso可能无法一致地识别无效工具变量，并且其后选择推断可能不可靠。在本文中，我们针对具有汇总级别数据的两样本MR开发了两种Lasso型程序。第一个是MR-ALasso，它通过引入多效性效应的自适应惩罚权重来扩展MR-Lasso，以改进有效和无效工具变量的识别。第二个是MR-ALasso-B，它结合了自适应Lasso选择和引导平滑，以改善后选择推断。我们建立了在两样本汇总数据框架下MR-ALasso的理论结果，包括无效工具变量识别的一致性和神谕型后选择行为。模拟研究表明，MR-ALasso在估计精度和无效工具变量识别方面通常优于MR-Lasso，而MR-ALasso-B相对于朴素的后选择推断显著改善了覆盖率和I类错误控制。基于多个复杂性状的双向分析的实际数据应用进一步说明了所提方法的实用性。我们提供了一个R包MRAlasso，以方便实现。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了两种新的Lasso型方法——MR-ALasso和MR-ALasso-B，用于处理汇总数据的两样本孟德尔随机化中的水平多效性问题。MR-ALasso通过自适应惩罚权重改进了无效工具变量的识别，而MR-ALasso-B结合自适应Lasso选择和引导平滑以提高后选择推断的可靠性。理论分析和模拟结果表明，这些新方法在估计精度、无效工具识别以及推断的覆盖率和I类错误控制方面均优于现有方法。论文还通过实际数据应用验证了其有效性，并提供了R包供使用。
AI.keywords: 孟德尔随机化, 水平多效性, 自适应Lasso, 引导平滑, 两样本MR
AI.comments: 本文针对两样本孟德尔随机化中水平多效性导致的问题，提出了创新的自适应Lasso方法。其亮点在于引入自适应惩罚权重以更准确地识别无效工具变量，并通过引导平滑显著提升了后选择推断的可靠性。理论结果、模拟研究和实际应用共同验证了这些方法的优越性，对因果推断领域具有重要意义。提供R包也大大方便了研究人员的实际应用。

title: Industrial Application of a Multi-Disciplinary Design Optimization with Uncertainties to a Pair of Telecommunication Satellites
summary: In satellite design, it is common practice to add safety margins to the constraints to achieve conservative solutions that are robust to uncertainties. This robustness often comes at the expense of performance and it may be more appropriate to include uncertainties in the definition of the design problem. This work addresses such a challenge by applying techniques of multidisciplinary design optimization under uncertainty to an industrial use case. The latter is a pair of telecommunication satellites launched together in a stacked configuration. Each satellite is a strongly coupled multidisciplinary system while the two satellites are not coupled at all. This use case can be extended to an arbitrary number of satellites. By considering uncertainty quantification techniques such as sensitivity analysis and reliability-based design optimization, this study demonstrates that accounting for uncertainties in the design problem results in a 66% reduction in performance loss compared to the adding of a predefined safety margins, while guaranteeing the feasibility of constraints with high probability.

AI.title_translation: 多学科设计优化在不确定性下对一对电信卫星的工业应用
AI.tldr: 本研究将考虑不确定性的多学科设计优化应用于一对电信卫星的工业案例，结果表明相比传统安全裕度方法，性能损失降低了66%，同时高概率保证了约束的可行性。
AI.motivation: 在卫星设计中，传统做法是增加安全裕度以获得对不确定性具有鲁棒性的保守解决方案，但这通常以牺牲性能为代价。本研究的动机是挑战这种做法，通过在设计问题中直接纳入不确定性来提高性能。
AI.method: 本研究将不确定性下的多学科设计优化技术应用于一对堆叠配置的电信卫星。采用了敏感性分析和基于可靠性的设计优化等不确定性量化技术。
AI.result: 与添加预定义安全裕度的方法相比，在设计问题中考虑不确定性使得性能损失降低了66%，同时高概率地保证了约束的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 在卫星设计中，通过将不确定性纳入多学科设计优化过程，可以显著提高性能（减少性能损失66%），同时保持高概率的约束可行性，这比传统的添加安全裕度的方法更优。
AI.translation: 在卫星设计中，通常的做法是在约束中添加安全裕度，以获得对不确定性具有鲁棒性的保守解决方案。这种鲁棒性往往以牺牲性能为代价，因此在设计问题的定义中纳入不确定性可能更为合适。这项工作通过将不确定性下的多学科设计优化技术应用于一个工业用例来应对这一挑战。该用例是一对以堆叠配置一起发射的电信卫星。每颗卫星都是一个强耦合的多学科系统，而两颗卫星之间完全不耦合。这个用例可以扩展到任意数量的卫星。通过考虑敏感性分析和基于可靠性的设计优化等不确定性量化技术，这项研究表明，在设计问题中考虑不确定性，与添加预定义安全裕度相比，性能损失降低了66%，同时高概率地保证了约束的可行性。
AI.summary: 本研究将不确定性下的多学科设计优化（MDO-U）应用于一对电信卫星的工业用例。与传统通过添加安全裕度来应对不确定性的方法相比，直接在设计问题中考虑不确定性（利用敏感性分析和基于可靠性的设计优化）能将性能损失降低66%，同时高概率地保证约束可行性。该方法为卫星设计提供了一种更高效、更鲁棒的解决方案。
AI.keywords: 多学科设计优化, 不确定性, 电信卫星, 敏感性分析, 可靠性设计优化
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种在卫星设计中处理不确定性的创新方法，通过直接将不确定性纳入多学科设计优化过程，而非传统地添加安全裕度。其主要创新在于将先进的不确定性量化技术（如敏感性分析和基于可靠性的设计优化）应用于复杂的工业航天器设计，并取得了显著的性能提升。这项工作的重要性在于为高风险工程项目提供了一种更精细、更高效的设计范式，有助于在保证可靠性的前提下优化性能。局限性可能在于其对特定工业案例的应用，以及不确定性建模的准确性对结果的影响。

title: Statistical Emulations of Human Operational Motions in Industrial Environments
summary: This paper tackles the challenging problem of developing emulators for human operational motions in industrial workplaces. We represent human motion as time-indexed sequences of body shapes and formulate a statistical generative model for these shape sequences. The sequences are modeled as continuous-time stochastic processes on a Riemannian shape manifold. Key challenges include the manifold's nonlinearity, variability in motion execution rates, the infinite-dimensional nature of the processes, and population-level variability across action classes. Deep learning methods are ineffective due to the small training samples typically available in this domain. To address these issues, we integrate a number of tools: temporal alignment via time warping, Riemannian geometry for handling nonlinearities, and shape- and functional-PCA for dimensionality reduction. A Gaussian model is then imposed on the reduced Euclidean spaces to emulate random motion sequences, which are then evaluated in representative industrial scenarios. We utilize a number of metrics to validate randomly generated shape sequences.

AI.title_translation: 工业环境中的人类操作运动的统计仿真
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种统计生成模型，用于模拟工业环境中人类的操作运动。由于训练样本少，深度学习方法效果不佳。研究人员结合了时间扭曲、黎曼几何和主成分分析等方法来处理模型的非线性、运动速率变化和高维度问题，并在简化后的欧氏空间上建立高斯模型来生成运动序列，并通过实验验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 开发工业环境中人类操作运动的仿真器，因为深度学习方法在数据量小的场景下效果不佳。
AI.method: 将人体运动表示为身体形状的时间序列，并构建一个统计生成模型。该模型将序列视为黎曼形状流形上的连续时间随机过程。通过时间扭曲进行时间对齐，利用黎曼几何处理非线性，并使用形状和功能主成分分析进行降维。最后，在高斯模型的基础上生成随机运动序列，并在工业场景中进行评估。
AI.result: 开发了一个统计生成模型，能够模拟工业环境中的人类操作运动，并在代表性工业场景中进行了评估和验证。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的统计仿真方法能够有效地模拟工业环境中的人类操作运动，克服了传统深度学习方法在小样本数据下的局限性，并通过在工业场景中的评估验证了其有效性。
AI.translation: 本文解决了在工业工作场所开发人类操作运动仿真器的挑战性问题。我们将人体运动表示为身体形状的时间索引序列，并为这些形状序列构建了一个统计生成模型。这些序列被建模为黎曼形状流形上的连续时间随机过程。关键挑战包括流形的高度非线性、运动执行速率的变化、过程的无限维度性质以及跨动作类别的总体水平变异性。由于该领域通常可用的训练样本很少，深度学习方法效果不佳。为了解决这些问题，我们整合了多种工具：通过时间扭曲进行时间对齐，利用黎曼几何处理非线性，以及通过形状和功能主成分分析进行降维。然后，在高斯模型的基础上对降维后的欧氏空间进行建模，以仿真随机运动序列，并在代表性的工业场景中进行评估。我们使用多种指标来验证随机生成的形状序列。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种新颖的统计生成模型，用于模拟工业环境中的人类操作运动。该模型将人体运动视为黎曼形状流形上的连续时间随机过程，并结合时间扭曲、黎曼几何和主成分分析等技术来处理数据中的非线性、变异性和高维度问题。研究表明，与深度学习方法相比，该模型在小样本数据情况下更有效，并在工业场景中得到了验证。
AI.keywords: 人类运动仿真, 统计生成模型, 黎曼几何, 主成分分析, 工业环境
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的方法来解决工业环境中人类运动仿真的挑战，特别是在训练数据有限的情况下。通过结合黎曼几何和统计建模，该方法有望在机器人学、人机交互和工作流程优化等领域具有广泛的应用前景。然而，模型的计算复杂性和泛化能力仍需进一步研究。

title: TraianProt: a user-friendly R shiny application for wide format proteomics data downstream analysis
summary: Mass spectrometry based proteomics enables large-scale identification, quantification, and characterization of proteins, post-translational modifications, and dynamic expression changes, providing critical insights into biological processes and disease mechanisms. However, downstream data analysis remains a significant challenge due to the heterogeneity of datasets, diverse computational platforms, and varying output formats, often requiring advanced expertise. To overcome these barriers, user-friendly, web-based solutions have emerged as essential tools, facilitating accessible, customizable, and reproducible analysis while accelerating discovery in proteomics research. We present TraianProt, a web-based, user-friendly proteomics data analysis platform that enables the analysis of both label-free and labeled data from Data-Dependent or Data-Independent Acquisition mass spectrometry mode, supporting MaxQuant, MSFragger, DIA-NN, ProteoScape, and Proteome Discoverer output formats. TraianProt provides a comprehensive suite of stepwise downstream analysis modules, which includes data filtering, normalization procedures, and missing value imputation strategies. The platform also incorporates robust statistical frameworks for differential expression testing, with peptide-spectrum match level correction, thereby enhancing the reliability of biological interpretations. Beyond quantitative comparisons, TraianProt integrates enrichment analyses to contextualize proteomic changes within functional pathways and interaction network analyses allowing users to extract biological insights from proteomic data without any programming skills.TraianProt serves as a comprehensive data analysis tool for proteomic studies, capable of analyzing outputs from main search algorithms without manual reformatting.

AI.title_translation: TraianProt：一个用于宽格式蛋白质组学数据下游分析的用户友好型R shiny应用程序
AI.tldr: TraianProt是一个无需编程的R Shiny网页平台，可无缝处理多种主流蛋白质组学软件的输出，并提供一站式的下游数据分析和生物学解释服务。
AI.motivation: 基于质谱的蛋白质组学能够进行大规模的蛋白质鉴定与定量，但由于数据集的异质性、计算平台的多样性以及输出格式的差异，下游数据分析仍面临巨大挑战，通常需要高级编程和专业知识，因此需要一个用户友好的网页端解决方案来克服这些障碍。
AI.method: 开发了一个基于R Shiny的Web平台（TraianProt），支持无标记和标记定量数据，兼容MaxQuant、MSFragger、DIA-NN、ProteoScape和Proteome Discoverer等多种主流软件输出格式，并集成了数据过滤、标准化、缺失值填补、差异表达分析、富集分析和相互作用网络分析等模块。
AI.result: 成功开发并介绍了TraianProt平台，它能够无缝处理多种主流搜索算法的输出无需手动重新格式化，为用户提供包括数据预处理、统计建模、功能富集和网络分析在内的完整下游分析流程。
AI.conclusion: TraianProt是一个功能全面、用户友好的蛋白质组学下游分析平台，能够有效促进蛋白质组学研究中的数据挖掘和生物学解释。
AI.translation: 基于质谱的蛋白质组学能够对蛋白质、翻译后修饰以及动态表达变化进行大规模的鉴定、定量和表征，从而为生物学过程和疾病机制提供关键见解。然而，由于数据集的异质性、不同的计算平台以及变化的输出格式，下游数据分析仍然是一个重大挑战，通常需要高级的专业知识。为了克服这些障碍，用户友好、基于网络的解决方案已成为必不可少的工具，它们有助于进行可访问、可定制和可重复的分析，同时加速蛋白质组学研究中的发现。我们介绍了TraianProt，一个基于网络的、用户友好的蛋白质组学数据分析平台，它能够分析来自数据依赖型或数据独立采集质谱模式的无标记和标记数据，支持MaxQuant、MSFragger、DIA-NN、ProteoScape和Proteome Discoverer的输出格式。TraianProt提供了一套全面的逐步下游分析模块，包括数据过滤、标准化程序和缺失值填补策略。该平台还结合了用于差异表达测试的强大统计框架，并带有肽段-谱图匹配级别的校正，从而增强了生物学解释的可靠性。除了定量比较，TraianProt还整合了富集分析（将蛋白质组变化置于功能通路中）和相互作用网络分析，允许用户在没有任何编程技能的情况下从蛋白质组数据中提取生物学见解。TraianProt作为蛋白质组学研究的综合数据分析工具，能够分析主要搜索算法的输出而无需手动重新格式化。
AI.summary: TraianProt是一个基于R Shiny开发的网页端蛋白质组学数据分析平台，旨在为没有编程经验的研究人员提供一个兼容多种主流质谱分析软件输出格式、支持全流程下游分析（从预处理到富集与网络分析）的用户友好型解决方案。
AI.keywords: 蛋白质组学, R Shiny, 下游分析, 质谱, 生物信息学工具
AI.comments: TraianProt提供了一个用户友好的R Shiny应用程序，通过支持多种主流质谱搜索算法的输出格式和提供一站式的下游分析功能，极大地降低了蛋白质组学数据分析的门槛。其亮点在于无需编程即可实现全流程分析、多平台兼容性以及内置的肽段-谱图匹配级别校正。

title: Ballot Design and Electoral Outcomes: The Role of Candidate Order and Party Affiliation
summary: We develop a causal inference model to study how designing ballots with and without party designations impacts electoral outcomes when partisan voters rely on party-order cues to infer candidate affiliation in races without designations. If the party orders of candidates in races with and without party designations differ, these voters might cast their votes incorrectly. We identify a quasi-randomized natural experiment with contest-level treatment assignment pertaining to North Carolina judicial elections and leverage double machine learning to accurately capture the magnitude of such incorrectly cast votes. Using precinct-level election and demographic data, we estimate that 12.0% (SE: 3.6%) of Democratic partisan voters and 15.4% (SE: 4.0%) of Republican partisan voters cast their votes incorrectly due to the difference in party orders. A placebo test using judicial races with party designations shows that the flip effect disappears when party affiliation is observable on the ballot, which is consistent with the proposed causal mechanism.

AI.title_translation: 选票设计与选举结果：候选人顺序和党派归属的作用
AI.tldr: 当选票上缺乏党派标志且候选人顺序发生变化时，超过10%的党派选民会因为依赖顺序线索而投错票。
AI.motivation: 研究当选票设计在没有党派标志的选举中，党派选民如何依赖党派顺序线索来推断候选人归属，以及当有无党派标志的选举中候选人党派顺序不同时，是否会导致选民错误投票。
AI.method: 开发了一个因果推断模型，利用北卡罗来纳州司法选举中的准随机自然实验和双机器学习（Double Machine Learning）方法，并结合选区级选举和人口统计数据来估计错误投票的规模。
AI.result: 估计有 12.0% 的民主党派选民和 15.4% 的共和党派选民由于党派顺序的差异而投错票；安慰剂检验表明，当选票上有党派归属时，这种翻转效应会消失。
AI.conclusion: 选票设计（如党派标签的缺失及候选人顺序的变化）会导致相当比例的党派选民因依赖候选人顺序线索而投错选票。当候选人党派可见时，这种翻转效应消失，验证了所提出的因果机制。
AI.translation: 我们开发了一个因果推断模型，以研究在没有党派标志的选举中，当党派选民依赖党派顺序线索来推断候选人归属时，带有和不带有党派标志的选票设计如何影响选举结果。如果带有和不带有党派标志的比赛中候选人的党派顺序不同，这些选民可能会错误地投票。我们确定了北卡罗来纳州司法选举中具有比赛级处理分配的准随机自然实验，并利用双机器学习准确捕捉此类错误投票的幅度。使用选区级别的选举和人口统计数据，我们估计 12.0%（标准误：3.6%）的民主党派选民和 15.4%（标准误：4.0%）的共和党派选民由于党派顺序的差异而错误地投票。使用带有党派标志的司法比赛进行的安慰剂检验表明，当选票上可以观察到党派归属时，翻转效应消失了，这与提出的因果机制一致。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了选票设计（特别是候选人顺序与党派标志）对选举结果的影响。通过构建因果推断模型并应用双机器学习方法分析北卡罗来纳州的选举数据，作者发现当缺乏党派标志且候选人顺序不同时，相当大比例的党派选民会因依赖顺序线索而投错票。
AI.keywords: 选票设计, 候选人顺序, 党派归属, 双机器学习, 准自然实验
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地结合了准自然实验与双机器学习（DML）方法，量化了选票设计中党派标签缺失和候选人顺序差异对选民投票行为（特别是错误投票）的影响，对选举工程和民主制度设计具有重要意义。

title: A Systematic Review of Spatio-Temporal Statistical Models: Theory, Structure, and Applications
summary: Data with spatio-temporal attributes are prevalent across many research fields, and statistical models for analyzing spatio-temporal relationships are widely used. Existing reviews focus either on specific domains or model types, creating a gap in comprehensive, cross-disciplinary overviews. To address this, we conducted a systematic literature review following the PRISMA guidelines, searched two databases for the years 2021-2025, and identified 83 publications that met our criteria. We propose a classification scheme for spatio-temporal model structures and highlight their application in the most common fields: epidemiology, ecology, public health, economics, and criminology. Although tasks vary by domain, many models share similarities. We found that hierarchical models are the most frequently used, and most models incorporate additive components to account for spatio-temporal dependencies. The preferred model structures differ among fields of application. We also observe that research efforts are concentrated in only a few specific disciplines, despite the broader relevance of spatio-temporal data. Furthermore, we notice that reproducibility remains limited. Our review, therefore, not only offers inspiration for comparing model structures in an interdisciplinary manner but also highlights opportunities for greater transparency, accessibility, and cross-domain knowledge transfer.

title: Model quality in football: Quantifying the quality of an Expected Threat model
summary: The recent growth in data availability in football has increased the risk of incorrect use of data-driven models, making guidelines on their validation and application necessary. The Expected Threat (xT) model is an accessible option for football organisations that start building in-house methods, yet little is known about how to assess its quality. The aim of this study is twofold: to examine how the model quality depends on the number of game states and the number of training points, and to translate these results into guidelines for constructing and applying the model. Using the Markov chain underlying the model, we perform theoretical analyses and simulations to study the estimation error. These show that the estimation error is approximately lognormal for a given number of training points and game states. Additionally, we combine the simulations with expert consultation to establish the estimation error beyond which player evaluations based on the Expected Threat model become unreliable for scouting applications. From this, we derive rules of thumb to ensure the quality of an Expected Threat model before application, and we illustrate through an example how a validated model can be applied in practice. Because the approach generalises to Expected Possession Value models, this paper illustrates a framework to systematically quantify model quality, despite the ground truth being unobservable in football analytics.

title: Improving Minority Population Sampling with BISG Probabilities: Evidence from a Survey of Jewish Americans
summary: Sampling geographically dispersed minority populations poses substantial challenges when individual group membership cannot be directly observed. Although stratified sampling can offer efficiency gains, these gains are typically modest unless the minority population is highly concentrated within a small number of strata. In this paper, we propose using Bayesian Improved Surname Geocoding (BISG) to enhance the efficiency of minority population sampling. BISG generates individual-level probabilities of minority group membership based on names and residential addresses. We incorporate these probabilities into a stratified Poisson probability sampling design. Applying the proposed approach to a national survey of Jewish Americans, we find that our estimates closely align with those from a large-scale Pew Research Center survey of the same population, which relied on a substantially more expensive sampling strategy involving geographic stratification and screening. At a fraction of the cost, our survey reproduces nearly identical patterns observed by Pew, including estimates of religious denominations and participation in specific religious activities.

title: Improving ecological inference and uncertainty quantification from camera trap data through the fusion of AI confidences and manual annotations
summary: Camera traps have become an important tool in ecological research, enabling large-scale, noninvasive monitoring of wildlife populations and behavior. By automatically recording animals as they pass within view, these devices generate massive image datasets with minimal field effort. This data richness introduces a new bottleneck when translating the images into usable information due to time and effort required for human annotation. Artificial intelligence (AI) has recently been integrated into the workflow to improve efficiency. However, the data procured from AI approaches are of a different nature, necessitating new statistical methods. We develop a new Bayesian hierarchical data-fusion model that combines the strengths of human annotations and AI predictions. The benefits of our approach are an ability to provide uncertainty quantification as well as improved inference and predictive power, which we demonstrate through simulation. We apply our model to an AI analysis of the body condition of white-tailed deer (Odocoileus virginianus) from camera trap images from North Carolina to study the relationship between health and their environment. Our analysis derived novel ecological inference compared to a more traditional approach using the same data. We find that bucks in rut have higher (healthier) body condition than other deer and that green, open habitats are correlated with high body condition.

title: Exact phylodynamic likelihood via structured Markov genealogy processes
summary: We show that each member of a broad class of Markovian population models induces a unique stochastic process on the space of genealogies. We construct this genealogy process and derive exact expressions for the likelihood of an observed genealogy in terms of a filter equation, the structure of which is completely determined by the population model. We show that existing phylodynamic methods based on the coalescent and linear birth-death processes are special cases. We derive some properties of filter equations and describe a class of algorithms that can be used to numerically solve them. Importantly, because these algorithms rely only on simulation of the population model, they retain the plug-and-play property upon which simulation-based inference depends. Our results open the door to statistically efficient likelihood-based phylodynamic inference for a much wider class of models than has been possible.

title: Fast data inversion for high-dimensional Ornstein-Uhlenbeck processes from noisy measurements
summary: In this work, we develop a scalable approach for a flexible latent factor model for high-dimensional dynamical systems. Each latent factor process has its own correlation and variance parameters, and the orthogonal factor loading matrix can be either fixed or estimated. We utilize an orthogonal factor loading matrix that avoids computing the inversion of the posterior covariance matrix at each time of the Kalman filter, and derive closed-form expressions in an expectation-maximization algorithm for parameter estimation, which substantially reduces the computational complexity without approximation. Our approach has several applications, including noise filtering for high-dimensional time series, estimating nonseparable covariance structure between different time series, and estimating latent physical processes from real-world measurements. Extensive simulated studies illustrate higher accuracy and scalability of our approach compared to alternatives. Furthermore, by applying our method to geodetic measurements to estimate slow slip events from geodetic data in the Cascadia region, our estimated slip better agrees with independently measured seismic data of tremor events. The substantial acceleration from our method enables the use of massive noisy data for geological hazard quantification and other applications.

title: Pathwise Portfolio Theory and Market Viability
summary: The theory of portfolios, and its allied notions and fundamental results concerning growth optimality, the numéraire property, and ``market viability'' -- which rules out the possibility of financing nontrivial future liability streams starting with arbitrarily small initial capital -- is developed in a pathwise setting, completely devoid of probabilistic considerations. The approach replaces the familiar semimartingale decomposition of stochastic analysis for assets' returns, by decompositions generated through suitable trend extractors and their associated residual paths; then deploys Föllmer's celebrated pathwise version of classical Itô integration and calculus. The resulting growth-numéraire and viability-boundedness equivalences bear considerable similarities to their semimartingale counterparts, but need not collapse into a single equivalence class in the pathwise setting; this separation is illustrated by two examples.

title: Mixing-Law Uncertainty in Multivariate Normal Mean-Variance Mixtures: Semi-parametric Estimation and Robust Cumulative-Prospect Decisions
summary: The distribution of a normal mean-variance mixture depends on the law of its positive mixing variable. We compare six parametric mixing laws with a grid nonparametric maximum likelihood estimator under the same determinant identification constraint. The mixing mean $m=\E(Z)$ is estimated and is not fixed at one. A paired block bootstrap is used to compare multivariate holdout log scores. The models that cannot be distinguished from the model with the largest score define a finite ambiguity set. We then consider a cumulative prospect problem on a common portfolio direction. For each model in the set, the NMVM representation gives a scalar projected return and a corresponding prospect-value function of the exposure. The distributionally robust decision maximizes the lower envelope of these functions. We prove existence of a solution, give the candidate points for the piecewise smooth problem, derive a reference-gap scaling result, and construct an interval branch-and-bound certificate for the finite-scenario optimum. In an application to 30 stock returns, the mixture models give higher holdout density scores than the multivariate Gaussian model. Several parametric and semi-parametric models, however, remain in the ambiguity set. The worst-case model is therefore determined at the portfolio optimization stage rather than selected in advance from a point estimate of the holdout score.

title: Denoising Subordinated Probabilistic Models: Diffusion with a Tempered-Stable Volatility Clock, and What the Noise Mechanism Actually Controls
comments: 14 pages, 5 figures; working draft, code available from the author
summary: Heavy-tailed diffusion models replace Gaussian noise by a Gaussian variance mixture: denoising Levy probabilistic models (DLPM) take the mixing variables i.i.d. across coordinates, while Student-t EDM shares one mixing variable per sample. Neither has dynamics, yet temporal dependence of the noise amplitude - volatility clustering - is the defining stylized fact of financial returns. We introduce the Denoising Subordinated Probabilistic Model (DSPM), whose mixing vector is a stationary AR(1) chain driven by tempered-stable subordinator increments (the discrete Barndorff-Nielsen-Shephard volatility process) along the data axis. Conditionally on the chain the DDPM machinery survives verbatim; kurtosis and squared-noise autocorrelation are closed-form in the chain parameters, giving an exactly identified, analytically invertible calibration; DDPM, DLPM and Student-t noise are boundary cases of one memory parameter. We then prove a delimiting result: when the denoiser is conditioned on the mixing variables, their law is a nuisance - in the exact-denoiser limit the generated distribution is invariant to it and interventions on the chain do nothing. Experiments confirm both halves: conditioned models match the data's clustering whatever the mixing law, a designed x8 volatility shock moves the envelope by under 13%, while blind models transmit the mechanism exactly as calibrated. Finally, coupling the chain to the data by a variational volatility encoder - trained with the stochastic-volatility likelihood whose log-determinant the simplified denoising loss provably drops - restores control (shock response 3.07 vs. naive 2.83), recovers latent volatility (correlation 0.76), and learns the prior memory toward the true persistence.
comment: 14 pages, 5 figures; working draft, code available from the author

title: Generalized Orlicz premia
summary: We introduce a generalized class of Orlicz premia based on possibly nonconvex loss functions, extending the classical framework of Haezendonck and Goovaerts (1982). Without the usual convexity requirement on the loss function $Φ$, the Orlicz framework naturally encompasses quantiles, expectiles and $L^p$-quantiles while preserving the fundamental properties of Orlicz premia. We show that within this framework cash-additivity axiomatizes $L^p$-quantiles, generalizing the classical `collapse-to-the-mean' result for cash-additive convex Orlicz premia into a `collapse-to-$L^p$-quantiles' result, with expectiles as a special case. We focus on two natural classes of nonconvex loss functions: concave-convex Orlicz functions, which mimic the idea of S-shaped value functions in prospect theory, and GA-convex Orlicz functions, which can be described in terms of comparative convexity with respect to a logarithmic reference, and for which the corresponding Orlicz premium is geometrically convex. Finally, we show that a suitable subclass of generalized Orlicz premia coincides with the class of law-invariant, monotone, positive, positively homogeneous, normalized functionals that are weakly lower semicontinuous, continuous from above, and whose level sets are convex with respect to mixtures (the so-called CxLS property).

AI.tldr: 本文放松了损失函数的凸性要求，提出了广义Orlicz保费，统一了分位数、期望位数和$L^p$-分位数，并给出了相应的公理化刻画。
AI.motivation: 传统的Haezendonck与Goovaerts（1982）Orlicz保费框架依赖于损失函数的凸性假设，这限制了其包含分位数等非凸保费度量的能力。通过引入可能非凸的损失函数，可以建立更广泛的保费体系，并结合行为经济学（如前景理论中的S型价值函数）来进行风险度量。
AI.method: 放弃损失函数的凸性限制，构建广义Orlicz保费框架；研究现金加性下泛函的结构；分析凹凸Orlicz函数（前景理论S型函数）和GA凸Orlicz函数；使用分布不变性、单调性、正齐次性、CxLS性质等公理对子集进行特征化。
AI.result: 证明了在该框架下现金加性将保费公理化为$L^p$-分位数（推广了传统的“塌缩至均值”结论）；阐明了GA凸损失函数对应的保费具有几何凸性；并证明了符合一系列基本公理（如CxLS性质、弱下半连续性等）的泛函等价于广义Orlicz保费的特定子集。
AI.conclusion: 广义Orlicz保费框架拓宽了经典理论的适用范围，成功将多种重要风险度量统一下来，并在非凸损失函数下提供了深刻的公理化特征与经济学/精算学解释。
AI.translation: 我们基于可能非凸的损失函数引入了一类广义的Orlicz保费，扩展了Haezendonck和Goovaerts（1982）的经典框架。在没有损失函数 $\Phi$ 的通常凸性要求的情况下，Orlicz框架自然地涵盖了分位数（quantiles）、期望位数（expectiles）和 $L^p$ 分位数（$L^p$-quantiles），同时保留了Orlicz保费的基本性质。我们表明，在该框架内，现金加性（cash-additivity）公理化了 $L^p$ 分位数，将经典的现金加性凸Orlicz保费“塌缩至均值”（collapse-to-the-mean）的结果推广为“塌缩至 $L^p$ 分位数”（collapse-to-$L^p$-quantiles）的结果，并以期望位数作为特例。我们专注于两类自然的非凸损失函数：凹凸Orlicz函数（模仿前景理论中S型价值函数的概念）和GA凸Orlicz函数（可以通过相对于对数参考的比较凸性来描述，其对应的Orlicz保费是几何凸的）。最后，我们证明了广义Orlicz保费的一个适当子集与一类分布不变、单调、正定、正齐次、规范化的泛函一致，这些泛函是弱下半连续的、自上连续的，且其水平集关于混合是凸的（即所谓的CxLS性质）。
AI.summary: 本文拓展了传统的Orlicz保费理论，通过引入可能非凸的损失函数，成功将分位数、期望位数及$L^p$-分位数统一至广义Orlicz保费框架中。论文证明了现金加性能够表征$L^p$-分位数，推广了经典的塌缩定理，并重点讨论了凹凸Orlicz函数和GA凸Orlicz函数，最后给出了广义Orlicz保费子集的公理化特征。
AI.keywords: Orlicz保费, 非凸损失函数, L^p分位数, 期望位数, 现金加性
AI.comments: 该论文在保险精算与风险度量理论方面作出了重要创新。通过放弃传统Orlicz保费中对损失函数的凸性约束，不仅成功将分位数、期望位数和$L^p$-分位数等重要度量纳入统一的框架，还与前景理论中的S型价值函数建立了深刻联系。公理化分析极大地丰富了该领域的数学工具和理论基础。

title: When large trades are not (automatically) news: Liquidity tail risk and price discovery
summary: When is a large trade news, and when is it a liquidity shock? We study this question in a sequential competitive limit order book with asymmetric information. In our model, liquidity suppliers observe aggregate order flow but not its decomposition into informed demand and uninformed liquidity demand. We model uninformed order flow with Student-$t$ tails, interpreted as a reduced form for rare liquidity regimes. The tail index of liquidity demand determines how informative large trades are. With thin-tailed noise, large order imbalances are quickly interpreted as private information. With heavy-tailed liquidity demand, the same imbalances remain plausibly liquidity-driven. This liquidity-tail ambiguity flattens and concavifies price impact, slows learning from order flow, and delays the decline of adverse-selection premia. We characterize equilibrium through a fixed-point equation for the marginal-cost schedule. Heavy-tailed liquidity demand changes the mathematics of equilibrium: the Gaussian monotonicity and compactness arguments fail because remote liquidity states remain pricing-relevant at polynomial order. We construct fixed points on a tail-controlled compact class and study learning and large-order asymptotics along selected monotone branches. Repeated order flow reveals the fundamental value under stable information-rate conditions, but heavier liquidity tails slow finite-horizon price discovery. Large-order impact obeys regular-variation asymptotics whose exponents depend on the liquidity-tail index, informed competition, and posterior beliefs. The model identifies liquidity tail risk as a state variable for market impact, spread resilience, and the informativeness of large trades.

AI.title_translation: 当大宗交易并非（自动成为）新闻时：流动性尾部风险与价格发现
AI.tldr: 研究在非对称信息限价订单簿中，大宗交易何时是信息，何时是流动性冲击。模型发现，重尾流动性需求会减缓价格发现，改变价格影响，并延迟逆向选择溢价的下降，流动性尾部风险是市场影响的关键状态变量。
AI.motivation: 探讨大宗交易何时被视为市场信息，何时被视为流动性冲击，并研究在非对称信息环境下，流动性需求尾部特征对价格发现过程的影响。
AI.method: 采用具有非对称信息的序列竞争性限价订单簿模型。通过Student-$t$尾部对非信息性订单流进行建模，并利用固定点方程来刻画均衡。通过构造尾部受控紧类上的固定点，研究了学习过程和大订单渐近行为。
AI.result:
1. 流动性尾部模糊性会使价格影响变平并凹化，减缓从订单流中学习的速度，并延迟逆向选择溢价的下降。
2. 重尾流动性需求改变了均衡的数学结构，导致高斯单调性和紧致性论证失效。
3. 重复订单流在稳定信息率条件下揭示基本价值，但较重的流动性尾部会减缓有限期内的价格发现。
4. 大订单影响遵循正则变异渐近性，其指数取决于流动性尾部指数、知情竞争和后验信念。
